title_en: A kind of underwater search and rescue region prediction technique based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The underwater search and rescue region prediction technique based on wireless sensor network that the invention discloses a kind of, comprising: wireless network threedimensional model is established to underwater multiple nodes, sends distress signal using wireless network, and by multiple node equivalents in model at random particles；Random particles are calculated based on particle swarm algorithm to issue in the initial position probability of several scenes；It combines marine environment to influence the drift probability data of calculating random particles according to the distribution of the initial position probability of random particles, and predicts to obtain search and rescue region according to particle drift probability data.The method that the present invention solves the determination maritime SAR region that the prior art provides determines search and rescue region based on classical search planing method, so that the search and rescue region determined there are error, increases the problem of searching and rescuing risk.

title_en: Table lookup correction method for average loss of catastrophe event model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a table look-up correction method for average loss of a disaster event model, which comprises a parameter reading step, a table building step, a calculation step and a correction step; and a computer program product, the computer program/instructions implementing the solution of the invention when executed by a processor; there is also a computing system having at least one processor and a memory storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, implement aspects of the present invention. The invention specifically provides a technical scheme for generating the transcendental probability distribution table according to the ELT of the catastrophe event model, and the average loss of the event is adjusted or corrected by the transcendental probability distribution table, so that the loss of the event can consider secondary uncertainty.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning system and method for slope disasters based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource information fusion intelligent monitoring and early warning system and method for side slope disasters, wherein the system comprises the following steps: perception layer: the method is used for acquiring slope related information; data layer: the slope monitoring data information base plate is used for constructing the slope monitoring data information base plate through the slope related information; service layer: the slope disaster monitoring function application platform is used for building a slope disaster monitoring function application platform based on the slope monitoring data information base plate; view layer: the method is used for performing visual operation and sending early warning information, and provides support for research, judgment and analysis of the plans and management and release of the plans in a digital scene. The invention overcomes the defects of uncertainty and ambiguity of monitoring data and imperfect slope monitoring system existing in single monitoring means, conforms to the development trend of digitization, automation and integration of slope monitoring, and has important significance for improving the monitoring and early warning capability and the defending capability of slope disasters and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Dynamic cable temperature prediction and fire disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting the temperature of a dynamic cable and early warning fire, which relate to the technical field of cable monitoring and comprise the steps of collecting data, constructing a BP-LSTM algorithm model and dynamically predicting the temperature change trend of the cable; and defining a temperature prediction result and a temperature rising trend as fuzzy input variables, defining a fire early-warning level as a fuzzy output variable, and carrying out cable fire early warning. The invention not only can effectively capture the long-term dependence and the periodic mode of the temperature change of the cable, but also can treat the problems of uncertainty and ambiguity in the early warning of the cable fire, reduce false alarms and provide powerful safety guarantee for the stable operation of the cable. The cable temperature change trend can be predicted by realizing remote real-time monitoring, so that early warning of cable fire is realized in an extremely early stage, and safe and stable operation of a power system is ensured.

title_en: Distributed laboratory system time keeping method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a distributed laboratory system time keeping method, a distributed laboratory system time keeping device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining calibration data of a coordinated universal time tracing module and clock difference data of at least two clock guards and corresponding stability of the clock differences in a distributed laboratory system, determining local atomic time according to the clock difference data and the corresponding stability of the clock differences, judging whether the coordinated universal time tracing module operates normally or not, calibrating the local atomic time according to the calibration data if yes, obtaining standard time, otherwise, obtaining reference data of a reference clock and prediction data of a virtual coordinated universal time prediction module and corresponding uncertainty of the virtual coordinated universal time prediction module, and calibrating the local atomic time according to the reference data and the prediction data and corresponding uncertainty of the virtual coordinated universal time prediction module, and obtaining the standard time. The embodiment of the application improves the disaster recovery performance and safety of the distributed laboratory system generated in standard time.

title_en: Pre-deployment robust optimization method and system for electric bus before disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-deployment robust optimization method and system before electric bus disaster, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid, bus, load and disaster prediction data, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to generate a fault scene set, establishing a robust optimization model aiming at minimizing system load shedding, considering electric bus operation, dispatching, scheduling constraint and power distribution network system constraint, describing line fault uncertainty by constructing a reinforced confidence set, and adopting a C & CG decomposition algorithm solution model to obtain an optimal pre-deployment scheme. The invention effectively solves the problems of inflexible deployment and high cost of the traditional fixed energy storage in post-disaster recovery, and remarkably improves the post-disaster recovery speed and the elasticity level of the power distribution network and reduces the economic loss of power failure while ensuring normal public transportation service by utilizing the mobile energy storage characteristic of the electric public transportation.

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network anti-seismic toughness comprehensive calculation method considering water quality and water quantity indexes
abstract_en: A comprehensive calculation method for the earthquake-resistant toughness of an urban water supply pipe network taking water quality and water quantity indexes into consideration belongs to the field of water supply pipe network earthquake-resistant performance evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: probability P of pipeline shock hazard  f  Is calculated; pipeline lineConfirming the post-earthquake state; determining the area of a leakage hole of a leakage pipeline; establishing a pipe network hydraulic model of the earthquake damage scene; simulating a pipe network post-earthquake recovery process, and adopting a pipeline dynamic importance ranking method to collect the pipeline water source distance to determine the post-earthquake recovery sequence; establishing a hydraulic power and water quality model of a pipe network in the post-earthquake recovery process; calculating the anti-seismic toughness; and (5) calculating the mean value of the anti-seismic toughness. According to the method, the water quality index is incorporated into the evaluation index of the anti-service performance of the urban water supply network, and the anti-seismic toughness of the urban water supply network is comprehensively calculated; the method for integrating the pipeline water source distances by adopting the pipeline dynamic importance sorting method is adopted to determine the post-earthquake repair order, so that the determined pipeline repair order is more reasonable; the water supply toughness evaluation index disclosed by the invention can comprehensively reflect the post-earthquake anti-seismic toughness, the hydraulic power and water quality change characteristics and the relative difference of a pipe network, considers the uncertainty of pipeline damage under an earthquake scene and the uncertainty of leakage type of a leakage pipeline, and generates a sufficient number of random earthquake damage scenes through Monte Carlo simulation. Has guiding significance for post-earthquake disaster relief and repair work.

title_en: Power transmission network toughness improvement and fault recovery method based on adaptive robust optimization
abstract_en: The application provides a transmission grid toughness improvement and fault recovery method based on self-adaptive robust optimization, which comprises the steps of obtaining differential toughness evaluation indexes; and constructing a self-adaptive robust optimization model guided by wind power uncertainty based on the differential toughness evaluation index, and carrying out iterative solution on the self-adaptive robust optimization model to determine a safe and economic scheduling scheme of the power system. According to the method provided by the application, a defending-scheduling collaborative optimization model oriented to budget constraint is established, the system operation cost, the reinforcement cost and the load loss cost are taken as objective functions, a line reinforcement scheme and a post-disaster operation strategy are completed through a C & CG algorithm, and balanced optimization of the toughness and the cost of the power grid is realized.
assignees: LAIWU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Small hydropower station outage risk assessment method under typhoon disaster based on opportunity constraint model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small hydropower station outage risk assessment method under typhoon disasters based on an opportunity constraint model, which comprises the steps of carrying out Latin hypercube sampling according to a probability distribution function of predicted output of a small hydropower station, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation, substituting a sample value into an electric power system containing the small hydropower station to carry out probability flow calculation, analyzing the small hydropower station outage as an independent event, establishing an opportunity constraint optimal cut-load model when calculating the result of the small hydropower station outage risk and the uncertainty output of the rest small hydropower station of the system, converting the opportunity constraint optimal cut-load model into a deterministic equivalent model and solving the deterministic equivalent model by CPLEX, and multiplying the small hydropower station outage probability by the minimum cut-load cost of the electric power system containing the small hydropower station to obtain a small hydropower station outage risk value. The method effectively solves the contradiction that the safety and the economical efficiency of the power grid cannot be coordinated due to the shutdown of the small hydropower station, and can be used for evaluating the risk caused by the shutdown of the small hydropower station under typhoon disasters.

title_en: Watershed and arid disaster prediction method based on Bayesian theorem and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prediction, and particularly discloses a watershed and arid disaster prediction method based on Bayesian theorem and machine learning, which comprises the following steps: data collection, construction of a disaster prediction model, adjustment of the disaster prediction model and real-time paddy and dry disaster prediction. The invention uses the loss function to generate Bayesian prediction, and constructs posterior prediction by approximating the variation of the generalized posterior, so that uncertainty in data can be fully considered, and the optimal disaster prediction can be helped to be made so as to minimize loss; according to the invention, three Bayesian optimization hyper-parameter methods of upper confidence, improved probability and expected improvement are combined to optimize the Gaussian process in the disaster prediction model, and the respective advantages of the three methods are combined through complementation of the different methods, so that the hyper-parameters can be optimized more comprehensively, and different conditions and data characteristics can be adapted.
assignees: GEOVIS YISHUI SICHUAN TECH CO LTD;INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION INST OF WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCE

title_en: Geological disaster hidden trouble point distribution prediction method based on neural network integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster hidden danger point distribution prediction method based on neural network integration, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining geological environment data and preprocessing, S2, constructing and training a heterogeneous model integrated by a graph convolutional neural network and a multi-layer perceptron, S3, combining residual connection and a attention mechanism to enhance the characteristic recognition capability of the model, optimizing model parameters through a cross entropy loss function, S4, evaluating the heterogeneous model through cross verification, calculating precision, mean square error and confidence level, dynamically distributing integration weight, S5, weighting and fusing the model output according to the integration weight, introducing Bayesian uncertainty estimation to generate a risk distribution probability map, S6, quantifying hidden danger point risk level, mapping into a two-dimensional space distribution map, and visualizing, S7, screening hidden danger points with the risk level higher than a threshold value, and outputting a prediction result. The invention provides a high-precision and reliable geological disaster hidden danger prediction method through an integrated neural network and a depth fusion technology.

title_en: Wind deflection flashover probability prediction method for power transmission line based on conditional diffusion model
abstract_en: A method for predicting wind deflection flashover probability of an electric transmission line based on a conditional diffusion model relates to the field of wind deflection risk prediction of the electric transmission line, and a space-time joint probability generating frame is constructed by fusing meteorological data and line structural features so as to realize the refined prediction of the wind deflection flashover probability of the electric transmission line. The method comprises the steps of S1 obtaining meteorological data, line parameters and historical flashover data of a power transmission line, carrying out data preprocessing, S2 carrying out condition coding, diffusion processing and iterative denoising on the data based on a parameterized Markov chain, establishing a condition diffusion model, S3 completing uncertainty quantification according to hidden probability modeling, generating a confidence interval, evaluating the wind deflection flashover probability of the power transmission line, S4 constructing accuracy and uncertainty quantification evaluation indexes about model prediction results and the confidence interval, and dividing wind deflection risk grades of the power transmission line. The invention promotes the accurate prevention and control of the wind deflection flashover disaster of the power transmission line and provides technical support for constructing a novel power system safety protection system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO RIZHAO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Active power distribution network optimal scheduling method for large-scale electric automobile access
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active power distribution network optimal scheduling method for large-scale electric automobile access, which particularly relates to the technical field of power distribution network optimal scheduling, and comprises the following steps: s1, a first layer is two-stage optimized scheduling implemented by DEMS; s2, performing real-time scheduling on the regional EV-EMS by a second layer; s3, optimizing a scheduling model and a solving method in each stage. According to the invention, the three-section type optimal scheduling strategy is adopted to cooperatively realize the daily scheduling of controllable resources of the power distribution network, the daily correction and the real-time control of EVs charging, the influence of uncertainty factors such as RES power generation, EVs charging behavior randomness and the like is reduced, the computing time is greatly reduced, the problem of dimension disaster is solved by adopting a 'centralized + distributed' mixed computing framework, in addition, the adverse effect of local communication failure on overall optimal scheduling is also reduced, and the requirement on the reliability of a communication system is reduced.

title_en: Hazard potential evaluation method for complex disasters
title_ko: 시나리오기반의 대형복합재난 위해성 평가방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a scenario-based hazard potential evaluation method for a big complex disaster, which is improved to display hazard potential evaluation of a big complex disaster on a navigation screen by forming a scenario of an occurrence expectation calculation process by using a hazard map and interdependence calculation for each disaster of a database in a hazard potential evaluation server and using an expert computer of an expert survey for defining interconnectivity between disaster types. To achieve the same, according to the present invention, the hazard potential evaluation server networks with the expert computer (10) of the expert survey for defining the interconnectivity between the disaster types and the database (20) of an existing research material such as an avalanche hazard map, a coastal flooding prognostic chart, and a wind speed probability map. The hazard potential evaluation server individually uses the generation of a natural disaster and social disaster matrix and generation of the map from a hazard map DB (50) for each disaster, from an interdependent database (40) for each disaster in a big complex disaster integrated database system (30). The hazard potential evaluation server selects the disaster in a case in which the interdependence is larger than a preset value in the occurrence expectation calculation process (60) and forms the scenario in accordance with the first disaster. The hazard potential evaluation server classifies the hazard map of a grid unit about a whole country as a result on the disaster forming the scenario and applies the same to the expectation calculation in accordance with the scenario. The hazard potential evaluation of the big complex disaster is displayed on the navigation screen (70) by using a scenario search unit of the disaster, reliability, relation, and disparity, a map display unit on which a grade of the hazard potential is displayed, and a disaster scenario pop-up unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난유형간 상호연관성 정립을 위한 전문가 설문조사의 전문가컴퓨터를 이용하고 위해성 평가서버에서 데이터베이스의 재난별 상호의존성산정과 위해성지도를 통해 발생기대치 연산프로세스의 시나리오를 구성함으로 대형 복합재난 위해성평가를 네비게이션화면으로 디스플레이시킬 수 있도록 개선한 시나리오기반의 대형복합재난 위해성 평가방법에 관한 것이다.  
이를 위한 본 발명은, 재난유형간 상호연관성 정립을 위한 전문가 설문조사의 전문가컴퓨터(10)와, 산사태 위험지도나 연안침수 예상도 및 확률풍속지도와 같은 기존 연구자료 데이터베이스(20)를 네트워킹하는 위해성 평가서버가 구성되어; 상기 위해성 평가서버는 대형복합 재난 통합 데이터베이스시스템(30)에서 재난별 상호의존성 데이터베이스(DB : 40)로부터 자연재난 및 사회재난 매트릭스 생성과 재난별 위해성지도 DB(50)로부터 해당 지도생성을 각각 이용하고; 발생기대치 연산프로세스 (60)에서 상호의존성이 설정값보다 클 경우의 재난을 선별하고 최초재난에 따라 시나리오를 구성하고, 시나리오를 구성하고 있는 재난에 대한 결과로써 전국에 대한 격자단위의 위해성지도를 등급화하여 시나리오에 따른 기대치 연산에 적용하며; 네비게이션 화면(70)에서 재난, 신뢰도, 연관도 및 차수의 시나리오 조회부, 위해성 등급표시된 지도표시부 및 재해시나리오 팝업부를 통해 대형복합재난 위해성평가가 화면디스플레이되게 한 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: JB TECH CO LTD;CUBERSOLUTION;CHUNGBUK NATIONAL UNIV INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Disaster front movable energy storage configuration method for expressway energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster movable energy storage configuration method for an expressway energy system, which belongs to the field of pre-disaster energy storage configuration of expressways, and comprises the steps of constructing a movable energy storage system charge-discharge model, and constructing a pre-disaster deterministic movable energy storage configuration model without considering DG output uncertainty according to the movable energy storage system charge-discharge model; based on a column constraint generation algorithm, decoupling the pre-disaster mobile energy storage two-stage robust optimal configuration model to generate a main problem model and a sub-problem model, and continuously iterating the generated main problem model and sub-problem model to obtain an optimal solution of the pre-disaster mobile energy storage configuration. The invention solves the problem of large-scale power failure of the expressway energy system caused by extreme disasters.

title_en: Physical meteorological factor guidance-based generation type typhoon prediction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of weather disaster prediction, and discloses a physical weather factor guiding-based generation typhoon prediction method, which comprises the steps of inputting typhoon history time sequence multi-attribute data, typhoon external environment weather variable data and typhoon inclination coefficient into a physical constraint coding module to obtain physical constraint preliminary characteristics; the method comprises the steps of inputting the primary physical constraint characteristics into a multi-constraint fusion alignment coding module to obtain a history multi-attribute information constraint, a typhoon external environment constraint and a typhoon internal structure constraint after fusion alignment coding, inputting standard noise, the history multi-attribute information constraint, the typhoon external environment constraint and the typhoon internal structure constraint which are consistent with the predicted attribute shape and have uncertainty higher than a threshold value into an uncertainty reduction module under the guidance of the physical constraint to obtain a predicted value of a typhoon target attribute with reduced uncertainty. The invention reduces uncertainty and realizes the movable and accurate global typhoon prediction with low calculation resource requirement.

title_en: A kind of automatic addressing method of complicated landform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automatic addressing methods of complicated landform, it is related to fire-fighting, rescue technique field, nodal analysis method including establishing tree, recognition node, judge moving direction and again programme path, technical solution of the present invention as a result of ranging avoidance, can indoors without GPS signal in the case of, realize unmanned plane or robot oneself search planning complicated landform (mine hole, construction building etc.) path, automatic pathfinding and supervision, it is (dangerous instead of manually arriving operation under some complicated landform environment, it is narrow, it is complicated, zone of ignorance), the injures and deaths for the personnel of can avoid, improve operating efficiency and intelligent level.
assignees: GUANGDONG RONGQE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Plateau mountain land landslide hazard early warning system based on daily displacement rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plateau mountain land landslide hazard early warning system based on daily displacement rate, which comprises a plateau mountain land landslide early warning protection system, a landform condition system, a daily displacement calculation system and an intelligent early warning system, wherein the daily displacement calculation system is used for obtaining the action of the place, the distance, the speed and the time of landslide debris flow, a building distance measurement module is used for measuring the distance between a building and the debris flow, a landslide countdown module is used for measuring the time of the debris flow reaching a corresponding building, a plateau mountain position module and an altitude sample analysis module are fixedly arranged in a geographic information module, and a soil quality type analysis module and a flowability analysis module are fixedly arranged in the soil quality information module; the method is applied to predicting the landslide disaster in advance, displaying general conditions intuitively and vividly, and when the disaster happens, the path and direction of the landslide movement can be known in time, so that the uncertainty caused by the disaster is reduced.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering management system based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and discloses a hydraulic engineering management system based on GIS, which comprises a data access and processing module, a multidimensional factor comprehensive evaluation module, a high-precision DEM generation and calibration module, a flooding simulation module, a scene setting and uncertainty analysis module, a decision support and early warning report module, a machine learning and prediction module and a real-time monitoring and updating module. According to the invention, various factors are introduced, a more accurate risk index is provided, a dynamic adjustment of risk level is supported, the inundation simulation and geological disaster prediction are more close to the actual situation through the high-precision DEM, an automatic early warning mechanism provides powerful technical support for disaster prevention and emergency management, a real-time monitoring updating module ensures rapid updating of post-disaster data, and a detailed support is provided for repairing work.
assignees: DUJIANGYAN WATER CONSERVANCY DEV CENTER OF SICHUAN PROVINCE;JIANGSU XUDIAN AUTOMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Output calculation method and terminal for multi-seaborne wind power plant group under influence of typhoons
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for calculating the output of a multi-sea wind power plant group under the influence of typhoons, which are used for predicting the typhoons track range by training acquired historical typhoons track data, simulating the uncertainty of typhoons tracks in the mode, acquiring surrounding wind speed scenes by adopting a vortex wind field model according to the typhoons track range which is obtained through prediction, establishing a wind speed-fan output physical model by combining the wind speed scenes, environmental parameters and fan parameters of the wind power plant, and then calculating output scenes corresponding to a plurality of wind power plants according to the wind speed-fan output physical model. In this way, under the condition that typhoon disasters occur in the working environment of the offshore multi-wind power plant, the uncertainty of typhoon tracks can be taken into consideration to change brought by wind power output prediction, so that the cooperative operation of various power supplies under the typhoon disasters is facilitated, and the utilization of wind resources and the operation safety of a power grid are considered.

title_en: Data shortage estuary composite flood disaster research method considering climate change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a research method of a composite flood disaster of a data shortage estuary considering climate change, which comprises the following steps: acquiring and preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data; constructing a wind-rain-wave-current coupling mathematical model; extracting extremum data pairs; estimating an edge distribution parameter; estimating Copula function parameters; generating a joint posterior distribution; and calculating the joint reproduction period and performing uncertainty analysis. The method effectively solves the problem of composite flood disaster research in the river mouth area with data shortage through multi-source data fusion, dynamic model construction and non-stationarity processing. The non-stationary characteristic of hydrologic elements and the complex dependency relationship thereof are accurately described by adopting a Bayesian non-parametric method and a time-varying Copula model, so that the scientificity and reliability of composite flood risk assessment are remarkably improved, and powerful support is provided for flood control and disaster reduction decisions under the climate change background.

title_en: Optimization method and device for rainfall station network, electronic equipment and computer program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer program product for optimizing a rainfall station network. The method comprises the steps of selecting the site by combining uncertainty of rainfall data of each original site, the mountain torrent disaster risk level of the sub-basin where each original site is located, and information overlapping amount of each original site and the previously selected site, and stopping site selection when information gain is smaller. The scheme provided by the application can reduce redundancy and information overlapping, and can ensure the improvement of the monitoring coverage rate of a key area while improving the overall information acquisition efficiency of the station network, thereby effectively improving the monitoring and early warning capability of the mountain torrent disasters.

title_en: Post-disaster city full-coverage detection method based on heterogeneous unmanned system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster city full-coverage detection method based on a heterogeneous unmanned system, which belongs to the technical field of rescue and comprises the steps of taking an unmanned aerial vehicle and an unmanned aerial vehicle as the heterogeneous unmanned system, constructing a heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning model, discretizing the heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning model to obtain a discrete optimization model of the heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning, optimizing the on-off state of path points in the discrete optimization model by adopting an improved model algorithm to obtain an optimal open point set, traversing the optimal open point set by adopting a mower algorithm to obtain a shortest full-coverage detection path, constructing a charging point dynamic adjustment mechanism, and carrying out full-coverage detection based on the shortest full-coverage detection path and the charging point dynamic adjustment mechanism. The invention effectively improves the global searching capability and convergence speed of the modular factor algorithm, designs a charging point dynamic adjustment strategy of bidirectional convergence, and effectively reduces the charging waiting time.

title_en: Fire identification method based on flame detection in night vision scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire identification method based on flame detection in a night vision scene, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring an image sequence of a monitored scene through a monitoring camera with a night vision function; step 2, carrying out brightness segmentation on each frame of acquired image, and simultaneously carrying out background modeling and motion detection on the acquired image sequence; step 3, carrying out logic screening on the alternative flame area, finding out scattered bright spots around the large bright spot, and filtering out interference noise of the scattered bright spots; step 4, calculating cumulative distribution on a time axis to form a cumulative distribution probability image of the bright spots; step 5, carrying out binarization and clustering operations on the obtained cumulative distribution probability map in space, and filtering out; step 6, extracting characteristics of each remaining cluster, and performing randomness detection on a time axis; and 7, judging whether a fire disaster occurs in the monitored scene. The method solves the problem that the night fire detection method in the prior art is easy to interfere and has high false alarm rate.
assignees: MECH & ELECTRICAL ENG ANHUI POLYTECHNIC UNIV

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on a time sequence, and relates to the technical field of information perception and recognition. The unmanned plane heading determining method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining ship navigation data in real time, recording comparison sequences of different moments and positions, predicting possible positions and headings of ships after AIS (automatic identification system) tracks of the ships disappear for a period of time based on a time sequence analysis model, and then calculating unmanned plane heading determining methods when the ship can search areas based on different navigational speeds based on searching meeting points. According to the invention, under the condition that the current ship position information cannot be acquired, the unmanned aerial vehicle is required to be dispatched to search and rescue the ship, the course of the unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescue is calculated and determined after a period of interruption based on a time sequence method, and engineering realization and application are easy.
assignees: THE 54TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Path planning method for collaborative search of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: A path planning method for collaborative search of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles comprises the steps of firstly establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle kinematics model, a sensor model and an environment cognition map, updating a target existence probability and an environment uncertainty map in real time based on a Bayesian theorem, secondly establishing a model-based predictive control path decision frame, predicting a future multi-step path through rolling optimization and generating a control sequence. In the optimization solution, a double-population three-layer competition mechanism is adopted to divide individual particle populations into losers, candidates and winners, a differentiated updating strategy is adopted to balance global exploration and local utilization capacity of particles, and a feedback mechanism based on particle evolution quality is introduced to dynamically adjust the size of sub-population scale and combine cycle recombination to maintain population diversity. The method remarkably improves the solving quality of the search path planning problem based on model predictive control, ensures higher search coverage rate, and is suitable for multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search scenes such as disaster relief, environment monitoring and the like.

title_en: Parallel intelligent emergency collaboration method, system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a parallel intelligent emergency cooperation method, a system and electronic equipment. Comprising the following steps: establishing an artificial system model based on visual space-time fusion, and performing crowd sensing and evacuation channel traffic state detection based on cross-video geographic intelligent fusion analysis on a space to be evacuated through the artificial system model; constructing a three-dimensional virtual simulation environment of the space to be evacuated, constructing a multi-agent evacuation simulation model based on personnel distribution based on historical disaster environment simulation and risk situation analysis, performing evacuation simulation through the multi-agent evacuation simulation model, and generating an optimal evacuation scheme prediction result; and establishing a parallel execution cooperative system based on real-time monitoring and augmented reality visualization to perform deduction simulation and dynamic evacuation simulation, and generating an optimal evacuation scheme by combining a prediction result of the calculation experiment system. The application solves the problems of prominence, instability, nonlinearity and uncertainty in a real system through virtual-real interaction mode and collaborative evolution.

title_en: Method for determining optimal loss curve of non-data city based on double-layer target optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an optimal loss curve of a double-layer target optimized non-data city based on a variation coefficient and beta distribution optimization principle, which is used for reducing uncertainty in a data processing process. Firstly, transferring loss rate values of a data reference area to a research area aiming at inland plain cities of disaster-lack data by referring to a comparison principle; and secondly, based on a preferred principle that the variation coefficient is minimum and the beta distribution probability is maximum, reducing the quotation error and the statistical error generated in the loss rate quotation, acquiring a relatively accurate investigation region loss value, and further establishing a disaster-suffering water depth-loss rate relation curve of the disaster-lack data city. Therefore, the generalized non-data city disaster damage curve fitting method taking the regional index value as an input parameter and the damage curve as an output result is formed, and scientific reference is provided for the establishment of a non-data city flood damage curve.

title_en: Dynamic risk level assessment method for village scale typhoon and storm related secondary disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk level evaluation method of a village scale typhoon and storm related secondary disaster, which comprises the steps of constructing a geographic information database of a region to be researched, and obtaining real-time disaster information of all types of buildings according to real-time wind speed and inundation conditions in a certain time range in the future. Taking the number of disaster-stricken residential buildings, the number of people to be evacuated and the expected value of total economic loss at village level as the dividing index of risk level, when considering the flood secondary disasters and geological secondary disasters caused by typhoons and storm, respectively analyzing by utilizing residential building function evaluation frames which are not coupled and coupled with the geological disasters to obtain the numerical value of each dividing index and dividing the numerical value into corresponding levels. And (5) carrying out cyclic calculation along with updating of weather forecast information. The disaster situation deduction is carried out based on a physical mechanism, building function assessment is taken as a core, and uncertainty of weather forecast and building disaster bearing capacity is considered to carry out real-time dynamic risk level assessment on different kinds of secondary disasters.

title_en: Rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change, which comprises the following five steps of (I) collecting future daily rainfall data in a global climate model and performing scale reduction treatment, (II) quantifying time-varying characteristics of non-stationary rainfall variables under the influence of climate change, (III) establishing a rainfall interval-rainfall duration alternating random process update model considering climate change, (IV) analyzing vulnerability of a rainfall slope considering uncertainty of rock-soil parameters, and (V) estimating the slope instability probability based on a full probability theorem convolution rainfall disaster curve and a slope vulnerability curve in a future predefined time. Compared with the prior art, the invention provides a new rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change, realizes quantitative characterization of non-stationary rainfall caused by climate change effect, and provides an effective method for more accurate estimation of future rainfall slope instability probability.

title_en: Active power distribution network load fault recovery strategy optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power system control, and particularly relates to an optimization algorithm for load fault recovery strategy of an active power distribution network. According to the traditional fault recovery scheme, when an accident occurs, a load recovery plan is carried out on a whole fault time interval by a controllable Distributed Generation (DG), a distributed energy storage and other limited power generation devices according to the output predicted values of intermittent energy sources such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like, the load recovery scheme cannot be dynamically adjusted by acquiring real-time information, and further the key load in the fault time interval cannot be effectively recovered. The application provides an optimization algorithm for load fault recovery strategy of an active power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a multi-period load fault recovery strategy optimization model; step 2: and solving by considering the risk indexes aiming at the optimization model. And in consideration of random uncertainty of wind, light and other intermittent energy output, dynamically correcting the load recovery plan through real-time measurement information of renewable energy after extreme disasters.

title_en: Extreme weather prediction method based on typical weather year
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather prediction, in particular to an extreme weather prediction method based on a typical weather year, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a typical weather year data set, combining ground, analysis and satellite data, and generating high-quality weather data through interpolation and fusion technologies; the method comprises the steps of generating the enhancement data of the countermeasure network, solving the problem of insufficient extreme event samples, extracting key meteorological variables through super-resolution and feature dimension reduction, constructing a deep learning model based on a convolutional neural network and a long-term and short-term memory network to conduct multi-task prediction, introducing physical constraint rules such as energy conservation and mass conservation to ensure that the prediction accords with the meteorological rules, generating confidence intervals of prediction results through an uncertainty quantization technology, and providing risk assessment and decision support information. The method improves the accuracy and the reliability of the extreme weather event prediction, and supports disaster prevention and reduction, resource scheduling, agricultural production and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: SAR image-based method for identifying flood fault hidden danger of transmission tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying flood fault hidden dangers of a transmission tower based on SAR images, which comprises the following steps: step 1: filtering the SAR image; step 2: extracting a binary image of the SAR image water body area by adopting a threshold algorithm; and step 3: calculating the shortest distance from the tower to the flood area and the flood ratio in the search area by adopting a tower center distance search algorithm and a tower foundation grid distance search algorithm; and 4, step 4: and calculating a flood hidden danger coefficient based on the distance from the tower to flood and the flood occupation ratio in the range of the tower, and judging the disaster condition of the tower.

title_en: Reservoir-lake-river system extreme flood simulation and flood control risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir-lake-river system extreme flood simulation and flood control risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method firstly identifies risk source factors of historical extreme flood events, and utilizes Vine Copula functions to describe the uncertainty of spatial distribution of the risk source factors, and Latin hypercube sampling is used for generating a risk source factor sample; the method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out a sampling analysis on a sample, then carrying out sample reduction based on a Neural Gas algorithm, constructing a risk source factor scene tree, combining historical flood data and adopting a homonymy scaling method to generate an extreme flood process line scene, then constructing a combined flood control optimization scheduling model, evaluating flood control risks of reservoirs and lakes, and analyzing evaluation effects. The invention has simple structure, accurate and stable risk assessment, is not only beneficial to the fine risk assessment of the high-incidence area of the flood disasters, but also provides theoretical support for extreme flood risk assessment in the data-deficient area.

title_en: Landslide remote sensing image segmentation method based on multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide remote sensing image segmentation method based on multi-modal fusion, and relates to the technical field of remote sensing image analysis and geological disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps of mapping multi-mode data of a landslide remote sensing image to the same dimension, obtaining respective corresponding token sequences, compressing in a low rank mode, obtaining feature matrixes, sequentially decoupling and dynamically weighting fusion to obtain fusion features, inputting the fusion features into a visual basic model, selecting a plurality of middle layers of the visual basic model to extract scale features, generating sampling fusion features through up-sampling, down-sampling and gating enhancement based on the scale features, inputting the sampling fusion features into BUR, obtaining convolution enhancement features, carrying out convolution, generating an uncertainty diagram, and inputting the uncertainty diagram into a decoder, thus obtaining the landslide remote sensing segmented image. The method effectively solves the problem of isomerism of multi-mode data, generates sampling fusion characteristics with higher spatial accuracy through fusion processing, and realizes accurate segmentation of landslide remote sensing images.

title_en: Building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under a flood disaster, which is based on a fine physical model and considers the uncertainty of resistance distribution of building components when coping with the flood disaster, and can obtain time-varying disaster economic loss in the whole flood process when being applied to a pre-disaster simulation scene, thereby providing a basis for the scheduling of related disaster relief materials; when the method is applied to a real-time monitoring scene, compared with the existing method, the method can accurately obtain the economic loss condition of each building in the monitoring area at the current moment.

title_en: Flood inundation drawing method and system integrating social media data and SAR (synthetic aperture radar) images
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood inundation drawing method and a system integrating social media data and SAR images, which relate to the technical field of emergency management and comprise the steps of acquiring text data which are related to a storm flood event and provided with POI address information in social media; the method comprises the steps of generating a rough flood inundation range map and a flood inundation probability map of a disaster area based on DEM data, POI inundation points and corresponding water depth information, confirming a flood inundation probability threshold interval based on field pictures and video data obtained through searching, obtaining a flood inundation range map of an urban built-up area by taking intersection, extracting water body data of different periods according to multi-view SAR images before, during and after a disaster, generating a river inundation range map, and combining the flood inundation range map of the urban built-up area and the river inundation range map to obtain a flood inundation range map of the disaster area. According to the method, the advantages of social media data and time sequence SAR images in urban flood and river flood detection are fully utilized, and high-precision drawing of large-scale flood events is achieved.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL CHINA NORMAL;CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Intelligent linkage treatment system for fire disaster of power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent linkage treatment system for a power plant fire disaster, which comprises a high-precision sensing layer, a time sequence prediction engine, a game decision system and an execution control system, wherein the high-precision sensing layer collects original data through a distributed sensor and is preprocessed into 12-dimensional feature vectors through edge computing nodes, the time sequence prediction engine takes the 12-dimensional feature vectors as input, adopts a physical constraint transducer model, embeds a heat conduction equation regularization term and outputs a fire evolution probability map, the game decision system generates an optimal evacuation path through a multi-target reinforcement learning algorithm based on the fire evolution probability map and the feature vectors and generates equipment control instructions through a three-level response mechanism, and the execution control system drives an executor to execute the control instructions through a time sensitive network and feeds back equipment states to the game decision system in real time. The invention realizes the efficient coordination and accurate response of fire monitoring, early warning, decision making and treatment by mutual linkage and dynamic adjustment of all links.
assignees: DIQIGAN INTERNET OF THINGS SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.
assignees: SOLVIT SYSTEM CO LTD;BIG & DEEP CO LTD

title_en: Uncertainty-based power system restoring force evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty-based power system restoring force evaluation method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining various data of a power system after experiencing extreme disasters, constructing an element fault rate model dynamically associated with a power system restoring decision based on the decision-dependent uncertainty, generating a power failure scene based on the obtained data and the element fault rate model by considering part of element states uncertainty, establishing an association matrix between the state uncertainty and a fault element based on a gray association theory, calculating damage confidence coefficient of the state uncertainty element, screening out a typical power failure scene by utilizing a system information entropy, constructing a multi-dimensional power system dynamic restoring force evaluation index system by combining with renewable energy output uncertainty, and calculating an evaluation index to evaluate restoring force. The invention integrates decision-dependent uncertainty, element state uncertainty and renewable energy output uncertainty, so that the evaluation result is more similar to the complexity of an actual post-disaster scene.

title_en: Engineering risk monitoring system and method based on state transition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering risk monitoring system and method based on state transition. The system comprises an initial data processing module, a state transition visualization expression module, an image feature extraction module, an automatic learning module and an automatic image identification module, wherein the state transition visualization expression module is used for generating a state transition diagram of all states in an engineering according to data processed by the initial data processing module; the image feature extraction module is used for extracting set features from the state transition diagram; the automatic learning module is used for calculating ratio of each characteristic value to a historical average value and setting a threshold value according to the extracted features the diagram; the automatic image identification module is used for extracting setting feature of t he state transition diagram according to the image feature extraction module and judging whether the engineering is in a risk state or not according to the threshold value set by the automatic learning module. According to the system and the method provided by the invention, the problems of indeterminateness and uncertainty of underground engineering disasters can be effectively solved, and the risks of the engineering can be visually and automatically monitored, so that the intuition and intelligence are realized.

title_en: Network fault recovery method for coordinating network reconstruction and mobile energy storage system vehicle team
abstract_en: The invention provides a network fault recovery method for coordinating network reconstruction and a mobile energy storage system vehicle team, which comprises the steps of constructing a MESS vehicle team driving model; constructing a coordinated network recovery model according to the MESS motorcade driving model; and constructing a coordinated network recovery model considering the load and the DG output prediction uncertainty, and obtaining a robust variant of the coordinated network recovery model to recover the network power supply of the active power distribution network. The invention coordinates MESS, SESS, network recovery, DG scheduling and demand response resources in the power outage area to recover power supply, considers the uncertainty of load and DG output prediction in the robust variant of the coordinated network recovery model, and provides guidance and suggestion for recovering power supply after power distribution system disaster.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Mountain avalanche-prone ladder-coupling element characteristic space prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting a mountain avalanche-prone ladder-coupling element characteristic space, and relates to the technical field of mountain disaster space intelligent evaluation and risk mapping. The invention firstly builds a four-dimensional high-resolution factor grid of terrain, weather, vegetation and snow, then balances avalanche positive and negative samples by step sampling, then outputs first-level posterior probability in parallel by a Platt calibrated extreme random tree, an AdaBoost and a naive Bayesian ternary heterogeneous learner, and forms high-dimensional meta-features by splicing with the original features, inputs the meta-features into a sparse attention-light transducer dual-channel dynamic gating network to realize secondary deep coupling and noise suppression, and finally enhances and outputs an avalanche probability map with 12.5m resolution by multi-scale test.

title_en: Method for Tracking Emergency Caller for Securing Emergency Rescue Golden Time in City Area
title_ko: 도심 지역에서 긴급 구조 골든타임 확보를 위한 요구조자 탐색 방법
abstract_en: A method for locating a first responder to ensure emergency rescue golden time in an urban area is disclosed. The method includes the following steps: measuring a signal strength from a rescuer terminal; estimating a GPS position error distribution of the rescuer; determining whether a path between the rescuer and the rescuer is LOS or NLOS and estimating a location and uncertainty of the rescuer after obtaining channel parameters according to each of the above; and minimizing a navigation path of the rescuer in a direction that minimizes a cramer-rao lower bound (CRLB), which is an inverse matrix of the FIM.
abstract_ko: 도심 지역에서 긴급 구조 골든타임 확보를 위한 요구조자 탐색 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 방법은 요구조자 단말기로부터의 신호 세기를 측정하는 단계; 구조대의 GPS 위치 오차 분포를 추정하는 단계; 구조대와 요구조자 사이의 경로가 LOS 인지 또는 NLOS인지 여부를 판단하고 각 상항에 따른 채널 파라미터를 획득한 후 요구조자의 위치 및 불확실성을 추정하는 단계; 및 FIM의 역행렬인 CRLB(Cramer-Rao Lower Bound)를 최소화하는 방향으로 구조대의 탐색 경로를 최소화하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UIF UNIV INDUSTRY FOUNDATION YONSEI UNIV

title_en: Foundation and satellite-borne radar precipitation data fusion method based on wavelet domain regularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground and satellite-borne radar precipitation data fusion method based on wavelet domain regularization. The fusion process of the invention considers the uncertainty of precipitation estimation of different sensors and the wavelet domain statistical characteristics of precipitation data, and the fusion result reduces the uncertainty of a single sensor, and simultaneously can better maintain and reconstruct the detail characteristics of strong precipitation extreme value, small-scale change and the like, thereby being more beneficial to monitoring and forecasting the strong disaster weather such as flood monitoring and the like.

title_en: Quakeproof safety fort
abstract_en: The invention provides a quakeproof safety fort which mainly comprises a buffer plate (1), an impact plate (2), a compressive beam (8), a separation resisting plate (4), a compressive pillar (5), an anti-sag support (9) and a body-building base plate (10). The safety fort can be used for effectively preventing and reducing the loss of life and personal injuries during earthquake and is a facility for safe self-rescue and daily effective earthquake prevention, which fills the blank of indoor earthquake safety facilities, solves the problem of insufficient safe facilities in quakeproofing all the time and the problem of uncertainty of the quake resistance of buildings, reduces universal panics caused in the quakeproofing, increases the sense of security of people and provides a relatively safe island for people in quakeproofing.

title_en: Port supply chain service-oriented proprietary cloud multi-stage migration rollback control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a proprietary cloud multi-stage migration rollback control system for port supply chain service, which relates to the technical field of proprietary cloud migration and aims to solve the problems of complexity and uncertainty of rollback decisions in a cloud platform multi-stage migration process, wherein service influence levels and recovery cost levels are obtained based on service system importance mapping and affected system sets, a finite state machine is driven by taking migration state tuples, fault levels, data consistency gears and service influence levels as inputs, the system automatically decides to rollback to stage 0 when specific conditions are met within one week after stage 2 cutting, and automatically prohibits to return to stage 0 after exceeding a window or old platform is removed, and disaster backup switching or self-healing is preferentially selected, so that a set of structured executable rollback opportunity and path control mechanism are formed under the port supply chain service proprietary cloud multi-stage migration scene.
assignees: SHANDONG PORT TECH GROUP QINGDAO CO LTD

title_en: Reliability assessment method for vibration isolation performance of nonlinear vibration isolator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method for vibration isolation performance of a nonlinear vibration isolator, and relates to the field of mechanical device vibration isolation technology and structural reliability evaluation. The evaluation method comprises the following steps: taking a nonlinear vibration isolator as a research object, taking the steady-state displacement response amplitude Y  ASDR  of the nonlinear vibration isolator as a quantitative evaluation index for evaluating vibration isolation performance under the condition of fully considering the uncertainty of the structure, the size and the excitation parameters of the nonlinear vibration isolator, solving and obtaining dynamic response according to an established nonlinear vibration isolator dynamic model, discussing the influence of the uncertainty of each parameter on the dynamic response amplitude, and evaluating the reliability of the vibration isolation performance by adopting a self-adaptive proxy model method. The invention is suitable for the nonlinear vibration isolator, can improve the reliability and the stability of the vibration isolator, and reduces the economic loss and irreversible disaster accidents caused by harmful vibration.

title_en: Beacon detection system for locating missing persons
abstract_en: A beacon detection system which can locate a missing search subject includes: a beacon signal receiver; a location position detector; and a beacon detector. The detector is configured to detect a location of a broadcasting beacon signal associated with a personal device of a search subject within search data covering a geographic search area derived from a search for the search subject, the search data gathered by the beacon signal receiver and location position detector. A computer implemented method of determining a location of a search subject is also provided. The method determines at least a possible connection request from Wi-Fi signals in search data gathered by a Wi-Fi radio covering a geographic search area for a search subject and associated location information to locate the search subject.

title_en: Energy station elastic lifting planning method and system under multiple uncertainties
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for planning elastic lifting of an energy station under multiple uncertainties, wherein the method comprises the following steps: taking multiple uncertainty factors of the disaster process of the energy station into consideration, and constructing probability distribution of each uncertainty factor, wherein the multiple uncertainty factors comprise earthquake intensity deviation, equipment damage state capability deviation, energy equipment earthquake vulnerability deviation, post-disaster multipotency load prediction error and post-disaster data load prediction error; based on the probability distribution of each uncertainty factor, constructing a load shedding condition risk constraint after the disaster of the energy station by utilizing a condition risk value theory; building an energy station elastic lifting planning model for coping with earthquake disasters under multiple uncertainties; and solving the energy station elastic lifting planning model to obtain a multi-energy station planning scheme for coping with the earthquake disasters. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of effectively avoiding potential risk of post-disaster load shedding of the energy station, improving the elasticity of the planning scheme for coping with earthquake disasters and the like.

title_en: Airplane search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an airplane search and rescue method, which comprises the following steps: 1. calculating the optimal search width W of search rescue according to the expected search success probability Q; 2. according to the optimal search width W and the minimum turning radius R of the airplane min Determining a search mode; 3. calculating coordinates of each turning point in the search area according to the optimal search width obtained in the step one, the search mode obtained in the step two, the search boundary point obtained in the step three and the turning reference point; all turning points are right below one point of the turning reference points, namely the turning points and the turning reference points have the same longitude; 4. the airplane carries out flying search and rescue according to the entry point and the turning point. The invention provides a method for planning search and rescue air lines in search and rescue areas according to a grid search mode, which defines key navigation parameters such as the entry point coordinates, the turning point coordinates and the like of the flight air lines, establishes feasible flight air lines for airplanes, and reduces repeated search and missed search areas.

title_en: Side slope collapse risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood and drought disaster data processing, and provides a slope collapse risk assessment method and a system, wherein the slope collapse risk assessment method comprises the steps of constructing a plurality of grid units based on a surface structure of a research area, and constructing a plurality of data matrixes; the method comprises the steps of obtaining future rainfall probability distribution, generating a future rainfall scene library, constructing a soil hydrologic mechanism model, obtaining a plurality of flood peak element results based on the future rainfall scene library and the soil hydrologic mechanism model to calculate uncertainty, obtaining a hydrologic mechanism data set, establishing a fault tree model of a slope collapse event, evaluating slope collapse risk expectations, and evaluating accuracy of the slope collapse risk expectations according to the uncertainty. By establishing a data matrix related to a time scale, the model simulates the whole hydrologic cycle process, predicts and understands the hydrologic process more deeply, and can obtain a dynamic slope condition change process, and quantitatively evaluate the slope collapse risk expectation and the expected accuracy.

title_en: Pollute small-sized river pollutant carrying capacity uncertainty disaster risk estimation method under source summit generalization
abstract_en: The present invention relates to small-sized river pollutant carrying capacity uncertainty disaster risk estimation methods under a kind of pollution source summit generalization, include the following steps：(1) determine receive dirty section analysis if appropriate for pollution source summit generally changes calculating its pollutant carrying capacity；(2) determining dirty section initial section position x, controls up to par cross section place x', the initial section pollutant concentration C of receiving 0 , measure average section of river flow velocity u, discharge of river Q；(3) dirty section contaminant degradation coefficient k and its uncertainty α are received according to measurement result determination；(4) pollutant of controls up to par section concentration C up to standard is determined s , generally change characteristic, contaminant degradation coefficient k and uncertainty α, average section of river flow velocity u, discharge of river Q in conjunction with pollution source summit, calculate the variance D (W) of the section pollutant carrying capacity, the dirty probabilistic risk of section pollutant carrying capacity is received as this.Through the invention, the risk that small-sized river pollutant carrying capacity uncertainty is brought can be effectively estimated in this method, be easy to promote in water quality management is received in various small-sized rivers.

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation water level prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water level prediction method and system for multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation, which utilize various spatial-temporal data related to reservoir water level prediction to generate a plurality of parallel CNN branches for feature fusion and dimension reduction, and the parallel CNN branches are processed as input vectors of Bi-LSTM models to predict water level, and a Monte Carlo technology is introduced to evaluate uncertainty and confidence of a prediction result. According to the invention, a multi-mode data fusion technology is adopted, different CNN branches are built for parallel operation aiming at different types of space-time data, a Bi-LSTM network is built for prediction through PCA dimension reduction, a Monte Carlo technology is introduced for prediction and uncertainty and confidence assessment of a model, so that the prediction error of the model is effectively reduced, and the prediction reliability is improved. The method has higher practicability, can be widely applied to the fields of water conservancy, weather and the like, and provides more rigorous and effective prediction and decision for application scenes such as water resource management, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Distribution robust planning method for improving inherent and dynamic toughness of gas-electricity combined distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of planning of a gas-electricity combined system and toughness improvement, and discloses a distributed robust planning method for improving inherent and dynamic toughness of a gas-electricity combined distribution network. The method comprises the steps of establishing an objective function of an expansion planning model of a gas-electricity combined power distribution system, providing a decision-related uncertainty modeling method, representing vulnerability curves of different types of power distribution network lines and natural gas pipelines under earthquake disasters, providing inherent toughness punishment and dynamic toughness punishment concepts, modeling the model objective function, finally establishing a fuzzy set based on KL divergence to obtain a two-stage distribution robust model, carrying out investment and operation cost minimization of a basic scene in a first stage, carrying out planning decisions made in the first stage in a second stage, furthest reducing inherent toughness punishment and dynamic toughness punishment expectations, and effectively solving the two-stage distribution robust planning model through a PH algorithm-based column and constraint generation method. The invention improves the economic benefit and the toughness reinforcing effect.

title_en: Building vulnerability assessment method and system based on AI and GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building vulnerability assessment method and system based on AI and GIS, which comprises the steps of constructing a seismic risk analysis model by acquiring preset building seismic risk data and a geographical space data set of a research area, acquiring building damage indexes and building vulnerability assessment indexes, constructing a vulnerability assessment model, constructing GeoIME ecosystem based on the seismic risk analysis model, the vulnerability assessment model and the LLM model, constructing a GeoIME GPT system, carrying out vulnerability and risk assessment on the building data of the research area according to a GeoIME GPT system to obtain an assessment result, realizing the identification of potential fragile buildings by AI, improving the global disaster resistance, improving the disaster management efficiency by the GeoIME GPT system, realizing the risk assessment automation, enabling a user to trace each analysis step by a transparent reasoning path of GeoIME-GPT, and converting uncertainty from hidden risks to controllable variables.
assignees: TONGCHUANG ENG DESIGN CO LTD;UNIV SHAOXING

title_en: Forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method oriented to forestry vertical field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method facing the forestry vertical field, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing and comprises the steps of constructing a space-time spectrum data set of forestry resources, wherein the data set comprises spectrograms, geographic information, climate data and real fire probability maps of different time steps in a monitoring area, constructing an ST-SegNet network, comprising a SegNet encoder, a SegNet decoder, a ConvLSTM model, a feature fusion layer and a merging layer, constructing the total loss of the ST-SegNet network, and training the ST-SegNet network to obtain the forestry resource space-time spectrum large model. The invention improves the space-time consistency and classification precision of remote sensing image data, ensures higher-quality data processing, enhances the adaptability to complex scenes through space-time spectrum data fusion, improves the detail processing capability, provides a new technical path for environment monitoring and disaster response, and remarkably improves the efficiency of an emergency early warning system.

title_en: Numerical integration early termination method based on disturbed trajectory dynamic characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical integration early termination method based on disturbed trajectory dynamic characteristics, which comprises the following steps: according to the disturbed track information, combining comprises: and judging whether numerical integration is terminated in advance according to dynamic characteristics including instability of a destabilization mode, disturbed track non-co-scheduling, maximum rotor angle gap, information similarity of equidirectional adjacent rotor angle gaps and oscillation attenuation. The invention can automatically match proper integral intervals for each sample according to the dynamic information, and can greatly improve the analysis speed on the premise of ensuring that the analysis precision of the sample is not changed compared with the original transient stability analysis method based on the fixed integral intervals. The method has great theoretical and engineering significance for further considering the accuracy and speed of online transient stability analysis and solving the problems of strong uncertainty, strong nonlinearity and dimension disaster which may be faced by transient stability analysis under the condition of high-proportion renewable energy networking.

title_en: Regional building earthquake damage prediction method and system aiming at complex terrain geological conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional building earthquake damage prediction method and a regional building earthquake damage prediction system aiming at complex terrain geological conditions, wherein the prediction method is used for acquiring data of a region to be detected and acquiring an earthquake resistance response result of the region to be detected based on the data; correcting the anti-seismic response result to obtain a correction result; the method solves the problem that the prediction result is inaccurate due to the fact that the traditional earthquake prediction system is limited under the geological condition of complex terrain and comprises geological heterogeneity, multiscale, uncertainty of geophysical parameters and the like. In addition, when the post-earthquake damage of the mountain structure is predicted, the soil and the structure influence the earthquake-resistant response of the structure mutually, so that the predicted result is more accurate, the predicted result needs to be corrected, the corrected result avoids the influence of the interaction of the soil and the structure, and the predicted result is more accurate. The method of the invention is helpful for early warning, scientifically planning city construction and improving disaster prevention measures, and provides more effective support for coping with earthquake disasters.

title_en: Method for evaluating wind disaster vulnerability of reversing branch tower by considering material parameter variation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind disaster vulnerability assessment method of a reversing branch tower, which considers material parameter variation, wherein the variation rule of various structural material parameters is considered by utilizing sampling operation when wind response of the reversing branch tower is calculated, an intelligent prediction model is adopted to learn the relationship between the average value and standard deviation of wind speed and structural requirement indexes, and finally the overrun probability of a structure under a series of wind speed values is predicted, so that a comprehensive wind disaster vulnerability result which considers the variation of the structural material parameters is formed. The method provides more accurate overrun probability evaluation based on the existing wind disaster vulnerability evaluation of the power transmission tower, and considers more uncertainty risks.
