The invention considers uncertainty of various variation parameters in a random sampling mode, reduces calculated amount, obtains a quantized relation between wind speed and overrun probability and a relation between wind speed and various material parameters and overrun probability by adopting an intelligent prediction model, can calculate the overrun probability more quickly by adopting the intelligent prediction model under a specified wind speed, obtains a vulnerability curve or curved surface under multiple wind speeds, and greatly improves analysis efficiency.

title_en: Mountain torrent formation disaster-causing mechanism analysis method based on pregnant disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent formation disaster-causing mechanism analysis method based on a disaster-causing environment, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a historical mountain torrent disaster attribute set and an environmental factor set of a research area, 2, determining a mountain torrent disaster-causing environment type partition and characteristics thereof, 3, determining explanation degree and uncertainty interval of each partition environment type and environmental factors on mountain torrent disaster attribute change, 4, determining dominant environmental factors of each disaster-causing environment type partition, and 5, analyzing influence of the dominant environmental factor change on a mountain torrent formation process and a disaster-causing process. The method fully considers the space-time heterogeneity of meteorological factors, geography and socioeconomic factors of a disaster-stricken river basin, separates and quantifies the contribution and uncertainty of different environmental factors such as meteorological factors, geography and socioeconomic factors to the formation of the torrential flood, can improve the comprehensive control level of the torrential flood disaster, has strong applicability, and provides scientific basis for the control and management of the torrential flood disaster.

title_en: Multi-mode data-driven potential disaster intelligent sensing and emergency data engineering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode data-driven potential disaster intelligent sensing and emergency data engineering system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent information processing, and comprises a super-surface communication module, a communication node and a communication node, wherein the super-surface communication module calculates phase gradients between the communication nodes by utilizing a disaster risk probability map and terrain height data to generate a beam forming matrix, performs low-power consumption non-line-of-sight data transmission, monitors link quality and feeds back communication energy consumption to generate an encrypted data packet; the system comprises a cloud coordination module, a rescue decision module and a communication power consumption data and a feedback topographic parameter, wherein the cloud coordination module decrypts the encrypted data packet and carries out three-dimensional disaster deduction to generate a disaster influence thermodynamic diagram, and the rescue decision module utilizes an improved path planning algorithm to carry out path optimization on the disaster influence thermodynamic diagram to generate an optimized rescue path, and combines the communication power consumption data and the feedback topographic parameter to generate updated communication power and redundancy configuration parameters. The invention greatly improves the reliability and the energy utilization efficiency of emergency communication and ensures the stability and redundancy of the communication link in the key area.

title_en: Gully type mud-rock flow channel Circulation Area dimensional topography evolution analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of gully type mud-rock flow channel Circulation Area dimensional topography evolution analysis methods, belong to geological disaster to prevent and reduce natural disasters technical field, the method of the present invention acquires channel cross section landform altitude along channel stream central line in the flowing area of mud flow at a certain distance, each cross section is subjected to equidistant segmentation based on discretization thought, it is deep by measuring the corresponding flow velocity of any time and mud in each segmentation, the groove channel erosion rate for calculating each cross section segmentation and the depth of erosion during mud-rock flow, landform altitude after obtaining each cross section debris flow erosion, finally adjacent cross section landform contour point is connected by straight line, landform of the channel Circulation Area ditch bed under mud-rock flow souring can be obtained to develop, the method of the present invention not only overcomes the subjectivity and uncertainty of conventional method empirical parameter value in debris flow erosion calculating, Dimensional topography of the channel Circulation Area landform after mud-rock flow washes away can be obtained simultaneously, the work that can prevent and reduce natural disasters for mud-rock flow provides reference.

title_en: Regional possible maximum rainfall determining method for mountain flood ditch drainage basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the regional possible maximum rainfall for mountain and flood ditches, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting hydrological data and scene rainfall flood data of a research area; step 2, determining the spatial distribution of maximum rainfall in different duration of the scene rainfall; step 3, determining a storm similar area; step 4, determining the possible maximum rainfall in the storm similar area; and 5, determining the possible maximum rainfall time course distribution of the storm similar area. The method fully utilizes the existing data such as hydrological weather in various places, increases the short-duration rainfall sample capacity, ensures the consistency of analysis results of the upstream and downstream of the watershed, and avoids uncertainty caused by subjective selection of typical heavy storm; and fully consider the influence of the regional complex topography change of hilly area to regional rainfall continuous space distribution, the suitability is strong, and the degree of accuracy is high, can supply mountain torrent disaster defense department to select to support work such as mountain torrent disaster defense risk decision-making and planning under the extreme storm scene.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Robot Following System Based on Wireless Communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot following system based on wireless communication, comprising: the system comprises a plurality of search and rescue robots, an electric energy supply robot for providing electric energy, and a plurality of search and rescue robots, wherein the plurality of search and rescue robots keep a formation from the original place to the direction of a suspected target, and sequentially search a plurality of distributed suspected search areas in the proceeding direction; when the suspected search area does not find the target, leaving a search and rescue robot in the suspected search area, and continuing the rest search and rescue robots; when the target is found in the next suspected search area, the electric energy supplying robot starts from the original place, and carries the remaining search and rescue robot along the proceeding path of the search and rescue robot to the target position together.

title_en: Mine water disaster accident emergency decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency decision method and an emergency decision system for mine water damage accidents. The decision method comprises the following steps: acquiring accident elements of the current mine water disaster accident to obtain first accident elements; determining the scene type of the current mine water disaster accident according to the first accident element to obtain a first scene type; acquiring all mine water damage accident cases corresponding to a first scene type in a case base to obtain an accident case set; according to the mine water damage accident case, obtaining decision information corresponding to each mine water damage accident case in the accident case set in the countermeasure library to obtain a countermeasure set; the strategy library comprises decision information corresponding to all mine water damage accident cases, and the decision information is rescue measures and disposal technology of the mine water damage accident cases at each accident stage; and determining the strategy set as an emergency decision of the current mine water disaster accident. The method can make a decision on the mine water disaster accident in real time so as to meet the decision requirements of urgency, complexity and uncertainty of the mine water disaster accident.

title_en: Marine unmanned equipment search and rescue method, device and equipment based on drifting track prediction
abstract_en: The application relates to a search and rescue method, a device and equipment for offshore unmanned equipment based on drift track prediction, which are characterized in that a trained coefficient correction model is utilized to optimize flow field coefficients and wind pressure coefficients in a pre-constructed target drift model according to feedback information fed back after the offshore unmanned equipment is in distress, an optimized target drift model is obtained, calculation is carried out according to environmental information of a sea area where the offshore unmanned equipment is located and the optimized target drift model, a drift track after the offshore unmanned equipment is in distress is obtained, and a Monte Carlo algorithm is adopted based on the drift track to obtain a search and rescue area of the offshore unmanned equipment, wherein the search and rescue area is represented by uncertainty quantization of search and rescue target distribution probability under marine environment rasterization. By adopting the method, an accurate search and rescue area can be provided for search and rescue of offshore unmanned equipment.

title_en: A kind of disaster monitoring early warning platform construction method based on SOA framework
abstract_en: The disaster monitoring early warning platform construction method based on SOA framework that the invention discloses a kind of, solving current Geological Hazards Monitoring early warning is by monitoring and the progress early warning of monitoring device Threshold Alerts of manually patrolling mostly, but the diversity and uncertainty of the factor due to inducing geological disaster, and the usually interspersed complicated geogen that blends, management and evaluation to data become abnormal difficult defect.This invention makes full use of the lower coupling feature of SOA framework by AI Warning Service preferably in conjunction with monitoring system, the advantage of machine learning algorithm processing complex data and precise classification is utilized simultaneously, on the basis of the hazard assessment of risk source and monitoring object are evaluated, the data of each monitoring object of real-time monitoring, a series of grade for varying strength geological disasters that certain period may occur in predicted area of danger, the characteristics of for different risk areas, proposes the every countermeasure reduced risks, and provides aid decision for Geological Hazards Monitoring early warning.
assignees: SHENZHEN MUNICIPAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY;SHENZHEN ADDRESS CONSTRUCTION ENG COMPANY

title_en: Random sequential inversion method for permeability coefficient of embankment body material
abstract_en: A random sequential inversion method for permeability coefficient of dyke body material includes such steps as designing the sections according to the flood-fighting requirement and the structural characteristics of dyke, setting up the monitor sections at equal intervals, and arranging several vertical-tube osmometers. According to the uncertainty of the permeability coefficient of the embankment material, a hydraulics or finite element method is used for carrying out embankment seepage analysis, a functional relation among the water level of a monitoring point, a seepage line and the permeability coefficient of the material is established, random sequential inversion analysis is carried out on the permeability coefficient of the embankment material based on a maximum likelihood estimation method, random sequential inversion analysis is carried out on the permeability coefficient of the embankment material by utilizing monitoring data measured from different positions at different moments, the permeability coefficient value of the embankment material is accurately determined, and flood fighting and early warning are carried out by setting a permeability coefficient threshold value. The invention not only is beneficial to finding out the problem of the dike in time, but also can guide dike management personnel to pertinently carry out flood control and emergency rescue work.

title_en: Visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power risk, and particularly relates to a visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a geographic sampling module, a probability evaluation module, an asset statistics module and a risk output module. According to the scheme, a GIS technology is adopted to analyze a flood disaster graph, the failure risk probability of the electric power asset and the potential influence thereof are quantized, and a process for monetizing and visualizing the generated risk results is established; the method comprises the steps of creating a cloud-shaped sampling point which is uniformly distributed in an influence area of each power distribution cabinet, generating a position of a sampling shape by using a Monte Carlo simulation method, randomly shifting the position of the cloud-shaped sampling point, and simulating the uncertainty of the position by using a fuzzy boundary; by means of the vulnerability profile without safeguarding or improvement measures, the losses or the extent of impact suffered by the electrical installation are evaluated in order to operate more robustly in the face of threats.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning improved algorithm for cold source disaster-induced disaster prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning improved algorithm for cold source disaster causing disaster prediction, which comprises the following steps: carrying out statistical classification on factors affecting disaster-causing disaster of cold source, and carrying out normalization processing on multi-source heterogeneous data by using a data normalization function to obtain grouped sample data; establishing a deep belief network, adopting a momentum learning rate-based deep belief network improvement algorithm, and combining a plurality of groups of sample data to perform repeated iterative training of model parameters so as to obtain a mapping relation determined between input and output of the deep belief network; and predicting the disaster grade of the cold source disaster causing object. According to the invention, by adopting an improved algorithm of deep learning, the network learning efficiency is effectively improved, the error convergence rate of prediction is reduced, and the problem of prediction of marine disaster caused by non-linearity, time variability and uncertainty is well solved.

title_en: Offshore wind power and power transmission network collaborative planning method considering typhoon disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative planning method of offshore wind power and a power transmission network considering the influence of typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a multi-scene distribution robust uncertainty set of the output of an offshore wind power plant and the faults of a power transmission line; establishing an objective function and constraint conditions of the initial model, and introducing short-term source-network-load measures into the initial model to obtain a final collaborative planning model for realizing collaborative planning of the offshore wind power and the power transmission network considering the influence of typhoon disasters. According to the invention, a multi-scene distribution robust model considering typhoon extreme disasters is established for the problem of collaborative planning of the offshore wind power and the power transmission network, multiple uncertainties of output of the offshore wind power plant and faults of the power transmission line in a normal scene and the typhoon extreme disasters are comprehensively considered, and the elasticity of a high-proportion new energy power system is improved.

title_en: Coverage path planning method of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles in dam abnormal environment inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coverage path planning method of a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in dam abnormal environment inspection, which is characterized in that firstly, an abnormal environment, namely a dam area after a disaster occurs, is defined, secondly, the coverage path planning problem of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in dam abnormal environment inspection is defined as an optimization problem, the optimization targets are coverage rate and energy consumption of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in the abnormal environment respectively, and a model design is that a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model based on DRL is constructed according to the optimization problem defined in the previous step, and the parameters of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model are updated and the performance of the model is evaluated. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of good practicability and the like.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for searching mountain-climbing distress people by using computer vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for searching mountain-climbing distress people by using computer vision, which comprises the following steps: firstly, reading videos or pictures in a search and rescue area; secondly, setting a pixel value occupied by the target object in the picture and a color range of the target object; thirdly, determining a convolution kernel matrix; processing all pixel points of the picture in the search and rescue area into a RGB matrix of a two-dimensional array, and then performing binarization processing on the colors of all the pixel points of the picture to obtain a color binarization matrix; and fourthly, performing convolution operation on the convolution kernel matrix and the color binarization matrix to obtain a convolution processing matrix. The method analyzes and processes the distant view picture or video of the search area by using computer vision on the basis that the search and rescue personnel take a picture or a video of the search area from a remote place or an aircraft, and identifies and marks the position of a possible missing person. The invention also discloses a system for searching mountain-climbing distress people by using computer vision.

title_en: Multi-source precipitation data fusion method based on mathematical uncertainty analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource precipitation data fusion method based on mathematical uncertainty analysis, which comprises the following steps: s1, unifying space-time resolution of precipitation data; s2, correcting systematic deviation of precipitation data; s3, constructing an error matrix of the multi-source precipitation data; s4, multi-source precipitation self-adaptive fusion; s5, correcting the weather classification errors of the fusion precipitation data set; s6, precipitation fusion data post-processing. The method and the device furthest overcome the dependence of multi-source precipitation data on ground observation in the uncertainty analysis and fusion process, perfects the precipitation fusion technology of a sparse area of a ground observation station, improves the fusion stability of the multi-source precipitation data in a large space range, remarkably reduces the false alarm rate of precipitation events, avoids the problem of overfitting of satellite data noise, finally obtains more accurate and reliable large-range precipitation data products, and provides powerful support for further improving the regional water resource management and natural disaster early warning and monitoring capability.

title_en: Network updating method for post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency management and discloses a network updating method of a post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data, which comprises the steps of converting acquired heterogeneous data into basic probability distribution of observation evidence; the method comprises the steps of predicting a physical field state based on a physical process simulator, generating basic probability distribution of prediction evidence, fusing the two to obtain posterior basic probability distribution, deciding and updating a road map network state according to the posterior basic probability distribution, and feeding the updated state back to the simulator as a dynamic boundary condition to form bidirectional coupling of the physical simulation and the road map state. According to the application, by constructing the simulation assimilation framework of the bidirectional coupling, the technical problems of physical simulation and infrastructure state fracture in the traditional method are solved, the uncertainty of data is effectively processed by utilizing the evidence theory, and the authenticity of disaster evolution prediction and the reliability of road state update are improved.

title_en: Unmanned cluster biology heuristic collaborative crowd-sensing method for disaster search
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned cluster biology heuristic collaborative crowd-sensing method for disaster search, which comprises the steps of firstly, designing an improved YOLOv target detection model, combining a smoke feature guiding and local relation modeling module, enhancing the smoke target recognition capability, and constructing a dynamic fire event detection and positioning mechanism through multi-source sensor information fusion. Secondly, aiming at a multi-ignition disaster scene, respectively constructing a distributed ant colony collaborative search model based on a pheromone triplet, and introducing a exploration and convergence desire function to form a real-time dynamic intelligent decision mechanism. The invention not only improves the fire identification precision and response efficiency, but also improves the coverage rate of the search area and the resource scheduling efficiency.

title_en: Transient electromagnetic and seismic wave multi-mode joint inversion imaging method based on physical information transducer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transient electromagnetic and seismic wave multi-modal joint inversion imaging method based on physical information transducer, belonging to the field of geophysical exploration and artificial intelligence intersection. The method comprises the steps of performing anomaly detection, interpolation, filtering and normalization preprocessing on transient electromagnetic and seismic wave original data, extracting characteristics representing electrical property, elasticity and cross physical significance, serializing space data through a meshing and alternating fusion strategy, constructing enhanced codes fusing absolute, relative positions and physical properties, designing a physically constrained encoder-decoder architecture to perform multi-scale forward modeling-inversion, and quantifying uncertainty of inversion results by adopting a Bayesian Monte Carlo method to generate a confidence map. According to the invention, through the physical rule driving and multi-mode depth complementation fusion, the fine recognition capability and interpretation reliability of hidden disaster-causing geologic bodies such as underground goafs and collapse columns are effectively improved while the physical consistency of data is maintained.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;CHONGQING HUIKAN INDUSTRIAL TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Ground-air combined collaborative search and rescue method based on robot group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground-air combined collaborative search and rescue method based on a robot group, which comprises the following steps: step S1, determining a plurality of search areas on the search and rescue route; step S2, the ground search and rescue robot group is carried out along the search and rescue route, and the corresponding search areas are searched in sequence; the suspected search area is determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the suspected search area has better search value than the preset search value, the left search and rescue robot can continue to perform search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area so as to improve the search and rescue success rate, and after a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supplying robot collaborates with the left search and rescue robot to reach the target position together, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved and the effective search and rescue time is strived for to the maximum extent through the collaborative work of a large number of robots at the target position.

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair electricity method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, considering the uncertainty of the output of wind-light power generation during typhoon disasters, and predicting the power generation of wind power and photovoltaic by using a phase space reconstruction and Stacking integrated model; secondly, using pumped storage as a black start power supply, and establishing a mixed integer linear programming model of emergency power generation vehicles, gas generators, hydrogen fuel cells, wind-solar storage and other distributed power supplies participating in power distribution network rush repair scheduling and fault recovery; and solving by using a CPLEX solver to obtain scheduling strategies of the rush-repair teams and the emergency power generation cars under different scenes, and analyzing the influence of the output of each device on the power distribution network. The invention can accurately predict the output of the wind-light power generation equipment when key information such as meteorological environment is lost, greatly improves the power distribution network re-electricity efficiency under typhoon disasters, and effectively reduces the loss caused by power failure.

title_en: Emergency material distribution and allocation method considering demand prediction and risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency material distribution and allocation method considering demand prediction and risk assessment, which comprises the following steps: based on an artificial intelligent prediction method, a gray model and a regression method, an emergency material demand prediction model is established, and emergency material demand and demand urgency degree of each disaster area are predicted according to disaster information and historical data, so that scientific basis is provided for material distribution. According to the invention, a plurality of sub-models are built to form a complete emergency material distribution and allocation model, and solution calculation is carried out on the emergency material distribution and allocation optimization model based on the sub-models, so that a decision scheme of material distribution and allocation can be dynamically adjusted according to disaster information, material information and the like, thereby realizing efficient utilization and distribution of emergency materials, and solving the problems that the prior art cannot timely respond to the change of demand of disaster areas, cannot effectively cope with uncertainty and risk of a supply chain and cannot balance a plurality of distribution targets and constraint conditions.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Pre-disaster deployment method for mobile power supply of multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster deployment method for a mobile power supply of a multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a pre-disaster deployment frame of the mobile power supply of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on regional mutual assistance in consideration of trans-regional supporting potential of the mobile power supply, 2) establishing a pre-disaster emergency response model in consideration of distributed power supply and network reconstruction cooperative scheduling based on the pre-disaster deployment frame of the mobile power supply of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system, and 3) solving the pre-disaster emergency response model in consideration of the distributed power supply and network reconstruction cooperative scheduling by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning network to obtain a pre-disaster deployment decision of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system. The method can fully consider the trans-regional supporting potential of the mobile power supply, fully describe uncertainty of multi-region faults on the premise of guaranteeing solving efficiency, and improve elasticity of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Virtual earthquake disaster scene optimization method based on earthquake rescue virtual drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual earthquake disaster scene optimization method based on an earthquake rescue virtual drilling system, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a primary model; step 2, respectively establishing a macro disaster area model, a search area model and an operation field model according to the primary model by three layers of different detail degrees, wherein the different detail degree models correspond to different drilling tasks, and the earthquake rescue virtual drilling system comprises: an earthquake rescue drilling scene setting subsystem; an earthquake rescue drilling simulation subsystem; an earthquake rescue drilling efficiency evaluation subsystem; the step 1 comprises the following steps: establishing a seismic motion model and simulation according to the earthquake occurrence principle; building damage models and simulation are built according to the intensity and the building earthquake-resistant structure principle; according to the behavioral principle of the emergency, a disaster victim behavior model and simulation are established; establishing a secondary disaster model and simulation according to the earthquake secondary disaster theory; and establishing a department collaborative rescue model and simulation according to the actual earthquake rescue emergency plan.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;XINXING CATHAY INT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Helicopter deployment method for multiple types of areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a helicopter deployment method in a multi-type area, which comprises the following steps: the first step is as follows: regulating the search area into a search graph with a regular shape; a second step; calculating the maximum hovering times of each fluctuation of a single helicopter; the third step: taking the search range of a single helicopter as a reference circle, filling a plurality of reference circle arrays into a search graph formed in the first step, and calculating the number of frames of the helicopter which need to be deployed and the number of waves of the helicopter which need to be launched for a single wave according to the array types of the plurality of reference circles; and fourthly, planning and generating a search path of the single-wave helicopter according to the number of the helicopters which need to be deployed in the single-wave mode. The invention aims to provide a deployment method for orderly and efficiently deploying a plurality of helicopters for search and rescue in a multi-type area.
assignees: THE 28TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improving method based on source network load multi-resource cooperation in ice disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention develops a method for improving the toughness of a power distribution network by the cooperation of multiple sources of a source network and multiple sources under an ice disaster scene; the influence of ice disaster weather on the power distribution network lines, distributed generators and residential loads is considered, the distribution network line reinforcement, liquefied natural gas capacity allocation and maintenance team allocation schemes are formulated in the pre-disaster stage aiming at the resource differentiation requirements of system prevention, response and recovery, and the load loss is minimized through unit output scheduling, power distribution network reconstruction, maintenance team scheduling maintenance and toughness improvement strategies of differentiated cut loads during disasters. And establishing a two-stage mixed integer random programming model of the multi-fault scene based on the proposed strategy, solving the problem by adopting a Gaussian-Saidel method based on punishment so as to improve the calculation efficiency, and adopting a robust optimization method to treat the uncertainty of wind and light output. The method can improve the power supply effect of the key load of the power distribution network in the ice disaster period, and the load loss can be effectively reduced by the cooperation of multiple resources.

title_en: Expert knowledge-fused power transmission line environment risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power transmission line risk assessment, and particularly relates to a power transmission line environment risk assessment method integrating expert knowledge. In the data acquisition stage, the invention integrates the influence of multiple data sources and multiple factors on the environmental risk of the power transmission line, and provides a multi-metadata basis for risk assessment. Then, combining expert knowledge and fuzzy mathematics, constructing a multi-risk multi-dimensional disaster-causing factor knowledge base and a multi-dimensional disaster-causing factor membership function knowledge base, achieving the purpose of multi-disaster environment risk assessment of the power transmission line, and improving the universality of the method. Finally, a calculation method for carrying out multi-risk assessment based on a multi-risk multi-dimensional disaster causing factor knowledge base and a multi-dimensional disaster causing factor membership function knowledge base is provided, wherein the calculation method comprises BPA calculation, multi-source evidence fusion, risk probability generation and the like, so that the quantitative assessment of the power transmission line risk is realized, the uncertainty of input data and an assessment result can be flexibly processed, and the stability of the risk assessment is improved.

title_en: Probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on logic tree method
abstract_en: The application relates to a probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on a logic tree method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an area to be analyzed for the probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method; respectively determining an earthquake tsunami source and a high-precision terrain file according to the area to be analyzed; constructing a parameter logic tree according to the first parameter set and the second parameter set corresponding to the earthquake tsunami source; calculating according to the high-precision terrain file and using a tsunami numerical model to determine a tsunami maximum wave height file; and determining the wave height exceeding probability at each pixel point of the area to be analyzed according to a logic tree method formed by the parameter logic tree, and a plurality of maximum wave height files which are combined and calculated in a probabilistic manner. The probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on the logic tree method can reduce the uncertainty of analysis and obviously reduce occupied computing resources.

title_en: Chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method based on multi-disaster real-time coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method based on multi-disaster real-time coupling, introduces a Monte Carlo analysis method and solves the problem of uncertainty of setting of a model probability parameter. By effective integration of the Monte Carlo analysis method and a risk distance calculation method, a chemical industry park site selection risk protection distance is initially determined. According to an environmental risk system principle, by combining characteristics of the chemical industry, a chemical industry park enterprise comprehensive risk assessment index system based on inherent risks of a risk source, effectiveness of a prevention and control mechanism and vulnerability of a receptor is constructed. A catastrophe rating method is introduced to assess an environmental risk comprehensive level, a chemical industry enterprise environmental risk comprehensive assessment method based on a catastrophe principle is proposed, and comprehensive assessment grades are divided into five grade levels so as to discriminate a comprehensive risk level of a chemical industry park enterprise and timely take emergency response strategies. According to the chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method disclosed by the invention, planning evaluation and risk management of a chemical industry park can be implemented, and a risk prevention ability and a risk management level of the chemical industry park can be improved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based drainage basin intelligent flood control scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based watershed intelligent flood control scheduling method and a digital twinning-based watershed intelligent flood control scheduling system, which relate to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction and comprise the steps of collecting static data and dynamic data of a watershed, constructing a hydrohydrodynamic coupling model based on the static data and the dynamic data to form a watershed digital twinning body, inputting a received numerical weather forecast into the watershed digital twinning body to simulate, generating various flood evolution scenes in a future period, calculating a dynamic flood risk probability map, constructing a simulation training environment by utilizing historical flood data and high-precision watershed digital twinning body, performing offline training on a scheduling strategy network in the simulation training environment based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, and outputting a scheduling strategy network with the training completion of a scheduling instruction according to a real-time watershed state. The invention effectively solves the core problems of insufficient timeliness of decision making and weak self-adaptation capability in an uncertainty environment in the traditional method.

title_en: Ground-air combined collaborative search and rescue method based on robot group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground-air combined collaborative search and rescue method based on a robot group, which comprises the following steps: step S1, determining a plurality of search areas on the search and rescue route; step S2, the ground search and rescue robot group is carried out along the search and rescue route, and the corresponding search areas are searched in sequence; the suspected search area is determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the suspected search area has better search value than the preset search value, the left search and rescue robot can continue to perform search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area so as to improve the search and rescue success rate, and after a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supplying robot collaborates with the left search and rescue robot to reach the target position together, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved and the effective search and rescue time is strived for to the maximum extent through the collaborative work of a large number of robots at the target position.

title_en: Rainfall estimation method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a rainfall estimation method based on multi-source information fusion, which comprises the following steps: combining the rainfall data observed by the ground station in the research area with the rainfall data of the multisource satellite in the research area to form a multisource data set of the research area; establishing a Bayesian rainfall prediction model of a research area based on a dynamic Bayesian theory; solving a nonlinear optimal solution of a Bayesian rainfall prediction model by using a maximum entropy method, and further determining optimal weight and uncertainty information of each satellite data source; and generating an estimation result of the rainfall amount of the multi-source information fusion applied in the research area based on the optimal weight and uncertainty of the satellite data source. Has the advantages that: according to the method, the result of fusion analysis of multiple data sources reduces the uncertainty of regional rainfall estimation caused by the inaccuracy of a single rainfall information; the method provides more reliable data input and richer and more refined modeling data for strengthening regional high-precision disaster early warning, avoiding flood risks or estimating torrential rain and flood in a small watershed.

title_en: Safety belt hanger on disconnecting link and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety belt hanger on a disconnecting link, relates to the technical field of safety protection, and comprises a supporting rod and a base. The support rod is provided with a plurality of hooks near the top end, and the hooks are used for hanging safety belts and accord with the principle of high hanging support. Install pressure sensor on the couple, pressure sensor detects the pressure sudden change when the operating personnel fall, makes alarm device action, reminds rescue personnel here to take place the accident of falling, has saved rescue time. The base is the shape of falling U, and the base includes roof, inboard baffle, outside baffle and guide rail. The guide rails are arranged, so that the inner side baffle can move in the installation process. The invention adopts double fixing modes of bolt fixing and baffle plate moving fixing, so that the invention is safe and reliable. The pressure sensor is arranged on the inner side baffle plate, so that the force for extruding the channel steel can be digitalized and visualized, and the uncertainty caused by artificially and subjectively judging the fastening degree is avoided.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ZOUCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for analyzing instability risk of bedding slope containing weak interlayer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering slope instability risk analysis, in particular to a method, equipment and medium for analyzing instability risk of a soft interlayer-containing bedding slope. According to the technical scheme, the complex and uncertain slope engineering problem is converted into a computable and inferable probability map model. The full life cycle disaster control factors from natural conditions, geological conditions, engineering design, construction and operation maintenance are systematically combed, the omission of key factors is avoided, and the comprehensiveness of risk analysis is ensured. The traditional qualitative causal analysis is upgraded to quantitative probability dependency relationship, and a mathematical model foundation is provided for subsequent risk diagnosis and prediction. The crossing of risk analysis from "static evaluation" to "dynamic reasoning" is achieved. The model not only can give a static risk value, but also can dynamically update the probability of all relevant variables after new evidence (such as monitoring data) is obtained, thereby realizing intelligent diagnosis and prediction.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.
assignees: SOLVIT SYSTEM CO LTD;BIG & DEEP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster risk assessment method for long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake of reticulated shell structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-disaster risk assessment of a reticulated shell structure, and particularly provides a method for assessing long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake multi-disaster risk of the reticulated shell structure. The method mainly comprises the steps of generating long-term wind load conforming to the local historical climate rule of the structure, evaluating fatigue damage and performance degradation degree of the latticed shell structure under the action of the long-term wind load, and calculating multi-disaster risk of the latticed shell structure under the action of long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake. The method solves the problem that the limitations of long-term wind induced fatigue and wind direction randomness are not considered in the existing multi-disaster analysis technology. In addition, uncertainty of structural materials, uncertainty of earthquake motion and fitting model errors are considered through a statistical method, and an exponential equation is utilized to establish a multi-disaster probability demand model, so that a multi-disaster risk assessment result of the reticulated shell structure is more accurate.

title_en: Power grid disaster real-time regulating and control device and method based on intuition fuzzy rough set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster real-time regulating and control device and method based on an intuition fuzzy rough set. The method includes the steps that historical disaster data in a database unit are called; the collected historical disaster data are reduced through the method based on the intuition fuzzy rough set, and then disaster grade evaluation rules of a power grid are obtained; disaster data of the power grid are collected in real time, and the current disaster grade of the power grid is determined according to the formed historical disaster grade evaluation rules; the data which are evaluated in real time are updated to a historical database and used for addition and modification of a power grid disaster knowledge base; power grid disaster emergency responses are conducted, namely, corresponding emergency restoration measures are taken according to different disaster grades to regulate and control the power grid. According to the system and method, the situation that the data size used in the power grid disaster evaluation process has fuzziness, randomness, uncertainty, redundancy and other characteristics is taken into account, the defect that internal relations and potential relations of data attributes can not be acquired through a traditional probability theory and other method is successfully overcome by the utilization of the method based on the intuition fuzzy rough set, and evaluation accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Beidou-based power emergency rescue scheduling method, device and command system
abstract_en: The application discloses electric power emergency rescue dispatching method, device and command system based on Beidou, the scheme of the application determines an emergency search area based on accident position information, searches front-end equipment in the emergency search area, then acquires position information of the front-end equipment at different time points, determines that a relative movement state between the front-end equipment and an accident position is close to or far away from, and determines that the front-end equipment which can reach the accident site faster is used as target front-end equipment according to second position information and relative movement state of different front-end equipment so as to issue an emergency rescue command to the target front-end equipment, thereby solving the technical problems of long emergency rescue dispatching time and low emergency repair efficiency of an electric power system.
assignees: ZHANJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for determining importance degree of nodes in power supply network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply networks and discloses a method, a device and electronic equipment for determining the importance of nodes in a power supply network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a basic path set between a power supply node and a demand node in a Markov random field model; determining the length weight and the reliability weight of each path according to the length of each path in the basic path set and the importance of the nodes in each path; the importance of the nodes in the power supply network is determined based on the length weight and the reliability weight. According to the determining method, the power supply system is modeled in a probability map mode, the importance of the nodes in the power supply network is determined based on the length weighting and the reliability weighting, the problems of data acquisition, pre-disaster emergency preparation and the like can be effectively solved, relevant departments can be supported to pertinently arrange the monitoring nodes under different budget standards, and the state sensing tasks of low cost, high precision and large range of the power supply network under extreme disasters are realized.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on deep forest
abstract_en: The invention provides a SAR image change detection method based on a deep forest, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art cannot fully obtain useful information from local image blocks, and the detection precision is poor due to the loss of information of edge parts of images. The implementation steps comprise: acquiring an initial SAR image change detection diagram; optimizing the deep forest model; acquiring a training sample data set; acquiring an initial category probability map P; calculating a gradient magnitude graph G and a gradient directional diagram M of the difference graph D; acquiring a final class probability map P2; and acquiring a final SAR image change detection diagram. The optimized deep forest model is used, the input of the model is multi-scale image input, and a final classification probability map is obtained after a gradient amplitude map and a gradient directional diagram of a difference map are calculated, so that the SAR image change detection precision is improved, and the SAR image change detection method can be used in the related fields of SAR image change detection such as environment monitoring, agricultural investigation, disaster relief work and the like.

title_en: Spacecraft debris search and rescue identification tracking method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network-based spacecraft debris search, rescue, identification and tracking method, which comprises the steps of determining a theoretical landing point of a falling spacecraft debris, planning a search area, controlling the aircraft to go to the search area, controlling the aircraft to move towards the actual landing point of the spacecraft debris, shooting images in real time in the moving process, carrying out real-time identification and detection on the acquired images by utilizing a multi-scale image neural network model, determining whether the spacecraft debris exists in the images, adjusting the running direction of the aircraft in real time according to the position of a detection target in the images, controlling the aircraft to move above the detection target, determining whether the confidence of a current detection result is larger than a preset threshold, determining whether the detection target is the spacecraft debris, leveling the camera of the aircraft if the detection target is not the spacecraft debris, and continuing controlling the movement of the aircraft. The invention can realize the quick search of the spacecraft remains, effectively reduce the search range and improve the search efficiency.

title_en: Power network fault recovery dynamic decision method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power network fault recovery dynamic decision method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting the structure and disaster damage information of a power network, evaluating the damage probability of a line, establishing a part of observable Markov decision process model for power network fault recovery under the uncertainty of damage evaluation, then constructing an actor-commentator framework for solving the power network fault dynamic recovery strategy, then training an intelligent body by using a near-end strategy optimization method in an offline training stage, and finally outputting an optimal power network fault inspection and recovery strategy based on the power network damage condition in an online decision stage. The method can effectively solve the dynamic decision of the power network recovery under the uncertainty of disaster damage evaluation, furthest improve the power network fault recovery efficiency and reduce the influence of disaster events.
assignees: STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UESTC

title_en: Robust positioning method based on maximum entropy principle and used for cooperation of multiple submarines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robust positioning method based on maximum entropy principle and used for cooperation of multiple submarines, and relates to the field of underwater positioning. The invention designs a particle characterization method of the relative position information of a submersible based on a particle-implemented submersible position prediction method based on the principle of maximum entropy. The potential device uses self position prediction and relative position representation between the potential device and the adjacent position to calculate the edge probability distribution of the position, and the estimated value of the self position is obtained in real time through a minimum mean square error estimator. Aiming at a severe underwater environment with complex dynamic time-varying and noise interference, the invention improves the stability and the persistence of the position estimation output by weakening the sensitivity of the positioning process of the submersible vehicle to uncertainty. The method can be directly applied to key applications such as sea area safety monitoring, sea information acquisition, underwater search and rescue and the like, and can provide high-efficiency and stable position estimation for the submersible vehicle.

title_en: Fire anti-interference detection method and system for wind power cabin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire disaster early warning of wind power cabins, in particular to a fire disaster anti-interference detection method and system for a wind power cabin. The invention discloses a fire anti-interference detection method for a wind power cabin, which comprises the steps of selecting a temperature-sensing fire detector and a smoke-sensing fire detector for signal detection; the temperature-sensing fire detector alarms according to the temperature alarm or the temperature change rate, and effectively adapts to the uncertainty influence of the environmental temperature change on the temperature alarm threshold; the smoke-sensing fire detector alarms according to the smoke self-adaptive threshold, and the smoke self-adaptive threshold is adjusted by processing related parameters, so that the smoke-sensing fire detector outputs a higher value under the condition of interference and outputs a lower value under the condition of open fire and smoldering, the detection sensitivity and anti-interference performance are improved, and the interference influence is reduced. The fire anti-interference detection method and system for the wind power cabin solve the problem that the influence of an interference source cannot be eliminated.
assignees: HUADIAN FUXIN ANHUI NEW ENERGY CO LTD;ANHUI ZHONGKE HENGAN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source precipitation fusion method based on context error modeling and uncertainty optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source precipitation fusion method based on Context error modeling and uncertainty optimization, which comprises the steps of preprocessing heterogeneous precipitation data, constructing an enhanced error data set containing multi-dimensional environment Context characteristics, carrying out fine modeling on joint probability distribution of the data set by using Context-Aware GMM, carrying out quantitative evaluation on condition deviation and condition variance of each data source under the current Context condition based on the Context-Aware GMM, adopting an uncertainty optimization-oriented strategy, generating optimal fusion weight, simultaneously carrying out condition deviation correction, carrying out space-time weighted fusion on the multi-source data according to dynamic weight, and generating a high-precision and high-space-time resolution precipitation grid product through spatial interpolation. The invention obviously improves the accuracy, robustness and space-time resolution of precipitation monitoring, and provides more reliable data support for refined weather forecast, disaster early warning and water resource management.

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present specification is to provide an apparatus and method for generating information about an area in which a search for a subject to be rescued may be effectively performed by means of radio wave analysis. The apparatus for generating search area information, according to the present specification, may: identify a reference base station, which is last connected to a mobile communication terminal, from information about histories of the mobile communication terminal that has accessed base stations; and select as a search area by means of information about analysis of coverage of the reference base station. The apparatus for generating search area information, according to the present specification, may exclude unnecessary search areas or select areas requiring preferential searches by generating information about an area in which a subject to be rescued is likely to be present, rather than searching the entire signal reachable range of a base station.
abstract_ko: 】 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.

title_en: Distributed multi-agent cooperative full-coverage path planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed multi-agent cooperative full-coverage path planning method which can realize the full coverage of an unknown environment area containing obstacles and improve the cooperative coverage effect. The method provided by the invention considers various complex constraint conditions such as intelligent body obstacle avoidance and collision avoidance, limited energy supply, limited communication range and the like aiming at unknown environment conditions such as underwater detection, post-earthquake rescue and the like, adopts a distributed multi-intelligent body organization structure, utilizes a heuristic motion planning strategy, and carries out motion path planning by combining information obtained by two ways of self perception and mutual communication, can avoid the conflict of the same covering path points among intelligent bodies, realizes efficient cooperation, reduces traversal overlapping degree, improves path planning efficiency, has good real-time property, expansibility and robustness, and provides an effective solution for the multi-intelligent body to cooperatively complete a full covering task under the unknown environment.

title_en: Ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG (HOG) features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG features, relates to the technical field of ground standby target classification identification, and particularly aims to solve the problems that classical HOG features in the background art do not have rotation invariance and feature dimension is too high, and provides the ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG features, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a target image and an interference background to form a sample training set; extracting a rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG feature map of a sample training set, and using the feature map for training a classifier; and classifying the target real-time rotation invariant dimension-reducing HOG feature map by using a classifier to obtain the classification identification of the real-time ground standby target. The method has the advantages of describing infrared images with fewer textures and adapting to uncertainty of a standby target visual angle, indirectly reducing the requirement on visual angle transformation training samples, avoiding the SVM classifier from falling into dimension disasters, and improving classification recognition efficiency.

title_en: Building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on deep learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic data and historical storm time sequence data of a research area; s2, processing the data; s3, constructing an FFC model based on a deep learning algorithm, training and verifying the FFC model, optimizing the affected building attention coefficient to obtain the optimal affected building attention coefficient for each building type, and testing the performance of the FFC model; s4, inputting the forecast rainfall time sequence into the FFC model tested for each building type, and performing repeated rolling iteration prediction to obtain probability distribution results of different functions of each building in a certain time range in the future of the research area. The obtained building function probability distribution result is beneficial to providing more information and uncertainty quantification for decision-making of decision-makers, thereby providing a good basis for the determination of the subsequent evacuation requirements.

title_en: Slope support stability prediction method and system based on remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing geological prediction, in particular to a method and a system for predicting the stability of side slope support based on remote sensing data, which are characterized in that a target side slope region multispectral remote sensing image is obtained, a vegetation mask is generated by utilizing a normalized vegetation index, interference pixels of a vegetation coverage region are eliminated by combining morphological filtering and connected region analysis, then the characteristics of a support structure are identified by an improved edge detection algorithm, an influence region is defined by adopting a region growing algorithm based on machine learning, the regional image is input into a convolutional neural network model, a deformation probability map is output by a data enhancement technology and a weight optimization layer, finally, a threshold value is determined according to historical data, slope support stability categories are divided by combining space neighborhood information and a voting mechanism, vegetation interference is effectively eliminated, a support structure is accurately identified, prediction precision is improved, slope support stability can be timely and accurately judged, and a reliable basis is provided for slope disaster early warning and protection.
assignees: MAOMING CITY TRANSP DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD;GUANGDONG DINGTU CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;GUANGDONG PROVINCE COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING & DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle mechanical arm tail end pose control method for multi-source interference
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling the pose of the tail end of a mechanical arm of an unmanned aerial vehicle aiming at multi-source interference, and aims to realize high-precision control of the tail end of a special unmanned aerial vehicle system under the condition of multi-source interference. Firstly, establishing a multi-source interference model of a special unmanned aerial vehicle mechanical arm end pose control system, and secondly, designing a robust H-infinity controller aiming at a system nominal model; then designing a disturbance observer aiming at the multisource disturbance, and estimating and compensating the external disturbance and the model uncertainty; and finally, high-precision control of the pose of the tail end of the mechanical arm is ensured by reasonably selecting parameters of the robust H-infinity controller and the disturbance observer. The invention is based on a composite layered anti-interference control framework, realizes high-precision pose control of the tail end of the mechanical arm of a special unmanned aerial vehicle system under multi-source interference, and is suitable for special tasks such as emergency rescue, non-cooperative target capture in narrow space and the like.

title_en: Method and device for calculating surging probability of random sampling and storage device
abstract_en: The application provides a calculation method of surging and overtaking probability of random sampling, which comprises the following steps: according to a target area, a numerical model is built, a landslide parameter value range of the target area is analyzed, landslide input parameters required by building the numerical model are processed, and random variables are generated. And carrying out Latin hypercube sampling according to the random variable to generate a random sample, inputting the random sample into the numerical model, extracting the surge propagation height corresponding to the random variable, determining a surge propagation height threshold according to a disaster-stricken body of the target area, and calculating the overrun probability of the surge propagation height exceeding the surge propagation height threshold. The random samples are generated by Latin hypercube sampling of the selected random variables, and then are processed by a model, so that the overrun probability that the surge propagation distance exceeds the threshold height is calculated, the uncertainty of landslide input parameters is quantized, and the accuracy of landslide-surge disaster prediction is improved.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system toughness improving method considering road network traffic uncertainty
abstract_en: A comprehensive energy system toughness improving method considering road network traffic uncertainty belongs to the technical field of safety planning operation of electric power systems, and comprises the steps of constructing a dual uncertainty model comprising wind power output uncertainty, photovoltaic output uncertainty and traffic road network traffic uncertainty, adopting a two-stage robust optimization method to conduct pre-disaster resource deployment decision-making based on the dual uncertainty model, wherein the resources comprise fixed electricity-hydrogen-storage resources and mobile hydrogen energy resources, and dynamically adjusting scheduling and operation strategies of the mobile hydrogen energy resources by adopting a model prediction control MPC rolling optimization method based on pre-disaster resource deployment decision-making results and system state information acquired in real time in the disaster occurrence process. According to the invention, the fixed and mobile electricity-hydrogen storage resources are cooperatively scheduled, so that the optimal configuration of the pre-disaster hydrogen energy resources and the dynamic response of the mobile hydrogen energy in the disaster are realized, and the survival and recovery capacity of the system under extreme weather events are obviously enhanced.

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improving method based on source network load multi-resource cooperation in ice disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention develops a method for improving the toughness of a power distribution network by combining multiple source networks and multiple loads under an ice disaster scene, considers the influence of ice disaster weather on power distribution network lines, distributed generators and residential loads, aims at resource differentiation requirements of system prevention, response and recovery, formulates a distribution network line reinforcement, liquefied natural gas capacity configuration and maintenance team configuration scheme at a pre-disaster stage, and minimizes load loss through unit output dispatching, power distribution network reconstruction, maintenance team dispatching maintenance and differential load-shedding toughness improvement strategies during disasters. And establishing a two-stage mixed integer random programming model of the multi-fault scene based on the proposed strategy, solving the problem by adopting a Gaussian-Saidel method based on punishment so as to improve the calculation efficiency, and adopting a robust optimization method to treat the uncertainty of wind and light output. The method can improve the power supply effect of the key load of the power distribution network in the ice disaster period, and the load loss can be effectively reduced by the cooperation of multiple resources.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on a time sequence, and relates to the technical field of information perception and recognition. The unmanned plane heading determining method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining ship navigation data in real time, recording comparison sequences of different moments and positions, predicting possible positions and headings of ships after AIS (automatic identification system) tracks of the ships disappear for a period of time based on a time sequence analysis model, and then calculating unmanned plane heading determining methods when the ship can search areas based on different navigational speeds based on searching meeting points. According to the invention, under the condition that the current ship position information cannot be acquired, the unmanned aerial vehicle is required to be dispatched to search and rescue the ship, the course of the unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescue is calculated and determined after a period of interruption based on a time sequence method, and engineering realization and application are easy.

title_en: Terrain-based path search method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a path search method, in particular to a terrain-based path search method, which belongs to the field of GIS (Geographic Information System) navigation methods and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: expressing a search area as a passage cost figure which consists of a plurality of passage units and contains passage cost information, and then, generating a passage path with the least cost which is formed by connecting passage unit sides in series according to the passage cost figure. Therefore, the capacity of searching for a known and an unknown path quickly can be realized with lower cost; specific equipment support is not required; the technical difficulty is lower, so that the cost can be effectively reduced in the activities of emergency command, field search and rescue and the like, and the cost performance is higher.

title_en: Distributed multi-agent cooperative full coverage path planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed multi-agent cooperative full coverage path planning method which can realize full coverage of an unknown environment area containing obstacles and improve the cooperative coverage effect. The method provided by the invention considers various complex constraint conditions such as obstacle avoidance and collision avoidance of the intelligent bodies, limited energy supply, limited communication range and the like aiming at unknown environment conditions such as underwater detection, post-earthquake rescue and the like, adopts a distributed multi-intelligent-body organization structure, utilizes a heuristic motion planning strategy, and combines information obtained by two ways of self perception and mutual communication to plan the motion path, so that the conflict that the covered path points among the intelligent bodies are the same can be avoided, the efficient cooperation is realized, the traversal overlapping degree is reduced, the path planning efficiency is improved, the method has good real-time performance, expansibility and robustness, and an effective solution is provided for the multi-intelligent-body cooperation to complete the full-coverage task under the unknown environment.
assignees: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative optimization scheduling method and system for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid multi-energy collaborative optimization scheduling method and a system, which are used for effectively solving the uncertainty challenges of a power grid after a disaster fault by combining a condition risk value (CVaR) and an information gap theory (IGDT). The invention constructs a multi-energy collaborative optimization scheduling model based on IGDT-CVaR, takes expected outage loss and CVaR risk coefficient under multiple scenes as objective functions, and comprehensively considers constraint conditions such as node voltage, line capacity, distributed power output, energy storage system and the like. By means of data-driven model solving, the method and the system can generate an optimal scheduling plan, give consideration to economy and toughness, and improve reliability and stability of the power grid in a complex operation environment.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Expansion planning method for elastically-lifting urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of interconnected comprehensive energy system planning, in particular to an expansion planning method for an elastic lifting urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps of S1: dividing the urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system into three disaster-stricken grades according to three evaluation indexes; s2: establishing a disaster fault uncertainty set of basic elements of the urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system; s3: establishing an elastically-lifted urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system expansion planning robust optimization model; s4, the established robust optimization model has a max-min-max three-layer structure, the established robust optimization model is converted, and a column constraint algorithm is utilized to solve the robust optimization model; s5: the method comprises the steps of using an IEEE33 node power system and a Belgium 20 node natural gas system as simulation calculation examples to verify and explain a model, using MATLAB language to program the model, and calling a CPLEX tool box to solve; the method has the advantages of more accurate and reasonable result and the aim of improving the elasticity of the system under the condition of optimal expansion planning.

title_en: Glacier debris flow disaster early warning method based on pregnancy disaster background
