abstract_en: The invention provides a glacier debris flow disaster early warning method based on a pregnant disaster background, and belongs to the technical field of disaster reduction and prevention. Determining a characteristic value of a debris flow basin through a remote sensing image or mapping data; (2) acquiring meteorological data in a drainage basin range through meteorological remote sensing or observation data; (3) determining the source quantity through field investigation; (4) obtaining the change of the glacier area by remote sensing or monitoring, calculating the daily change kappa of the glacier area, and obtaining the channel avalanche accumulation V by field investigation s And the change rule day by day; (5) and (4) carrying out data processing on the debris flow pregnancy disaster background parameters obtained in the steps 1-4, calculating an early warning factor value of the glacier debris flow disaster, and sending early warning signals of different grades according to the size of the early warning factor. The invention fully considers the interaction of the trigger factors and the underlying surface conditions, and effectively solves the problems of the polygenetic and uncertainty of the triggering conditions of the glacier debris flow disasters.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF EXPLORATION TECH OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Two-stage robust fault recovery method for power distribution network based on toughness improvement
abstract_en: A two-stage robust fault recovery method for a power distribution network based on toughness improvement belongs to the field of power distribution network fault recovery. The method comprises the steps of combining important load recovery time in the fault recovery process of the power distribution network and load shedding time possibly caused by output fluctuation of a distributed power supply, and constructing a power distribution network toughness assessment method; an ellipsoid uncertainty set is introduced to fully consider the characteristics of randomness, volatility and the like of the distributed power supply output; and taking the optimal toughness index as an objective function, completing the establishment of a two-stage robust optimization model, and adopting an improved C & CG algorithm based on a limit scene to complete the solution of the fault recovery model. Aiming at the influence of extreme disasters on the power distribution network, the characteristics of randomness and fluctuation of the output of the distributed power supply are fully considered from the viewpoint of load recovery after the power distribution network fails, the power supply to the key load is met to the greatest extent, and the toughness of the power distribution network under the influence of the extreme disasters can be ensured. The method can be widely applied to the fields of operation management and fault emergency treatment of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster comprehensive risk dynamic assessment method based on multi-dimensional set information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive risk dynamic evaluation method based on multi-dimensional set information mountain torrent disasters, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, mountain torrent risk assessment based on corrected disaster rainfall; step 2, mountain torrent risk assessment based on water level-flow; step 3, mountain torrent risk assessment based on submergence range, flow velocity and water depth; step 4, determining the risk level of the torrential flood; step 5, dynamically evaluating the risk of torrential flood; and 6, carrying out uncertainty analysis on the mountain torrent risk assessment result. The invention provides a comprehensive risk dynamic assessment method for mountain torrent disasters based on multi-dimensional set information, which is suitable for the mountain torrent risk refined assessment of data-free areas, is more scientific and reliable in assessment index, and provides a more effective decision basis for mountain torrent disaster defense by performing dynamic assessment on the mountain torrent risk based on real-time monitoring data or simulated forecast data of a model.

title_en: Method and system for calculating fault rate of power distribution network under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for calculating the fault rate of a power distribution network under typhoon disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively establishing a probability density function model representing typhoon intensity and a probability distribution function model representing typhoon duration; establishing a power distribution network fault rate calculation model under typhoon disasters; and calculating the total probability of load power loss in the duration time of the typhoon disaster based on the power distribution network fault rate calculation model. The invention simultaneously considers the uncertainty of typhoon intensity and duration, analyzes the physical principle of different types of faults of the power distribution network caused by typhoon disasters and has higher accuracy. The method is used for modeling the fault rate of the power distribution network, the influence of typhoon intensity and duration on the fault rate of the power distribution network is comprehensively considered, the running state of the power distribution network under the typhoon disaster is completely and accurately described by carrying out detailed modeling on multiple disaster-causing factors and disaster-causing mechanisms of the typhoon disaster, and the precision of the fault rate model of the power distribution network is greatly improved by utilizing the advantage of combined driving of the data model.

title_en: Fire brigade fire fighting rescue success probability calculation method based on Monte Carlo simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the success probability of fire fighting rescue of a fire brigade based on Monte Carlo simulation, which takes input uncertainty parameters as samples and comprises the following steps: s1, determining simulation times N; s2, obtaining distribution types of uncertainty parameters and generating N groups of uncertainty samples; s3, calculating the bombing time t of the building through Monte Carlo simulation f And the intervention time t of the fire brigade i An uncertainty sample of (d); s4, fitting the ratio R of the intervention time of the fire brigade to the flashover time of the building tc Probability density distribution function f (R) tc ) (ii) a And S5, calculating the fire fighting and rescue success probability of the fire brigade and analyzing the influence of the uncertain parameters. The invention has the advantages that: and (4) calculating the success probability of the fire fighting team for extinguishing the building fire in a simulation mode, and analyzing the influence of each uncertain parameter on the success probability.

title_en: Toughness improvement method and terminal for power distribution network
abstract_en: According to the toughness improving method and terminal for the power distribution network, uncertainty of fault repair time of the power distribution network is considered in the fault repair process, the purpose of least weighted power shortage amount is achieved, a multi-stage fault recovery model of the power distribution network is established, maintenance personnel scheduling and mobile emergency power supply vehicle scheduling are used as optimization variables, and the maintenance personnel and the mobile emergency power supply vehicle are scheduled in a coordinated mode according to a model solving result. Compared with the prior art, the fault repair time is taken as a known condition to be considered, the coupling influence process between the scheduling of post-disaster maintenance personnel, the scheduling of the mobile emergency power supply vehicle and the fault repair time is ignored, the multi-stage process of uncertainty of the fault repair time and load recovery is comprehensively considered, and the rapid recovery of the post-disaster critical load is ensured, so that the resistance and recovery capacity of the power distribution terminal to extreme weather are comprehensively improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Low-carbon economic planning method for elastic lifting of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon economic planning method for power distribution network elastic lifting, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling for uncertainty of new energy output, S2, carrying out renewable energy scene reduction by combining clustering and an optimization algorithm based on an uncertainty model and a plurality of scenes, screening out typical scenes, S3, establishing an index system for elastic recovery strength of a power distribution network when facing accidents and carbon emission strength of the power distribution network, and S4, providing an optimal site selection, a capacity configuration model and an objective function of a distributed power supply in a distributed power network, and constructing a power distribution network fault risk model by analyzing correlation between disaster intensity distribution characteristics and power distribution network element operation risks. The self-healing capacity of the power distribution network facing risks is improved, so that the reliability of power supply is enhanced, the elasticity of the power distribution network is improved, better low-carbon economy is realized, and the supply and demand balance is better realized.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous path planning and comprises the steps of constructing a city low-altitude simulation environment, calculating an unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and an uncertainty matrix based on the city low-altitude simulation environment, constructing a 3D Gaussian probability distribution according to the unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and the uncertainty matrix, calculating the collision probability of an unmanned aerial vehicle by combining Monte Carlo sampling, calculating rewards according to the collision probability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, maximizing accumulated entropy reinforcement rewards by adopting a strategy pi, and performing strategy learning by utilizing a Soft Actor-Critic, and further outputting an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning optimal control instruction. The method focuses on the urban complex environment, integrates dynamic uncertainty perception and reinforcement learning technologies, solves the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning errors, obstacle collision risks and the like, realizes safe and efficient path planning, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle application scenes requiring autonomous navigation, such as logistics transportation, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Fire evacuation path planning method and system based on road seeker and A-algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire evacuation path planning method and a system based on a road finder and an A-algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining that a fire disaster occurs in a target area according to information acquired in real time on a perception site; acquiring the position information of trapped personnel in a target area; when the position elevation of the trapped person is higher than or equal to the position coordinates of the fire point, path planning is carried out according to a path finder mechanism based on a heuristic function under a fire scene until the position coordinates of all the trapped person are lower than the position coordinates of the fire point; when the position coordinates of the trapped person are lower than the position coordinates of the fire points, path planning is carried out according to a path planning mechanism based on heuristic function MOA under the fire scene. The application adopts a segmentation algorithm to plan. According to the position relation, two different path planning algorithms are adopted, the uncertainty of environmental change under a fire scene is fully considered, and the respective emphasis points under the two conditions are considered, so that the aim of combining safety and speed is fulfilled.

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method of new energy power system considering weather uncertainty
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power system operation, in particular to an intelligent scheduling method of a new energy power system considering weather uncertainty, which comprises the following steps of establishing a pre-disaster early warning intelligent body model, adopting a long-period memory network, and generating an early warning signal by combining wind-light power generation power, load history and prediction data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a disaster scheduling agent model, determining a disaster thermal power unit scheduling sequence, establishing a disaster recovery agent model, correcting the disaster thermal power unit scheduling sequence, establishing a multi-agent cooperative Markov game framework, determining a reinforcement learning state value, an action value and a reward value, establishing a staged cooperative reinforcement learning method, determining multi-agent cooperative experience sharing parameters and establishing a strategy updating formula, and can effectively improve the economy and safety of a power system in extreme weather, remarkably improve the operation reliability of the power system and provide technical support for power system scheduling.

title_en: Coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion, and belongs to the technical field of gas risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting geological, mining and environmental multisource data, carrying out preprocessing and feature extraction, fusing to construct a high-dimensional risk feature vector, then driving a virtual working face system comprising mining, ventilation and gas emission intelligent agents to evolve by the vector, adopting a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm to prospectively deduce future multistep states, calculating risk entropy of each path, finally generating a dynamic risk probability map based on the deduction result, and solving a Pareto optimal decision set considering safety, efficiency and economy through multi-objective optimization. The invention realizes the transition from passive monitoring to active early warning of gas risk, effectively solves the problem of early warning hysteresis, and provides advanced and accurate scientific decision support for gas disaster prevention and control through risk visualization and space positioning.

title_en: Embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and early warning of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical time sequence monitoring data of a landslide body, constructing a training data set, performing space-time characteristic decoupling on the data, decomposing the data into a global component and a detail component, constructing a double-branch lightweight time sequence convolution network comprising the global branch and the detail branch, completing joint training and self-adaptive weight fusion at a cloud end, performing differential lightweight processing on the trained network, deploying the trained network in an embedded terminal, performing characteristic decoupling and prediction by utilizing a real-time data stream at the embedded end, obtaining a predicted value and uncertainty estimation by combining a lightweight Monte Carlo Dropout method, and finally realizing dynamic threshold calculation and hierarchical early warning. The method effectively solves the problem that the existing method is difficult to consider the prediction precision and the calculation efficiency at the embedded terminal, and achieves real-time, accurate and self-adaptive early warning of landslide disasters.

title_en: Disaster prevention emergency electricity optimization collocation method and device in a kind of urban area
abstract_en: The invention discloses disaster prevention emergency electricity optimization collocation method and device in a kind of urban area, the implementation steps of method include：The allotment time of each user is arrived according to each switched-mode power supply of determination, calculate the loss of outage of each important power consumers during having a power failure on a large scale, the emergent cost that Utilities Electric Co. allocates disaster prevention emergency supply vehicle to user is calculated respectively, the uncertainty of disaster prevention emergency supply vehicle allotment time and power consumer load is described respectively with radial direction interval number and common interval number, calculate total social benefit, establish the disaster prevention emergency electricity optimization allocation models for being up to object function with total social benefit, the method optimized using robust solves preferred plan of each switched-mode power supply to each important power consumers allotment disaster prevention emergency power supply in urban area.Calculating process of the present invention is simple, has taken into full account the uncertainty of disaster prevention emergency supply vehicle allotment time and the uncertainty of customer charge, has at utmost met future scheduling demand and weigh loss of outage and emergent cost.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;MAINTENANCE CO STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method based on energy storage type flexible switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault recovery method based on an energy storage type flexible switch, which comprises the following steps: s1, evaluating damage risks and determining the installation position of the energy storage type flexible switch according to landslide disaster historical data of the area where the power distribution area is located; s2, calculating and determining a control strategy of the energy storage type flexible switch according to the annual cycle life and the life cost of a storage battery of the energy storage type flexible switch, the storage and release of electric energy smooth power fluctuation and load demand uncertainty reduction; and S3, calculating and outputting a distributed power supply power output value and a capacity value which enables the service life of the energy storage type flexible switch to be longest with the aim of minimizing the operation cost. The mounting position of the energy storage type flexible switch is determined by evaluating the landslide damage risk of the mountain, the annual cycle life and the service life cost of the storage battery are calculated, the use mode is determined, and finally the output is controlled by combining a distributed power supply with the minimized commissioning cost, so that the power supply recovery efficiency and the power supply quality are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY OF CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INSTITUTE;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of power distribution network in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of a power distribution network in extreme weather, which comprises the following steps: establishing an element fault rate model, and modeling an uncertainty scene of a power distribution network fault disaster; extracting an extreme weather scene by a Monte Carlo method, reducing the extreme weather scene by adopting a K-means algorithm, and taking the uncertainty of load and distributed power output into consideration, extracting the load, the distributed power output and a power distribution network fault scene by adopting Latin hypercube sampling; selecting evaluation indexes from multiple angles, and calculating objective weights of the indexes to construct a power distribution network reliability and elasticity evaluation index system; taking two indexes of the loss before disaster and the recovery rate after disaster as optimization targets, and establishing a mobile energy storage optimization planning model considering the full disaster period; and adopting COBL-PSO algorithm to solve the mobile energy storage optimization planning model. The invention realizes the improvement of the reliability and elasticity of the power distribution network through the optimization planning scheme of the mobile energy storage.

title_en: High-cold mountain area slope space-time probability prediction method considering snow cover change
abstract_en: The invention provides a space-time probability prediction method for a slope of a alpine mountain area, which considers the change of snow cover, combines a remote sensing model, a climate model and slope stability analysis, comprehensively considers the change of snow cover and the influence of the snow cover on the future climate change, and can more accurately predict the space-time probability of the slope of the alpine mountain area. The accuracy and the reliability of slope space-time probability prediction are effectively improved by accurately detecting the current snow coverage range, scientifically predicting the future snow coverage range change and reasonably determining the rainfall parameter for slope probability prediction, and more powerful support is provided for early warning and prevention and control of geological disasters. The invention considers the temperature and snowfall change under different climate change situations in the future, so that the prediction result can better adapt to the uncertainty of the climate change, and provides scientific basis for the sustainable development of the alpine mountain area.

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network transmission management method for earthquake early warning information
abstract_en: S101, according to seismic wave data, geological structure data, historical seismic data and meteorological data, through the fusion algorithm of the multisource data, produce the predicted value of risk of comprehensive failure; S102, constructing a layered failure probability model based on the comprehensive failure risk predicted value, generating a node failure risk probability map, distributing weights of all layers according to the earthquake stage, S103, constructing a network topology, calculating the survival time of network nodes, calculating the weighted comprehensive failure probability of each network node, dynamically updating the network topology, S104, fusing the weighted comprehensive failure probability and the survival time of each network node to obtain node stable utilization characteristics, and further executing staged resource scheduling. The invention realizes the accurate prediction of the failure risk of the network node and the phased resource scheduling in the whole process of the earthquake disaster.

title_en: Probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method for electric comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method of an electric comprehensive energy system, which relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy system optimization and comprises the following steps of firstly, considering the uncertainty of earthquake intensity, dispersing a target earthquake magnitude range into a plurality of equidistant intervals and calculating the occurrence probability of earthquakes of different earthquake magnitudes; the method comprises the steps of modeling disaster causes of earthquakes of different earthquake levels by adopting a vulnerability curve, calculating expected values of damaged elements of a power distribution system and a natural gas system, then randomly generating a fault scene under each classified earthquake level by using a Monte Carlo method, carrying out simulation on cascading faults of an electric comprehensive energy system under the random fault scene, recording the total loss load of the system, and finally calculating average loss load under each classified earthquake level, selecting a typical fault scene and forming a classified fault scene set. The method quantifies the tail risk of the low-probability extreme event and provides a scene basis for the toughness promotion strategy formulation of the comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Side slope displacement prediction method and device based on earthquake induction
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a slope displacement prediction method and device based on earthquake induction, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake induction slope disaster early warning. The corresponding method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of seismic records of a side slope and a plurality of first displacements of the side slope corresponding to the plurality of seismic records, carrying out background grid strain on initial object particles of the side slope according to a preset strain softening constitutive model of the side slope to determine final object particles of the side slope, determining a plurality of second displacements of the side slope under different characterization parameters according to the final object particles, and generating a displacement prediction model according to the plurality of seismic records, the plurality of first displacements and the plurality of second displacements to predict the displacement of the side slope corresponding to the seismic acceleration time course, wherein the displacement prediction model is generated by training the plurality of seismic records, the plurality of first displacements and the plurality of second displacements based on a deep learning algorithm. The invention can reduce uncertainty of earthquake induced soil slope displacement prediction and improve displacement prediction precision.
assignees: YAJIANG CLEAN ENERGY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH BEIJING CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Method for evaluating vulnerability of shield tunnel under water and sand gushing disaster driven by physical-data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical-data fusion-driven shield tunnel vulnerability evaluation method under water and sand gushing disasters, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of (1) determining information such as selected tunnel types, soil layer sections, water gushing disasters and the like, (2) establishing a substance point method-finite element method coupling model taking soil body-structure interaction into consideration under the action of the water gushing sand gushing disasters for dynamic response analysis, (3) training and optimizing a multi-layer perceptron machine learning model, establishing a multi-input-multi-output real-time prediction model, and the like. The method for evaluating the vulnerability of the shield tunnel under the water and sand gushing disaster, which is based on stratum-tunnel interaction and a soil mass catastrophe deformation mechanism, is established by combining a dynamic numerical analysis method and a machine learning prediction model, simultaneously systematically considers the rigidity of the tunnel joint, the soil mass characteristics, the uncertainty of monitoring data and the like, and can comprehensively evaluate the capability of the tunnel for resisting damage under the water and sand gushing effect.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating earthquake damage of sedimentary basin building group
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for evaluating earthquake damages of a settlement basin building group, which belong to the technical field of engineering disaster prevention and are characterized in that the method for evaluating the earthquake damages of the settlement basin building group comprises the following steps: s1, determining a target site and characteristic input parameters; s2, establishing a three-dimensional sedimentary basin model, and acquiring an earthquake response; s3, establishing an improved data set: s4, optimizing an artificial neural network; s5, acquiring a sample: s6, determining earthquake motion parameters; s7, prediction and evaluation. According to the method, the calculation efficiency of constructing a data set and evaluating the influence of the uncertainty of the site medium parameters on the basin vibration is sequentially improved through the rapid multipole algorithm and the proxy model, the peak acceleration statistical moment and the probability information of any position of the basin surface can be given out, and the method is applied to rapid prediction and evaluation of the earthquake damage of the building group and serves for toughness cities.

title_en: AC/DC power distribution network post-disaster recovery method considering load uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for recovering an AC/DC power distribution network after disaster by considering load uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: modeling various scheduling resources in the rush repair and recovery process; modeling the uncertainty of the load by a scene probability method; constructing a rush repair recovery model under the two-stage AC/DC power distribution system by taking the maximum total load recovery amount and the minimum total air rejection amount as targets; and solving the rush repair recovery model under the two-stage AC/DC power distribution system to obtain the optimal recovery strategy under the AC/DC power distribution system. The recovery strategy obtained by the method fully considers the load uncertainty and the special grid structure and electrical characteristics of the AC/DC hybrid power distribution network, reduces the air discarding quantity while maximizing the recovery quantity, has a simple model, is easy to solve, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.

title_en: Urban flood prediction method based on Bayesian convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood prediction method based on a Bayesian convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of collecting historical rainfall events of a research area, simulating different rainfall events by using hydrodynamic simulation software to obtain the maximum submerged water depth, selecting characteristic variables which influence the submerged water depth and comprise 10 rainfall characteristic variables and 10 space characteristic variables, constructing a Bayesian convolutional neural network prediction model by considering uncertainty, training the model based on a loss function MAE, inputting verification centralized data into the trained model, and solving an average value of output approximate posterior distribution to serve as a predicted value of the water depth. The method is used for calculating and analyzing the relation between the characteristic variable and the target variable, effectively fusing different data, taking possible uncertainty sources into consideration, not only realizing the prediction of the size and the range of the submerged depth of the research area, but also quantifying the prediction uncertainty, and providing support for real-time flood disaster management.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative coverage path planning method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative coverage path planning method based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation and path planning. The method is suitable for scenes requiring multi-agent area coverage path planning problems (MACPP) such as post-disaster search and rescue, agricultural irrigation and the like. The invention decomposes MACPP into two sub-problems of inter-area access sequence planning (MTSP) and sub-area Coverage (CPP), and designs a lightweight cross-layer connection multi-agent reinforcement learning framework. The framework adopts a complete collaborative learning strategy to optimize MTSP, designs and uses an exploration mechanism dynamically adjusted along with the interaction frequency to optimize the entrance and exit combination strategy in the training process, and combines a round-trip path algorithm to efficiently solve the CPP problem. By the method, the multi-area search task can be efficiently completed in the shortest time by multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, so that the requirements of actual application scenes are met.

title_en: Electric power system toughness assessment method based on deep learning under large-scale uncertainty scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system toughness evaluation method under a large amount of uncertainty scenes based on deep learning, which aims to solve the problem that the existing power system lacks effective evaluation on various uncertainty scenes. The toughness evaluation method of the electric power system comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a maximum wind speed intensity measurement graph of the electric power system in a target area, secondly, simulating and generating resistance distribution of a power transmission tower in the electric power system by utilizing Monte Carlo, constructing a power transmission line damage scene, simulating power transmission tower damage based on random fields, thirdly, performing recovery simulation on the power transmission tower in the electric power system based on a function loss value, determining a toughness evaluation index, fourthly, establishing a toughness evaluation proxy model of the electric power system under a large number of uncertain scenes based on deep learning, and obtaining the toughness evaluation index of the electric power system based on the trained deep learning model. The method can more accurately evaluate the damage condition of the target power network under various actual uncertain typhoon disaster situations and uncertain power transmission tower damage situations, and improves analysis efficiency.

title_en: Method and apparatus for compensating photovoltaic output prediction uncertainty and intermittency
title_ko: 태양광 발전의 출력 예측 불확실성 및 간헐성 보상 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method performed by a device for compensating the output prediction uncertainty and intermittence of photovoltaic power generation according to one embodiment comprises the steps of: additionally generating an independent variable for reflecting a time unit delay value of photovoltaic power generation amount and the characteristics of time series data based on the past power generation amount data of a photovoltaic power generation facility as a dependent variable and disaster prevention weather observation data as an initial independent variable; selecting the variables to be used as an input, based on the correlation between the dependent variable, the initial independent variable, and the additionally generated independent variable; predicting the photovoltaic power generation amount of the photovoltaic power generation facility as an output of a deep learning artificial neural network by inputting the selected variables to the pre-learned deep learning artificial neural network; applying the intermittence by multiplying an actual photovoltaic power generation data value of the photovoltaic power generation facility by a random value following a Gaussian distribution; comparing the predicted photovoltaic power generation amount with the photovoltaic power generation amount to which the intermittency is applied; and determining an operation mode of a BESS as one of stop, a charging operation, and a discharging operation according to a result of the comparison. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the problem of limiting the output of renewable energy due to an imbalance in supply and demand can be alleviated.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 태양광 발전의 출력 예측 불확실성 및 간헐성 보상 장치가 수행하는 방법은, 종속변수로서 태양광 발전설비의 과거 발전량 데이터와 초기 독립변수로서 방재기상관측 자료에 기초하여, 태양광 발전량의 시간 단위 지연값 및 시계열 데이터의 특성을 반영하기 위한 독립변수를 추가 생성하는 단계와, 상기 종속변수, 상기 초기 독립변수 및 상기 추가 생성된 독립변수 간의 상관 관계에 기초하여, 입력으로 사용할 변수들을 선정하는 단계와, 상기 선정된 변수들을 기학습된 딥러닝 인공신경망에 입력하여, 상기 딥러닝 인공신경망의 출력으로서 상기 태양광 발전설비의 태양광 발전량을 예측하는 단계와, 상기 태양광 발전설비의 실제 태양광 발전량 데이터 값에 가우시안 분포를 따르는 랜덤 값을 곱하여 간헐성을 적용하는 단계와, 상기 예측된 태양광 발전량과 상기 간헐성을 적용한 태양광 발전량을 비교하는 단계와, 상기 비교의 결과에 따라, BESS의 동작 모드를 정지와 충전 동작 및 방전 동작 중 어느 하나로 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: One kind being based on the probabilistic flood probability forecasting procedure of multi-source
abstract_en: The present invention relates to one kind to be based on the probabilistic flood probability forecasting procedure of multi-source, and steps are as follows: estimating areal rainfall probability distribution based on incomplete rainfall monitoring group；The suboptimum disaggregation for constructing each model parameter, obtains the probability distribution of model parameter；The random combination for generating areal rainfall and parameter, driving hydrological model generate the initial forecasting runoff process of multiple groups；Estimate that each model is relatively optimal probability using BMA method；Optimal models and corresponding initial forecasting runoff are randomly selected, the Posterior probability distribution of estimated prediction flow realizes probability forecast.The present invention is to comprehensively consider rainfall input, parameter, three aspect uncertainty of model structure, realize the calculation method of flood probability forecast, it can be widely used in that rainfall error originated from input is significant, is suitble to the model of flood forecasting or model structure not to predict accurately, the higher situation of model parameter uncertainty, the accuracy and reliability of flood forecasting result can be improved, provide technical support for flood control and disaster reduction work.
assignees: HUAIHE RIVER COMMISSION OF WATER RESOURCES HYDROLOGY BUREAU INFORMATION CENTER

title_en: Fire risk assessment method for ancient building group
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire risk assessment method for an ancient building group. Aiming at the problems of heavy fire hidden danger and complex fire cause of the ancient building group, the invention provides a framework for fire risk assessment of the ancient building group single ancient building. The process firstly needs to construct a risk evaluation index system aiming at the fire disaster of the ancient building group, and collects fire risk index data of the individual building of the ancient building group. And then respectively carrying out data processing and fusion according to different characteristics (space-attribute) of the indexes, and forming a corresponding fire risk index database based on the space uniqueness of the single ancient architecture. Considering fire risk uncertainty in an ancient building group, introducing an entropy weight method and combining TOPSIS to construct a fire risk comprehensive evaluation model of a single ancient building, and finally forming a fire risk map. The invention can objectively realize fire risk assessment of single ancient architecture in the ancient architecture group, quantify fire risk uncertainty and provide auxiliary information for fire protection work of the ancient architecture group.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Storm trapped person emergency rescue and evacuation method based on double-objective robust optimization technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a storm trapped person emergency rescue and evacuation method based on a double-target robust optimization technology, which comprises the following steps: s1: introducing decision variables S2 related to emergency center construction, starting, personnel evacuation and material distribution: analyzing the relation among the decision variables and constructing decision variable association constraint; s3: analyzing the relation among the personnel evacuation related decision variables, and constructing personnel evacuation related decision variable association constraint; s4: and analyzing the relation among the material distribution decision variables, and constructing the material distribution decision variable association constraint. S5: analyzing the relation among personnel evacuation, material distribution and emergency center construction or starting optimization targets, and constructing an objective function to obtain an original model; s6: and processing uncertainty of a response node and the like based on a double-target robust optimization technology, and converting the nonlinear robust optimization model by using a robust optimization linearization conversion method to obtain a double-target robust optimization model easy to calculate and solve. S7: and analyzing the complexity of the model and solving to obtain a rescue scheme.

title_en: Toughness improving method for electrothermal communication system under endogenous uncertainty and nonlinear reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toughness improvement of an electrothermal information physical system, and discloses a method for improving toughness of an electrothermal communication system under endophytic uncertainty and nonlinear reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of: an electric wired communication network model and a thermal wireless communication network model, and a natural disaster uncertainty set model established based on decision-dependent uncertainty; then taking the minimum total investment and running cost as an objective function, and performing dimension reduction and linearization treatment on the electric heating information physical system toughness collaborative lifting model by utilizing an improved Yen's algorithm, so as to establish an electric heating information physical system toughness lifting linearization model; and finally, reconstructing the uncertainty problem into a deterministic problem by a strong dual theory, and generating a robust cutting plane solving method by using the proposed relaxation columns and constraints. The invention realizes the toughness improvement of the electric heating information physical system more economically, reduces the threat of natural disasters to the system and ensures the operation safety of the system.

title_en: Storm disaster risk early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster risk early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source data, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of S1, a historical precipitation data reading stage, S2, a disaster factor calculating stage, S3, a storm disaster risk index calculating stage, a disaster body data calculating stage, S5, a storm disaster risk index calculating stage and a storm disaster risk early warning stage, wherein the storm disaster risk index calculating stage is used for calculating a storm disaster risk early warning grade of each preset area according to the storm disaster risk index, the vulnerability of the disaster body, the exposure of the disaster body and the weights of the disaster body, and the disaster risk early warning grade of the storm disaster. The rainfall estimation precision and the space variability are considered, and the uncertainty of the risk estimation result is reduced by combining the rainfall estimation precision and the space variability with the characteristics of long-sequence observation data identification.

title_en: Integrated decision method and system for post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated decision-making method and system for post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection, which comprises the steps of analyzing various costs of post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection, namely facility point station opening cost, personnel evacuation transportation variable cost, fixed cost, material transportation variable cost and fixed cost, constructing an integrated decision-making optimization model by taking the minimum total cost as an optimization target, converting parameter uncertainty conditions in the integrated decision-making optimization model based on robust optimization, and then solving the integrated decision-making optimization model to obtain decision variables, namely the open condition of a refuge, the open condition of a medical center, the number of disaster people evacuated from a disaster point to the refuge, the number of wounded evacuated from the disaster point to the medical center, and various material amounts distributed to the refuge and the medical center by a material distribution center. According to the invention, under the condition of uncertain environment and sufficient emergency materials, the disaster relief efficiency is improved, the disaster loss is reduced, and the uncertainty and complexity of the disaster can be better dealt with.

title_en: Urban power system toughness improving method and device based on vehicle network interaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-network interaction-based urban power system toughness improving method and device, which construct a two-stage random optimization model aiming at the minimum total cost of a system, cover long-term planning and operation scheduling of the urban power system in disaster scenes, improve the toughness of the urban power system in extreme weather long-term scenes, realize collaborative optimization of multidimensional costs such as power generation capacity expansion, line reinforcement, operation maintenance and load reduction, effectively reduce comprehensive cost and enhance dynamic response capability of the system. The integration channel of vehicle network interaction and urban power network toughness planning is opened, and a technical path capable of being popularized is provided for the safe, flexible and economic operation of the power system under the future climate uncertainty.

title_en: Emergency broadcast early warning system and terminal based on big data dynamic linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency broadcast early warning system and a terminal based on big data dynamic linkage, wherein the system comprises an emergency broadcast data acquisition module, an emergency broadcast information making and broadcasting module, an emergency broadcast scheduling control module, an emergency broadcast transmission module and terminal equipment; the terminal comprises a broadcasting control table, a Beidou emergency broadcasting terminal, an Ai automatic detection intelligent terminal, a computer and a control console. According to the invention, a set of comprehensive disaster assessment index system which considers influences of all aspects is formed from the aspects of disaster properties, social influences, economic influences and natural environment influences, references can be provided for disaster assessment index selection of different disaster types, the randomness and the ambiguity of subjective assessment are considered based on a weight determination method of a cloud model, the uncertainty conversion from assessment weight to comprehensive weight data is realized, all areas are automatically detected through a pre-installed camera and a sound column, and the linkage broadcasting of video monitoring and emergency broadcasting is realized.

title_en: Expressway tunnel fire evacuation research method and system considering uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a highway tunnel fire evacuation research method and system considering uncertainty, and relates to the technical field of tunnel emergency safety, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the evacuation characteristics and the evacuation uncertainty of tunnel fires based on highway tunnel fire evacuation cases; constructing an evacuation behavior uncertainty quantitative model, and inputting the model by using a fuzzy tool box based on MATLAB; setting up a simulation model, setting up a scene through tunnel space meshing, constructing an evacuation rule based on a floor field model, and introducing an evacuation behavior uncertainty quantitative model into evacuation behavior selection; and carrying out simulation experiments of typical scenes and single-factor control fixed scenes in different cross-hole intervals, carrying out sensitivity analysis on the results of the single-factor control experiments, and determining influence factors of evacuation uncertainty. The application is helpful to reveal the uncertainty influencing factors and the influencing mechanism of crowd evacuation under the fire disaster of the highway tunnel, so that the evacuation simulation result is closer to the actual evacuation behavior.

title_en: Calculation method for volume weight characteristic value of viscous debris flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calculating a volume weight characteristic value of a viscous debris flow, and belongs to the technical field of disaster reduction and prevention. The method comprises the steps of (1) carrying out field investigation on the debris flow gully and calculating the peak flow of the debris flow; (2) determining the position of a sampling area according to the debris flow accumulation form and obtaining a soil sample; (3) analyzing the particle component characteristics of each soil sample, and calculating the volume weight value corresponding to each sample; (4) analyzing the data of each sampling area, and calculating the average value of the volume weight values obtained in the step (3) as the volume weight of the area; (5) analyzing the volume weight obtained in the step (4), and calculating the maximum volume weight and the average volume weight of the debris flow; (6) and (5) analyzing the relation between the volume weight value obtained in the step (5) and the peak flow value obtained in the step (1), and checking the calculation result. The invention fully considers the sampling error generated by the debris flow accumulation sample and the correlation relationship among all parameters, and effectively solves the problems of ambiguity and uncertainty in the definition and calculation of the current debris flow volume weight value.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF EXPLORATION TECH OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Urban underground space geothermal potential intelligent evaluation and decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban underground space geothermal potential intelligent evaluation and development decision-making method, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data related to geothermal potential, preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain standardized spatio-temporal data with uniform spatio-temporal dimensions, extracting layer by layer characteristics of spatial data corresponding to each time step in the processed standardized spatio-temporal data to obtain multi-level spatial characteristic diagrams corresponding to each time step, obtaining space-time associated field characteristics by combining a bidirectional long-short term memory network and a graph convolution network, inputting physical parameters and space-time associated field characteristics in a three-dimensional geological knowledge graph constructed by unstructured data and structured data into a prediction model of a fusion physical mechanism to obtain a grading result of geothermal potential and a real-time potential index in an uncertainty interval of the grading result, the real-time potential index, the structured data, the unstructured data, the historical disaster data and a plurality of risk evaluation models to obtain a target geological disaster risk diagram, and further deducing a geothermal potential development decision.

title_en: Coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion, and belongs to the technical field of gas risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting geological, mining and environmental multisource data, carrying out preprocessing and feature extraction, fusing to construct a high-dimensional risk feature vector, then driving a virtual working face system comprising mining, ventilation and gas emission intelligent agents to evolve by the vector, adopting a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm to prospectively deduce future multistep states, calculating risk entropy of each path, finally generating a dynamic risk probability map based on the deduction result, and solving a Pareto optimal decision set considering safety, efficiency and economy through multi-objective optimization. The invention realizes the transition from passive monitoring to active early warning of gas risk, effectively solves the problem of early warning hysteresis, and provides advanced and accurate scientific decision support for gas disaster prevention and control through risk visualization and space positioning.
assignees: WANBEI COAL ELECTRICITY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water logging disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water-logging disasters, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing an electric power-drainage network coupling model based on partial differential constraint of pressure and non-pressure unsteady flow hydrodynamic force, and representing dynamic interactive evolution processes of power failure, rainwater overflow and road ponding of a power grid under a storm disaster; s2, establishing an equivalent linear complex algebraic equation of a drainage network nonlinear hydrodynamic partial differential equation in a frequency domain; s3, deducing a multi-hyperplane formula of an electric power-drainage composite safety area, and representing a feasible operation boundary of an electric pump-sluice group under the injection conditions of complex electric power and rainwater; and S4, taking rainfall uncertainty in heavy rain into consideration, adopting multi-scene random optimization based on Monte Carlo simulation, and solving an emergency scheduling decision scheme at the current moment through rolling optimization. The invention realizes the coordination reconstruction of the network topology of the power distribution network and the drainage network under the disaster of rainstorm and waterlogging.

title_en: Rock burst intensity level prediction method based on game theory-variable weight
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock burst intensity level prediction method based on game theory-variable weight, which is suitable for the engineering fields of mines, tunnels and the like. The invention establishes a rock burst prediction decision system, and builds a practical rock burst prediction index system by taking the frequency as a standard; based on game theory thought, a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and an anti-entropy weight process are adopted, and the rock burst prediction cloud model based on game theory-variable weight is established by utilizing the difference information of objective characteristics of rock burst prediction objects and is used for predicting rock burst intensity levels. The rock burst intensity level prediction method provided by the invention better reflects the relative influence between subjective judgment of an expert and characteristic difference of rock burst prediction objects, can better solve the problems of fuzzy uncertainty and random uncertainty in the rock burst prediction process, improves the rock burst prediction accuracy, and provides an important decision method for preventing rock burst disasters.

title_en: Uncertainty-based power system restoring force evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty-based power system restoring force evaluation method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining various data of a power system after experiencing extreme disasters, constructing an element fault rate model dynamically associated with a power system restoring decision based on the decision-dependent uncertainty, generating a power failure scene based on the obtained data and the element fault rate model by considering part of element states uncertainty, establishing an association matrix between the state uncertainty and a fault element based on a gray association theory, calculating damage confidence coefficient of the state uncertainty element, screening out a typical power failure scene by utilizing a system information entropy, constructing a multi-dimensional power system dynamic restoring force evaluation index system by combining with renewable energy output uncertainty, and calculating an evaluation index to evaluate restoring force. The invention integrates decision-dependent uncertainty, element state uncertainty and renewable energy output uncertainty, so that the evaluation result is more similar to the complexity of an actual post-disaster scene.

title_en: High-dimensional complex system uncertainty analysis method based on statistical machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-dimensional complex system uncertainty analysis method based on statistical machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting uncertainty factors affecting a high-dimensional complex system, and acquiring a high-dimensional random variable input sample matrix; inputting the high-dimensional random variable into a sample matrix, and converting the high-dimensional random variable into a low-dimensional random variable sample matrix; the high-dimensional random variable is input into a sample matrix to be calculated one by one, so that an output response matrix is obtained; accurately modeling the random response surface agent model to obtain a random response surface model which is highly similar to the studied high-dimensional complex system; obtaining the mean value and variance of the output response quantity of the random response surface model by a formula deduction method; and analyzing the uncertainty factors according to the mean value and the variance to obtain an uncertainty analysis result. The method has the advantages of high accuracy of calculation results, reduced calculation amount and improved calculation efficiency on the basis of ensuring calculation accuracy, avoidance of dimension disaster, high flexibility and the like.

title_en: Active power distribution network load fault recovery strategy optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power system control, and particularly relates to an optimization algorithm for load fault recovery strategy of an active power distribution network. According to the traditional fault recovery scheme, when an accident occurs, a load recovery plan is carried out on a whole fault time interval by a controllable Distributed Generation (DG), a distributed energy storage and other limited power generation devices according to the output predicted values of intermittent energy sources such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like, the load recovery scheme cannot be dynamically adjusted by acquiring real-time information, and further the key load in the fault time interval cannot be effectively recovered. The application provides an optimization algorithm for load fault recovery strategy of an active power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a multi-period load fault recovery strategy optimization model; step 2: and solving by considering the risk indexes aiming at the optimization model. And in consideration of random uncertainty of wind, light and other intermittent energy output, dynamically correcting the load recovery plan through real-time measurement information of renewable energy after extreme disasters.

title_en: Marine unmanned equipment search and rescue method, device and equipment based on drifting track prediction
abstract_en: The application relates to a search and rescue method, a device and equipment for offshore unmanned equipment based on drift track prediction, which are characterized in that a trained coefficient correction model is utilized to optimize flow field coefficients and wind pressure coefficients in a pre-constructed target drift model according to feedback information fed back after the offshore unmanned equipment is in distress, an optimized target drift model is obtained, calculation is carried out according to environmental information of a sea area where the offshore unmanned equipment is located and the optimized target drift model, a drift track after the offshore unmanned equipment is in distress is obtained, and a Monte Carlo algorithm is adopted based on the drift track to obtain a search and rescue area of the offshore unmanned equipment, wherein the search and rescue area is represented by uncertainty quantization of search and rescue target distribution probability under marine environment rasterization. By adopting the method, an accurate search and rescue area can be provided for search and rescue of offshore unmanned equipment.

title_en: Rural building group flood disaster loss assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building group flood influence analysis, and provides a method and a system for evaluating the flood disaster loss of a rural building group, aiming at the problem that the accuracy of an evaluation result is low due to the fact that uncertainty factors in the loss evaluation process are not fully considered in the existing building flood loss function; comparing the submerged depth map with SAR image water body extraction data and social media data to obtain a flood simulation result, combining building classification information and the maximum submerged depth map to obtain submerged depth of each building, calculating component information of the building, analyzing building flood vulnerability according to the component information and the submerged depth to determine total loss of all buildings, and evaluating the effect of the current disaster prevention measures according to the total loss under different disaster prevention measures. The invention can provide scientific basis for building flood loss assessment and disaster prevention decision.
assignees: NO 4 ENG CORP LTD OF CR20G;UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP

title_en: Bridge digital twin risk assessment method under extreme event
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bridge risk assessment method based on digital twinning under extreme events. Firstly, multi-source data in a short time window are collected to form a unified observation vector. The abnormal sensor is then identified and redundancy repair is performed. And then, constructing a triple calibration model, solving damage parameters, identifying a damage dynamic evolution field, constructing a full-link uncertainty propagation system, and calculating the residual bearing capacity and risk index. When the risk index or confidence interval thereof covers 1.0, a conservative traffic policy is output. And finally, generating a traffic control scheme by combining the risk indexes, and carrying out collaborative updating on multiple bridges in the area. The invention has the advantages of fault tolerance, robustness, causality interpretability, dynamic prediction, full link transparency, assessment-management closed loop and the like, can rapidly and reliably output the residual bearing capacity and traffic strategy of the bridge after an extreme event, and improves the emergency efficiency and operation safety after disaster.
assignees: GUANGXI XINFAZHAN COMMUNICATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Distributed laboratory system time keeping method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a distributed laboratory system time keeping method, a distributed laboratory system time keeping device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining calibration data of a coordinated universal time tracing module and clock difference data of at least two clock guards and corresponding stability of the clock differences in a distributed laboratory system, determining local atomic time according to the clock difference data and the corresponding stability of the clock differences, judging whether the coordinated universal time tracing module operates normally or not, calibrating the local atomic time according to the calibration data if yes, obtaining standard time, otherwise, obtaining reference data of a reference clock and prediction data of a virtual coordinated universal time prediction module and corresponding uncertainty of the virtual coordinated universal time prediction module, and calibrating the local atomic time according to the reference data and the prediction data and corresponding uncertainty of the virtual coordinated universal time prediction module, and obtaining the standard time. The embodiment of the application improves the disaster recovery performance and safety of the distributed laboratory system generated in standard time.

title_en: Search-and-rescue method and system based on integration measure random meet uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search-and-rescue method and system based on integration measure random meet uncertainty. The method comprises the following steps: 1, determining a path L along which a lost person D gets lost, and determining a position point where the lost person D is located on the path L finally; 2, measuring the length I of the path L, and measuring a position point where a searcher C is located on the path L; 3, calculating a probability density function that the searcher C and the lost person D are distributed on the path L, and deriving out a meet event Emeet; 4, calculating out the meet probability p (Emeet) according to the probability density function and the meet event Emeet; 5, deriving out the probability p (Emeet xk) of 'an event that the searcher C located at a point xk can meet the lost person D' according to the meet probability p (Emeet); 6, conducting the search and rescue in a mode that the searcher C moves to a position adjacent to a point xm where the lost person D can be found to the maximum probability.

title_en: Task planning method, device and equipment for maritime collaborative search and rescue and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a task planning method, device, equipment and storage medium for maritime collaborative search and rescue, which are characterized in that a search and rescue probability map which is quantitatively represented by uncertainty of search and rescue target distribution probability under the gridding of a marine environment is obtained by adopting a Monte Carlo algorithm based on a drifting track, a maritime target search and rescue model is constructed based on the search and rescue probability map, meanwhile, an initial population is obtained by setting an initial chromosome gene segment according to collaborative search and rescue parameters, the optimal solution is obtained by adopting a global optimal genetic bionic intelligent algorithm based on the initial population, the optimal solution is obtained after the initial population is decoded, and a task planning scheme of multiparty participation in collaborative search and rescue is obtained after interaction with the maritime target search and rescue model in each iterative optimization process, and population optimization is carried out according to the fitness. By adopting the method, a multiparty collaborative search and rescue task planning scheme with high search and rescue success rate can be obtained.

title_en: Mobile robot visual range coverage path planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for planning a coverage path of a visual range of a mobile robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, abstracting the visual range of the camera to a fan-shaped plane, and therefore geometrically filling the map by using the fan-shaped plane; s2, planning the path according to the coverage result of the visible range node obtained in S1 in the map: and converting the coverage result into a traveling salesman problem to solve, and planning the path according to the visiting sequence. The method expands the coverage problem from point coverage to surface coverage, better meets the actual requirements of search and rescue tasks, can effectively shorten the path length, and improves the search efficiency.

title_en: Power grid equipment fault prediction method and system under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid equipment fault prediction method and system under extreme weather, comprising the following steps: and acquiring and preprocessing the first object data to obtain a data set. And further sampling to obtain a balanced data set according to the test set condition. And establishing a prediction fault model and outputting a prediction result. The method and the system for predicting the power grid equipment faults in extreme weather well solve the problems of low probability, few samples, nonlinearity and the like of the power grid extreme disasters, and have strong nonlinear mapping capability and learning speed for the characteristics of weather data such as multiple time spaces, multiple dimensions, multiple scales, uncertainty and the like. The method is simple and practical, is reliable in calculation, is easy to realize and deploy on the engineering site, and has strong operability and popularization and application values.

title_en: Method and system for predicting disaster and stability of slope in alpine mountain area by considering climate change
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of natural disaster prevention and control, and discloses a method and a system for predicting the disaster and the stability of a slope in a alpine mountain area by considering climate change, wherein the method comprises the following steps of predicting future precipitation and temperature change by combining output data of a plurality of regional climate models and global climate models and different climate situations; based on historical LULC data and climate change prediction data, predicting future LULC change by using a land change model, calculating landslide susceptibility in different future scenes by using a FSLAM model to obtain failure probability (PoF) of each grid unit, evaluating influence of climate change and LULC change on the stability of the slope by calculating PoF differences in different scenes, and carrying out uncertainty analysis on climate model, LULC prediction and model parameters to quantify the uncertainty range of a prediction result. The application can provide quantitative assessment of landslide risk in alpine regions and reliable data support for the establishment of disaster prevention and reduction measures.

title_en: Random finite fault seismic source model building method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a random limited fault source model, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining the geometrical morphology of a fault based on regional geological data and earthquake monitoring data, estimating non-planar fault parameters and average sliding quantity of fault surfaces by combining historical data and an empirical formula, S2, estimating the concave-convex bodies, obstacle distribution and sliding strength of the fault surfaces according to historical earthquake inversion data, obtaining sliding quantity of each sub fault through random disturbance average sliding quantity, S3, determining an initial breaking point and average breaking speed of the discrete fault surfaces as sub fault units, generating random breaking initial time conforming to normal or power law distribution based on a random number method, S4, calculating the earthquake time of each sub fault by adopting a random point source method, superposing contribution and introducing the influence of a shallow speed structure V30, and generating a three-dimensional earthquake dynamic field, S5, comparing actual strong earthquake record adjustment parameters, and outputting a multi-risk-level earthquake parameter evaluation result after iterative optimization. According to the method, the randomness and the experience data are fused, so that the simulation precision of the seismic source model on the uncertainty of the seismic process is improved, the influence of the potential maximum magnitude earthquake of the movable fracture zone in the future can be effectively estimated, the simulation precision and the calculation efficiency of the earthquake are improved, and the method is suitable for earthquake resistant design of engineering structures and earthquake disaster assessment.
assignees: JIANGXI TONGJI CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MAN CO LTD;HU YISHI

title_en: Transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of distribution network after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of a distribution network after disaster, belongs to the technical field of safety planning operation of power systems, and solves the problems that the traditional sequencing relies on manual/single indexes, is difficult to cope with fault uncertainty and lacks a standardized model. The method comprises the steps of calculating load recovery weights based on population density and unit load economic loss by using an improved analytic hierarchy process, simulating and generating a multi-fault scene by using Monte Carlo, building an optimization model by taking minimum economic and social losses as targets and combining a complex electricity means and scheduling constraint, solving the model to obtain switch operation time, and determining transfer priority by using Copride sequencing. The invention provides a scientific scheme for emergency decision of complex fault scenes, meets the requirement of rapidly making an optimal transfer strategy after disaster, and reduces economic and social losses.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Plateau mountain land landslide hazard early warning system based on daily displacement rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plateau mountain land landslide hazard early warning system based on daily displacement rate, which comprises a plateau mountain land landslide early warning protection system, a landform condition system, a daily displacement calculation system and an intelligent early warning system, wherein the daily displacement calculation system is used for obtaining the action of the place, the distance, the speed and the time of landslide debris flow, a building distance measurement module is used for measuring the distance between a building and the debris flow, a landslide countdown module is used for measuring the time of the debris flow reaching a corresponding building, a plateau mountain position module and an altitude sample analysis module are fixedly arranged in a geographic information module, and a soil quality type analysis module and a flowability analysis module are fixedly arranged in the soil quality information module; the method is applied to predicting the landslide disaster in advance, displaying general conditions intuitively and vividly, and when the disaster happens, the path and direction of the landslide movement can be known in time, so that the uncertainty caused by the disaster is reduced.

title_en: Coal mine disaster intelligent linkage method based on space-time event chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent linkage method for coal mine disasters based on a space-time event chain, which belongs to the technical field of mining and information and comprises the following steps: step 1, arranging sensors at key positions in a coal mine stope so as to sense environmental parameters in the stope in real time; step 2, storing data by adopting a self-defined data storage mode, fusing and integrating the spatio-temporal data acquired from different sensors, and establishing a complete spatio-temporal event chain; step 3, modeling and deducing the data in the event chain by applying a probability map model; step 4, automatically identifying abnormal conditions of the coal mine stope by utilizing a Boltzmann machine model; and 5, estimating and updating the state of the coal mine stope in real time by using a particle filtering algorithm, automatically triggering an early warning signal according to a preset early warning rule or a threshold value, and automatically generating a rescue scheme and a disaster avoidance route. According to the invention, by constructing a space-time event chain, dynamic monitoring, information acquisition, multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis of coal mine disaster events are realized.

title_en: Method for improving precision of earthquake instability model based on post-processing
