abstract_en: The embodiment of the method discloses a method for improving the precision of a seismic instability model based on post-processing, which comprises the following steps: the accuracy of the seismic instability model can be improved through the post-processing methods such as data cleaning and preprocessing, parameter optimization and correction, model integration and correction, prediction uncertainty evaluation, model verification and evaluation and the like. This helps to improve the efficiency of seismic risk management, enhance awareness and perception of seismic risk, and effectively reduce the risk of seismic disasters. The implementation of this embodiment has the following main advantages: (1) Providing a more accurate result, errors and uncertainties in the model may be corrected, thereby providing a more accurate result; (2) improving model predictive power: the seismic instability model is typically constructed based on known seismic events and geological data. But the actual situation may differ from the model assumption. By post-processing, deviations in the model can be corrected, improving its predictive power. (3) optimizing resource configuration: the accuracy of the seismic instability model affects the configuration of risk management resources. By post-processing, the source of uncertainty in the model can be identified and optimized according to its importance.

title_en: Mine rescue training simulation device and simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue training, in particular to a mine rescue training simulation device and a simulation method. The device comprises a departure hall, an arrival hall and a simulation system arranged between the departure hall and the arrival hall, wherein the simulation system comprises a path subsystem and a simulation unit, the path subsystem comprises a main roadway and a plurality of secondary roadways connected with the main roadway, the simulation unit comprises a simulation room, a simulation scene is arranged in the simulation room, the simulation scene can be changed according to actual needs, and each secondary roadway is communicated with a plurality of simulation rooms. The main roadway and the multiple secondary roadways are arranged to be connected with the multiple simulation rooms, simulation scenes can be changed, abundant and various rescue simulation environments and path selections are constructed, the rescue workers are prevented from forming fixed thinking and muscle memory, the capability of coping with different disaster positions and types in complex and changeable mine environments is exercised, the reality and effectiveness of training are improved, and the rescue workers are more suitable for the diversity and uncertainty of actual rescue work.

title_en: Multi-stage toughness improvement method for power distribution network considering intelligent soft switch optimization configuration
abstract_en: The application particularly relates to a multi-stage toughness improving method of a power distribution network considering intelligent soft switch optimization configuration, which comprises the following steps: taking typhoon weather as representative of extreme weather, generating a random disaster scene by considering uncertainty, and establishing a power distribution network fault model under typhoon disasters; analyzing a power distribution network fault processing and power supply recovery process during typhoon disasters; determining constraint conditions, considering cost, determining the installation position of the intelligent soft switch, and obtaining a recovery strategy; and converting the toughness improvement optimization model of the power distribution network into a mixed integer second order cone planning framework, taking the toughness index of the power distribution system during typhoon disasters as an objective function, formulating a recovery operation rule of the power distribution network, and determining the operation sequence of switching between adjacent states of the system to obtain a toughness improvement scheme of the power distribution network. According to the application, by using a two-stage mixed integer second-order cone model, economic cost and toughness indexes are used as objective functions, and the installation position of the intelligent soft switch is optimally determined, so that the toughness improvement scheme of the power distribution network is completed.

title_en: Prediction method for soil corrosion rate of metal material and model thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the soil corrosion rate of a metal material and a model thereof, belongs to the technical field of metal life assessment and environmental rock-soil disaster prevention and reduction, is used for predicting the metal corrosion rate in a soil environment based on a mathematical model determined by a basic reaction process of an electrode system response, calculates a dissolution reaction current I  1 , a passivation reaction current I  2  and a corrosion product layer coverage rate theta to represent the metal corrosion strength, definitely comprises the key characteristics of the electrochemical reaction of the surface of the metal under the action of different soil environments, compensates the defects of the prior data analysis, and can more reliably predict the charge transfer mechanism between the metal surface and surrounding soil, thereby solving the uncertainty of the traditional analysis method in the aspect of interpreting impedance data.

title_en: Early warning method for fire disaster in passenger car engine cabin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method for the fire disaster in a passenger car engine cabin. The method comprises the steps that a mamdani type fuzzy inference system of the fire disaster of the passenger car engine cabin is established, temperature data, oil gas data and current data inside the passenger car engine cabin are collected through a sensor, the collected data are converted into a corresponding temperature rate, corresponding oil gas concentration and a corresponding current pulse, the corresponding temperature rate, the corresponding oil gas concentration and the corresponding current pulse are input into the fuzzy inference system, the danger class of the fire disaster in the current passenger car engine cabin is obtained based on a fuzzy interference rule, and the early warning judgment is further made. The uncertainty and the limitation of a single parameter are overcome according to the coordination of a plurality of parameters and the complementary advantage of the performance, the effective performance of the early warning is improved, and according to the complex environment in the engine cabin, the fire disaster danger degree in the cabin can be effectively judged very well based on the occurrence characteristics of the passenger car fire disaster and the information fusion technology of the fuzzy theory.

title_en: Computation reduction methode for h.264/avc motion estimation
title_ko: Ｈ.264／ａｖｃ 움직임 추정의 연산량 감소방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A computation reduction method of H.264/AVC motion estimation is provided to adjust a search area during IME(Integer Motion Estimation) and take a partial cost calculating method during FME(Fraction Motion Estimation), thereby largely reducing a computation amount. CONSTITUTION: An integer motion estimation process comprises the following units. An initial search area is extracted from motion vectors of neighbor macro blocks. Distribution values of neighbor motion vectors are calculated in x and y directions. The size of an initial search window increases in the initial search area according to the calculated distribution values of the neighbor motion vectors.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에는 정수 움직임 추정(IME)과 분수 움직임 추정(FME)으로 이루어지는  H.264/AVC 움직임 추정의 연산량 감소방법에 관한 것으로, 정수 움직임 추정에서 탐색영역을 조정하고, 분수 움직임 추정에서 부분 코스트 계산방법을 도입함으로써 연산량을 대폭 줄이도록 하는 기술구성이 개시된다.

title_en: International SOS letter shape distress signal balloon
abstract_en: The utility model provides an international SOS letter shape distress signal balloon, be by SOS letter spheric balloon body, SOS letter spheric balloon aerify the hole, the pull wire constitutes, wherein, being equipped with in SOS letter spheric balloon body lower part and aerifing the hole, be equipped with the pull wire in SOS letter spheric balloon body lower part, have a plurality of reflection of light labelings at SOS letter spheric balloon body surface paste, surface paste has a plurality of luminous labelings at SOS letter spheric balloon body, is provided with red LED lamp at the alphabetical spheric balloon body of SOS. The utility model discloses in have a few striking signs of department, leading the lead wire by succour person, to put the height aerial, conveniently the personnel of suing and labouring several kilometers or the personnel of suing and labouring with the telescope tens kilometers can all the contact with a target, reduced the search area, reduced the personnel of suing and labouring, shortened the search and rescue time, be favorable to succour person to obtain succour, assurance succour person's life safety in the shortest time. And simultaneously, the utility model discloses or the distress signal instrument of a low price.

title_en: Gaussian process method and device for rapidly identifying stability coefficient of sliding karst dangerous rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Gaussian process method and device for rapidly identifying a stability coefficient of sliding karst dangerous rocks, and mainly solves the problem of reasonably identifying the anti-sliding stability safety coefficient of sliding unstable collapse type dangerous rocks in a karst region. Firstly, selecting 14 characteristic indexes which obviously influence the stability coefficient of the sliding karst dangerous rock; secondly, establishing a machine learning sample set through collection of a plurality of engineering examples and calculation of stability coefficients; then, training and testing a GPR model by adopting a cross validation strategy; further, inputting a new dangerous rock mass to be recognized into the trained GPR model, and directly outputting a recognition result with probability significance of the stability coefficient of the dangerous rock mass to be recognized; and finally, quantitatively evaluating the uncertainty of the identification result. The method can be used for rapidly identifying the stability coefficient of the large-batch slippage type dangerous rock mass in the karst region, and is particularly suitable for geological disaster management or technical personnel application without professional background knowledge and experience of calculation and analysis of the stability of the dangerous rock mass.

title_en: Optimization method and device for rainfall station network, electronic equipment and computer program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer program product for optimizing a rainfall station network. The method comprises the steps of selecting the site by combining uncertainty of rainfall data of each original site, the mountain torrent disaster risk level of the sub-basin where each original site is located, and information overlapping amount of each original site and the previously selected site, and stopping site selection when information gain is smaller. The scheme provided by the application can reduce redundancy and information overlapping, and can ensure the improvement of the monitoring coverage rate of a key area while improving the overall information acquisition efficiency of the station network, thereby effectively improving the monitoring and early warning capability of the mountain torrent disasters.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO

title_en: Scene modeling method based on fuzzy superposition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of scene modeling, and solves the problems of fusion distortion, uncertainty expression loss and static model self-adaptation deficiency of multi-source heterogeneous data. The method comprises the steps of uniformly processing physical sensing data and subjective description data through a differential fuzzy processing mechanism (continuous quantity is mapped by using a trapezoidal membership function and discrete quantity meaning rules), realizing data collaboration based on a space association matrix by adopting a dynamic weight superposition strategy, adding an aging attenuation factor for dynamic optimization, synchronously outputting a deterministic model frame and fuzzy boundary thermodynamic diagram during scene reconstruction, and establishing a real-time feedback closed loop optimization membership function parameter and weight strategy. The method has the innovation points that a confidence level conversion mechanism eliminates semantic distortion, an adaptive superposition operator switches operation modes according to a confidence level threshold, and three-dimensional semitransparent rendering visualizes uncertainty distribution. The multi-source fusion semantic distortion rate is reduced by 62%, the disaster early warning accuracy rate is improved by 55%, and the continuous operation accuracy attenuation rate of the model is controlled below 3%.
assignees: NANJING QIANCHENGJIAMING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean rescue navigation system based on dynamic environment modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine rescue navigation system based on dynamic environment modeling, which comprises a rear-end service platform and a rescue execution body, wherein the rescue execution body is provided with a plurality of rescue ships and a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the rear-end service platform comprises an effective ratio calculation module, a judgment notification module and a judgment notification module, wherein the effective ratio calculation module is used for obtaining the number of additional search areas uploaded by all rescue execution bodies in a current rescue period and summing the number of the total area N1, obtaining the number of the additional search areas uploaded by all rescue execution bodies in the current rescue period and searching the rescue target and summing the number of the effective area N2, calculating the expanded effective ratio Z=N2/N1, and the judgment notification module is used for obtaining a preset ratio threshold Z1, and sending a regulation notification message if Z is not less than Z1 in the current rescue period. Not only can the timeliness be maintained, but also the system has stronger flexibility, thereby remarkably improving the success rate of search and rescue and optimizing the overall rescue efficiency.
assignees: HAINAN WEIZI GUIDE CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Current disaster risk assessment method and system based on cascade coefficient quantification early-stage disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a current disaster risk assessment method and system based on cascade coefficient quantification early-stage disaster influence, belongs to the field of disaster risk management and hydraulic engineering intersection, and is suitable for disaster risk assessment of drought, flood and the like in a river basin scale. The method aims at solving the problems that the influence of the early-stage disasters is difficult to quantify, the memory effect lacks a damping mechanism and the coverage of the evaluation scene is limited in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining early-stage disaster and current disaster data, calculating memory parameters such as soil drought depth and vegetation damage rate, constructing cascade coefficients containing coefficients of same part (enhancement), different part (uncertainty) and opposite part (weakening), correcting the cascade coefficients through an exponential/linear/power function attenuation model, and adjusting a current disaster reference risk value by combining the cascade coefficients to obtain a final risk value. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a memory parameter calculation module, a cascade coefficient construction module, a time correction module, a risk calculation module and a result output module. The invention effectively solves the quantitative problem of the influence of the early-stage disasters, remarkably improves the evaluation precision, reduces the error rate from 22% -31% to 7% -9%, can cover four typical disaster combined scenes such as drought-drought, drought-flood, flood-drought and the like, has good river basin adaptability and practicality, and provides more scientific and operable basis for the disaster prevention and reduction decision of the river basin.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;WENG BAISHA

title_en: Multi-mode joint learning tracking method and system based on attention mechanism
abstract_en: A multi-mode joint learning tracking method and system based on an attention mechanism comprises the steps of obtaining a target template area and a search area of RGB mode and infrared mode images of a fire scene, respectively carrying out blocking and embedding on the target template area and the search area of the two modes to obtain corresponding image blocks, embedding the corresponding image blocks into the target template area and the search area, combining the target template area and the search area with experience vectors to obtain feature representations of the two modes, respectively sending the feature representations corresponding to the two modes into a feature extraction network to extract corresponding feature vectors, sending the feature vectors corresponding to the two modes into a multi-mode fusion network to achieve mutual fusion of the dual-mode features, obtaining the fused robust feature representations, updating the experience vectors through fusion features, transmitting the fused feature representations to a target calibration bit, and generating a classification score graph and a boundary frame regression result of a target of the frame to be used for personnel rescue decisions.

title_en: Island sea area-oriented multi-unmanned-ship autonomous collaborative search method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned ship control and multi-agent cooperation, in particular to a multi-unmanned ship cooperation search method for island-reef sea areas, which comprises the following steps of constructing island-reef environment perception maps containing barriers and search area grids, and dividing a monitoring area into a plurality of subareas according to fixed grid scales; defining a subarea state variable, initializing a task allocation table, constructing an area allocation mechanism based on distance and state judgment, establishing a local obstacle avoidance enhanced propulsion control algorithm, synthesizing the propulsion speed of the unmanned ship by a target guiding speed and an obstacle avoidance speed, enabling the synthesized speed to meet the power constraint of the unmanned ship, setting a search completion judgment mechanism and an area state updating rule, and establishing a search task degradation scheduling mechanism. The method disclosed by the invention has the advantages of strong flexibility, definite division of labor and high autonomy, can effectively improve the searching efficiency of complex sea areas, and has wide application prospects in unmanned system formation searching, disaster emergency inspection and offshore information acquisition.

title_en: Distribution network elastic lifting method and system based on distributed new energy aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network elastic lifting method and system based on distributed new energy aggregation, which improve the effect of a distributed new energy unit on the elastic lifting of a power distribution system under the large background of energy transformation. The method comprises the steps of carrying out probability modeling on output and load data prediction errors of a new energy unit based on multi-element normal distribution, obtaining a typical output curve which is updated continuously along with time by utilizing rapid forward scene reduction, constructing an aggregation model of an energy storage system and a distributed new energy unit, inputting aggregation characteristics corresponding to the aggregation model, namely a voltage frequency range and an active and reactive power output range, to a power distribution network layer, setting optimization targets and various constraint conditions for maximizing key load recovery, and improving the recovery capacity of a power distribution system after disaster. The invention solves the problems of uncertainty and fluctuation of high-proportion new energy access in the power distribution network under the large background of energy transformation, improves the key load recovery capability of the power distribution system after disaster, and lays a foundation for solving the key outstanding problem of the elastic power distribution network technology advancing to practical industrial application.

title_en: Simulation method for evacuation process of people in fire, evacuation early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating the evacuation process of people under a fire disaster, an evacuation early warning method and a system. The sample is obtained by a simulation method of a personnel evacuation process under the fire, the simulation method comprehensively considers the correlation among building fire spread, structural failure and personnel evacuation in the simulation process, and simulates an evacuation route corresponding to a fire source according to the preset fire source. The evacuation route adopted by the invention is obtained according to the actual simulation condition, the risk uncertainty of fire spread, the resistance uncertainty of structural failure and the environment uncertainty of personnel evacuation are considered, and the real-time evacuation efficiency and the personnel safety under the condition of uncertain structural failure, in particular the safety of fire rescue people, can be improved.

title_en: Distributed resource uncertain transaction strategy considering typhoon time-space evolution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed resource uncertain transaction strategy considering typhoon space-time evolution, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, establishing a typhoon disaster space-time evolution model, and S2, calculating a power distribution network line time-varying fault rate and a fan time-varying fault rate based on the typhoon disaster space-time evolution model. S3, training a graph attention network based on time-varying failure rate of the nodes to obtain a power distribution network failure rate prediction model based on graph attention, obtaining an actual failure rate prediction value based on the power distribution network failure rate prediction model, S4, obtaining a wind power historical output data set, constructing an uncertainty fuzzy set based on Wasserstein distance, S5, constructing a distributed resource uncertainty trading strategy model considering typhoon time-space evolution, and solving the model to obtain a trading strategy. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the prediction result of the faults of the power distribution network under typhoon conditions, further optimizing the distribution and transaction of power resources and the like.

title_en: Extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty, and belongs to the field of disaster simulation and early warning of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of carrying out cascading failure simulation on a power grid in the typhoon scene, determining disconnection conditions of lines at each time point based on wind-induced failure rates of the lines at each time point in the typhoon scene and forming a wind-induced failure set, traversing the wind-induced failure set, calculating cascading failure caused by wind-induced failure at each time point based on the disconnection conditions of the lines and corresponding wind-electricity output, wherein the cascading failure comprises wind-induced failure and line disconnection failure caused by one or more thermal overloads, and determining key lines in the power grid based on the cascading failure in multiple simulation. The method provided by the invention accurately evaluates the influence of the cascading failure caused by typhoons on the power grid through the simulation of the cascading failure under typhoons by double time scales (typhoons and cascading failure time scales).
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-source precipitation data fusion method based on mathematical uncertainty analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source precipitation data fusion method based on mathematical uncertainty analysis, which comprises the following steps: s1, unifying the space-time resolution of precipitation data; s2, correcting the system deviation of the precipitation data; s3, constructing an error matrix of the multi-source precipitation data; s4, self-adaptive fusion of multi-source rainfall; s5, weather classification error correction of the precipitation data set is fused; and S6, post-processing precipitation fusion data. The method overcomes the dependence of multi-source precipitation data on ground observation in the uncertainty analysis and fusion process to the maximum extent, perfects the precipitation fusion technology of sparse areas of ground observation stations, improves the fusion stability of the multi-source precipitation data in a large spatial range, obviously reduces the false alarm rate of precipitation events, avoids the over-fitting problem of satellite data noise, finally obtains a more accurate and reliable large-range precipitation data product, and provides powerful support for further improving regional water resource management and natural disaster early warning and monitoring capability.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle group forest fire detection and extinguishing method and system based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle group forest fire detection and extinguishing method and system based on an improved ant colony algorithm, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control. The method comprises the following steps: updating the flying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the initial flying speed and the initial water carrying capacity; detecting whether an obstacle exists in the current flight direction and executing obstacle avoidance operation; searching for fire points in the current area, and if no fire points exist, releasing the rejection pheromone; if a fire point exists, water source is consumed to extinguish fire, and the attraction pheromone is released in the current area; updating a transfer probability function according to the rejection pheromone and the attraction pheromone, and determining the flight direction at the next moment according to the transfer probability function; under the full coverage condition, if the number of fire points is 0, the fire point detection of the current round is ended. The invention considers the relation between the flying speed and the water carrying capacity, and is more fit with the actual situation; the ant colony algorithm is improved by introducing the attraction pheromone and the rejection pheromone, so that all search areas can be covered more quickly, and the fire disaster point can be detected quickly.

title_en: Building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on deep learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic data and historical storm time sequence data of a research area; s2, processing the data; s3, constructing an FFC model based on a deep learning algorithm, training and verifying the FFC model, optimizing the affected building attention coefficient to obtain the optimal affected building attention coefficient for each building type, and testing the performance of the FFC model; s4, inputting the forecast rainfall time sequence into the FFC model tested for each building type, and performing repeated rolling iteration prediction to obtain probability distribution results of different functions of each building in a certain time range in the future of the research area. The obtained building function probability distribution result is beneficial to providing more information and uncertainty quantification for decision-making of decision-makers, thereby providing a good basis for the determination of the subsequent evacuation requirements.

title_en: Offset registration method and system for disaster deformation image
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offset registration method and system for disaster deformation images, which relate to the technical field of disaster deformation monitoring and comprise the steps of obtaining images to be registered in the same place before and after disaster deformation through a plurality of platforms, dividing the images to be registered into a plurality of blocks, obtaining reference images with geographic reference information before disaster deformation, extracting characteristic points on the reference images, determining search areas in the images to be registered through the geographic reference information of the characteristic points, detecting the same name points between the reference images and each image to be registered, correcting errors of each image to be registered through the same name points, splicing the corrected images to be registered to obtain images to be registered, and performing optical offset processing on the images to be registered to obtain offsets of the images to be registered after registration. The invention overcomes the defect of insufficient data or insufficient time resolution of a single platform and improves the time and space resolution.

title_en: Mobile energy storage pre-layout and dynamic scheduling system and method for toughness improvement of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage pre-layout and dynamic scheduling system and method for improving toughness of a power distribution network, which belong to the technical field of power systems and smart grids and comprise two stages of pre-disaster pre-configuration and post-disaster cooperative scheduling, wherein a two-stage robust optimization model for fusing uncertainty of photovoltaic output is constructed in the pre-disaster stage, the configuration cost of mobile energy storage, load reduction risk and key node traffic accessibility are comprehensively considered to generate an optimal deployment scheme, and a multi-source cooperative dynamic scheduling model is constructed based on traffic network states and multi-source output characteristics in the post-disaster stage to optimize migration paths, charge-discharge strategies and charge state control of mobile energy storage in real time and minimize power supply loss of key load. The system realizes the rapid power supply recovery and safe operation in the island power grid by cooperatively controlling distributed resources such as mobile energy storage, electric vehicles, photovoltaic generators, diesel generators and the like. The invention obviously improves the quick response capability and recovery efficiency of the power distribution network under extreme disasters.

title_en: In-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence, which comprises the steps of obtaining state data, a target extreme climate data set and historical disaster data of an in-service bridge, determining vulnerable key structural components of the in-service bridge under corresponding extreme climate according to the historical disaster data, determining a dominant failure mode, constructing an in-service bridge model containing parameter uncertainty according to the state data of the bridge, the vulnerable key structural components under the corresponding extreme climate and the dominant failure mode by adopting finite elements, inputting the target extreme climate data set into the in-service bridge model, and calculating probability distribution of bridge damage states of the key structural components at the second moment under different intensities through Monte Carlo simulation of a plurality of groups of random parameter samples to generate an extreme climate intensity-failure probability vulnerability curve. By implementing the method, the efficiency and the precision are effectively balanced, and the safety risk of the bridge under extreme weather is reduced.

title_en: Important facility early warning critical rainfall calculation method based on high-precision digital earth surface model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an important facility early warning critical rainfall calculation method based on a high-precision digital earth surface model, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting high-precision point cloud mapping data of cities where important facilities are located, data such as current land utilization classification and the like, and collecting submerged water depth data of key positions; s2, correcting various collected data; s3, fusing the corrected various data; s4, dynamically dividing the sub-catchment areas in three stages based on the fused topographic data; s5, constructing a multi-city rainfall flood runoff model based on Bayesian average; s6, inputting rainfall data under different reproduction periods into a multi-city rainfall runoff model based on Bayesian average constructed in the step S5, predicting a flooding result under rainfall conditions of different reproduction periods, and calculating the early warning critical rainfall of each important facility storm disaster caused by the flooding result; the invention overcomes the simulation error caused by the structural uncertainty of the single urban rainfall flood runoff model and improves the accuracy of storm disaster early warning.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting track position of mobile user
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for predicting a track position of a mobile user, and belongs to the technical field of data mining processing. According to the invention, a circulating mixed density network comprising an LSTM network and an MDN network is constructed as a prediction model, the prediction model can automatically extract depth features, and the prediction model can be used for learning the motion trend, long-time history information and hidden representative features of a user from the latest trajectory data of the mobile user, so that the prediction of the position coordinates of the user in a period of time in the future is realized. The invention solves the problems of sparsity and dimension disaster faced when predicting continuous position coordinate values, can fully simulate the uncertainty of motion behaviors, and can improve the accuracy of prediction.

title_en: Rural building group flood disaster loss assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building group flood influence analysis, and provides a method and a system for evaluating the flood disaster loss of a rural building group, aiming at the problem that the accuracy of an evaluation result is low due to the fact that uncertainty factors in the loss evaluation process are not fully considered in the existing building flood loss function; comparing the submerged depth map with SAR image water body extraction data and social media data to obtain a flood simulation result, combining building classification information and the maximum submerged depth map to obtain submerged depth of each building, calculating component information of the building, analyzing building flood vulnerability according to the component information and the submerged depth to determine total loss of all buildings, and evaluating the effect of the current disaster prevention measures according to the total loss under different disaster prevention measures. The invention can provide scientific basis for building flood loss assessment and disaster prevention decision.

title_en: Disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for synchronization signals and improves broadcasting quality of radio shaded areas
title_ko: 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal in a wireless section where data loss may occur and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area so as to improve the reliability of disaster broadcasting. The disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area comprises: a disaster broadcasting receiving device having an FPGA module for noise reduction to reduce noise caused by the surrounding environment when receiving a disaster broadcasting RF signal, and converting a digital demodulated signal from which the noise has been removed into Internet packet data and outputting the same; a main relay device that receives the Internet packet data output from the disaster broadcasting receiving device through a wired network and outputs the same as a short-range wireless signal; a sub-relay device that receives the short-range wireless signal output from the main relay device, modulates the same into a synchronized disaster broadcasting RF signal, and outputs the same; and a user terminal having a disaster broadcasting reception communication module for receiving the disaster broadcasting RF signal output through the sub-relay device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 동기신호를 보상하여 불확실성을 갖는 무선구간의 신뢰성을 향상시키고 전파음영지역에 용이하게 재난방송을 전달할 수 있도록 하는 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템에 관한 것으로, 전파음영지역의 건물내부에 설치되며 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하는 경우에 주변환경으로 인한 노이즈를 저감시키기 위한 노이즈 저감용 FPGA모듈을 구비하여 노이즈가 제거된 디지털 복조신호를 인터넷 패킷 데이터로 변환하여 출력하는 재난방송 수신장치, 상기 건물내부를 구성하는 층별로 설치되고 상기 재난방송 수신장치에서 출력되는 인터넷 패킷데이터를 유선망으로 수신하여 근거리 무선신호로 출력하는 메인중계장치, 상기 메인중계장치가 설치된 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되며 상기 메인중계장치에서 출력되는 근거리무선신호를 수신하여 동기화된 재난방송용 RF신호로 변조하여 출력하는 서브중계장치, 및 상기 서브중계장치를 통해 출력되는 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하기 위한 재난방송수신용 통신모듈을 구비하는 사용자 단말기;를 구비한다.

title_en: Disaster-stricken person searching method based on rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-stricken person searching method based on a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: after flying into a designated search area, the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle collects audio signals; when the audio signal is detected to be a voice signal according to the spectral entropy of the audio signal, positioning a sound production source of the audio signal to obtain the position of the disaster-stricken person; controlling a nose of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to always point to a target position, wherein the target position and the position of the disaster-stricken person are positioned in the same vertical direction, and the distance between the target position and the position of the disaster-stricken person is a first designated distance; controlling the head of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to keep a second specified distance from the target position; and the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle carries out point-winding flight monitoring around the target position according to the preset flying-winding speed and the second specified distance. Can lock the personnel that suffer from a disaster fast to rescue action is saved more lives in limited time in the acceleration of being convenient for.

title_en: Expert knowledge fused power transmission line environment risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power transmission line risk assessment, and particularly relates to a power transmission line environment risk assessment method fusing expert knowledge. In the data acquisition stage, the influence of multiple data sources and multiple factors on the environmental risk of the power transmission line is integrated, and a multi-metadata basis is provided for risk assessment. And then, combining expert knowledge and fuzzy mathematics to construct a multi-risk multi-dimensional disaster-causing factor knowledge base and a multi-dimensional disaster-causing factor membership function knowledge base, so that the purpose of multi-disaster environmental risk assessment of the power transmission line is achieved, and the universality of the method is improved. Finally, a multi-risk calculation method based on the multi-risk multi-dimensional disaster-causing factor knowledge base and the multi-dimensional disaster-causing factor membership function knowledge base is provided, the calculation method comprises BPA calculation, multi-source evidence fusion, risk probability generation and the like, the risk quantitative evaluation of the power transmission line is achieved, the uncertainty of input data and evaluation results can be flexibly processed, and the stability of the risk evaluation is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU KAPU DATA SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Expressway mobile energy storage pre-disaster pre-layout planning method, system, equipment and medium considering fault situation and uncertainty of photovoltaic conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-layout planning method, system, equipment and medium for expressway mobile energy storage before disaster, which take fault situations and uncertainty of photovoltaic conditions into account, comprising the following steps: step 1, constructing a pre-layout model of the expressway before the mobile energy storage disaster by taking the constraint of the expressway power distribution network and the limitation of the scheduling resources into consideration with the aim of ensuring the safety and reliability of the expressway energy consumption and economy; step 2, solving an objective function and constraint conditions in the model based on a robust optimization method of a column constraint generation algorithm to obtain a pre-layout scheme; step 3, based on the consideration of double uncertainties of fault situations and photovoltaic conditions, combining a pre-layout scheme to obtain a robust optimization pre-layout scheme; the invention can reasonably layout the mobile energy storage equipment before disaster according to the prediction scene so as to cope with the adverse effect on the expressway system caused by possible fault moment.
assignees: CHANGAN UNIV;GUANGXI COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP CO LTD;GUANGXI GUIHE HIGHWAY CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive plain reservoir dam break simulation method for break position
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, discloses a method for simulating dam break of a plain reservoir with self-adaptive break position, and aims to solve the problems of low modeling efficiency, large human error, poor model reusability and the like existing in the traditional method for simulating dam break aiming at uncertainty of the break position of the plain reservoir. According to the invention, the position of the breach is decoupled from the grid profile through a predefined self-adaptive boundary and automatic matching mechanism, the single scene switching is shortened to the minute level, the manual operation error is eliminated, the simulation of the breach at any position of the box dam is supported, the efficiency, the reliability and the flexibility of dam break risk analysis of a plain reservoir are greatly improved, and a powerful technical support is provided for flood control and disaster relief emergency decision.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.
assignees: SOLVIT SYSTEM CO LTD;BIG & DEEP CO LTD

title_en: Electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on probability map
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on a probability map, which comprises the following steps: establishing a Bayesian network model of a power distribution network equipment outage event under a typhoon disaster, and predicting the power distribution network equipment outage probability based on a Bayesian network; establishing an alternating current optimal power flow model, analyzing the overload condition of a power distribution network line, and carrying out load shedding on a power system; evaluating the capability of the coupling network for resisting external interference by using a probability graph-based electric traffic coupling network vulnerability evaluation model; the method takes a probability graph as a support, establishes an electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment model, and realizes calculation of electric traffic coupling network elasticity measurement; based on historical meteorological data, the method can be used for predicting the cascade fault propagation mechanism of the electric power traffic coupling network under typhoon disasters, ensures the accuracy and rapidity of real-time estimation, and provides theoretical basis for emergency plans under typhoon weather.

title_en: Sea surface search and rescue target strengthening method based on polarization information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea surface search and rescue target strengthening method based on polarization information, and aims to solve the technical problems that the existing sea surface search and rescue target based on the polarization information has limited detection imaging technical level and target strengthening level, and is difficult to flexibly meet the requirements of complex and variable sea conditions and weather in real time. The method comprises the steps of firstly, imaging a search area on a plurality of specific polarization angles simultaneously through a real-time snapshot type polarization imaging device, ensuring that the imaging effect is free from adverse effects caused by relative movement such as trailing and the like through a mechanical electronic image stabilizing device on the imaging device, then carrying out initial contrast evaluation and classification on collected images containing suspected targets, and carrying out image enhancement by utilizing target multimode visible light polarization information in combination with weather information at the time of search and rescue when the contrast is evaluated to be low.
assignees: XIAN INST OPTICS & PREC MECHANICS CAS

title_en: Method, device, equipment, storage medium and product for forecasting river basin flood
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of flood forecasting, in particular to a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product for forecasting river basin flood, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a watershed hydrological model based on the acquired topographic data, soil information, vegetation information, meteorological information, actual measurement precipitation data and actual measurement flow data of the target watershed; constructing an accumulated distribution function by utilizing historical remote sensing soil humidity data of a target river basin obtained by a hydrologic model; correcting the current remote sensing soil humidity data of the target river basin by utilizing the accumulated distribution function to obtain a state value of the soil humidity of the underlying surface of the target river basin; and inputting the humidity state value of the underlying soil into a watershed hydrological model, and generating watershed flood forecast information according to the rainfall weather forecast data of the target watershed. The application can effectively reduce uncertainty of flood forecast, realize accurate forecast of flood in river basin, provide more accurate and reliable forecast data for flood forecast, and facilitate expansion of flood control and disaster reduction work.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster factor identification method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and a system for identifying disaster causing factors of geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining geological disaster point data and environment data of a target area, generating environment influence factor data according to the environment data, calculating and analyzing influence degree of each environment influence factor on spatial distribution of the geological disaster point by using a geographic detector based on the geological disaster point data and the environment influence factor data, extracting disaster causing factors influencing the spatial distribution of the geological disasters, and carrying out data mapping on the target area, the geological disaster type and the disaster causing factors to generate a disaster causing factor database of the target area. According to the embodiment of the invention, the disaster causing factors influencing the spatial distribution of the geological disasters are extracted by using the geographic detector by acquiring the geological disaster point data and the environment data of different target areas and different geological disaster types, and the disaster causing factor database aiming at the different target areas and different types of geological disasters is established, so that the uncertainty of the susceptibility evaluation of the geological disasters is reduced.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Planning method and system for improving pre-disaster variability of toughness of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planning method and a system for improving the pre-disaster variability of the toughness of a power distribution network, belonging to the technical field of planning of the toughness improvement of the power distribution network and a traffic network. Combining historical data, constructing a fuzzy uncertainty set of partial component faults under the conditions of different reinforcement grades and disaster intensities, adopting an opportunity constraint model to carry out constraint modeling to form fault probability condition data, generating a post-disaster severe scene, carrying out maintenance team repair and cutting load scheduling, evaluating a total cost function, and judging whether a minimum total cost target is reached. The invention carries out differential planning based on the uncertainty of the multi-level fault probability and the deep coupling characteristic of the power grid and the traffic network, reduces the investment cost before disaster while improving the toughness of the network, effectively balances the relation between the improvement of the toughness and the economy, and has better applicability.

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling charging network toughness assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electric power-traffic coupling charging network, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis. According to the method, an electric power-traffic coupling charging network is built, a Bezier curve is combined to simulate a typhoon path and a Holland wind field model to calculate wind speed, dynamic traffic flow distribution, alternating current optimal power flow and cascading fault models are built, a Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate a fault data set, a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to train a fault prediction model, a dynamic probability map is output after the actually measured wind speed is input, and dynamic toughness indexes are calculated to evaluate the toughness of the electric power-traffic coupling charging network. According to the method, the problem of fault propagation and insufficient dynamic evaluation among the systems is considered, and the toughness evaluation precision of the power-traffic coupling charging network under typhoon disasters is improved.

title_en: Flow process analysis method for intensity index space variation flow state landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flow process analysis method of an intensity index space variation flow state landslide, which comprises the steps of inputting boundary conditions of the flow state landslide, the geometric dimension of a landslide body and rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters into a program, initializing the boundary conditions, the geometric dimension of the landslide body and the rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters, utilizing a Karhunen-Lo e expansion method as a stochastic theory, modeling uncertainty and space propagation of a random variable to generate a random sample of the space variation flow state landslide, carrying out deterministic analysis on the flow process of the flow state landslide based on an SPH method, combining the stochastic theory with an SPH model, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation in the SPH method, and finally carrying out statistical analysis on simulation results of different stochastic examples to obtain a probability statistical rule of flow state landslide sliding distance and sliding speed; the method can evaluate the sliding distance, the sliding speed and the disaster causing range of the landslide under the influence of the spatial variability of the strength parameters.

title_en: Optimization method for maritime search and rescue disposal scheme of civil helicopter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil helicopter maritime search and rescue treatment scheme optimization method, which comprises the following steps: initializing a population of a disposal scheme according to the parameterization definition and value range of the task area; carrying out non-dominated sorting on the population, and endowing virtual fitness until all individuals are grouped; performing crossover, mutation and selection genetic mutation operations in the population, and outputting a Pareto front solution set when an optimization result is converged or the iteration number exceeds a set maximum genetic algebra; adding corresponding search and rescue modes and task properties in the task area of each front edge solution set to form a disposal scheme set for maritime search and rescue of the helicopter; simulation deduction is carried out according to the sequence, and simulation data of the treatment scheme evaluation indexes under the influence of uncertainty factors are output through large sample simulation; and comprehensively evaluating the simulation data of each treatment scheme, representing the comprehensive evaluation result in a normal distribution mode, and selecting the treatment scheme with the largest mean value and the smallest variance.

title_en: Multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation
abstract_en: The multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation that the invention discloses a kind of, method include: that S1 applies a variety of focal shock parameter estimation methods to establish potential tsunami source region seismicity parameters logic tree；S2 establishes tsunami unit source Green's function database using linear tsunami numerical simulation；S3 generates Stochastic earthquake event set according to above-mentioned logic tree, using Monte Carlo stochastic simulation；S4 is simulated using random slippage according to tsunami unit source Green's function database and Stochastic earthquake event set and is generated tsunami wave amplitude collection；Analysis of uncertainty of the S5 according to tsunami wave amplitude collection, to multiple current Tsunami disaster distribution results statistics and result.The above method be able to solve risk evaluation result in the prior art it is higher and can not provide its correspond to probability of happening the problem of, a variety of uncertainties are fused in final assessment result, increase the confidence level of result, operational efficiency is improved simultaneously, policymaker is facilitated targetedly to make prevent and reduce natural disasters deployment and physical construction planning.

title_en: Method for reducing natural disaster loss through artificial intervention earthquake
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of geoscience and discloses a method for reducing natural disaster loss through artificial intervention on earthquakes. According to the invention, through drilling and deep burying, explosives are placed near the position of the crust with potential earthquake risk, the explosives are detonated, and the stress and energy accumulated in the crust are released, so that the aims of early prediction and planned occurrence of the earthquake are fulfilled. Avoiding personal casualties and property loss caused by the uncertainty of earthquake. The natural disaster of the earthquake which is originally uncertain and high in loss is made to be interventable and low in loss.
assignees: SHENYANG COMMUNICATION NETWORK SERVICE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for sensing disaster of soluble rock stratum tunnel based on multi-source information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soluble rock stratum tunnel disaster sensing method and system based on multi-source information, which belong to the technical field of tunnel engineering safety monitoring and comprise the steps of establishing a monitoring index data set, converging the monitoring index data set to a cloud end for space-time registration to generate a multi-dimensional time sequence data field, calculating data uncertainty of each monitoring area by adopting an information entropy theory, calculating space-time evolution characteristics, carrying out classifier identification by combining spatial gradients of a deformation field to obtain a key monitoring area, adaptively adjusting sensor acquisition frequency, starting a supplementary monitoring device for encryption observation, carrying out space-time response calculation by adopting a machine learning algorithm to generate a tunnel disaster evolution prediction result, and carrying out grading threshold comparison and numerical simulation verification on the prediction result to realize effective identification and sensing of disaster evolution states. The method adopts the technical means of combining multisource data fusion, information entropy theory, machine learning and self-adaptive monitoring, and can realize dynamic, accurate and predictive sensing of the tunnel disaster evolution process.

title_en: Urban flood disaster dynamic emergency decision method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic emergency decision method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for urban flood disasters, and relates to the technical field of emergency management and response scheduling. The method comprises the steps of constructing a random differential game model for flood disaster emergency decision, solving a game saddle point strategy through a forward-backward scanning algorithm to obtain an optimal emergency prevention and control strategy, carrying out multi-dimensional simulation verification by taking a typical flood disaster event as a sample, and finally adjusting the strategy according to a simulation result to form a target emergency prevention and control strategy and using the target emergency prevention and control strategy for actual emergency decision. The application can give consideration to space-time dynamic characteristics and random uncertainty in emergency decisions of urban flood disasters, and realize dynamic adaptation and continuous efficient decisions of disaster systems and emergency response systems.

title_en: Method for constructing large through tower in mountain rock mass and section superposing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a large through tower in mountain rock mass and a section superposing method thereof. The technical scheme adopted is as follows: the construction process comprises the steps of digging a transportation channel, connecting for construction, expanding for construction, strengthening and preburying for construction, and installing for construction. The construction of preburying and irrigating comprises the step of burying the preburied part when irrigating, and the construction of the upper and the lower standard components comprises the step of strengthening the standard component with the preburied part through the method of constructing simultaneously up and down. By using the construction method of the technique, in the construction process, the excavated stone can be output continuously from the transportation channel so that the construction schedule can be quickened and the uncertainty that the stones fall in the course of drilling from down to up is avoided; therefore, the method is safe. The method has the beneficial effects of being small in investment, low in cost, short in construction period, less in influence from disaster, free from the effect of nucleus, safe in constructing process, stable in operating process, easy in confidentiality, easy to start emergency generation system and good in reutilization; besides, multiple processes can run simultaneously in construction.

title_en: Uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT, and belongs to the field of intelligent prediction of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining slope history monitoring data and normalizing, constructing a GRU deterministic prediction model to conduct displacement prediction and generate an error sequence, decomposing the error sequence into a low-frequency system error and a high-frequency random error by adopting a TCN-Attention-EWT combined method, respectively establishing a GRU error correction sub-model with Monte Carlo Dropout, calculating probability distribution dynamic fusion weights of the low-frequency system error and the high-frequency random error correction based on an information theory, fusing a deterministic prediction value with probability distribution of the two correction values, and obtaining a final displacement prediction mean value and a prediction interval through inverse normalization. The method realizes high-precision prediction and uncertainty quantification of landslide displacement and provides reliable technical support for landslide early warning.

title_en: Robot cluster search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot cluster search and rescue method, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of search and rescue robots form a cluster, a formation is kept to be carried out from the original place to the direction of a suspected target, and a plurality of distributed suspected search areas are searched in the proceeding direction in sequence; when the suspected search area does not find the target, leaving a search and rescue robot in the suspected search area, and keeping the rest search and rescue robots in a cluster state to continue to carry out until the target is searched; the invention can continue to expand search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area to improve the success rate of search and rescue, and when a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supply robot collaboratively sends the left search and rescue robots to the target positions together.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on multi-modal adaptive association learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and system based on multi-mode self-adaptive association learning, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. The intelligent migration and sharing of geological knowledge are realized by generating three key steps and components through cross-regional multi-modal associated learning, adaptive analysis in an evolution stage and intelligent early warning, and deeply fusing InSAR monitoring data and geological expert knowledge, the staged features in the geological disaster evolution process are adaptively captured, stable early warning performance can be maintained under different geological conditions and evolution stages, and the uncertainty influence of a single data source is reduced particularly through complementation and constraint of multi-modal information. The method can remarkably improve the accuracy and timeliness of geological disaster early warning, is particularly suitable for data scarce areas, and provides scientific basis for disaster prevention and reduction decisions.

title_en: Sea surface search and rescue target strengthening method based on polarization information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea surface search and rescue target strengthening method based on polarization information, which aims to solve the technical problems that the existing sea surface search and rescue target based on the polarization information has limited detection imaging technical level and target strengthening level, and is difficult to flexibly cope with complex and changeable sea conditions and weather requirements in real time. The method comprises the steps of firstly, imaging a search area on a plurality of specific polarization angles through a real-time snapshot type polarization imaging device, ensuring that the imaging effect is free from adverse effects caused by relative movement such as tailing and the like through a mechano-electronic image stabilizing device on the imaging device, then carrying out initial contrast evaluation classification on the acquired images containing suspected targets, and carrying out image reinforcement by utilizing target multimode visible light polarization information in combination with search and rescue weather information when the contrast is evaluated to be low.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for risk loss of single landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method for risk loss of monomer landslides (including soil landslides and rock landslides), and belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and reduction and risk management research. The method is based on an upper limit theorem, a lower limit theorem and an interval analysis method, approaches to a landslide disaster risk loss truth value from the lower limit direction and the upper limit direction, overcomes the defects of large uncertainty, large deviation between an evaluation result and actual landslide disaster loss and the like caused by the adoption of a single fixed value risk loss evaluation result in the past, has the characteristics of quickness, dynamic property, practicability and the like, can serve for landslide disaster quantitative risk evaluation, and provides a decision basis for formulating landslide disaster risk management measures.
assignees: LOGISTICAL ENGINEERING UNIV OF PLA;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Path planning method and device for searching of unmanned aircraft and unmanned aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method and a path planning device for unmanned aircraft searching and an unmanned aircraft, and belongs to the technical field of offshore intelligent search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: analyzing the marine accident information by adopting a Monte Carlo random particle simulation method to establish a particle initial distribution map; performing cluster analysis on the initial particle distribution by using a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), and determining a target search area corresponding to the probability of the best particle based on a corrosion expansion confidence ellipse algorithm; s2: establishing an under-actuated unmanned aircraft steering mathematical model adaptive to boundary characteristics, and determining a steering non-working path; s3: and optimizing the global search discovery probability and the search total path based on a double-normalization multi-target search planning algorithm to obtain an area coverage optimal path planning strategy. The invention provides a search area determining method, improves a classic parallel line sea sweeping search strategy to realize area search planning, and improves the search success probability of the people in distress on the premise of putting limited search force.

title_en: Graph search driving mode based on extended spiral line
abstract_en: The invention provides a graph search driving mode based on an extended spiral line, and mainly solves the problems that parameters needing to be input when search rescue is carried out in the prior art are complex, the efficiency is low, a search area is incomplete, and the best search and rescue opportunity is easy to miss. The implementation scheme is as follows: according to the principle that the airplane realizes turning by controlling the inclination angle, firstly, four input parameters of an initial position delta, an initial radius chi, a linear increasing speed xi and a turning direction lambda are set; then, respectively calculating an inclination angle alpha and an additional inclination angle beta according to a standard control law and an airplane turning radius formula; and finally, controlling the airplane to realize a circular flight mode with a radius r ═ χ + ξ × dt increasing according to the new inclination angle γ ═ α + β, wherein dt is a program cycle period. The invention has the advantages of simple input parameters, high efficiency and wide search coverage, can effectively avoid or reduce casualties, meets the use requirements of search and rescue, and can be used for an airborne navigation system.
assignees: SHAANXI CHANGLING ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-stage toughness improving method considering intelligent soft switch optimization configuration for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a multi-stage toughness improving method for a power distribution network considering intelligent soft switch optimal configuration, which comprises the following steps of: taking typhoon weather as a representative of extreme weather, generating a random disaster scene by considering uncertainty conditions, and establishing a power distribution network fault model under the typhoon disaster; analyzing the fault processing and power supply recovery process of the power distribution network during the typhoon disaster; determining constraint conditions, considering cost, determining the installation position of the intelligent soft switch, and obtaining a recovery strategy; the method comprises the steps of converting a power distribution network toughness improvement optimization model into a mixed integer second-order cone planning framework, formulating a power distribution network recovery operation rule by taking a power distribution system toughness index during a typhoon disaster as a target function, and determining an operation sequence of switching between adjacent states of a system to obtain a power distribution network toughness improvement scheme. According to the method, a two-stage mixed integer second-order cone model is used, economic cost and toughness indexes are used as objective functions, the installation position of the intelligent soft switch is determined in an optimized mode, and then the toughness improvement scheme of the power distribution network is completed.
assignees: FUSHUN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Firefly algorithm-based regional power grid evaluation model and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power supply or distribution technology, in particular to a regional power grid evaluation model and an optimization method based on a firefly algorithm, wherein uncertainty risk calculation is carried out based on a risk theory and an N-1 fault, and the importance degree of a line return result representation branch is quantized; evaluating the network characteristics of the nodes based on a Flouard algorithm, comprehensively representing the node importance degree by combining the branch importance degree, and giving consideration to both the electrical characteristics and the network characteristics by an element evaluation system; constructing a core backbone network frame search model by taking the sum of economic construction cost and network operation risk as an objective function and combining actual operation constraint; and solving by adopting an improved binary firefly algorithm to obtain a final core backbone network construction scheme. The method provides a new method and a new idea for constructing the core backbone network frame, optimizes the search result of the network frame, and improves the disaster tolerance and resistance capability of the system so as to establish a safer and more economic power system. The method has certain reference value for the optimization planning development of the power grid in the current region.

title_en: New energy output uncertainty-based power transmission system partition recovery method and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a partition recovery method and a terminal of a power transmission system based on uncertainty of new energy output, which are used for establishing a black start power supply operation model according to starting, climbing and scheduling of a thermal power unit in the power transmission system and fully linearizing the model; then, providing a power transmission network partition rule based on power transmission network black start power distribution information and post-disaster damage information; and establishing a random optimization model based on the partitioned recovery of the power transmission network of the plurality of new energy units according to the black start power supply linearization model and the partitioned rule of the power transmission network. And the problem that the model solving efficiency is reduced under the condition that the output scene of the new energy unit is increased is considered, so that model decomposition and distributed solving are carried out, and the calculating efficiency of the model is further improved. In this way, a method for quickly recovering the power system after large-scale grid connection of new energy is provided.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile grid-connected optimization operation method for emergency power supply of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric automobile grid-connected optimization operation method for power distribution network emergency power supply, which comprises the following steps: s101, acquiring typhoon extreme weather historical data information; s102, establishing a disaster uncertainty scene set of a traffic-electrical coupling network of typhoon disasters; s103, establishing a scene-based electric vehicle two-stage random optimization problem model, wherein the first stage is a pre-disaster defense plan, and the second stage is post-disaster emergency power supply; s104, solving a two-stage random optimization problem model of the electric automobile to obtain electric automobile scheduling schemes under different probability scenes and obtain optimized operation curves of all units in an optimization period and corresponding index calculation results.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization, which comprises the following steps of S1, converting a to-be-searched and rescue area into a two-dimensional search and rescue area, S2, conducting grid decomposition on the two-dimensional search and rescue area, S3, obtaining a probability map through a Gaussian mixture model, S4, establishing a multi-target collaborative optimization function of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, S5, solving the function based on a mixed particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution, and generating a specific search and rescue path of an unmanned aerial vehicle according to the solved optimal solution.
