According to the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue multi-objective collaborative optimization function, the unmanned aerial vehicle is guided to execute the search and rescue task by taking the resource balanced allocation, the maximum path safety, the priority coverage of the high-risk area and the minimum energy consumption as targets, the task allocation, the path planning and the energy management are improved, the multi-objective optimization of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path planning is realized, the accurate flight path is determined for each unmanned aerial vehicle, the whole coverage of the search and rescue task is ensured, and the search and rescue efficiency and the success rate are remarkably improved.

title_en: Multi-source weather refined prediction method based on physical offset model
abstract_en: A multisource weather refined prediction method based on a physical offset model introduces a double-channel space-time coding, a physical priori guided attention mechanism, a multiscale sliding window input and gating feature fusion strategy into a model framework, and combines the technologies of Bayesian optimization driven super-parameter automatic search, self-adaptive mixed loss function, uncertainty quantization, physical consistency post-processing and the like, thereby remarkably improving modeling capacity and prediction robustness of the model on complex weather processes (especially extreme events). Whether based on simulation testing of analysis data or in verification of a real meteorological observation site, the method shows prediction accuracy, stability and interpretability superior to those of a traditional numerical mode and a single deep learning model. The invention provides reliable technical support for refined weather service, disaster weather early warning and energy scheduling decision, and has important application value and popularization prospect.
assignees: POWERCHINA HENAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA CENTRAL CHINA ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster risk assessment method for long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake of reticulated shell structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-disaster risk assessment of a reticulated shell structure, and particularly provides a method for assessing long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake multi-disaster risk of the reticulated shell structure. The method mainly comprises the following steps: generating a long-term wind load conforming to the local historical climate law of the structure; evaluating fatigue damage and performance degradation degree of the latticed shell structure under the action of long-term wind load; and calculating the multi-disaster risk of the reticulated shell structure under the long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake actions. The method solves the problem that the limitations of long-term wind induced fatigue and wind direction randomness are not considered in the existing multi-disaster analysis technology. In addition, uncertainty of structural materials, uncertainty of earthquake motion and fitting model errors are considered through a statistical method, and an exponential equation is utilized to establish a multi-disaster probability demand model, so that a multi-disaster risk assessment result of the reticulated shell structure is more accurate.

title_en: Intelligent switch planning method considering disaster pre-disaster-middle-post multi-stage cooperation and disaster uncertainty
abstract_en: An intelligent switch planning method considering pre-disaster-mid-post multi-stage synergy and disaster uncertainty relates to the technical field of intelligent switch planning of power grids and is used for solving the problem that the existing pre-disaster planning does not consider the disaster intensity uncertainty. The invention realizes the multi-stage coordination of determining the number of switches in the planning stage, finishing switch address selection in the prevention stage and closing the switch to restore load in the post-disaster stage by coupling the available measures of the pre-disaster planning stage, the pre-disaster prevention stage, the post-disaster recovery stage. In addition, a gradual hedging algorithm is provided, a large nonlinear model is decomposed into a plurality of scene-related sub-problems to be solved, and the calculation load is greatly reduced. Simulation results show that compared with a pre-disaster-post-disaster two-stage planning model, the model provided by the invention not only can obtain a more flexible planning scheme, but also can reduce investment cost and load power failure loss.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;YANTAI ENGINEERING UNIV RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST

title_en: Automatic detection and restoration discrimination method for side slope damage area based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope damage area automatic detection and restoration judging method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multi-time-phase slope monitoring data and preprocessing the multi-time-phase slope monitoring data to form multi-source input data, inputting the multi-source input data into a variant DeepLab to divide a network to generate slope damage area boundary data, carrying out time sequence analysis based on the slope damage area boundary data to generate slope damage evolution data, combining the boundary data with the evolution data, extracting areas, crack widths, displacement rates and slopes to form restoration judging parameter sets, inputting the restoration judging parameter sets into an improved multi-parameter restoration judging network to output restoration grade data, introducing an uncertainty modeling module into the network to generate restoration judging confidence coefficient data, matching restoration measure libraries according to the restoration grade data and the restoration judging confidence coefficient to generate restoration measure recommendation results and outputting a judgment report. The detection and discrimination are integrated, and the method is suitable for geological disaster monitoring and treatment.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Geological disaster emergency decision method and system based on self-adaptive generation type AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster emergency decision method and a system based on self-adaptive generation type AI, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster emergency response and artificial intelligence intersection, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing; S2, landslide segmentation and uncertainty quantification, S3, feature extraction and uncertainty gating, S4, high confidence report Prompt construction, S5, low confidence retrieval enhancement processing, S6, final report generation and output, S7, active learning and model iteration. The geological disaster emergency decision method based on the self-adaptive generation type AI is used for realizing high-efficiency analysis, omitting emergency labeling and retraining cost, improving the reliability of a report, combining an external professional knowledge base which can be dynamically maintained, and enabling a power assisting system to self-evolve, so that the identification accuracy and robustness are continuously improved, and the low confidence coefficient target is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for calculating surging probability of random sampling and storage device
abstract_en: The application provides a calculation method of a surge override probability of random sampling, which comprises the following steps: according to a target area, a numerical model is built, a landslide parameter value range of the target area is analyzed, landslide input parameters required by building the numerical model are processed, and random variables are generated. And carrying out Latin hypercube sampling according to the random variable to generate a random sample, inputting the random sample into the numerical model, extracting the surge propagation height corresponding to the random variable, determining a surge propagation height threshold according to a disaster-stricken body of the target area, and calculating the overrun probability of the surge propagation height exceeding the surge propagation height threshold. The random samples are generated by Latin hypercube sampling of the selected random variables, and then are processed by a model, so that the overrun probability that the surge propagation distance exceeds the threshold height is calculated, the uncertainty of landslide input parameters is quantized, and the accuracy of landslide-surge disaster prediction is improved.

title_en: Geological disaster factor identification method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and a system for identifying disaster causing factors of geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining geological disaster point data and environment data of a target area, generating environment influence factor data according to the environment data, calculating and analyzing influence degree of each environment influence factor on spatial distribution of the geological disaster point by using a geographic detector based on the geological disaster point data and the environment influence factor data, extracting disaster causing factors influencing the spatial distribution of the geological disasters, and carrying out data mapping on the target area, the geological disaster type and the disaster causing factors to generate a disaster causing factor database of the target area. According to the embodiment of the invention, the disaster causing factors influencing the spatial distribution of the geological disasters are extracted by using the geographic detector by acquiring the geological disaster point data and the environment data of different target areas and different geological disaster types, and the disaster causing factor database aiming at the different target areas and different types of geological disasters is established, so that the uncertainty of the susceptibility evaluation of the geological disasters is reduced.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based automatic field personnel searching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic field personnel searching method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle receives a route flight instruction sent by the handheld terminal device and carries out route flight in a search area, the unmanned aerial vehicle acquires an infrared image of the search area through a camera in the route flight process, carries out image processing on the infrared image, identifies whether a result of a person exists in the image through thermal imaging threshold analysis and trapped person motion analysis, controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out tracking snapshot on the person according to the image identification result, acquires position information and environment information of the person, and sends the position information and the environment information to the handheld terminal device and the cloud server. The invention can accurately identify the trapped person in the field under the condition of more field shielding objects, and accurately rescue the trapped person by fully automatically identifying the person and acquiring surrounding environment information, thereby not only reducing the cost, but also reducing the manpower resource.

title_en: Post-disaster city full-coverage detection method based on heterogeneous unmanned system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster city full-coverage detection method based on a heterogeneous unmanned system, which belongs to the technical field of rescue and comprises the steps of taking an unmanned aerial vehicle and an unmanned aerial vehicle as the heterogeneous unmanned system, constructing a heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning model, discretizing the heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning model to obtain a discrete optimization model of the heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning, optimizing the on-off state of path points in the discrete optimization model by adopting an improved model algorithm to obtain an optimal open point set, traversing the optimal open point set by adopting a mower algorithm to obtain a shortest full-coverage detection path, constructing a charging point dynamic adjustment mechanism, and carrying out full-coverage detection based on the shortest full-coverage detection path and the charging point dynamic adjustment mechanism. The invention effectively improves the global searching capability and convergence speed of the modular factor algorithm, designs a charging point dynamic adjustment strategy of bidirectional convergence, and effectively reduces the charging waiting time.

title_en: Power distribution network pre-disaster toughness improvement method considering typhoon time sequence and information physical cooperative regulation and control
abstract_en: A pre-disaster toughness improvement method for a power distribution network taking typhoon time sequence and information physical cooperative regulation into consideration includes the steps of constructing a DCPS element vulnerability model under the influence of a strong wind-storm dual-disaster-causing factor by analyzing the time sequence and uncertainty of typhoon disasters, generating a typical DPCS disaster scene set based on the DCPS element vulnerability model and combining historical typhoon disaster data, taking the information physical cooperative regulation into consideration, bringing dynamic response of the power distribution network in the typhoon disaster process into a pre-disaster toughness improvement frame, establishing a pre-disaster toughness improvement model, and solving in the generated typical DPCS disaster scene set to obtain an optimal pre-disaster toughness improvement scheme. According to the method, the time sequence of typhoon disasters and the dynamic response of the system are considered, the static assumption limitation of simplifying typhoon disasters into instantaneous uniform impact events in traditional researches is broken through, and a toughness improvement scheme which better meets the actual demands of the system is formulated.

title_en: Multi-dimensional matrix construction method for disaster monitoring of power transmission corridor
abstract_en: The application provides a method for constructing a multidimensional matrix for monitoring disasters in a power transmission corridor, which relates to the field of disaster monitoring, and comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional main coordinate system of a chain pile-cross section-time by taking a central line of a power transmission line as a reference, and constructing a corridor multidimensional coordinate system; mapping a geographic observation point to corridor space coordinates through a space projection mapping relation, performing time resampling and covariance constraint spatial interpolation on multi-source monitoring data to achieve space-time alignment, constructing a fused disaster monitoring matrix, embedding uncertainty dimensions in the matrix, dividing each corridor local unit in the disaster monitoring matrix into a four-quadrant structure, modeling a coupling relation among disaster seeds through a Copula function, embedding map regularization constraint to obtain a multidimensional matrix, slicing the multidimensional matrix embedded with the disaster coupling relation, extracting local risk views, and outputting a risk cube with a confidence interval. The application breaks through the limitation of traditional two-dimensional geography or single disaster monitoring.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JUHONGKAI INTELLIGENT ELECTRIC CO LTD;UNIV HUBEI

title_en: Fire monitoring and early warning system for key region of urban underground space
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire monitoring early warning system for urban underground space key region includes: the intelligent monitoring system comprises a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, an intelligent host, a regulation and control module and an alarm module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring monitoring data of a key region of an urban underground space in real time and sending the monitoring data to the intelligent host; the intelligent host is used for analyzing and early warning the monitoring data so as to control the regulation and control module; the regulation and control module is used for executing disaster treatment; and the data transmission module is connected with the intelligent host and used for sending alarm information to the mobile terminal or the upper computer. According to the invention, the complexity and uncertainty of the fire are quantitatively calculated according to signals such as on-site detection temperature, gas flow rate, smoke concentration and pressure, the current fire situation and the fire development trend are analyzed, a powerful theoretical basis is provided for rescue and fire extinguishing work, and the reliability and the scientificity of an early warning system are greatly enhanced.

title_en: Transformer substation enhanced resource allocation method considering uncertainty of element fault quantity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transformer substation strengthening resource allocation method considering uncertainty of element fault quantity, which comprises the following steps of S1, dividing cognitive uncertainty of damaged quantity of a transformer substation, S2, evaluating random scene probability of the damaged quantity of different transformer substations, S3, fusing probability evaluations of different experts by utilizing an improved D-S evidence theory, and S4, respectively calculating corresponding SSDAD models through NFE C & CG according to uncertainty division of the damaged quantity of the transformer substation, so as to obtain a transformer substation strengthening resource allocation scheme enabling system load shedding loss to be minimum. The random optimization model for the enhanced resource allocation of the transformer substation can enable the system to expect the optimal transformer substation rush repair and enhanced resource allocation scheme with the minimum load loss under extreme events, and the two-stage robust optimization C & CG algorithm embedded in the network flow can improve the solving speed by several orders of magnitude, so that more time is striven for the actual deployment execution of the optimal transformer substation enhanced resource allocation scheme before disaster.

title_en: Building disaster evaluation uncertainty optimization method for coupling multi-source data with random distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data and random distribution coupled building disaster damage assessment uncertainty optimization method which comprises the steps of collecting historical flood data of different cities and different types of buildings, meshing an assessment area, simulating and generating high-resolution water depth data of each grid unit by using a HiPIMS model, verifying and generating disaster damage data of each grid by combining remote sensing data, generalizing the cost of the different types of buildings by using building cost data in urban statistics annual authentication, assessing the building flood vulnerability based on a meshing method, and quantifying assessment uncertainty of the building flood vulnerability by using a confidence level analysis method. The method solves the problems of multi-source data fusion and accurate classification of buildings, unifies the scale difference of flood characteristics and socioeconomic data, introduces quantitative uncertainty of a confidence level analysis method, remarkably improves evaluation accuracy and reliability, and provides scientific support for urban disaster prevention and reduction, risk management and planning.

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network transmission management method for earthquake early warning information
abstract_en: S101, according to seismic wave data, geological structure data, historical seismic data and meteorological data, through the fusion algorithm of the multisource data, produce the predicted value of risk of comprehensive failure; S102, constructing a layered failure probability model based on the comprehensive failure risk predicted value, generating a node failure risk probability map, distributing weights of all layers according to the earthquake stage, S103, constructing a network topology, calculating the survival time of network nodes, calculating the weighted comprehensive failure probability of each network node, dynamically updating the network topology, S104, fusing the weighted comprehensive failure probability and the survival time of each network node to obtain node stable utilization characteristics, and further executing staged resource scheduling. The invention realizes the accurate prediction of the failure risk of the network node and the phased resource scheduling in the whole process of the earthquake disaster.

title_en: Underwater target search and rescue strategy determination method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining an underwater target search and rescue strategy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining marine environment information of a target sea area, calculating motion characteristics of an underwater target according to the marine environment information, constructing a dynamics model, predicting a target track of the underwater target based on a Monte Carlo algorithm and combining the dynamics model, constructing a grid probability model, preliminarily determining a search strategy based on the grid probability model, dynamically updating probability distribution through Bayesian theory to optimize the search strategy, and establishing a cost-effectiveness analysis model to secondarily optimize the optimized search strategy. The uncertainty of the environment and the target motion is fully considered, and the reliability of track prediction is improved. And constructing a grid probability model, dynamically updating probability distribution and optimizing a search strategy through Bayesian theory, so that the search has pertinence and the efficiency is improved. Through optimizing the strategy secondarily, optimal allocation of resources is realized, the search and rescue effect is guaranteed, the cost is controlled, and the economical efficiency and the practicability are improved.

title_en: Urban road traffic accident emergency rescue path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban road traffic accident emergency rescue path planning method, which comprises the following steps: 1) generating a topological structure chart of an urban road network, and acquiring traffic flow data and rescue start and end point information; 2) analyzing the emergency rescue characteristics of the urban road traffic accidents, and selecting a proper rescue path planning method to evaluate indexes; 3) constructing a basic framework of the timing coevolution path planning, and explaining the optimization principle of the timing coevolution path planning by a system; 4) designing a proper solving algorithm by combining the running characteristics of the urban road vehicles; 5) determining a calculation method of uncertainty factors in an actual traffic environment of an urban road network; 6) and outputting a rescue path planning result through computer programming. The urban road emergency rescue path planning method can solve the problem of urban road emergency rescue path planning.

title_en: Random sequential inversion method for permeability coefficient of embankment material
abstract_en: A random sequential inversion method for the permeability coefficient of the embankment body material includes such steps as designing segments according to the flood-fighting requirement of the area where embankment is protected and the structural characteristics of embankment itself, arranging the monitoring sections at equal intervals, and arranging several monitors such as vertical tube osmometers. According to uncertainty of the permeability coefficient of the embankment body material, hydraulic or finite element method is used for carrying out embankment seepage analysis, a functional relation among water level of monitoring points, a seepage line and the permeability coefficient of the material is established, then random sequential inversion analysis of the permeability coefficient of the embankment body material is carried out based on a maximum likelihood estimation method, random sequential inversion analysis is carried out on the permeability coefficient of the embankment body material by using monitoring data measured from different positions at different moments, the permeability coefficient value of the embankment body material is accurately determined, and flood fighting and emergency warning are carried out by setting permeability coefficient threshold values. The invention is not only helpful for finding the problem of the danger existing in the embankment in time, but also can guide the embankment manager to conduct flood control and rescue work in a targeted manner.

title_en: Emergency rescue material dynamic allocation method based on distributed robust optimization technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency rescue material dynamic allocation method based on a distributed robust optimization technology, which comprises the following steps of S1: and introducing a vehicle scheduling decision variable, a material distribution decision variable and a time window decision variable. S2: analyzing the relation between the vehicle scheduling decision variables and constructing vehicle scheduling decision variable association constraints; s3: analyzing the relation between the material distribution decision variables, and constructing material distribution decision variable association constraints; s4: and analyzing the relation between the time window decision variables and constructing the time window decision variable association constraint. S5: and analyzing the relation between the material distribution and the vehicle scheduling optimization target, and constructing an objective function to obtain an original model. S6: the uncertainty of emergency rescue material demand is processed based on a distribution robust optimization technology, and a dual theory is utilized to derive an original model safety convex approximation processable form, so that a distribution robust model which is easy to calculate and solve is obtained. S7: and analyzing the complexity of the model and solving to obtain a dynamic rescue material allocation scheme.

title_en: Method for analyzing uncertainty contribution degree in disaster emergency Internet of things model
abstract_en: The invention provides an analysis method for uncertainty contribution in a disaster emergency Internet of things model. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out a communication connection request aiming at the disaster emergency Internet of things model; calculating the power of the communication request of the Internet of things equipment in the disaster emergency Internet of things model; calculating the integral uncertainty of the disaster emergency Internet of things model; calculating the contribution of the sampled uncertainty parameters; and substituting six representative groups of uncertain parameters into the disaster emergency Internet of things communication model according to the variation curve of the contribution degree, and verifying the disaster emergency Internet of things communication model according to the deployment condition of the ground Internet of things equipment. According to the method, on the premise that normal communication of equipment in the disaster emergency Internet of things model is guaranteed, the analysis of the contribution degree of uncertainty parameters in the disaster emergency Internet of things model is achieved, and the method has guiding significance for the analysis of uncertainty in the disaster emergency Internet of things model.

title_en: Mine working face stress monitoring and disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring stress on a mine working face and early warning disasters, in particular relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and aims to solve the problem that the reliability of disaster early warning is insufficient due to model uncertainty in the existing stress field inversion method; the method is characterized in that accurate early warning of working face dynamic disasters is realized by constructing a stress field analysis system containing uncertainty evaluation, surrounding rock strain data is obtained through an optical fiber sensing network, leading stress field distribution is obtained through inversion calculation, uncertainty transfer and amplification effects in the inversion process are analyzed, confidence intervals of stress values of all areas are calculated, the critical degree of the current stress state is evaluated by combining historical stress data, disaster early warning information is generated based on a multi-dimensional risk evaluation result, reliability of stress field analysis and accuracy of disaster early warning are effectively improved, and technical support is provided for safe production of the working face.
assignees: CHINA PINGMEI SHENMA HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;XIAN MEIKE TRANSPARENT GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Power distribution system toughness assessment method and system based on medium-and-long-term disaster risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution system toughness assessment method and system based on medium-and-long-term disaster risks, which comprise the steps of obtaining disaster scenes and disaster occurrence time, establishing a disaster risk uncertainty set, carrying out risk prediction on each disaster scene based on the disaster risk uncertainty set, calculating disaster risk sampling probability, carrying out disaster scene sampling based on the disaster risk sampling probability, sampling the disaster occurrence time based on disaster occurrence time distribution probability in the disaster risk uncertainty set, calculating load loss value expectations according to the sampled disaster scenes and the sampled disaster occurrence time, and determining toughness levels considering disaster risk distribution under the condition that the load loss value expectations are converged. The method solves the problem that the existing power grid toughness assessment resource consumption based on disaster risk is high.

title_en: Slope support stability prediction method and system based on remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing geological prediction, in particular to a method and a system for predicting the stability of side slope support based on remote sensing data, which are characterized in that a target side slope region multispectral remote sensing image is obtained, a vegetation mask is generated by utilizing a normalized vegetation index, interference pixels of a vegetation coverage region are eliminated by combining morphological filtering and connected region analysis, then the characteristics of a support structure are identified by an improved edge detection algorithm, an influence region is defined by adopting a region growing algorithm based on machine learning, the regional image is input into a convolutional neural network model, a deformation probability map is output by a data enhancement technology and a weight optimization layer, finally, a threshold value is determined according to historical data, slope support stability categories are divided by combining space neighborhood information and a voting mechanism, vegetation interference is effectively eliminated, a support structure is accurately identified, prediction precision is improved, slope support stability can be timely and accurately judged, and a reliable basis is provided for slope disaster early warning and protection.

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for multi-dimensional parameters in electrical impedance imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for solving the problem of uncertainty quantification of multi-dimensional parameters in an electrical impedance imaging technology. The method comprises the steps of firstly training a deep neural network to construct a substitution model of an original uncertain system, then analyzing and quantifying uncertain parameters based on the deep neural network substitution model and combining a univariate dimension reduction method, and finally obtaining distribution of uncertain output. And compared to the baseline method, the performance of the method of the invention was evaluated. The result shows that the method has high calculation precision and can accurately quantify the uncertainty of output; when the uncertainty dimensionality of the parameters is increased, the uncertainty quantification problem of the high-dimensional parameters can be effectively solved, the dimensionality disaster is relieved, the method is not limited by the interaction between variables, and the calculation cost is effectively reduced. In addition, the method can also be applied to the uncertainty system quantification in other complex fields.

title_en: Turbine blade geometric structure uncertainty quantitative analysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative analysis system for uncertainty of a turbine blade geometry, which comprises a CAD model building module, an uncertainty sampling module, a CFD batch calculation module, a DNN model training module, an uncertainty analysis module and a turbine performance optimization module. On one hand, the analysis system greatly improves the efficiency and stability of CFD calculation of a large number of uncertainty design sample sets, and is beneficial to promoting the application of uncertainty optimization design technology in the aspect of actual engineering. On the other hand, by means of the system, the structure of the geometric model of the turbine blade is parameterized, sampling calculation of uncertainty design can be carried out on up to dozens of parameters at the same time, and then relatively important parameters are screened on the basis of sensitivity analysis to achieve a dimension reduction target, so that the problem of dimension disaster in traditional uncertainty analysis is solved, and the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the uncertainty analysis of the turbine blade are improved.

title_en: Railway tunnel multi-department collaborative emergency rescue method based on two-stage robust optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-department collaborative emergency rescue method for a railway tunnel based on two-stage robust optimization, and relates to the technical field of railway rescue; according to the invention, by constructing a two-stage robust optimization model and a main problem-sub problem iterative solution algorithm, comprehensive minimization of resource preset cost and response cost under the worst accident scene is realized, and strong robustness of the rescue scheme in the face of uncertainty such as demand, passing time and the like is ensured. The method establishes an united command mechanism based on department weights, effectively coordinates actions of multiple departments such as fire fighting, medical treatment and the like, and greatly improves task cooperativity and response speed. Meanwhile, by quantifying the synergistic benefit, the remarkable advantage of the synergistic rescue compared with the independent action in shortening the rescue time is scientifically evaluated, reliable data support is provided for rescue decisions, and the efficiency, reliability and adaptability of the railway tunnel emergency rescue are improved.

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.
assignees: SOLVIT SYSTEM CO LTD;BIG & DEEP CO LTD

title_en: Offshore wind power and power transmission network collaborative planning method considering typhoon disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative planning method of offshore wind power and a power transmission network considering the influence of typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a multi-scene distribution robust uncertainty set of the output of an offshore wind power plant and the faults of a power transmission line; establishing an objective function and constraint conditions of the initial model, and introducing short-term source-network-load measures into the initial model to obtain a final collaborative planning model for realizing collaborative planning of the offshore wind power and the power transmission network considering the influence of typhoon disasters. According to the invention, a multi-scene distribution robust model considering typhoon extreme disasters is established for the problem of collaborative planning of the offshore wind power and the power transmission network, multiple uncertainties of output of the offshore wind power plant and faults of the power transmission line in a normal scene and the typhoon extreme disasters are comprehensively considered, and the elasticity of a high-proportion new energy power system is improved.

title_en: Enhanced emergency notification system
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure are directed to systems and methods for alerting user devices of anomalous behavior of user equipment (UE) within a wireless communication system. In order to alert users of natural disasters associated with the anomalous behavior and enable them to take appropriate actions such as evacuating or sheltering in place, a pattern of a number of internet of things (IoT) devices and UEs (e.g., smart phones) disconnecting from a network is detected, a cone of uncertainty (e.g., the direction that the natural disaster is likely to continue in) is inferred from that pattern, and people within the cone of uncertainty are warned that they may be in danger of an approaching natural disaster.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for risk loss of single landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method for risk loss of monomer landslides (including soil landslides and rock landslides), and belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and reduction and risk management research. The method is based on an upper limit theorem, a lower limit theorem and an interval analysis method, approaches to a landslide disaster risk loss truth value from the lower limit direction and the upper limit direction, overcomes the defects of large uncertainty, large deviation between an evaluation result and actual landslide disaster loss and the like caused by the adoption of a single fixed value risk loss evaluation result in the past, has the characteristics of quickness, dynamic property, practicability and the like, can serve for landslide disaster quantitative risk evaluation, and provides a decision basis for formulating landslide disaster risk management measures.

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method based on energy storage type flexible switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault recovery method based on an energy storage type flexible switch, which comprises the following steps of S1, evaluating damage risks and determining the installation position of the energy storage type flexible switch according to landslide disaster historical data of an area where a power distribution area is located, S2, calculating and determining a control strategy of the energy storage type flexible switch according to annual cycle life and life cost of a storage battery of the energy storage type flexible switch, smooth power fluctuation of storage and release of electric energy, load demand uncertainty reduction and S3, and calculating and outputting a distributed power output value and a capacity value enabling the service life of the energy storage type flexible switch to be longest with the aim of minimizing operation cost. The mountain landslide damage risk is evaluated to determine the installation position body of the energy storage type flexible switch, the annual cycle life and life cost of the storage battery are calculated, the use mode is determined, and finally the distributed power supply is combined to control and output so as to minimize the running cost, so that the power supply recovery efficiency and the power supply quality are improved.

title_en: Star-based and foundation lightning data fusion method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fusing lightning data of a star base and a foundation, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of (1) selecting star base and foundation lightning data effective data; (2) Calculating a time threshold value of the fusion of the lightning data of the star base and the foundation; (3) Calculating a space threshold value of the fusion of the lightning data of the star base and the foundation; (4) And constructing a data fusion scheme to obtain a localized full-lightning data set. The invention realizes the cross fusion of the lightning data of the satellite base and the foundation, overcomes the shortages, solves the problems of data incompleteness and uncertainty caused by a single information source, and is beneficial to more comprehensively recognizing the lightning activity characteristics. The integrated full-lightning data can be applied to the fields of lightning monitoring and early warning, strong weather analysis, lightning disaster investigation and identification and lightning protection design, and provides scientific support for lightning protection and disaster reduction business service and research work.

title_en: Landslide identification method based on multi-source data and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide identification method based on multi-source data and related equipment, relates to the technical field of landslide disaster identification, and solves the problem of low landslide identification accuracy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of an area to be identified, extracting phase stability index, polarization scattering entropy, interference coherence, topography curvature and time sequence deformation trend of the multi-source data based on multi-temporal SAR data and DEM data in the multi-source data, carrying out weighted calculation on important features in the five-dimensional features through a space-channel dual-attention mechanism to generate a first fusion feature matrix, and inputting the first fusion feature matrix into the random forest classifier to obtain a landslide probability map of the area to be identified, wherein the landslide probability map is output by the random forest classifier. According to the landslide recognition method based on the multi-dimensional feature complementation, on one hand, robustness of landslide recognition is improved through the multi-dimensional feature complementation, and on the other hand, efficiency and accuracy of a recognition algorithm are improved through selecting important features to perform corresponding recognition calculation.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating risk of strong wind disaster of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, in particular to a method and a system for evaluating the risk of a strong wind disaster of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of constructing a data vector of each node at t time by means of meteorological observation of wind resistance parameters, environmental parameters and t time of each node in a power distribution network topology model, constructing a node vulnerability model based on a wind pressure response-failure probability mapping function, acquiring failure probability of each node at t time, acquiring risk propagation weight between each node at t time and adjacent nodes based on electric adjacent strength, inverse proportion function of the geographic coordinates and meteorological consistency of each node and adjacent nodes, and dividing all nodes into a plurality of risk areas by considering consistency, connectivity, boundary complexity and time stability in the areas, and acquiring node level risk assessment results, area level risk assessment results and whole network level risk assessment results at t time. The method and the system effectively improve the evaluation precision of the risk of the wind disaster of the power distribution network.
assignees: SHIZUISHAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Parallel smart emergency collaboration method and system, and electronic device
abstract_en: A parallel smart emergency collaboration method and system, and an electronic device. The method comprises that: a visual spatial-temporal fusion-based artificial system model is established, and by means of the artificial system model, cross-video geographical smart fusion analysis-based personnel group sensing and evacuation channel passing state detection are performed on a space to be evacuated; a 3D virtual simulation environment of the space is constructed, a personnel distribution-based multi-agent evacuation simulation model is constructed on the basis of historical disaster environment simulation and degree-of-risk situation analysis, evacuation simulation is performed by means of the multi-agent evacuation simulation model, and an optimal evacuation plan prediction result is generated; a real-time monitoring and augmented reality visualization-based parallel execution collaboration system is established to perform deduction simulation and dynamic evacuation simulation, and an optimal evacuation plan is generated in combination with the prediction result of a computing experiment system. The problems of emergency, instability, nonlinearity and uncertainty in a real system are solved by means of a virtual reality interaction mode and collaborative evolution.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation system of pedestrian safetiness according to inunddation flow of underground facility, and method for the same
title_ko: 지하시설의 침수흐름에 따른 보행 안전성 종합평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 지하철 역사, 철도시설 등의 지하시설 침수흐름에 따라 대피자의 보행 안전성 분석과 대피경로 설정 의사결정을 위한 보행 안전성 평가를 위해서 다양한 평가지표를 종합적으로 고려한 종합평가점수 산정을 통해 보행 위험구간을 판별할 수 있으며, 또한, 여러 평가지표를 종합 판단한 결과에 따라 홍수로 인한 재난상황 발생시 시설 관리자의 의사결정의 불확실성을 줄임으로써 시설 이용자의 대피 안전성을 향상시킬 수 있는, 지하시설의 침수흐름에 따른 보행 안전성 종합평가 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method based on space-time multi-feature uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method based on space-time multi-feature uncertainty, which is characterized by collecting historical mountain torrent data of a research area, extracting and analyzing mountain torrent vulnerability factor data of the research area to form at least 5-level risk areas, rasterizing the research area and classifying the risk areas into levels of each grid; respectively constructing mountain torrent disaster risk assessment models of all levels of risk areas; fitting the distribution of each torrent disaster risk factor as prior distribution based on historical torrent data, sampling by adopting a DREAM algorithm, respectively inputting a torrent disaster risk assessment model of each grade risk area to obtain posterior distribution of each torrent disaster risk index, and obtaining the probability of risk occurrence of each grade risk area by adopting Bayesian inference; setting a risk scenario set, analyzing the mountain torrent disaster risks of each grid in the research area through a mountain torrent disaster risk assessment model, and calculating the risk contribution rate of each mountain torrent disaster risk factor; the scientificity of mountain torrent disaster risk early warning is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Robot Following System Based on Wireless Communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot following system based on wireless communication, comprising: the system comprises a plurality of search and rescue robots, an electric energy supply robot for providing electric energy, and a plurality of search and rescue robots, wherein the plurality of search and rescue robots keep a formation from the original place to the direction of a suspected target, and sequentially search a plurality of distributed suspected search areas in the proceeding direction; when the suspected search area does not find the target, leaving a search and rescue robot in the suspected search area, and continuing the rest search and rescue robots; when the target is found in the next suspected search area, the electric energy supplying robot starts from the original place, and carries the remaining search and rescue robot along the proceeding path of the search and rescue robot to the target position together.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage three-dimensional rescue path planning algorithm in complex disaster-stricken environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-coverage three-dimensional rescue path planning algorithm for an unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex disaster-stricken environment. The method comprises the following steps: (1) establishing an environment model; (2) dividing the model into different height layers through a layered planning strategy, and reconstructing a current height layer map through a map reconstruction strategy to obtain a two-dimensional reconstruction map; (3) and (3) performing two-dimensional full-coverage path planning on the two-dimensional reconstruction map: performing regional branch judgment on the position nodes, and screening according to the sequence from the dead zone, the local region to the global region; (4) adopting an interlayer connection strategy to associate child nodes and father nodes between different layers; (5) judging whether all height layers in the three-dimensional environment are traversed or not; (6) and tracing the path, finding out a complete three-dimensional path and outputting the path. The invention effectively reduces the number of the trapped dead points, rapidly plans a short path in real time, reduces the path repetition rate, has better robustness and is suitable for the three-dimensional full-coverage path planning in a complex disaster-stricken environment.

title_en: LSTM-based power line post-disaster inspection scene image understanding method
abstract_en: An LSTM-based power line post-disaster inspection scene image understanding method comprises the following steps: extracting the image characteristics of the post-disaster inspection scene of the power line based on an attention mechanism; extracting time and place information in the picture; constructing an image description sentence data set; the post-disaster inspection scene of the power line describes Chinese word segmentation; and constructing an LSTM-based post-disaster inspection scene image translation model of the power line. Aiming at the problems of batch labeling of a large quantity of images in post-disaster inspection of a power line, and the characteristics of multi-scale inspection scene targets, diversified objects, large style difference, strong space-time correlation, uncertainty targets and the like, the invention provides a Chinese description generation model of the post-disaster inspection scene images of the power line based on the combination of a convolutional neural network and a long-short-term memory network, which is combined with a jieba word segmentation tool, so that the automatic translation of the monitoring images of the post-disaster inspection scene of the power line is realized, and the problems of auditing and annotating of the large quantity of images in the inspection of the power line are solved.

title_en: Geological disaster risk assessment method and system for multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk assessment method and a system for multi-source data analysis, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and have the advantages that the uncertainty of multi-source data is quantified by an evidence theory, the credibility weight is updated in a Bayesian mode, the data quality is adapted through a attention dynamic neural network, the credibility calibration and the parameter feedback optimization are combined, and the assessment accuracy and the robustness are improved, wherein the invention has the advantages that: the method comprises the steps of quantifying multi-source data uncertainty characteristics through an evidence theory, correcting the data source reliability weight by combining a Bayesian dynamic update mechanism, utilizing a dynamic neural network based on an attention mechanism to adaptively adjust a structure and a decision boundary according to the data uncertainty, introducing robust optimization to inhibit low-reliability data error conduction, and meanwhile, marking key influence factors through reliability interval calibration, thereby effectively solving the defects that the prior art ignores the data uncertainty, an evaluation model cannot adapt to data quality fluctuation, only outputs a single result and has no reliable basis.
assignees: JIANGSU NEW ENERGY GEOLOGICAL SURVEY BRIGADE

title_en: Wisdom fire control early warning system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire-fighting early warning, and discloses an intelligent fire-fighting early warning system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a sensor, a wireless router and a fire recognition device, and discloses an intelligent fire-fighting early warning method based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a fire distinguishing index system, and acquiring fire distinguishing index data by using a sensor device; preprocessing the collected fire distinguishing index data to obtain a fire distinguishing index vector; constructing a fire recognition early warning model based on the probability map model; and inputting the fire distinguishing index vector into a fire recognition early warning model, outputting the probability of fire occurrence by the fire recognition early warning model, and if the output probability is greater than a specified probability threshold value, indicating that the fire occurs. According to the method, the fire disaster distinguishing index data are collected based on the Internet of things equipment, and a fire disaster recognition early warning model is constructed to realize real-time fire disaster early warning.
assignees: SHANDONG OODEEP INTELLIGENT ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating power grid restoration supporting capacity of distributed photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of elasticity evaluation of power distribution networks, in particular to a method, a device and equipment for evaluating the supporting capacity of a distributed photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system to power grid recovery and a readable storage medium, which specifically comprise the following steps: dividing the operation scenes of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system under extreme weather conditions based on historical statistical data, optimally calculating the recovery capacity of the supporting power grid under different operation scenes of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system, and finally obtaining the comprehensive evaluation value of the recovery supporting capacity of the supporting power grid by combining the occurrence probability of each operation scene of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system; the uncertainty influence of extreme weather conditions on the photovoltaic output can be fully considered, and the power supply recovery support capability of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system on the power grid after disaster is reasonably evaluated, so that the adequacy of the output of the schedulable resources and the cooperative coordination among different resources can be fully considered when an application personnel makes a recovery strategy after disaster.
assignees: STATE GRID SUZHOU URBAN ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Sand liquefaction judging method based on cloud model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster evaluation and prevention and control, in particular to a cloud model-based sand liquefaction judging method, which mainly comprises the following steps of determining main influencing factors; the method comprises the steps of collecting and screening sand liquefaction engineering examples, classifying and grading the sand liquefaction engineering examples by adopting a l ogi st ic model, calculating cloud model digital characteristics of each factor under different levels, and calculating the certainty that each factor belongs to each liquefaction risk level based on measured values of each factor of a working point to be evaluated. The cloud model theory is applied to convert the sand liquefaction risk concept with the characteristics of ambiguity and randomness into quantitative certainty, and a novel sand liquefaction risk judging method is established. The method has the advantages of firm and reliable theoretical foundation and easy operation, reveals uncertainty rules in the process of judging the risk of liquefaction of the sand, enables the evaluation result to have more practical significance, and can provide basic basis for prevention and treatment of the geological disaster of liquefaction of the sand.
assignees: HEBEI PROVINCIAL COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;TANGSHAN HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION MAN CENTER

title_en: Earthquake refuge locker
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake shelter cabinet, which belongs to an earthquake risk preventing safety protection article. The earthquake shelter cabinet comprises a high-strength cabinet body, a shock absorption pad, an earthquake alarm, an air hole provided with a filter screen, an escape hole and a safety belt. The earthquake shelter cabinet is a storage space storing salvaging articles such as drinking water, foods, a rescue beacon, a radio, pharmaceuticals, an oxygen bottle, a torch, a mobile phone and the like; as for the suddenness and uncertainty of an earthquake, people can take precaution to prevent the loss brought by the earthquake; the earthquake shelter cabinet can reduce the fluster and helplessness when the earthquake occurs, avoid the risk of getting killed or hurt by stone, prevent the invasion of dust, fire and coal gas and improve the survival rate; and the earthquake shelter cabinet also has the advantages of convenience, quickness and safety, and is widely applied to families, units and hotels.

title_en: A kind of underwater search and rescue region Forecasting Methodology based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of underwater search and rescue region Forecasting Methodology based on wireless sensor network, including：Wireless network threedimensional model is established to underwater multiple nodes, distress signal is sent using wireless network, and by multiple node equivalents in model into random particles；Random particles are calculated based on particle cluster algorithm to issue in the initial position probability of several scenes；Combining marine environment according to the distribution of the initial position probability of random particles influences to calculate the drift probability data of random particles, and predicts to obtain search and rescue region according to particle drift probability data.The method that the present invention solves the definite maritime SAR region that the prior art provides determines search and rescue region based on classical search planing method so that definite search and rescue region increases the problem of searching and rescuing risk there are error.

title_en: Side slope creep monitoring method, device, equipment, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a side slope creep monitoring method, a side slope creep monitoring device, side slope creep monitoring equipment, a side slope creep monitoring system and a storage medium, and relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring. The side slope creep monitoring method comprises the steps of calculating the similarity of a reference image and a window image in a first search area preset by a first acquisition image by using a sliding window method, and determining a first matching image with the highest similarity and larger than a preset first threshold; setting a second search area in the first acquisition picture based on the coordinate range of the first matching image; based on a sliding window method with the step length smaller than 1 pixel, acquiring a range of a first coordinate corresponding to a window image with the highest similarity with the reference image in the second search area; and calculating and outputting a first slope displacement value based on the first coordinate range and the coordinate range of the monitoring area. The sliding window with the step length smaller than 1 pixel is used for identifying the image with the finer granularity, the more accurate image is determined for displacement calculation, so that the calculation result is higher in accuracy, and the obtained conclusion and the alarm are more reliable.
assignees: GUANGZHOU XIEZUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain area shallow landslide risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountainous area shallow landslide risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring mountain rainfall data, soil strength parameters and terrain data through rainfall station field monitoring and indoor tests; s2, calculating the soil saturation condition by using the rainfall infiltration hydrological geological model, calculating the slope safety coefficient by combining the slope stability physical mechanical model, finally calculating the slope instability probability by using the Monte Carlo simulation method, and drawing the corresponding landslide risk map in the mountain area. The method is based on a physical mechanics control equation, considers the rainfall infiltration and slope stability change process, simultaneously considers the uncertainty of soil body parameters, realizes shallow layer landslide risk assessment under the condition of rainfall in the mountainous area, and provides an important theoretical basis for disaster prevention and reduction and emergency rescue work of geological disasters of landslides in the mountainous area.

title_en: Method for selecting non-landslide sample based on landslide susceptibility evaluation factor characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selecting a non-landslide sample based on landslide susceptibility evaluation factor characteristics, which comprises the following steps of: collecting data of a research area, perfecting a landslide database and establishing a landslide susceptibility evaluation index system; each evaluation factor is subdivided into a plurality of subclasses, the frequency ratio of each subclass is calculated, and the subclasses with similar frequency ratios are combined to form the final evaluation factor classification; determining a characteristic factor according to the characteristics of the research area and the landslide space distribution characteristics; integrating the region of the category with the lower characteristic factor frequency ratio as a non-landslide sample sampling region; resampling for multiple times in a non-landslide sample sampling area to obtain a non-landslide sample; the method for selecting the non-landslide sample based on the landslide susceptibility evaluation factor characteristics limits the sampling area of the non-landslide sample, improves the quality of the non-landslide sample, reduces the uncertainty of the non-landslide sample, thereby obtaining a more reliable landslide susceptibility partition map and providing basic guarantee for a management department to carry out land planning and disaster prevention and reduction work.

title_en: Method and system for estimating flood inundation probability by combining microblog data and geographic data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for estimating flood inundation probability by combining microblog data and geographic data, which relate to the technical field of flood disaster prediction and estimation and comprise the following steps: collecting a real-time data source, extracting the water depth value and the geographic position of texts and pictures, and obtaining the specific longitude and latitude of a submerged point; according to the different origins of the geographic information data, processing the geographic information data into influence factors with the same resolution and the same size; calculating flooding probability distribution of the whole graph; calculating the weight value of the influence factor in the interest radius by using the center of the submerged point; and based on the submerged probability layer and the weight value, weighting, superposing and averaging to obtain a weighted comprehensive probability map. According to the invention, through integrating social media, a geographic information system, satellite images and ground observation data, real-time monitoring of flood disasters and accurate estimation of flood probability are realized. The multisource data fusion and efficient information processing method not only greatly improves accuracy and timeliness of flood prediction, but also enhances decision support capability of disaster emergency management.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Gas-electricity combined distribution network distribution robust extension planning method considering system toughness constraint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of planning of a gas-electricity combined system and toughness improvement, in particular to a gas-electricity combined network distribution robust expansion planning method considering system toughness constraint, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a gas-electricity combined network expansion planning model taking the sum of operation cost and planning cost as an objective function, considering the capability of changing fuel supply load when natural gas of a dual-fuel unit is insufficient under a disaster in the aspect of improving the toughness, further modeling the construction of the dual-fuel unit and a connecting line, and considering constraints such as power distribution network reconstruction at the operation level, and secondly establishing a two-stage distribution robust expansion planning model considering the toughness constraint of the gas-electricity combined network system under the extreme disaster by using a distribution robust optimization method based on KL divergence to consider the uncertainty of the influence of the extreme disaster. The method can improve the economical efficiency of the gas-electricity combined distribution network in normal operation and enhance the toughness capability in extreme disasters.

title_en: Beacon detection system for locating missing persons
abstract_en: A beacon detection system which can locate a missing search subject includes: a beacon signal receiver; a location position detector; and a beacon detector. The detector is configured to detect a location of a broadcasting beacon signal associated with a personal device of a search subject within search data covering a geographic search area derived from a search for the search subject, the search data gathered by the beacon signal receiver and location position detector. A computer implemented method of determining a location of a search subject is also provided. The method determines at least a possible connection request from Wi-Fi signals in search data gathered by a Wi-Fi radio covering a geographic search area for a search subject and associated location information to locate the search subject.

title_en: Method and device for predicting track position of mobile user
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for predicting a track position of a mobile user, and belongs to the technical field of data mining processing. According to the invention, a circulating mixed density network comprising an LSTM network and an MDN network is constructed as a prediction model, the prediction model can automatically extract depth features, and the prediction model can be used for learning the motion trend, long-time history information and hidden representative features of a user from the latest trajectory data of the mobile user, so that the prediction of the position coordinates of the user in a period of time in the future is realized. The invention solves the problems of sparsity and dimension disaster faced when predicting continuous position coordinate values, can fully simulate the uncertainty of motion behaviors, and can improve the accuracy of prediction.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle mechanical arm tail end pose control method for multi-source interference
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling the pose of the tail end of a mechanical arm of an unmanned aerial vehicle aiming at multi-source interference, and aims to realize high-precision control of the tail end of a special unmanned aerial vehicle system under the condition of multi-source interference. Firstly, establishing a multi-source interference model of a special unmanned aerial vehicle mechanical arm end pose control system, and secondly, designing a robust H-infinity controller aiming at a system nominal model; then designing an interference observer aiming at the multi-source interference, and estimating and compensating the external interference and the model uncertainty; and finally, high-precision control of the pose of the tail end of the mechanical arm is ensured by reasonably selecting parameters of the robust H-infinity controller and the disturbance observer. The invention is based on a composite layered anti-interference control framework, realizes high-precision pose control of the tail end of the mechanical arm of a special unmanned aerial vehicle system under multi-source interference, and is suitable for special tasks such as emergency rescue, non-cooperative target capture in narrow space and the like.

title_en: Rolling toughness regulation and control method for physical-information coupling power distribution system considering space-time dynamic faults
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rolling toughness regulation method of a physical-information coupling power distribution system considering space-time dynamic faults, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, establishing a tree-shaped space-time dynamic fault model by considering space-time dynamic evolution characteristics of the power distribution system faults, S2, establishing a physical-information coupling power distribution system toughness regulation model considering space-time dynamic faults, S3, rolling to generate a space-time dynamic fault scene of the power distribution system and regulating the dynamic toughness. The rolling toughness regulation method for the physical-information coupling power distribution system considering the space-time dynamic faults can effectively cope with the space-time dynamic uncertainty of the faults of the power distribution system, achieves physical-information collaborative optimization, and has remarkable advantages in the disaster resistance toughness decision aspect of the power distribution system.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling optimization method considering load three-phase imbalance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system rush-repair scheduling, and discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush-repair scheduling optimization method considering load three-phase imbalance, which adopts the technical scheme that the weighting of the maximum load accumulation recovery amount and the minimum fuel cost of a mobile generator during the rush-repair of the power distribution network is adopted as a target, the three-phase unbalanced safety constraint and the wind power output uncertainty are considered, a random optimization model is built by modeling wind power output, coupling rush repair team scheduling, mobile generator scheduling and power distribution network operation constraint through a scene probability method, and a CPLEX solver is adopted to solve after linearization so as to coordinate various resources to promote the three-phase load accumulation recovery amount and ensure the operation safety of a system and equipment.

title_en: Method for generating average shear wave velocity maps using proxy-based prediction models for earthquake disaster prediction, recording medium and device for performing the method
title_ko: 지진재해 예측을 위한 광범위 레이어 기반 예측 모델을 이용한 평균 전단파 속도 지도 작성 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록 매체 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for generating an average shear wave velocity map using a wide range layer-based prediction model for earthquake disaster prediction comprises: a step of building a dataset including a shear wave velocity soil column map, topographic information, geological information, and distance information from mountain land; a step of analyzing a shear wave velocity in accordance with a soil layer, the type of soil, geological classification, and a rock formation from the built dataset; a step of generating a shear wave velocity estimation model in accordance with the geological classification and the topographic information based on the analyzed shear wave velocity; a step of correcting the generated shear wave velocity estimation model in accordance with the property of each geological age; and a step of using the corrected shear wave velocity estimation model to generate a shear wave velocity map based on the thickness of a sedimentary layer in accordance with the distance information from mountain land. Accordingly, the uncertainty from a land amplification effect can be lowered through accurate V_S30 estimation, and the reliability of Korean peninsula earthquake disaster analysis and seismic designs can be secured by using V_S30 for the Korean peninsula.
abstract_ko: 지진재해 예측을 위한 광범위 레이어 기반 예측 모델을 이용한 평균 전단파 속도 지도 작성 방법은, 전단파 속도 주상도, 지형 정보, 지질 정보 및 산지로부터의 거리 정보를 포함하는 데이터 셋을 구축하는 단계; 구축된 데이터 셋으로부터 토층, 흙의 종류, 지질 분류 및 암반층에 따른 전단파 속도를 분석하는 단계; 분석된 전단파 속도를 기반으로 지질 분류 및 지형 정보에 따른 전단파 속도 추정모델을 생성하는 단계; 생성된 전단파 속도 추정모델을 지질 시대별 특성에 따라 각각 전단파 속도 추정모델을 보정하는 단계; 및 보정된 전단파 속도 추정모델을 이용하여 산지로부터의 거리 정보에 따른 퇴적층의 두께를 기반으로 전단파 속도 지도를 생성하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 정확한 V S30 의 추정을 통해 부지증폭효과의 불확실성을 낮추고, 한반도용 V S30 을 사용하여 한반도 지진재해 분석 및 내진설계의 신뢰도를 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Channel emergency rescue management mode based on robust optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel emergency rescue management mode based on a robust optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps: the uncertainty factors such as whether the actual search and rescue ship travel route is downwind and downwater, whether the actual search and rescue ship travel route is provided with obstacles, whether the actual search and rescue ship travel route is provided with sudden accidents and the like are considered; consider a situation in which different types of accidents may occur at the same time at multiple locations; the rescue materials of the invention are divided into communication, lifesaving, medical, pollution cleaning, protection and fire protection. According to the invention, different accidents are reasonably allocated according to limited rescue resources, and the search and rescue ship can be ensured to load enough materials to arrive at the accident site in the shortest time.

title_en: Method for evaluating wind disaster vulnerability of reversing branch tower by considering material parameter variation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind disaster vulnerability assessment method of a reversing branch tower, which considers material parameter variation, wherein the variation rule of various structural material parameters is considered by utilizing sampling operation when wind response of the reversing branch tower is calculated, an intelligent prediction model is adopted to learn the relationship between the average value and standard deviation of wind speed and structural requirement indexes, and finally the overrun probability of a structure under a series of wind speed values is predicted, so that a comprehensive wind disaster vulnerability result which considers the variation of the structural material parameters is formed. The method provides more accurate overrun probability evaluation based on the existing wind disaster vulnerability evaluation of the power transmission tower, and considers more uncertainty risks. The invention considers uncertainty of various variation parameters in a random sampling mode, reduces calculated amount, obtains a quantized relation between wind speed and overrun probability and a relation between wind speed and various material parameters and overrun probability by adopting an intelligent prediction model, can calculate the overrun probability more quickly by adopting the intelligent prediction model under a specified wind speed, obtains a vulnerability curve or curved surface under multiple wind speeds, and greatly improves analysis efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle multitasking point path planning method
