abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal configuration method, a storage medium and equipment for a telemechanical switch of an elastic power distribution network, which are used for acquiring transformer data, distribution network load data and system topological structure information connected with a distribution network system; and (3) iterating by using a robust optimized CCG algorithm, solving the most serious attack mode with the maximum cut load power as a target for a given telemechanical switch configuration scheme in each iteration, including the attack mode into an uncertainty set of the robust optimization, and solving the optimal switch configuration scheme with the minimum power cut load power of the power grid as a target for the uncertainty set consisting of a series of attack modes obtained at present, wherein the power grid can maintain the power supply to the greatest extent when suffering from the most serious attack through continuous iteration. According to the invention, through reasonable switch configuration, when the power grid is struck by an extreme disaster event and fails, the switch can be operated in time to isolate the failure, so that the power failure range and loss are reduced.

title_en: Rainfall monitoring data driven intelligent early warning method for small-river-basin geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a rainfall monitoring data-driven intelligent early warning method for small-river-basin geological disasters, which comprises the steps of acquiring historical rainfall data of a target small river basin and preprocessing geological disaster historical record data; the method comprises the steps of matching geological disaster events to corresponding rainfall events to obtain a rainfall event set with geological disasters, taking the rainfall event set as a positive sample and a rainfall event set without the occurrence of the geological disasters as a negative sample, using the positive sample and the negative sample for constructing a data set for learning, training and testing a machine learning model, constructing an intelligent early warning machine learning model array for the geological disasters in the small river basin, training, verifying and testing the intelligent early warning machine learning model array by using the data set, constructing a calculation model and an uncertainty analysis model for the occurrence probability of the geological disasters in the small river basin under the influence of the rainfall events, calculating the occurrence probability and uncertainty of the geological disasters in the small river basin under the influence of the rainfall events, and carrying out early warning. The method improves the reliability and accuracy of the geological disaster early warning result of the small river basin.

title_en: Method for constructing large through tower in mountain rock mass and section superposing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a large through tower in mountain rock mass and a section superposing method thereof. The technical scheme adopted is as follows: the construction process comprises the steps of digging a transportation channel, connecting for construction, expanding for construction, strengthening and preburying for construction, and installing for construction. The construction of preburying and irrigating comprises the step of burying the preburied part when irrigating, and the construction of the upper and the lower standard components comprises the step of strengthening the standard component with the preburied part through the method of constructing simultaneously up and down. By using the construction method of the technique, in the construction process, the excavated stone can be output continuously from the transportation channel so that the construction schedule can be quickened and the uncertainty that the stones fall in the course of drilling from down to up is avoided; therefore, the method is safe. The method has the beneficial effects of being small in investment, low in cost, short in construction period, less in influence from disaster, free from the effect of nucleus, safe in constructing process, stable in operating process, easy in confidentiality, easy to start emergency generation system and good in reutilization; besides, multiple processes can run simultaneously in construction.

title_en: Power scheduling method considering uncertainty of new energy output and successive fault risk
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dispatching of power systems, and provides a power dispatching method considering uncertainty of new energy output and successive fault risks, which comprises the following steps: determining relevant parameters of each time interval of each distribution by using a moment estimation method; acquiring an uncertainty set of wind power and photovoltaic output to describe the uncertainty of new energy output; estimating the poisson strength under various disasters by using a moment estimation method; setting a future risk pre-control scheduling period and a risk probability threshold for different types of disasters, determining successive fault poisson probability distribution of the disasters in scheduling time from occurrence, and obtaining the maximum fault number reaching the threshold in the scheduling period; under the double uncertain set of new energy output and successive fault risk, a two-stage robust optimization model aiming at minimizing the running cost of the system under the condition of the most serious faults is constructed so as to determine the temporary unit start-stop and power distribution decision of the corresponding natural disasters.
assignees: NORTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk prediction method based on hybrid machine learning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster risk prediction method based on a hybrid machine learning method, which relates to the technical field of model prediction and solves the problems of difficult model data acquisition, uncertainty of mountain torrent disaster influence factor weights, local excessive optimization of a model, inapplicability of the model in a non-observation area, low learning efficiency of a machine learning model and the like in the use process of a current mountain torrent disaster risk prediction model; the method utilizes the ABC algorithm to optimize the initial network structure and the connection weight of the RBFNN model, is beneficial to avoiding the problem of local optimization, integrates the RBFNN and the ABC algorithm, accelerates model learning, the learning speed and accuracy of the mountain torrent disaster prediction model are improved, the weight of the characteristic factors in the model is determined according to historical data based on an RF method, the model is not fixed and unchanged, and the whole system has universality.
assignees: CHINA WATER SUNNY DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy station elastic lifting planning method and system under multiple uncertainties
abstract_en: The invention relates to an elastic lifting planning method and system for an energy station under multiple uncertainties, wherein the method comprises the following steps of considering multiple uncertainties in a disaster receiving process of the energy station, constructing probability distribution of each uncertainty factor, wherein the multiple uncertainties comprise earthquake intensity deviation, equipment damage state capability deviation, energy equipment earthquake vulnerability deviation, post-disaster multipotency load prediction error and post-disaster data load prediction error; based on the probability distribution of each uncertainty factor, constructing energy station post-disaster load shedding condition risk constraint by utilizing a condition risk value theory, constructing an energy station elastic lifting planning model for coping with earthquake disasters under multiple uncertainties, and solving the energy station elastic lifting planning model to obtain a multi-energy station planning scheme coping with the earthquake disasters. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of effectively avoiding potential risk of post-disaster load shedding of the energy station, improving the elasticity of the planning scheme for coping with earthquake disasters and the like.

title_en: Small-area single-machine grid-shaped search route planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-area single-machine grid-shaped search route planning method. Aiming at a known search area at a certain moment, a single-machine grid-shaped search model is built in a plane based on a kinematic equation and a plane geometry principle, and a complete search route is obtained by planning and obtaining key flight route points of a search helicopter under the condition of comprehensively considering visibility and flight characteristics of the helicopter by using a plane geometry method. The method overcomes the defects of low manual estimation speed and low precision, converts the search application problem into a simple and visual geometric problem, has the characteristics of easy realization of computer programming, high precision, good real-time performance and the like, and can meet the requirements of a ground target search task on precision and effectiveness. The method is particularly suitable for ground target reconnaissance or search and rescue application of the helicopter command system.
assignees: NO 54 INST CN ELECT SCI & TECH

title_en: Slope and foundation pit stability monitoring and early warning method based on remote sensing data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and particularly relates to a slope and foundation pit stability monitoring and early warning method based on remote sensing data fusion. According to the method, deformation monitoring precision and point density are improved through the combination optimization of a multiband SAR scattering mechanism, a weighted self-adaptive adjustment model is introduced to achieve objective fusion and uncertainty quantification of deformation-weather-background factors, and a deformation-weather coupling prediction model is constructed to achieve advanced early warning and hierarchical prevention and control. The invention solves the problems of sparse midpoint, low precision and insufficient early warning reliability in the traditional monitoring, and realizes high-precision and full-coverage stability evaluation and active prevention and control.
assignees: XINJIANG ROAD AND BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Spilled oil searching and collecting apparatus
title_ko: 유출유 탐색 및 회수 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for searching and collecting spilled oil and, more specifically, to an apparatus for searching and collecting spilled oil which uses a drone (unmanned moving body) to quickly search for spilled oil, and quickly establishes a disaster prevention plan in accordance with search information of spilled oil. To this end, the apparatus for searching and collecting spilled oil comprises: a disaster prevention search area setting unit which sets the coordinates of a disaster prevention search area in an unmanned moving body to fly the disaster prevention search area in an unmanned manner in accordance with an ocean oil spill accident; a spilled oil search unit which searches for spilled oil based on a spilled oil search image acquired while flying the disaster prevention search area; a spilled oil distinguishing unit which separates oil and seawater based on the spilled oil search image to distinguish spilled oil; a disaster prevention route search unit which searches for a spilled oil collection route based on information of the spilled oil distinguishing unit; an oil collection unit which separates oil and seawater by specific gravity while collecting spilled oil along the searched spilled oil collection route; and a collected oil storage unit which is detachably coupled to and fixed on the oil collection unit, and stores oil separated by the oil collection unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유출유 탐색 및 회수 장치에 관한 것으로서, 무인 이동체인 드론을 활용하여 신속히 유출유를 탐색하고, 유출유의 탐색정보에 따라 방제 계획을 신속히 수립하는 유출유 탐색 및 회수 장치에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 해양 기름 유출사고에 따라 방제 탐색영역을 무인 비행하도록 무인 이동체에 방제 탐색영역의 좌표를 설정하는 방제 탐색영역 설정부, 방제 탐색영역을 비행하면서 획득되는 유출유 탐색영상을 토대로 유출유를 탐색하는 유출유 탐색부, 유출유 탐색영상을 토대로 기름과 해수를 구분하여 유출유를 판별하는 유출유 판별부, 유출유 판별부의 정보에 기초하여 유출유 회수 경로를 탐색하는 방제 경로 탐색부, 탐색된 유출유 회수 경로를 따라 유출유를 회수하면서 기름과 해수를 비중에 의해 분리하는 유회수부, 및 유회수부와 착탈식으로 결합 고정되며, 유회수부에서 분리된 기름을 저장하는 회수유 저장부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 유출유 탐색 및 회수 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion disaster cellular alarm linkage system based on particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a particle swarm optimization-based disaster cellular alarm linkage system with interval demonstration and multi-sensor fusion, which comprises a fire monitoring alarm linkage system, a public fire alarm system and a property management platform, wherein the fire monitoring alarm linkage system comprises entrance guard terminals of all unit buildings of a community and cellular user terminals; emergency alarm switches are arranged on the property management platform and the property management platform; the public fire alarm system comprises CO, smoke and temperature sensors and an alarm controller which are arranged in a residential building, wherein a fire judgment data fusion algorithm based on IPSO optimized interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion is arranged in the alarm controller. The fire monitoring alarm linkage system and the public fire alarm system work in a matched mode, automatic fire alarm and manual fire alarm are integrated, an IPSO optimized interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion fire judgment data fusion algorithm is based on, and uncertainty of sensor measurement data is eliminated.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair method and a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring state information of a post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically repaired through an environment side; inputting the state information of the post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically repaired to an intelligent body side comprising a reinforcement learning model to obtain a dynamic repair result of the post-disaster power distribution network output by the intelligent body; the intelligent agent side obtains a reinforcement learning state from the environment side, selects an action to act on the power distribution network based on a strategy, receives a corresponding reward value and the next state for iterative training, and obtains the reinforcement learning model after continuously updating network parameters. The embodiment of the invention realizes the high-efficiency and high-accuracy emergency repair effect of the post-disaster emergency repair of the power distribution network under the conditions of deep coupling of cooperative allocation, emergency repair recovery and power transfer and recovery of multiple emergency repair teams and uncertainty of disaster conditions.

title_en: Tunnel surrounding rock convergence deformation prediction model dynamic selection and deformation probability prediction method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for dynamically selecting a tunnel surrounding rock convergence deformation prediction model and predicting deformation probability, and relates to the technical field of information processing. In the embodiment of the invention, a surrounding rock convergence deformation dynamic prediction model based on a continuous Bayesian inverse analysis method and optimal model selection is established, tunnel convergence deformation monitoring information is used as an observation value, parameters of 3 empirical models are continuously updated and calibrated, and the optimal model is selected to predict the final convergence deformation value of the surrounding rock and quantify the uncertainty of the final convergence deformation value. The final deformation result about 40 days can be effectively predicted by adopting the prediction Fan Fagei only by using the observation data about 10 days, and an important technical support is provided for the deformation limit of the surrounding rock of the tunnel and the prevention and the control of large deformation disasters.

title_en: Resource collaborative elastic planning method for accounting for uncertainty of new energy under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource collaborative elastic planning method for accounting for uncertainty of new energy under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of constructing time-varying fault rate of a line through typhoon disaster disturbance and line fault rate models, identifying fragile lines, further constructing an evolution model considering linkage faults under typhoon disasters, generating a wind-light output scene through combining a mixed Copula function with multi-element normal distribution, screening out a wind-light scene set through a synchronous back-band reduction method, improving system elasticity through flexible resource collaborative planning such as wind-light photovoltaic energy storage and line reinforcement, and solving the constructed model through column and constraint generation and Big-M method to obtain a collaborative planning scheme of various flexible resources. The invention can solve the problem of safe and reliable operation of the power system caused by typhoon disasters and uncertainty of new energy output.

title_en: Maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of emergency search and rescue, wherein the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method comprises the following steps of responding to a preset maritime search area and dividing the search area into a plurality of subareas to be searched; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-mode data acquisition on a sub-region to be searched, carrying out real-time processing on the acquired multi-mode data through a preset lightweight visual semantic model to generate a semantic processing result, sending the semantic processing result and the multi-mode data to a cloud processing system, receiving a cloud identification result returned by the cloud processing system, and executing an emergency rescue strategy corresponding to the cloud identification result. According to the application, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used as the edge equipment to acquire and process data, so that the data processing result which is convenient to transmit to the cloud is obtained, and after the cloud identification result returned by the cloud is received, a corresponding emergency rescue strategy is executed, so that the efficiency of the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue is improved.

title_en: Interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion disaster cellular alarm linkage system based on particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a particle swarm optimization-based disaster cellular alarm linkage system with interval demonstration and multi-sensor fusion, which comprises a fire monitoring alarm linkage system, a public fire alarm system and a property management platform, wherein the fire monitoring alarm linkage system comprises entrance guard terminals of all unit buildings of a community and cellular user terminals; emergency alarm switches are arranged on the property management platform and the property management platform; the public fire alarm system comprises CO, smoke and temperature sensors and an alarm controller which are arranged in a residential building, wherein a fire judgment data fusion algorithm based on IPSO optimized interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion is arranged in the alarm controller. The fire monitoring alarm linkage system and the public fire alarm system work in a matched mode, automatic fire alarm and manual fire alarm are integrated, an IPSO optimized interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion fire judgment data fusion algorithm is based on, and uncertainty of sensor measurement data is eliminated.

title_en: Power transaction data reflow method based on deep learning conflict prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning conflict prediction-based power transaction data reflow method, which relates to the field of power transaction and comprises the following steps of obtaining a data change log of a disaster recovery data center station and analyzing the data change log into a structured change event, carrying out feature extraction on the structured change event to generate a multi-mode feature vector, inputting a pre-trained Bayesian conflict prediction model, outputting conflict probability and uncertainty information of each structured change event, shunting the structured change event to a quick channel or a cautious channel through a rule engine strategy, carrying out differential synchronization processing corresponding to the channel type on the shunted structured change event, and carrying out Bayesian conflict prediction model and rule engine strategy updating by combining a data reflow process monitoring result. The parallelization and self-adaptive optimization of the data reflux are realized through Bayesian conflict prediction and intelligent shunting, and the reflux efficiency and the recovery speed of the main system are improved on the premise of ensuring the data consistency.

title_en: AI-based unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, device, equipment and storage medium based on AI, this method includes: receiving a search and rescue task sent by a central server, wherein the search and rescue task comprises a target search area and terminal information of a terminal to be searched and rescued; determining a flight route based on the target search area; receiving position information sent by a terminal in the process that the target search area flies along the flight route, wherein the position information comprises terminal identification information; judging whether the terminal identification is the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued; if the terminal identification is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, acquiring the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued; and sending the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued to a search and rescue terminal so that search and rescue personnel holding the search and rescue terminal can carry out rescue according to the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, thereby realizing the quick positioning of the trapped position of the personnel to be searched and rescued and improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Fine prediction method for disaster-stricken and evacuation population of rural area under typhoon and storm disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of typhoon and storm disaster emergency decision, and particularly discloses a refined prediction method for disaster receiving and evacuation population in a rural area under typhoon and storm disaster, which comprises the following steps: according to basic information and wind speed and rainfall forecast information of residential buildings in a region to be researched, obtaining real-time disaster conditions of the research region, calculating the probability that all residential buildings are in different functional states at different moments by using a building function evaluation frame, and obtaining disaster-affected buildings at village level and town level and expected values of people to be evacuated. And carrying out cyclic calculation by using the method along with continuous updating of rainfall forecast products. The disaster situation deduction and building function evaluation are carried out based on a physical mechanism, the number and distribution of disaster-stricken population are directly deduced from the human demand perspective, the uncertainty of weather forecast and building disaster-bearing capacity is considered, and a decision maker can select two modes of risk neutrality and risk aversion.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster first-aid repair operation strategy optimization method considering renewable energy and load uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush repair operation strategy optimization method considering renewable energy and load uncertainty. The distribution network emergency repair operation scheme obtained based on the method can consider the worst condition of renewable energy and load uncertainty, can ensure the effectiveness and safety of the recovery process after distribution network disaster, can accelerate the distribution network emergency repair recovery process, reduces load loss, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on dynamic data monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system based on dynamic data monitoring, comprising the steps of obtaining multi-source geological disaster investigation data of a target area, screening hidden danger positions of geological disasters in the target area, obtaining existing deformation characteristics and geological conditions based on the hidden danger positions, and generating geological disaster hidden danger characteristics; acquiring influence factors of hidden danger positions, determining geological monitoring indexes and acquiring multidimensional monitoring data in real time; and constructing a geological disaster early warning model, dynamically judging the development trend of the geological disaster, carrying out danger analysis and danger avoidance decision making visual expression according to the development trend, and obtaining interactive information between a user and the danger analysis and danger avoidance decision making dynamic correction of the geological disaster early warning model. According to the dynamic expression of the personalized geological disaster characteristics of the hidden danger points, the uncertainty analysis of the geological disaster time is satisfied, the reliability and the accuracy of geological disaster early warning are improved, and a data basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction work of the geological disaster.

title_en: Method for estimating success rate of multi-machine participation on large-scale search and rescue at sea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the success rate of multi-machine participation on a large scale search and rescue at sea, which comprises the following steps: the first step: acquiring various data; and a second step of: calculating the area A of the regular search and rescue area; and a third step of: calculating the searching capability Z of single movement of each rescue platform  i  And calculating the total searching capacity Z of single movement of each rescue platform  total  Comparison of A and Z  total  If Z  total  More than or equal to A goes to the fourth step, if Z  total  Step five, the step A is carried out; fourth step: setting the coverage factor C of the search area to be a fixed value, and then entering a sixth step; fifth step: calculating a corrected coverage factor C of the search area  co  Then, a sixth step is carried out; sixth step: referring to the probability-coverage factor corresponding curve of the detection personnel, and pre-estimatingTo the probability of successfully finding the rescue subject in the existing situation. The invention aims to provide a method capable of rapidly and accurately estimating the success rate of the existing multiple models to participate in the large-scale search and rescue at sea.
assignees: THE 28TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Multimode integrated precipitation forecasting method and system based on generalized triangular cap theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode integrated rainfall forecasting method and system based on a generalized triangular cap theory, which relates to the technical field of weather forecast, the method eliminates systematic deviation by acquiring multisource numerical mode data in real time, and preprocessing through spatial standardization and real-time frequency matching, and dynamically analyzing a covariance matrix of a difference sequence between modes by using a generalized triangular cap theory to quantify uncertainty, dynamically distributing weight coefficients based on the uncertainty, and finally weighting and integrating to output a standardized rainfall forecast product. The method can realize that TS score is improved by 49% -124% compared with an international advanced mode (such as ECMWF) in the rainstorm and heavy rainstorm forecast without depending on historical or live observation data, and the method shows high precision and strong adaptability in turning weather scenes such as a scarce area of a meteorological site, typhoons and fronts, and the integrated result is directly connected with a national meteorological center service platform to support real-time disaster early warning decision.

title_en: Task planning method, device and equipment for maritime collaborative search and rescue and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a task planning method, device, equipment and storage medium for maritime collaborative search and rescue, which are characterized in that a search and rescue probability map which is quantitatively represented by uncertainty of search and rescue target distribution probability under the gridding of a marine environment is obtained by adopting a Monte Carlo algorithm based on a drifting track, a maritime target search and rescue model is constructed based on the search and rescue probability map, meanwhile, an initial population is obtained by setting an initial chromosome gene segment according to collaborative search and rescue parameters, the optimal solution is obtained by adopting a global optimal genetic bionic intelligent algorithm based on the initial population, the optimal solution is obtained after the initial population is decoded, and a task planning scheme of multiparty participation in collaborative search and rescue is obtained after interaction with the maritime target search and rescue model in each iterative optimization process, and population optimization is carried out according to the fitness. By adopting the method, a multiparty collaborative search and rescue task planning scheme with high search and rescue success rate can be obtained.

title_en: Drought early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly provides an drought early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence, comprising the steps of collecting data of a drought early warning river basin; the method comprises the steps of constructing a deep learning model considering hydrologic process to simulate daily runoff, reconstructing long-series daily runoff data, constructing a month-scale vegetation-meteorological hydrologic drought regression model, calculating comprehensive meteorological hydrologic drought indexes, extracting drought events, constructing K artificial intelligent models, inputting meteorological hydrologic observation data into the K artificial intelligent models to simulate, adopting a Bayesian mode averaging method to calculate the weight of each artificial intelligent model, constructing a combined distribution function of drought index observation and forecast values based on Copula functions, and adopting an artificial intelligent-Bayesian coupling model to develop drought forecast. The method solves the problems of data scarcity, model uncertainty and the like in drought early warning, and provides high-precision and quantifiable decision support for water resource management, disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Surface matrix map modification data processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geology, in particular to a surface matrix map modification data processing method which comprises the steps of data dynamic acquisition, intelligent pretreatment, three-dimensional modeling, multi-scale nested analysis, decision deduction and dynamic visualization; compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the periodic manual acquisition and static database updating scheme is adopted, the data updating period is long, sudden environmental change is difficult to capture, the scheme adopts the multi-source data real-time access and AI dynamic cleaning scheme, the method has the advantages of real-time updating capability and automatic abnormal value correction, the earth surface matrix model can dynamically respond to environmental change, the timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision is remarkably improved, the deep learning fusion multi-mode data and Bayesian uncertainty quantification scheme is adopted, the method has the advantages of high-resolution three-dimensional modeling and risk area visualization, and complex geological structures can be accurately depicted and clear priority guidance is provided for manual verification.
assignees: QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL MINERAL RES INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL REMO

title_en: Intelligent judging method for stability of highway slope rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent judging method for stability of a highway slope rock mass, which comprises the steps of obtaining rock mass displacement and moisture content of the highway slope rock mass, obtaining a rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram through finite element simulation, comparing the rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram with historical geological data, dividing the rock mass into a high uncertainty area and a low uncertainty area, extracting a deformation monitoring sequence from the high uncertainty area, classifying to obtain a deformation trend classification result, fusing the deformation trend classification result with the mechanical property of the low uncertainty area to generate a slope stability index map, updating rock mass fracture density and permeability, combining the updated fracture density, permeability and deformation trend, obtaining a instability probability distribution curve through probability simulation, generating an early warning signal according to whether a curve peak probability point is located in a safety interval, and outputting a slope stability judging report. The method improves accuracy and instantaneity of slope stability evaluation and obviously reduces geological disaster risks.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) search and rescue operations are provided. A UAV may include a camera configured to capture one or more images of a search area. The UAV may include at least one logic device configured to calculate a flight pattern for searching the search area, receive a target image, and analyze the one or more images of the search area to identify a target matching the target image.

title_en: Civil helicopter maritime search and rescue disposal scheme optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil helicopter maritime search and rescue treatment scheme optimization method, which comprises the following steps: initializing a population of a treatment scheme according to parameterized definition and a value range of a task area; non-dominant ordering is carried out on the population, and virtual fitness is given to the population until all individuals are grouped; performing crossover, mutation and genetic mutation selection operations in the population, and outputting a Pareto front solution set when the optimization result is converged or the iteration number exceeds a set maximum genetic algebra; adding corresponding search and rescue modes and task properties in a task area of each front edge solution set to form a disposal scheme set for maritime search and rescue of the helicopter; performing simulation deduction according to the sequence, and outputting simulation data of the treatment scheme evaluation index under the influence of uncertainty factors through large sample simulation; and comprehensively evaluating the simulation data of each treatment scheme, expressing the comprehensive evaluation result in a normal distribution mode, and selecting the treatment scheme with the largest mean value and the smallest variance.

title_en: Four-rotor fault disaster recovery degradation control method based on observer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-rotor fault disaster recovery degradation control method based on an observer, which relates to the technical field of four-rotor faults and comprises the following steps: in order to facilitate the design of a subsequent controller, a kinematic model and a dynamic model of the four-rotor unmanned helicopter are introduced, and a coordinate system of the four-rotor unmanned helicopter in the flight process is defined: inertial system { I } = { O  I  ,X  I  ,Y  I  ,Z  I  { B } = { O in body coordinate system }  B  ,X  B  ,Y  B  ,Z  B  }. Subsequently, in order to avoid the singular problem existing in Euler angle gesture expression, a degradation gesture control algorithm based on quaternion is provided, and a disturbance observer is provided to compensate the uncertainty of system modeling and external unknown disturbance; in the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle position loop, a robust integral geometric control algorithm is provided for compensating external disturbance introduced by the position loop, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can better resist the external disturbance on the premise that one blade is completely out of control, the safety and the stability of the system are improved, and finally,the effectiveness of the control algorithm provided by the invention is verified through numerical simulation.

title_en: Network updating method for post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency management and discloses a network updating method of a post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data, which comprises the steps of converting acquired heterogeneous data into basic probability distribution of observation evidence; the method comprises the steps of predicting a physical field state based on a physical process simulator, generating basic probability distribution of prediction evidence, fusing the two to obtain posterior basic probability distribution, deciding and updating a road map network state according to the posterior basic probability distribution, and feeding the updated state back to the simulator as a dynamic boundary condition to form bidirectional coupling of the physical simulation and the road map state. According to the application, by constructing the simulation assimilation framework of the bidirectional coupling, the technical problems of physical simulation and infrastructure state fracture in the traditional method are solved, the uncertainty of data is effectively processed by utilizing the evidence theory, and the authenticity of disaster evolution prediction and the reliability of road state update are improved.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Toughness prevention scheduling method for hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a toughness prevention scheduling method for a hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system, which is used for performing prevention scheduling based on a preventive scheduling model constructed by a self-adaptive robust optimization framework, wherein the preventive scheduling model comprises the steps of quantifying uncertainty impact caused by natural disasters on three infrastructures of a power transmission line, a natural gas pipeline and a traffic road, integrating two scheduling measures of electric power hydrogen production and heating and hydrogen transportation, and adopting a two-stage optimization structure to generate an active resource deployment scheme before disasters occur. By building a two-stage preventive scheduling model based on self-adaptive robust optimization, the model systematically brings uncertainty damage to three key infrastructures of a power transmission line, a natural gas pipeline and a traffic road caused by natural disasters into a unified frame for the first time, and achieves the purpose of flexible resource operation scheduling in a system by introducing P2HH and HT scheduling.

title_en: Safety evaluation method for coal mine spontaneous combustion coal seam
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting a fire disaster in a coal mine spontaneous combustion coal seam, which introduces an entropy method and a mutation theory into a model structure, wherein the entropy method is a measure for uncertainty factors, and the mutation theory can directly process discontinuous change and mutation phenomena and is particularly suitable for the research of a system with uncertain internal action. The mutation series method is a nonlinear dynamic evaluation method, and can accurately calculate the membership degree of each evaluation index aiming at the uncertainty and the mutation of the spontaneous combustion fire of the coal mine. Therefore, the entropy method and the mutation theory are combined and applied, and the uncertainty and the mutation of the spontaneous combustion fire of the coal mine can be well met.

title_en: Regional rock-soil body strength parameter correction method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk analysis, in particular to a regional rock-soil body intensity parameter correction method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting at least one influence factor data of a target region to construct a geographical information database of a regional landslide susceptibility evaluation model; calculating an area landslide susceptibility index by using a frequency ratio model to determine an area landslide occurrence probability to obtain first area landslide stability, determining an area rock-soil body intensity parameter to calculate an area slope stability coefficient, reducing the area rock-soil body intensity parameter to obtain second area slope stability, constructing a cross entropy loss function to quantitatively evaluate the result difference, and carrying out iterative updating on the rock-soil body intensity parameter to obtain a final area rock-soil body intensity parameter. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, the shear strength parameter of the slope has larger uncertainty, the calculation error of the easiness of earthquake landslide is possibly increased, the prediction accuracy and reliability are reduced and the like are solved.

title_en: Missing Person Searching System Using Smart Device Based on Drone
title_ko: 드론 기반의 스마트기기를 활용한 실종자 추적 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a missing person tracking system using drone-based smart devices. The missing person tracking system using drone-based smart devices includes: a searcher smart device that receives a missing person ID from the outside through a wireless communication network and transmits missing person identification information and missing person location information to the outside; a drone that receives a seed ID from the outside through a wireless communication network and transmits GPS information, altitude information, missing person identification information and missing person location information to the outside, and takes aerial photographs of the area when the missing person smart device is called; and a management server that stores missing person personal information internally, transmits a missing person ID with missing person personal information encrypted to the searcher smart device and drone, and transmits GIS information on the missing person's location to the searcher smart device. According to the present invention, the search area can be prevented from being duplicated or a specific area from being excluded from the search area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 기반의 스마트기기를 활용한 실종자 추적 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무선 통신망을 통해 외부로부터 실종자가 소지한 실종자 스마트기기를 호출할 수 있는 실종자 ID를 전송받고, GPS 정보와 함께 실종자 스마트기기로부터의 응답여부에 따른 실종자 인식 정보와 실종자 위치 정보를 외부로 전송하는 수색자 스마트기기; 무선 통신망을 통해 외부로부터 실종자가 소지한 실종자 스마트기기를 호출할 수 있는 실종자 ID를 전송받고, GPS 정보, 고도 정보, 실종자 인식 정보 및 실종자 위치 정보를 외부로 전송하며, 실종자 스마트기기가 호출될 때에는 해당 지역의 항공사진을 촬영하는 드론; 및 실종자 구조요청 시 입력되는 실종자 개인정보를 내부에 저장하고, 실종자 개인정보를 암호화한 실종자 ID를 수색자 스마트기기 및 드론으로 전송하며, 수색자 스마트기기와 드론으로부터 전송되는 실종자 인식 정보, GPS 정보, 고도 및 항공사진을 통해 실종자 수색반경 및 실종자의 위치를 분석한 후 실종자 위치에 대한 GIS 정보를 수색자 스마트기기로 전송하는 관리서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Quick evaluation method for toughness of power transmission system based on influence increment sensitivity

title_en: Fuzzy BN task reliability prediction method for multi-state airborne search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of reliability analysis of aviation onboard search and rescue systems, and discloses a fuzzy Bayesian Network (BN) task reliability prediction method for a multi-state onboard search and rescue system. The description advantages of logic association and uncertainty information thereof in a complex system by BN and the division definition capability of a fuzzy set theory on multiple states of performance degradation equipment are integrated, the model can effectively express the uncertainty of the search and rescue system under the multi-level and multi-cross-linked logic and the multi-state attribute of the equipment under the performance degradation, and the prediction and evaluation of the system task reliability level and the health state trend are realized.
assignees: CHINESE AERONAUTICAL RADIO ELECTRONICS RES INST

title_en: Search and rescue method and system based on warning lamp
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of warning lamps, and discloses a search and rescue method and system based on the warning lamps, wherein the method and system are characterized in that a plurality of ultrasonic signals are sent out based on the warning lamps, an ultrasonic monitoring device monitors whether at least one ultrasonic signal is received in real time, if the ultrasonic signal is received, a search and rescue range is predicted according to the ultrasonic signal and sent to a dispatching platform, so that the dispatching platform determines a current search area according to the search and rescue range, when the warning lamps search the search area, search results can be transmitted to the dispatching platform in real time, the dispatching platform determines search and rescue positions based on the search results, and after the search and rescue positions are confirmed, the dispatching platform generates dispatching information according to the search and rescue positions, so that the search areas of the warning lamps are dispatched again, and the purpose of search and rescue is achieved. Therefore, the condition of searching and rescuing of the warning lamps can be known in time, and a plurality of warning lamps are scheduled in time when a person waiting for rescuing is found, so that the overall searching and rescuing difficulty is reduced, and the rescuing time is shortened.

title_en: Uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT, and belongs to the field of intelligent prediction of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining slope history monitoring data and normalizing, constructing a GRU deterministic prediction model to conduct displacement prediction and generate an error sequence, decomposing the error sequence into a low-frequency system error and a high-frequency random error by adopting a TCN-Attention-EWT combined method, respectively establishing a GRU error correction sub-model with Monte Carlo Dropout, calculating probability distribution dynamic fusion weights of the low-frequency system error and the high-frequency random error correction based on an information theory, fusing a deterministic prediction value with probability distribution of the two correction values, and obtaining a final displacement prediction mean value and a prediction interval through inverse normalization. The method realizes high-precision prediction and uncertainty quantification of landslide displacement and provides reliable technical support for landslide early warning.
assignees: YIBIN VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE;YIBIN JIABO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: End cloud fusion type overspeed prevention control method for emergency rescue vehicle engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an end cloud fusion type overspeed control method for an engine of an emergency rescue vehicle, which solves the problem that the existing vehicle running recorder only has a speed overspeed alarm function and can only be controlled manually by a driver, so that great uncertainty exists. The method comprises the steps that a real-time monitoring and measuring and calculating function is added on a vehicle-mounted controller of a vehicle, a vehicle-mounted controller operation learning and early warning algorithm model is built, real-time operation data of the vehicle speed, the rotating speed, the torque and the load power of an engine, which are collected by a sensor, are read, the vehicle-mounted controller is analyzed and prejudged through the data, a vehicle-end control system is started in a servo mode according to analysis results, a starting threshold value and data collection surface density are adjusted according to different conditions, abnormal data appear on the vehicle, the vehicle-end automatically intervenes by adopting corresponding measures, and an abnormal information alarm of the vehicle is synchronously transmitted to a cloud end to inform management personnel. The invention can effectively prevent the overspeed damage of the engine, reduce the failure rate and maintenance cost of the vehicle and prevent the overspeed of the vehicle from improving the operation safety of the vehicle.

title_en: Table lookup correction method for average loss of disaster event model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a table lookup correction method for average loss of a disaster event model, which comprises a parameter reading step, a table building step, a calculating step and a correcting step, a computer program product, a computing system and a memory, wherein the computing system comprises at least one processor and a memory, and the memory stores instructions, and the instructions are executed by the at least one processor to realize the technical scheme of the invention. The invention particularly provides a technical scheme for generating an overrun probability distribution table according to ELT of a disaster event model, and the average loss of the event is adjusted or corrected by means of the overrun probability distribution table, so that the loss of the event can be considered for secondary uncertainty.

title_en: Emergency rescue material dynamic allocation method based on distributed robust optimization technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency rescue material dynamic allocation method based on a distributed robust optimization technology, which comprises the following steps of S1: a vehicle scheduling decision variable, a material allocation decision variable and a time window decision variable are introduced. S2: analyzing the relation among the vehicle dispatching decision variables, and constructing vehicle dispatching decision variable association constraint; s3: analyzing the relation among the material distribution decision variables, and constructing a material distribution decision variable association constraint; s4: and analyzing the relation among the time window decision variables, and constructing time window decision variable association constraint. S5: and analyzing the relation between the material distribution and the vehicle dispatching optimization target, and constructing an objective function to obtain an original model. S6: and (3) processing uncertainty of emergency rescue material demands based on a distributed robust optimization technology, and deriving a safe convex approximation processable form of an original model by utilizing a dual theory to obtain a distributed robust model easy to calculate and solve. S7: and analyzing the complexity of the model and solving to obtain a dynamic rescue material allocation scheme.

title_en: Power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water logging disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water-logging disasters, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing an electric power-drainage network coupling model based on partial differential constraint of pressure and non-pressure unsteady flow hydrodynamic force, and representing dynamic interactive evolution processes of power failure, rainwater overflow and road ponding of a power grid under a storm disaster; s2, establishing an equivalent linear complex algebraic equation of a drainage network nonlinear hydrodynamic partial differential equation in a frequency domain; s3, deducing a multi-hyperplane formula of an electric power-drainage composite safety area, and representing a feasible operation boundary of an electric pump-sluice group under the injection conditions of complex electric power and rainwater; and S4, taking rainfall uncertainty in heavy rain into consideration, adopting multi-scene random optimization based on Monte Carlo simulation, and solving an emergency scheduling decision scheme at the current moment through rolling optimization. The invention realizes the coordination reconstruction of the network topology of the power distribution network and the drainage network under the disaster of rainstorm and waterlogging.

title_en: Intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of safety prediction and early warning, and comprises the steps of obtaining online monitoring historical data of a tailing dam, preprocessing data, constructing a GRU main prediction model to predict main prediction displacement, obtaining an error sequence through actual measurement data and the main prediction displacement, decomposing the error sequence into a trend item and a noise item error sequence through PSO-VMD-TOPSIS, respectively constructing a trend item and noise item error correction model based on GRU, obtaining error correction values and standard deviations of the trend item and the noise item through MC-dropout technology, constructing a dynamic weight calculation mechanism, obtaining a final displacement prediction value and a confidence interval through combining the main prediction displacement, judging whether to alarm or not, realizing high-precision real-time prediction, uncertainty quantization and real-time early warning of the tailing dam displacement, and providing intelligent decision support for the safety state assessment and disaster early warning of the tailing dam.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN SCI & ENG;YIBIN JIABO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire identification method based on flame detection in night vision scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire identification method based on flame detection in a night vision scene, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring an image sequence of a monitored scene through a monitoring camera with a night vision function; step 2, carrying out brightness segmentation on each frame of acquired image, and simultaneously carrying out background modeling and motion detection on the acquired image sequence; step 3, carrying out logic screening on the alternative flame area, finding out scattered bright spots around the large bright spot, and filtering out interference noise of the scattered bright spots; step 4, calculating cumulative distribution on a time axis to form a cumulative distribution probability image of the bright spots; step 5, carrying out binarization and clustering operations on the obtained cumulative distribution probability map in space, and filtering out; step 6, extracting characteristics of each remaining cluster, and performing randomness detection on a time axis; and 7, judging whether a fire disaster occurs in the monitored scene. The method solves the problem that the night fire detection method in the prior art is easy to interfere and has high false alarm rate.

title_en: A kind of nuclear reactor fuel rod fusing visual experimental apparatus and method
abstract_en: A kind of nuclear reactor fuel rod fusing visual experimental apparatus and method, high temperature smelting furnace including having several saturating windows, testpieces is vertically arranged in high temperature smelting furnace, the top and bottom of testpieces are respectively arranged with rhenium molybdenum electrode, rhenium molybdenum electrode is by testpieces, rhenium molybdenum electrode is connected with the copper electrode for passing through high-temperature fusion furnace sidewall, testpieces includes fuel rod, it is provided with W-Re heating rod in fuel rod, is provided on the outside of high temperature smelting furnace for carrying out cooling cooling water recirculation system to high temperature smelting furnace.The present invention guarantees that furnace body temperature outside is maintained within security restriction by high temperature smelting furnace cooling water recirculation system, and external high-speed camera instrument can work normally, being capable of core melt progression under the conditions of real simulation reactor disaster.The experimental data that the present invention obtains can provide verifying for conventional numeric analogy method, reduce the uncertainty of existing Analysis Codes of Severe Accident.

title_en: Integrated decision method and system for post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated decision-making method and system for post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection, which comprises the steps of analyzing various costs of post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection, namely facility point station opening cost, personnel evacuation transportation variable cost, fixed cost, material transportation variable cost and fixed cost, constructing an integrated decision-making optimization model by taking the minimum total cost as an optimization target, converting parameter uncertainty conditions in the integrated decision-making optimization model based on robust optimization, and then solving the integrated decision-making optimization model to obtain decision variables, namely the open condition of a refuge, the open condition of a medical center, the number of disaster people evacuated from a disaster point to the refuge, the number of wounded evacuated from the disaster point to the medical center, and various material amounts distributed to the refuge and the medical center by a material distribution center. According to the invention, under the condition of uncertain environment and sufficient emergency materials, the disaster relief efficiency is improved, the disaster loss is reduced, and the uncertainty and complexity of the disaster can be better dealt with.

title_en: Electric power traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on probability map
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the vulnerability of an electric power traffic coupling network based on a probability map, which comprises the following steps: establishing a Bayesian network model of the outage event of the power distribution network equipment under the typhoon disaster, and predicting the outage probability of the power distribution network equipment based on the Bayesian network; establishing an alternating current optimal power flow model, analyzing the overload condition of a power distribution network line, and carrying out load removal on a power system; evaluating the capacity of the coupling network for resisting external interference by using a power traffic coupling network vulnerability evaluation model based on a probability map; the method is supported by a probability chart, a vulnerability assessment model of the electric power traffic coupling network is established, and calculation of elasticity measurement of the electric power traffic coupling network is achieved; based on historical meteorological data, the method can realize prediction of a cascading failure propagation mechanism of the electric power traffic coupling network under typhoon disasters, ensure the accuracy and rapidity of real-time estimation, and provide a theoretical basis for emergency plans under typhoon weather.

title_en: Urban power grid fault early warning method and system based on expected fault set
abstract_en: The application provides an urban power grid fault early warning method and system based on an expected fault set, wherein the method comprises the steps of combining meteorological data with real-time monitoring data and operation data of a power grid to judge the type of disaster where the power grid is currently located; the method comprises the steps of receiving a target prediction model corresponding to a current disaster type, calling the target prediction model corresponding to the current disaster type to predict whether the power grid can fail, predicting the failure type after judging that the power grid can fail, optimizing super parameters of the target prediction model through a parameter adjusting tool, carrying out global risk assessment and disaster early warning on the power grid through an expected failure set, dynamically updating the model through an online learning algorithm and a model parameter self-adaptive adjustment algorithm based on real-time data flow, and carrying out failure prediction and risk assessment again based on the dynamically updated model. According to the method, prediction uncertainty is reduced through staged model prediction, and accurate fault prediction can be realized under various disaster scenes by combining dynamic updating of a prediction model and an expected fault set.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUXI POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL

title_en: offshore search area estimation method based on wind pressure difference overturning and drifting model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an offshore search area estimation method based on a wind pressure difference overturning drift model, which comprises the following steps of: normalizing the wind speed change quantity; obtaining the influence of the self speed of the target on the wind pressure difference turnover according to the target drift speed; obtaining the wind pressure difference turnover rate according to the normalized wind speed change and the influence of the target speed on the wind pressure difference turnover, and judging whether the current wind pressure difference is turnover; obtaining a target drift model according to the wind pressure difference overturning structure; and estimating a search area by adopting a Monte Carlo method based on the target drift model. The search area estimated by the sea search area estimation method based on the wind pressure difference overturning and drifting model can contain search and rescue targets to the maximum extent, is small in area, can avoid useless search of invalid areas, and improves the sea search success rate.

title_en: Star-base and foundation lightning data fusion method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fusing star-based and foundation lightning data, which comprises the following steps: selecting effective data of the satellite-based and foundation lightning data; (2) Calculating a time threshold value of fusion of star foundation and foundation lightning data; (3) Calculating a space threshold value of fusion of star foundation and foundation lightning data; (4) And constructing a data fusion scheme to obtain a localized full-lightning data set. The method realizes the cross fusion of the satellite-based lightning data and the foundation lightning data, makes up for the deficiencies of the satellite-based lightning data and the foundation lightning data, solves the problems of data incompleteness and uncertainty caused by a single information source, and is favorable for more comprehensively recognizing the lightning activity characteristics. The fused full lightning data can be applied to the fields of lightning monitoring and early warning, strong weather analysis, lightning disaster investigation and identification and lightning protection design, and scientific support is provided for lightning protection and disaster reduction business services and research work.
assignees: NANJING METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Throat blockage emergency rescue simulation teaching method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation teaching method and device for throat obstruction emergency rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a replaceable airway physical model integrated with a pressure sensor, a position sensor and an airflow sensor, utilizing an airway resistance-displacement dynamic model to control airway resistance change of the replaceable airway physical model in real time, constructing a case library according to acquired real emergency cases, synchronously calling corresponding teaching guidance content in the case library when a learner operates the replaceable airway physical model, comparing learner operation data with a preset standard operation threshold, adopting a Dempster-Shafer evidence algorithm to carry out uncertainty reasoning on pressure curve stability, operation time and airway smoothness, outputting an evaluation result and an operation error report, and automatically generating a visual training report. According to the invention, through the replaceable airway physical model and the Dempster-Shafer evidence algorithm, the pathological and physiological changes of the laryngeal obstruction can be accurately simulated, and the fine flaws in the operation of a learner can be identified, so that the training accuracy and efficiency are obviously improved.
assignees: AFFILIATED TONGJI HOSPITAL OF TONGJI MEDICAL COLLEGE OF HUAZHONG UNIV SCI & TECH

title_en: Typhoon disaster pre-post-disaster interconnected power distribution network recovery method based on reconfigurable soft switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering a typhoon pre-disaster post-disaster interconnection power distribution network based on a reconfigurable soft switch, which comprises the steps of considering the power supporting effect of an electric bus in a pre-disaster stage, combining the topology cooperative change of the reconfigurable soft switch and an interconnection power distribution network port to construct a pre-disaster deployment model of the electric bus, so as to determine the stop position of the electric bus before a fault occurs; in the post-disaster stage, the uncertainty of renewable energy sources and loads in continuous faults and recovery of the interconnected distribution network is considered, an event-driven recovery model is built by defining fault events and prediction error events by using an event-driven mechanism, and therefore a fault recovery strategy of the interconnected distribution network is obtained, and fault recovery of the interconnected distribution network is promoted. The invention can carry out fault deduction before disaster, reduce potential power loss load and accelerate power supply recovery after disaster, and can trigger strategy update in real time under the continuous fault state after disaster, thereby being applicable to fault evolution and uncertainty of renewable energy sources and loads.

title_en: Flood probability forecasting method based on multi-source uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood probability forecasting method based on multisource uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: estimating surface rainfall probability distribution based on an incomplete rainfall monitoring group; constructing a suboptimal solution set of each model parameter, and acquiring probability distribution of the model parameters; randomly generating a combination of surface rainfall and parameters, and driving a hydrological model to generate a plurality of groups of initial flow forecasting processes; estimating the probability of each model to be relatively optimal by utilizing a BMA method; and randomly extracting an optimal model and corresponding initial forecast flow, and estimating posterior probability distribution of the forecast flow to realize probability forecast. The method for calculating the flood probability forecast comprehensively considering the uncertainty of the rainfall input, the uncertainty of the parameters and the uncertainty of the model structure can be widely applied to the conditions that the rainfall input error is obvious, the model or the model structure suitable for the flood forecast cannot be accurately predicted, and the uncertainty of the model parameters is high, can improve the accuracy and the reliability of the flood forecast result, and provides technical support for flood control and disaster reduction.

title_en: Transmission tower side slope deformation monitoring method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle corner reflectors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower side slope deformation monitoring method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle corner reflectors, which relate to the technical field of remote sensing measurement and side slope disaster monitoring, and comprise that sub-pixel level fine registration of multi-mode images is realized by combining SAR image distance-Doppler model geocoding and optical image strict geometric model orthorectification and SIFT-RANSAC algorithm, so that the fusion precision of SAR and optical data in space is improved, the edge probability map is built by combining a fractional differential image enhancement method with a fractional ant colony algorithm, and an Otsu algorithm is introduced to realize automatic rough positioning of the corner reflector, so that the robustness and positioning efficiency of target extraction are improved, the high-precision inversion and time sequence optimization of three-dimensional geodetic coordinates of the corner reflector are realized by combining sub-pixel contour extraction and least square ellipse fitting with a beam method adjustment model, and the geometric precision of deformation monitoring results is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV CO

title_en: Search and rescue simulator and simulation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue simulator and a simulation method thereof. The search and rescue simulator comprises a marine simulator, an aviation simulator and a communication simulation unit, wherein the search and rescue simulator also comprises a central control simulation unit which is used for setting scene parameter information of the marine simulator and the aviation simulator, and transmitting the scene parameter information to the marine simulator and the aviation simulator; after the marine simulator and the aviation simulator loading the scene parameter information, the marine simulator transmits a distress signal to the central control simulation unit through the communication simulation unit; the central control simulation unit determines an optimal search area by combining an electronic chart according to the distress signal and transmits a search and rescue command to the marine simulator and the aviation simulator; the marine simulator and the aviation simulator performs search and rescue simulation according to the search and rescue command. Therefore, the disadvantages of high cost and high risk caused by using real equipment of a conventional marine search and rescue system for performing search and rescue practice are overcome.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searching and positioning method and device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a search positioning method and device for an unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the search positioning method for the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises the following steps: controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to search a search target in a first search area; after the unmanned aerial vehicle searches the search target in the first search area, with the search target as a center, defining an area with a preset area as a second search area; reducing the flying height of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the transmitting power of an antenna on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and positioning the search target in the second search area; and acquiring the position information of the search target. This application can realize when utilizing unmanned aerial vehicle to search for, after searching for the search target, reduces unmanned aerial vehicle's flight height and the transmitting power of the antenna on the unmanned aerial vehicle, fixes a position the search target in the search area who reduces, improves the accuracy of the search position who obtains, and then improves search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Multi-information fusion and heat source assisted medical search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning, and particularly relates to a medical search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method based on multi-information fusion and heat source assistance. According to the method, a GPS, an inertial measurement unit, an optical flow sensor, an ultrasonic sensor, an infrared thermal imaging camera and other sensors are integrated, an extended Kalman filtering algorithm and an active disturbance rejection control algorithm are utilized to achieve accurate positioning of a target heat source and accurate landing of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and a real-time monitoring unit in a real-time monitoring and decision support system receives data returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle and transmits analysis results to a real-time decision unit. The positioning method provided by the invention enables the unmanned aerial vehicle to effectively execute medical search and rescue tasks in a wide search area under complex terrain and changeable weather conditions, and provides immediate medical assistance for trapped persons, thereby playing a vital role in the field of emergency medical rescue.
assignees: JIANGXI CHANGHE PHARMACEUTICAL SUPPLY CHAIN MAN CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for enabling decision-making of flood storage area based on group intelligent optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision-making method, a system, equipment and a medium for enabling a flood storage area based on a group intelligent optimization algorithm, which comprise a multi-source data integration architecture, wherein hydrologic engineering, space geography and historical case data are collected, and after clipping, outlier processing and standardization, structured data with uniform time scale are formed; an uncertainty scene generation architecture for flood scene pre-judgment. Based on the LSTM deep learning model, outputting flood evolution trend and uncertainty interval, automatically generating multi-class disturbance scenes of flood peak flow, peak time and downstream risk level, and using a group intelligent optimization decision framework for solving an optimal scheme. Traversing all scenes through a north sea parrot optimization algorithm, minimizing the total flood diversion cost under the conditions of hard constraint and soft constraint, and dynamically and iteratively outputting flood diversion critical points and an optimal starting scheme. The dynamic adaptability and decision robustness of the invention are obviously improved, the multi-objective balance and the service floor property are considered, and the flood control risk and the disaster loss are effectively reduced.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER;HENAN SHIMANTAN RESERVOIR OPERATION CENTER

title_en: Coverage path planning method of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles in dam abnormal environment inspection
