abstract_en: The invention discloses a coverage path planning method of a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in dam abnormal environment inspection, which is characterized in that firstly, an abnormal environment, namely a dam area after a disaster occurs, is defined, secondly, the coverage path planning problem of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in dam abnormal environment inspection is defined as an optimization problem, the optimization targets are coverage rate and energy consumption of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in the abnormal environment respectively, and a model design is that a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model based on DRL is constructed according to the optimization problem defined in the previous step, and the parameters of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model are updated and the performance of the model is evaluated. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of good practicability and the like.

title_en: Urban flood prediction method based on Bayesian convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood prediction method based on a Bayesian convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of collecting historical rainfall events of a research area, simulating different rainfall events by using hydrodynamic simulation software to obtain the maximum submerged water depth, selecting characteristic variables which influence the submerged water depth and comprise 10 rainfall characteristic variables and 10 space characteristic variables, constructing a Bayesian convolutional neural network prediction model by considering uncertainty, training the model based on a loss function MAE, inputting verification centralized data into the trained model, and solving an average value of output approximate posterior distribution to serve as a predicted value of the water depth. The method is used for calculating and analyzing the relation between the characteristic variable and the target variable, effectively fusing different data, taking possible uncertainty sources into consideration, not only realizing the prediction of the size and the range of the submerged depth of the research area, but also quantifying the prediction uncertainty, and providing support for real-time flood disaster management.

title_en: A kind of nuclear reactor fuel rod fusing visual experimental apparatus and method
abstract_en: A kind of nuclear reactor fuel rod fusing visual experimental apparatus and method, it include the high temperature smelting furnace with several saturating windows, testpieces is vertically arranged in high temperature smelting furnace, the top and bottom of testpieces are respectively arranged with rhenium molybdenum electrode, rhenium molybdenum electrode is by testpieces, rhenium molybdenum electrode is connected with the copper electrode across high-temperature fusion furnace sidewall, testpieces includes fuel rod, it is provided with W-Re heating rod in fuel rod, is provided on the outside of high temperature smelting furnace for carrying out cooling cooling water recirculation system to high temperature smelting furnace.The present invention ensures that furnace body temperature outside is maintained within security restriction by high temperature smelting furnace cooling water recirculation system, and external high-speed camera instrument can work normally, being capable of core melt progression under the conditions of real simulation reactor disaster.The experimental data that the present invention obtains can provide verification for conventional numeric analogy method, reduce the uncertainty of existing Analysis Codes of Severe Accident.

title_en: Power distribution network information physical system rush-repair method based on information gap decision theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power information physical systems and discloses a power distribution network information physical system rush-repair method based on an information gap decision theory. Firstly, establishing a model considering the coupling relation between a power distribution network and an information network by taking the total cost of the information physical system of the power distribution network as a target; then, on the basis of the coupling model of the power distribution network and the information network, a post-disaster coordination recovery model of a post-disaster power distribution network information physical system is established; then, adding an emergency resource model such as network reconstruction of the power distribution network, a mobile emergency power supply, an emergency communication vehicle and the like; and finally, on the basis of an emergency resource model, based on an information gap decision theory, the condition of uncertainty of wind power output is considered, and a multi-source coordination recovery strategy after disaster of the information physical system of the power distribution network is established. The invention can improve the elasticity of the information physical system of the power distribution network after faults and reduce the influence and loss of natural disasters to the power distribution network and users thereof.

title_en: Small-area single-machine grid-shaped search route planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-area single-machine grid-shaped search route planning method. Aiming at a known search area at a certain moment, a single-machine grid-shaped search model is built in a plane based on a kinematic equation and a plane geometry principle, and a complete search route is obtained by planning and obtaining key flight route points of a search helicopter under the condition of comprehensively considering visibility and flight characteristics of the helicopter by using a plane geometry method. The method overcomes the defects of low manual estimation speed and low precision, converts the search application problem into a simple and visual geometric problem, has the characteristics of easy realization of computer programming, high precision, good real-time performance and the like, and can meet the requirements of a ground target search task on precision and effectiveness. The method is particularly suitable for ground target reconnaissance or search and rescue application of the helicopter command system.

title_en: Emergency resource mobilization and transportation scheduling plan generation method based on robust optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating an emergency resource mobilization and transportation scheduling plan based on robust optimization, which comprises the following steps of 1: considering uncertainty factors of disaster area requirements and transportation time, establishing an uncertainty parameter optimization model integrating emergency resource mobilization and transportation scheduling, wherein the uncertainty parameter optimization model comprises a total cost optimization target and constraint conditions; step 2: processing the total cost optimization target and the constraint condition under the uncertainty parameter condition into a robust corresponding total cost optimization target and a robust corresponding constraint condition by adopting a robust optimization method; and step 3: solving a robust corresponding total cost optimization target based on the robust corresponding constraint condition; and 4, step 4: and outputting the emergency resource mobilization and transportation scheduling plan. The method has the advantage that emergency resource mobilization and rescue personnel and severe sick and wounded transportation scheduling plans such as rescue personnel, transportation tools and medical services can be generated quickly and effectively after a major natural disaster occurs.

title_en: Distribution network elasticity improving method and system based on distributed new energy aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network elastic lifting method and system based on distributed new energy aggregation, and aims to improve the effect of a distributed new energy unit on elastic lifting of a distribution system under the large background of energy transformation. Carrying out probability modeling on the output and load data prediction error of the new energy unit based on multivariate normal distribution; obtaining a typical output curve which is continuously updated along with time by utilizing rapid forward scene reduction; building an aggregation model of the energy storage system and the distributed new energy source unit; inputting the aggregation characteristics corresponding to the aggregation model, namely a voltage frequency range and an active and reactive power output range, into the power distribution network layer; setting an optimization target and various constraint conditions for maximizing the recovery of the key load; and the recovery capability of the post-disaster power distribution system is improved. The method solves the problems of uncertainty and volatility of high-proportion new energy in the power distribution network under the large background of energy transformation, improves the key load recovery capability of the post-disaster power distribution system, and lays a foundation for solving the key prominent problem that the elastic power distribution network technology advances to practical industrial application.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on dynamic data monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system based on dynamic data monitoring, comprising the steps of obtaining multi-source geological disaster investigation data of a target area, screening hidden danger positions of geological disasters in the target area, obtaining existing deformation characteristics and geological conditions based on the hidden danger positions, and generating geological disaster hidden danger characteristics; acquiring influence factors of hidden danger positions, determining geological monitoring indexes and acquiring multidimensional monitoring data in real time; and constructing a geological disaster early warning model, dynamically judging the development trend of the geological disaster, carrying out danger analysis and danger avoidance decision making visual expression according to the development trend, and obtaining interactive information between a user and the danger analysis and danger avoidance decision making dynamic correction of the geological disaster early warning model. According to the dynamic expression of the personalized geological disaster characteristics of the hidden danger points, the uncertainty analysis of the geological disaster time is satisfied, the reliability and the accuracy of geological disaster early warning are improved, and a data basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction work of the geological disaster.
assignees: TIANJIN GEOLOGICAL RES AND MARINE GEOLOGICAL CENTER;GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion environment anomaly detection method under communication limited condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, in particular to a multi-sensor fusion environment anomaly detection method under a communication limited condition. The sensor node is used for collecting multidimensional environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, methane, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide concentration and the like in real time, the multisource data are fused through a Dempster-Shafer evidence theory, the conflict and uncertainty of the sensor are solved, and the one-dimensional convolutional neural network 1DCNN classifier is used for identifying fire disaster abnormality based on the fused data. The invention adopts the edge computing technology to deploy the DSET filter and the 1DCNN classifier on the microcontroller. The method not only reduces the dependence on cloud computing, but also improves the real-time performance and the data security of the system. By local processing, the system remains efficient even in the event of network disruption or delay.

title_en: Power transaction data reflow method based on deep learning conflict prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning conflict prediction-based power transaction data reflow method, which relates to the field of power transaction and comprises the following steps of obtaining a data change log of a disaster recovery data center station and analyzing the data change log into a structured change event, carrying out feature extraction on the structured change event to generate a multi-mode feature vector, inputting a pre-trained Bayesian conflict prediction model, outputting conflict probability and uncertainty information of each structured change event, shunting the structured change event to a quick channel or a cautious channel through a rule engine strategy, carrying out differential synchronization processing corresponding to the channel type on the shunted structured change event, and carrying out Bayesian conflict prediction model and rule engine strategy updating by combining a data reflow process monitoring result. The parallelization and self-adaptive optimization of the data reflux are realized through Bayesian conflict prediction and intelligent shunting, and the reflux efficiency and the recovery speed of the main system are improved on the premise of ensuring the data consistency.
assignees: GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD;SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID GROUP GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Method for estimating success rate of multi-machine participation on large-scale search and rescue at sea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the success rate of multi-machine participation on a large scale search and rescue at sea, which comprises the following steps: the first step: acquiring various data; and a second step of: calculating the area A of the regular search and rescue area; and a third step of: calculating the searching capability Z of single movement of each rescue platform  i  And calculating the total searching capacity Z of single movement of each rescue platform  total  Comparison of A and Z  total  If Z  total  More than or equal to A goes to the fourth step, if Z  total  Step five, the step A is carried out; fourth step: setting the coverage factor C of the search area to be a fixed value, and then entering a sixth step; fifth step: calculating a corrected coverage factor C of the search area  co  Then, a sixth step is carried out; sixth step: and referring to the probability-coverage factor corresponding curve of the detection personnel, and estimating the probability of successfully finding the rescue object under the prior condition. The invention aims to provide a method capable of rapidly and accurately estimating the success rate of the existing multiple models to participate in the large-scale search and rescue at sea.

title_en: Geological deformation early warning method and system based on AI vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning and discloses a geological deformation early warning method and system based on AI vision, wherein the geological deformation early warning method based on AI vision comprises the steps of obtaining earth surface micro deformation characteristics by using an AI vision system and constructing a geological map structure network, fusing a nonlinear geomechanical equation to achieve characteristic extraction driven by physical constraints in the map neural network, creating a multidimensional map structure model representing different depth layers, achieving cross-layer information transmission through a physical information guiding type map attention mechanism, deploying the map neural network of a Bayesian probability framework to conduct geological stress field distribution modeling, quantifying prediction uncertainty, and finally generating intelligent early warning decision information with risk grade division.

title_en: Method and system for researching drainage basin water resource risk transfer rule
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for researching a drainage basin water resource risk transfer rule, which mainly aim at the uncertainty problem of drainage basin water resource scheduling and represent the problem of dynamic transfer of a risk source in a drainage basin system and a subsystem. Identifying the risk source elements of the water resources of the basin under study based on a disaster risk system theory and a disaster risk forming mechanism; establishing a watershed water resource risk evaluation model; the method comprises the steps of judging a water resource risk transfer relation by using a basin risk transfer method, identifying a water resource risk transfer path, establishing a basin water resource risk transfer model, drawing a risk transfer path diagram, and researching risk transfer characteristics and transfer rules. The method can evaluate the water resource risk on the time-space scale of the drainage basin, clearly analyze the water resource risk transmission path, direction and strength, analyze the risk transmission rule in a drainage basin system and a subsystem, and provide a new technical scheme for drainage basin water resource risk evaluation, forecast and management.

title_en: Simple typhoon moving direction prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simple typhoon moving direction prediction method, which comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring physical quantity and time sequence thereof on a lattice point isobaric surface; secondly, preprocessing the physical quantity to enable the time intervals to be equidistant and calculating the total time; thirdly, performing multi-scale subspace transformation scale decomposition on the physical quantity; fourthly, calculating the regular transmission of kinetic energy between the typhoon and the environment where the typhoon is located Fifth, intercepting typhoon within 7 degrees of center And performing vertical averaging on the obtained data; sixthly, calculating the typhoon center The orientation of the dipole. The prediction method only uses the existing data to carry out prediction, does not need large-scale numerical prediction, and saves a large amount of calculated amount and precious time on the premise of ensuring the accuracy. The method provides timely opinions for dealing with typhoon disaster early warning decisions, can adjust typhoon disaster protection policies more timely, reduces the panic of the public on the uncertainty of the typhoon disaster, enables the public to transfer property as early as possible, and reduces direct economic loss.

title_en: Electrothermal energy network toughness improving method considering topology scene uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric heating energy network toughness improvement, and particularly discloses an electric heating energy network toughness improvement method considering uncertainty of topological scenes, comprising the following steps of 1, respectively establishing element fault probability models under different polar disasters according to space-time characteristics of different disasters; the method comprises the steps of calculating a line fault model under the action of typhoons, calculating a line fault model under the action of ice disasters, calculating a line fault model under the action of earthquakes, quantifying uncertainty and risk of a topology scene, introducing an uncertainty set of network topology scene distribution, and introducing a conditional risk value theory to describe the uncertainty of the network topology scene. According to the electrothermal energy network toughness improving method considering the uncertainty of the topological scene, CVaR is combined with the distributed robust fuzzy set of the probability of the topological scene, the risk of the uncertainty of the topological scene is quantized, and the network disaster tolerance capacity is improved.

title_en: Rescue system using mobile phone
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for aiding a rescue operation by a mobile phone of a rescuer side without using a communication line.SOLUTION: By adding functions of a rescue signal transmission system and a rescue signal reception system to one mobile phone, a disaster victim can continually transmit a rescue pulse signal as a rescue signal asking for rescue by the rescue signal transmission system as long as the functions of the mobile phone work even in the case a communication line is unable to use at the time of a disaster or the phone is out of a service area. A searcher side, by the rescue signal reception system, locates a place where the rescue pulse signal transmitted by the disaster victim can be received, and narrows down a search area to a place indicating a strong level to be able to aid rescue operation.

title_en: Power distribution network extreme scene modeling method and system based on uncertainty analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network extreme scene modeling method and system based on uncertainty analysis, which relate to the field of power distribution network fault modeling and comprise the following steps: receiving grid frame data, load time sequence data and illumination intensity time sequence data of a power distribution network; obtaining a typical meteorological feature model of an extreme natural disaster by using grid data of a power distribution network; inputting the load time sequence data and the illumination intensity time sequence data into a model to obtain a line fault probability model and an intermittent distributed power generation resource model under the influence of extreme disasters; selecting a typical extreme natural disaster scene through scene reduction; calculating the line fault probability and the intermittent distributed power generation resource fault probability by using a line fault probability model and an intermittent distributed power generation resource model under the influence of extreme disasters; and inputting the line fault probability and the intermittent distributed power generation resource fault probability into a suggested probability distribution function to obtain a plurality of extreme fault scenes, and selecting the extreme fault scene corresponding to the system information entropy with the maximum probability as a typical extreme scene.

title_en: Historical similar runoff classification recommendation method based on characteristic index identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a characteristic index identification-based historical similar runoff classification recommendation method which comprises the steps of historical runoff process restoration, historical scene water rising process extraction, historical runoff characteristic depiction, archive construction, scene runoff process cluster analysis and Siamese network architecture-based historical similar runoff process recommendation. According to the invention, the matching efficiency of the historical similar runoffs is shortened from the small hour level to the minute level, the real-time decision of flood control dispatching is supported, meanwhile, the short-term forecast is replaced by recommending the complete historical runoff process, the uncertainty conduction risk is effectively reduced, high-confidence data support is provided for reservoir group joint dispatching and disaster emergency response, and the initiative and the scientificity of flood control disaster defense are comprehensively improved.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on logic tree method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on a logic tree method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an area to be analyzed for the probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method; respectively determining an earthquake tsunami source and a high-precision terrain file according to the area to be analyzed; constructing a parameter logic tree according to the first parameter set and the second parameter set corresponding to the earthquake tsunami source; calculating according to the high-precision terrain file and using a tsunami numerical model to determine a tsunami maximum wave height file; and determining the wave height exceeding probability at each pixel point of the area to be analyzed according to a logic tree method formed by the parameter logic tree, and a plurality of maximum wave height files which are combined and calculated in a probabilistic manner. The probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on the logic tree method can reduce the uncertainty of analysis and obviously reduce occupied computing resources.
assignees: HAINAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk zoning and prediction method based on GIS-neural network integration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mountain torrent disaster risk zoning and predicting method based on GIS-neural network integration, which comprises the following steps: s1, mining an association relation between risk factors and risk levels in the mountain torrent disasters by using association rules, identifying the risk factors, and constructing a quantitative mountain torrent disaster risk evaluation index system; s2, determining a risk and vulnerability index system and weights thereof by adopting an analytic hierarchy process to generate each element map layer; s3, overlapping the mountain torrent disaster risk and vulnerability distribution map layers by utilizing ArcGIS to obtain a mountain torrent disaster risk distribution map; s4, clustering by adopting an ISO maximum likelihood method, combining bottom-up region combination and top-down qualitative analysis to form a mountain torrent disaster risk division; and S5, analyzing the nonlinear relation between the evaluation indexes and the risk level and between the evaluation indexes and the disaster data by using an Elman neural network, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster risk evaluation and loss estimation model. The method solves the problem of uncertainty of the spatial scale in mountain flood disaster assessment under the changing environment, and can be widely used for mountain flood disaster risk assessment.

title_en: Agent index-based quick evaluation method and system for earthquake-resistant toughness of water supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaluation method and a rapid evaluation system for earthquake-resistant toughness of a water supply pipe network based on an agent index, which belong to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of civil engineering and comprise the following steps of S1, pipe network topology modeling and information determination, S2, earthquake-resistant toughness time dimension division and index definition, S3, preparation index and agent index calculation, S4, robustness index and agent index calculation, S5, recovery index and agent index calculation, S6, adaptability index and agent index calculation, S7, monte Carlo simulation and uncertainty analysis, and S8, establishing a functional relation. The rapid evaluation method and the rapid evaluation system for the earthquake-resistant toughness of the water supply pipe network based on the agent index solve the problem of rapid evaluation of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the urban water supply pipe network and provide an effective approach for analysis and design of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the pipe network.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based automatic field personnel searching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle-based automatic field personnel searching method. The unmanned aerial vehicle receives a flight line flight instruction sent by the handheld terminal equipment and carries out flight on a flight line in a search area; the unmanned aerial vehicle acquires an infrared image of a search area through a camera in the process of flight of the flight, processes the infrared image, and identifies whether a result of a person exists in the image through thermal imaging threshold analysis and trapped person motion analysis; and controlling the flight attitude of the unmanned aerial vehicle to track and snapshot personnel according to the image recognition result, acquiring position information and environment information of the personnel and sending the position information and the environment information to the handheld terminal device and the cloud server. The invention can accurately identify the personnel trapped in the field under the condition of more field shelters, accurately rescues the trapped personnel by full-automatically identifying the personnel and acquiring the surrounding environmental information, thereby not only reducing the cost, but also reducing the manpower resource.

title_en: Power distribution network recovery method and device considering switch uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network recovery method and device considering switch uncertainty, which are based on a three-layer robust post-disaster recovery model proposed by a linearized Distflow model and a traveling merchant model, consider faults of elements and a remote switch in the post-disaster recovery process, consider the rescheduling and network reconstruction technology of a distributed generator, solve the scheduling problem of maintenance personnel under the condition of uncertain fault types, solve the problem of scheduling of the maintenance personnel under the condition of uncertain fault types, and the obtained power distribution network recovery scheme is suitable for all possible fault scenes, so that the maximum load loss possibly suffered by a power distribution network under the condition of incomplete fault information is reduced.

title_en: Regional building earthquake damage prediction method and system aiming at complex terrain geological conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional building earthquake damage prediction method and a regional building earthquake damage prediction system aiming at complex terrain geological conditions, wherein the prediction method is used for acquiring data of a region to be detected and acquiring an earthquake resistance response result of the region to be detected based on the data; correcting the anti-seismic response result to obtain a correction result; the method solves the problem that the prediction result is inaccurate due to the fact that the traditional earthquake prediction system is limited under the geological condition of complex terrain and comprises geological heterogeneity, multiscale, uncertainty of geophysical parameters and the like. In addition, when the post-earthquake damage of the mountain structure is predicted, the soil and the structure influence the earthquake-resistant response of the structure mutually, so that the predicted result is more accurate, the predicted result needs to be corrected, the corrected result avoids the influence of the interaction of the soil and the structure, and the predicted result is more accurate. The method of the invention is helpful for early warning, scientifically planning city construction and improving disaster prevention measures, and provides more effective support for coping with earthquake disasters.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCIAL ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage power station control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage power station control system, relates to the technical field of energy storage control, and is used for solving the defects of the prior art in the aspects of uncertainty coping, special scene adaptation, low-carbon cooperation, heat dissipation efficiency and the like. The intelligent power distribution network power distribution system comprises an uncertainty sensing module, a multi-time-space scale response evaluation module, a cooperative control decision module and an execution regulation module, wherein the uncertainty sensing module collects power grid data under the conditions of distributed energy output, multiple loads and disasters, prediction precision is optimized through a feature extraction and multi-model fusion strategy, the multi-time-space scale response evaluation module divides the day and evaluates energy storage response capacity and generates grid load data, the integrated device comprises a multifunctional mechanism and an intelligent heat dissipation regulation mechanism, the multifunctional mechanism regulates a core module, and the intelligent heat dissipation regulation mechanism dynamically regulates the wind plate angle and the heat dissipation module region to regulate start and stop through a sliding table and worm and gear structure, so that the intelligent power distribution system is suitable for high-efficiency, reliable and low-carbon operation of a power distribution network under high-proportion new energy access.
assignees: ANHUI YINGLE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network topology reconstruction method based on extreme disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network topology reconstruction method based on an extreme disaster scene, which considers the uncertainty of disaster occurrence through a random optimization method, optimizes the power distribution network topology on the basis of accurately predicting the probability distribution of a power grid fault scene, and realizes the optimal topology reconstruction of the power distribution network under the extreme disaster fault. The virtual tide method is adopted to keep the radial operation of the power distribution network, and the power and voltage balance of the power distribution network under the topology reconstruction is considered, so that a power distribution network topology reconstruction model based on extreme disaster scenes is constructed. According to the invention, the current natural environment and the actual situation that severe weather frequently occur are considered, the fault occurrence scene is considered through a random optimization method, the topology of the power distribution network is reconstructed, and the power supply reliability and the safety of the power distribution network under extreme disasters are ensured.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method, a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning device, electronic equipment and a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning medium, and relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster research, wherein the mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method comprises the following steps: simulating a flood process based on a hydrologic model to obtain flood occurrence occasions in a research period, and acquiring soil humidity data and rainfall data corresponding to each flood occurrence occasion; calculating the uncertainty of rainfall input corresponding to each flood occurrence according to the rainfall data corresponding to each flood occurrence; calculating uncertainty of a hydrologic model according to the uncertainty of rainfall input corresponding to each flood occurrence, and calculating uncertainty of early warning critical rainfall according to the uncertainty of rainfall input and the uncertainty of the hydrologic model; calculating the coupling uncertainty under each risk level according to the uncertainty of the early warning critical rainfall; and carrying out early warning on the mountain torrent disaster risk according to the coupling uncertainty under each risk level. The method greatly improves the accuracy of mountain torrent disaster early warning.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for power distribution network containing distributed energy sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution system elasticity assessment method containing distributed energy, which comprises the steps of firstly adopting Gumbel probability distribution to generate disaster scenes; then randomly sampling the element fault state according to the vulnerability equation, and dividing the network state based on a graph searching algorithm; then establishing an island micro-grid optimization problem based on mixed integer programming, taking the minimum total cost of load shedding compensation and distributed energy running cost as an objective function, and taking reactive power and voltage control problems into consideration to carry out linearization treatment on alternating current power flow; and finally, considering time-varying characteristics of the distributed renewable energy output and the load demand, adopting non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation to simulate, recording the load state under each disaster simulation, and calculating to obtain the elasticity evaluation indexes of the node level and the system level. According to the invention, a set of complete elastic evaluation index system is established by considering various uncertainty factors, so that the defending and recovering capabilities of the distribution network system to extreme events are quantified.
assignees: HUANGGANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent analysis method and system for preventing and controlling geological disasters in tunnel construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent analysis method and system for preventing and controlling geological disasters in tunnel construction, and belongs to a data processing system or method for supervision or prediction. Under complex geological conditions, tunnel construction geological disasters are subjected to the coupling action of various disaster sources, the catastrophe evolution mechanism is extremely complex, disaster prevention and control are closely related to geological environments and disaster characteristics where the disasters are located, and prevention and control measures are selected based on artificial experience or existing standard specifications, so that the tunnel construction geological disasters have larger uncertainty and blindness. The analysis method is provided, the existing expert knowledge and a large number of disaster prevention and control cases are fully researched and summarized, a disaster prevention and control knowledge system and a term dictionary are constructed, a correlation map between disaster characteristics and prevention and control countermeasures is established, potential correlation relations between the prevention and control countermeasures and tunnel construction geological disasters are mined through a visual map analysis technology, and timeliness and effectiveness of prevention and control decisions are improved.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network operation strategy determination method, device, medium and product considering intelligent soft switch and distributed resource cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a medium and a product for determining a power distribution network operation strategy by considering intelligent soft switch and distributed resource cooperation, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network operation scheduling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the historical photovoltaic output data into a photovoltaic output prediction model to obtain predicted photovoltaic output data of the day before the disaster occurs; constructing a photovoltaic output uncertainty set based on the predicted photovoltaic output data; inputting the uncertain set of the photovoltaic output and the unit pre-configuration cost into a pre-disaster pre-configuration model to obtain initial power distribution network data; the unit load reduction cost, the initial power distribution network data and the power distribution network constraint quantity of each node in the power distribution network are input into a post-disaster operation strategy determination model, and operation strategy data of each date from the occurrence of the current disaster to the completion of the rush repair are obtained; and regulating and controlling the power distribution network based on the operation strategy data of each date. The invention improves the toughness and economy of the power distribution network and effectively enhances the power supply recovery capability of key loads.

title_en: Flood control regulation and control method and device with three-dimensional cooperation of double reservoirs and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction, in particular to a method, a device and related equipment for controlling flood control by three-dimensional cooperation of double reservoirs, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining target total water quantity; splitting the target total water quantity to obtain underground water quantity and overground water quantity, wherein the underground water quantity is the total water quantity to be stored in a first water storage area in the target period, the overground water quantity is the total water quantity to be stored in a second water storage area in the target period, the first water storage area is composed of a plurality of underground water storage areas in the target flow area, the second water storage area is composed of a plurality of overground water storage areas in the target flow area, and the first water storage area and the second water storage area are regulated and controlled according to the underground water quantity and the overground water quantity. According to the invention, the adaptation and the robustness of flood control to future uncertainty risks can be enhanced by incorporating the underground water storage area into the flood control system, and the protection effect of the flood control system under the condition of extreme rainfall is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Road disaster accurate positioning inspection method for unmanned aerial vehicle AI autonomous cruising
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road disaster accurate positioning and routing inspection method for unmanned aerial vehicle AI autonomous cruise, which belongs to the technical field of space-time image processing and comprises the steps of obtaining dynamic environment parameters and prediction index parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying out fusion processing and prediction extraction, generating fusion prediction vectors, adjusting frame rate and regional focusing parameters of image acquisition, obtaining predicted road image data, carrying out predictive preprocessing, generating an optimized prediction image, carrying out space-time fusion feature extraction, generating space-time fusion feature vectors, carrying out prediction disaster identification by utilizing the space-time fusion feature vectors, generating an enhanced disaster probability map, carrying out prediction fusion positioning processing, generating prediction accurate positioning coordinates, updating a cruise path of the unmanned aerial vehicle by combining historical routing inspection data, and generating an optimized prediction cruise path. By combining image acquisition, space-time feature recognition and dynamic cruising path updating driven by fusion prediction, the road disaster can be efficiently, accurately and intelligently subjected to closed loop inspection.
assignees: UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH;NANJING XINDA SAFETY EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Power grid transmission line assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid transmission line assessment method, which is characterized in that a three-layer optimization model is established to identify a key transmission line in a system on the basis of considering the resource of an attacker, an optimal attack decision and rescheduling of a system operator so as to enhance the capability of the transmission line for resisting potential malicious physical attack and natural disasters; meanwhile, the uncertainty of attack characteristics of an attacker is considered, and a distributed robust optimization model for identifying a key power transmission line with unknown malicious physical attack scene is provided; in order to quantify the importance of the key power transmission lines on the system against malicious physical attacks, improve the system elasticity, and realize the power transmission line importance level ranking, a power transmission line importance level assessment index under the condition of the malicious physical attacks is provided, and the power transmission line importance level of each key power transmission line in the power grid is determined according to the importance level assessment index, so that the power transmission line importance level assessment of the power grid for the malicious physical attacks is realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method based on space-time multi-feature uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method based on space-time multi-feature uncertainty, which is characterized by collecting historical mountain torrent data of a research area, extracting and analyzing mountain torrent vulnerability factor data of the research area to form at least 5-level risk areas, rasterizing the research area and classifying the risk areas into levels of each grid; respectively constructing mountain torrent disaster risk assessment models of all levels of risk areas; fitting the distribution of each torrent disaster risk factor as prior distribution based on historical torrent data, sampling by adopting a DREAM algorithm, respectively inputting a torrent disaster risk assessment model of each grade risk area to obtain posterior distribution of each torrent disaster risk index, and obtaining the probability of risk occurrence of each grade risk area by adopting Bayesian inference; setting a risk scenario set, analyzing the mountain torrent disaster risks of each grid in the research area through a mountain torrent disaster risk assessment model, and calculating the risk contribution rate of each mountain torrent disaster risk factor; the scientificity of mountain torrent disaster risk early warning is improved.

title_en: Rainfall monitoring data driven intelligent early warning method for small-river-basin geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a rainfall monitoring data-driven intelligent early warning method for small-river-basin geological disasters, which comprises the steps of acquiring historical rainfall data of a target small river basin and preprocessing geological disaster historical record data; matching the geological disaster event to a corresponding rainfall event to obtain a rainfall event set with geological disaster, wherein the rainfall event set is used as a positive sample, and the rainfall event set without geological disaster is used as a negative sample; the positive sample and the negative sample are used for constructing a data set for learning, training and testing a machine learning model; constructing an intelligent early warning machine learning model array of the small watershed geological disaster, and training, verifying and testing by using a data set; and constructing a target small-basin geological disaster occurrence probability calculation model and an uncertainty analysis model under the influence of a rainfall event, calculating the target small-basin geological disaster occurrence probability and uncertainty under the rainfall event, and carrying out early warning. The method improves the reliability and accuracy of the geological disaster early warning result of the small river basin.
assignees: CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES;UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING HUADI ZIHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improving method for active and reactive power collaborative optimization under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving toughness of a power distribution network through active and reactive power collaborative optimization under extreme disasters, and relates to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling. The method comprises the steps of firstly predicting renewable energy power generation and load requirements in a next time window in a first stage, optimizing control strategies of a remote control switch, a capacitor bank and energy storage charging/discharging in a long time scale, then optimizing output of a distributed resource and a static reactive compensator in a short time scale according to latest accurate prediction information and a first stage decision in a second stage so as to compensate deviation caused by uncertainty in the first stage decision, and finally, continuously rolling forward in the prediction time window along with the passage of time, and cooperatively optimizing active and reactive equipment through cooperation of the two stages to ensure that the decision is always based on the latest prediction information. The invention provides a two-stage active power distribution network scheduling strategy considering the difference of the response capacities of the equipment, and improves the recovery capacity and toughness of a power distribution system.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster comprehensive risk dynamic assessment method based on multi-dimensional set information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive risk dynamic evaluation method based on multi-dimensional set information mountain torrent disasters, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, mountain torrent risk assessment based on corrected disaster rainfall; step 2, mountain torrent risk assessment based on water level-flow; step 3, mountain torrent risk assessment based on submergence range, flow velocity and water depth; step 4, determining the risk level of the torrential flood; step 5, dynamically evaluating the risk of torrential flood; and 6, carrying out uncertainty analysis on the mountain torrent risk assessment result. The invention provides a comprehensive risk dynamic assessment method for mountain torrent disasters based on multi-dimensional set information, which is suitable for the mountain torrent risk refined assessment of data-free areas, is more scientific and reliable in assessment index, and provides a more effective decision basis for mountain torrent disaster defense by performing dynamic assessment on the mountain torrent risk based on real-time monitoring data or simulated forecast data of a model.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Spacecraft wreckage search and rescue identification tracking method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spacecraft debris search and rescue identification tracking method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: determining a theoretical drop point of the spacecraft debris falling, planning a search area, and controlling the aircraft to move to the search area; controlling the aircraft to move towards the actual landing point direction of the spacecraft debris, and shooting images in real time in the moving process; carrying out real-time identification and detection on the acquired image by using a multi-scale image neural network model, and determining whether spacecraft debris exists in the image; if yes, adjusting the driving direction of the aircraft in real time according to the position of the detected target in the image, and controlling the aircraft to move above the detected target; and determining whether the confidence of the current detection result is greater than a preset threshold, if so, determining whether the detection target is the debris of the spacecraft, and if not, or not, leveling the camera of the aircraft and continuously controlling the aircraft to move. The method can realize the rapid search of the remains of the spacecraft, effectively reduce the search range and improve the search efficiency.
assignees: NATIONAL DEFENSE SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION INSTITUTE ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES PLA CHINA

title_en: Natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method based on a Bayesian network, which is characterized in that an emergency model is used for carrying out basic modeling on a natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission change process, on the basis, the basic model is analyzed by utilizing the advantages of the Bayesian network in uncertainty event analysis, key elements and incidence relations among the key elements are extracted from the basic model to form a node table and an adjacent matrix, the Bayesian network is constructed on the basis of the node table and the adjacent matrix to carry out reasoning calculation, and the carbon emission change analysis of a power system under the action of multiple natural disasters is realized. The method provides support for subsequent disaster-resistant optimization, energy structure optimization, emission reduction and carbon fixation measures and the like of the power system, and can be transferred and applied to other complicated carbon emission process analysis.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;NARI GROUP CORP;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: A system for locating and tracking floating objects, and methods thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a system for locating and tracking floating objects and methods thereof. In particular, the present disclosure relates to a method and system for locating and tracking objects floating submerged or non-submerged on or near the surface of marine environment. The system and method of the present invention provide for receiving data on the object's physical characteristics, mapping the search area in the water body, acquiring meteorological data for the search area, simulating and predicting the object's movement based on input data, creating a map of predicted locations with probabilities of containing the object, displaying the predictions on a graphical user interface, tracking the object based on the map and communicating the object's location to a rescue team.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and device and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along a set route in the target search area; receiving position updating information sent by a terminal, wherein the position updating information comprises a terminal identifier; judging whether the terminal identification is the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued which is stored in advance; and if the terminal identification is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, acquiring the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to fly along the set route in the target search area, and when the terminal identifier sent by the terminal is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued is obtained, so that search and rescue personnel can search and rescue according to the position information, and thus the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle multitasking point path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle multi-task point path planning method which specifically comprises the following steps of starting the method, establishing an air-ground system channel model and an uncertainty model of an eavesdropper position, establishing CUAV task total completion time and communication interruption time weighted sum minimization model based on the air-ground system channel model and the uncertainty model of the eavesdropper position, discretizing CUAV task total completion time and communication interruption time weighted sum minimization model optimization problems, modeling a Markov decision process for the discretized optimization problems, and solving HT-D3QN algorithm. The path planning method combining the HRL and the T-D3QN can effectively improve the task execution efficiency and the communication safety of CUAV in a complex dynamic environment, and provides reliable technical support for application of CUAV in the fields of smart cities, emergency rescue and the like.

title_en: Post-earthquake building ruin distribution range probability prediction model and urban road network blocking vulnerability estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of post-earthquake building falling object accumulation range probability prediction models and urban road network blocking vulnerability estimation, and discloses post-earthquake building ruin distribution range probability prediction models and urban road network blocking vulnerability estimation methods. The building weight accumulation range prediction model provided by the invention considers various damage states of the building under the action of earthquake, including complete collapse of the building and damage of non-structural members, and can obtain posterior probability distribution of unknown parameters of the prediction model based on the Bayesian theory, thereby quantifying the cognitive uncertainty from the model parameters in the evaluation of the vulnerability of road blockage after earthquake. The method is not only beneficial to improving the accuracy of road blocking risk assessment after earthquake, but also beneficial to reasonably planning the rescue evacuation path after disaster.

title_en: Distribution network disaster prevention material allocation method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a distribution network disaster prevention material allocation method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium, which take account of the uncertainty of disaster conditions and utilize the result of Bayesian network disaster condition inference, namely node outage probability of each node, and then fuse the node outage probability on the basis of the distribution network importance degree information such as weight coefficient and load quantity of the nodes, and the elastic risk index of the whole distribution network is taken as a judging objective function to obtain node material allocation quantity of each node when the elastic risk index meets the optimization requirement, thereby realizing the optimization of distribution network overall material allocation and solving the technical problems of unreasonable disaster prevention material allocation and high resource waste degree of the conventional distribution network disaster prevention material allocation mode.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster optimal path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle flight planning, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster optimal path planning method and system. The two models are innovatively trained by adopting a double machine learning algorithm, so that not only are the accuracy of model prediction and decision making improved, but also the path planning result is effectively corrected and optimized by constructing a residual fitting model, and the planning robustness is enhanced. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster optimal path planning method, the dynamic flight state, the environmental uncertainty and the task target diversity of the unmanned aerial vehicle are comprehensively considered, and the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster optimal path planning instruction meeting the actual flight condition can be generated in real time. The method improves the task execution efficiency and the safety of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, is suitable for a plurality of fields such as military reconnaissance, disaster relief, logistics distribution and the like, and has wide application prospect and important practical value.

title_en: Landslide movement distance transcendental probability calculation method
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide motion distance transcendence probability calculation method which comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic numerical model related to a landslide object, taking input parameters of the selected dynamic numerical model as random variables, determining statistical characteristics of the random variables, conducting hierarchical sampling on the random variables by utilizing a Latin hypercube sampling L HS method, generating a plurality of groups of random samples, inputting the random samples into the dynamic numerical model according to the statistical characteristics, calculating landslide motion distances corresponding to each group of random samples, determining a landslide motion distance threshold value according to actual distances between a disaster bearing body and the landslide object, calculating the probability that the landslide motion distances exceed the landslide motion distance threshold value, and effectively quantifying the uncertainty of the input parameters to improve the reliability of a landslide slide prediction result.

title_en: Goaf collapse disaster risk zoning and grading assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a sectional grading evaluation method for collapse disaster risks in a goaf, which comprises the steps of determining instability probability of each ore pillar in the goaf, assuming instability of any ore pillar, and judging the instability of other ore pillars caused by the instability of the ore pillar by adopting a repeated iteration instability method until the instability is terminated; then determining the number of induced ore pillars in the rest ore pillar groups, and calculating the disaster consequence value of the ore pillars; obtaining disaster consequence values of all ore pillars according to the mode, and calculating instability risk weight values of all ore pillars; and finally, determining the risk levels of all ore pillars in the goaf to obtain a goaf collapse disaster risk zoning classification cloud picture. The method is based on the stability theory of the ore pillar group, considers the uncertainty of the strength of the ore pillar, quantifies the potential of collapse of the goaf, particularly the potential of single ore pillar instability induced goaf linkage collapse by introducing the induced ore pillar, realizes the risk zoning grading evaluation of the goaf linkage collapse disaster, and can be used for guiding related personnel to perform differentiated treatment on different risk grade areas.

title_en: Basin risk assessment method and system based on geographic space and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment and discloses a river basin risk assessment method and system based on a geographic space and a Bayesian network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a digital elevation model diagram of a target river basin, multi-disaster investigation record and simulation research results, and extracting key points; establishing a disaster chain path according to the key points to complete Bayesian network modeling, carrying out node probability modeling and initializing parameters, establishing a disaster chain probability propagation mechanism to describe the sequential transmission process of disasters among nodes, establishing a high-dimensional joint distribution model to carry out forward reasoning propagation of a plurality of Bayesian networks, carrying out uncertainty compression of a disaster reasoning chain, carrying out probability propagation and reasoning, and calculating disaster probability of population loss and economic loss. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, the overall synergy of disaster chain reasoning and the delicacy of risk expression under a complex system can be improved, and the risk assessment capability of the model under the complex chain disaster system is improved.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Beacon detection system for locating missing persons
abstract_en: A beacon detection system which can locate a missing search subject includes: a beacon signal receiver; a location position detector; and a beacon detector. The detector is configured to detect a location of a broadcasting beacon signal associated with a personal device of a search subject within search data covering a geographic search area derived from a search for the search subject, the search data gathered by the beacon signal receiver and location position detector. A computer implemented method of determining a location of a search subject is also provided. The method determines at least a possible connection request from Wi-Fi signals in search data gathered by a Wi-Fi radio covering a geographic search area for a search subject and associated location information to locate the search subject.

title_en: Artificial intelligence based mountain accident risk area prediction system
title_ko: Ai 기반 산악사고 위험지역 예측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is configured so that the ai model predicts a mountain accident risk area by using mountain terrain spatial information and structural activity data. Accordingly, areas with a high risk of accidents are derived in advance. Moreover, the search priority is automatically generated and speed and effectiveness of the rescue activity are improved. In the ai-based mountain accident risk area prediction system 100, the data collection and purification processing unit 110 preprocesses mountain terrain precision space information and fire rescue activity information. Accident risk area prediction the ai model unit 120 generates cell-based learning data, learns the ai model, and predicts a dangerous area. The priority area is created among the accident risk area in which the search priority area recommending part(130) is anticipated based on the risk index and it recommends.
abstract_ko:

또한, 본 발명의 AI 기반 산악사고 위험지역 예측 시스템에 따르면, 산악지형의 정밀공간정보와 소방청 구조 활동 정보를 활용하여 인공지능(AI) 기반으로 산악 사고 위험 지역을 예측할 수 있도록 함으로써, 산악 사고 위험 지역에서의 인명사고를 최소화할 수 있도록 지원하며, 특히, 실족, 낙석, 낭떠러지, 급경사, 계곡 등과 같이 등산객이 산행 중 노출될 수 있는 위험도를 예측하여 사고 예방 및 실종자 수색 지역을 추천하여 신속한 요구조자 수색 및 구조 활동을 지원할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault recovery method, a system, equipment and a medium, comprising the following steps: and (3) establishing a two-stage robust optimization model for power distribution network fault recovery by considering uncertainty of wind power and photovoltaic output, and adopting a C & CG algorithm to iteratively solve a power distribution network reconstruction and load switching scheme. Firstly, in the first stage, according to the wind-light output predicted value, the operation variables such as the opening and closing state, the load recovery state and the like of a line are decided, and in the second stage, a wind-light output uncertainty set is constructed, the operation power of each distributed power supply is optimized, and the minimum economic loss cost and the load recovery plan under the worst scene are obtained. And (3) rapidly solving a two-stage model by using a C & CG algorithm, and alternately solving the main and sub problems until the model converges, so as to obtain an original problem optimal solution and determine a load recovery scheme. The method fully mobilizes the resources in the power distribution network, furthest recovers the power supply of the key load of the power distribution network, reduces the power failure economic loss caused by extreme weather disasters, and improves the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network two-stage toughness improvement strategy based on phase-shifting transformer
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-stage toughness improvement strategy of a power distribution network based on a phase-shifting transformer, and belongs to the technical field of power grid planning. In the pre-disaster stage, a two-stage robust planning model which considers a phase-shifting transformer and an energy storage pre-layout is provided in consideration of uncertainty of line faults, linear relaxation is carried out on power flow of a power system by utilizing a Big-M method, and then a pre-layout scheme of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage is solved by a nested column and constraint generation algorithm; in the post-disaster stage, a second-order cone planning model of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage collaborative optimization is established so as to realize the rapid power supply of the post-disaster load; finally, the validity of the proposed model is verified by testing through an IEEE33 node system. Simulation results show that the cooperative configuration of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage can effectively ensure the power supply of the load and improve the toughness of the system.

title_en: Forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method oriented to forestry vertical field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method facing the forestry vertical field, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing and comprises the steps of constructing a space-time spectrum data set of forestry resources, wherein the data set comprises spectrograms, geographic information, climate data and real fire probability maps of different time steps in a monitoring area, constructing an ST-SegNet network, comprising a SegNet encoder, a SegNet decoder, a ConvLSTM model, a feature fusion layer and a merging layer, constructing the total loss of the ST-SegNet network, and training the ST-SegNet network to obtain the forestry resource space-time spectrum large model. The invention improves the space-time consistency and classification precision of remote sensing image data, ensures higher-quality data processing, enhances the adaptability to complex scenes through space-time spectrum data fusion, improves the detail processing capability, provides a new technical path for environment monitoring and disaster response, and remarkably improves the efficiency of an emergency early warning system.

title_en: Nerve radiation field DSM generation method constrained by two-dimensional triangular network
abstract_en: The invention provides a nerve radiation field DSM generation method based on two-dimensional triangular mesh constraint, which comprises the following steps of step 1, implicit body density and radiation field modeling, step 2, extracting density field gradient and surface normal, step 3, constructing a two-dimensional triangular mesh, step 4, realizing normal consistency constraint based on the two-dimensional triangular mesh, step 5, calculating uncertainty perception rendering loss, and step 6, performing end-to-end joint optimization. The method of the invention optimizes geometric constraint and rendering loss through end-to-end combination, reduces root mean square error of three-dimensional reconstruction compared with the traditional NeRF method, and provides a high-precision DSM generation scheme for remote sensing applications such as city planning, disaster monitoring and the like.

title_en: Method and system for identifying and filtering suspicious monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying and filtering suspicious monitoring data, which are applied to a software system in a central application server of a disaster prevention system, change the uncertainty of monitoring foreign matters through a sensor in the traditional mode, and find a hyperplane for dividing the boundary between a credible data space and a suspicious data space by carrying out meteorological data related statistical analysis on the weather and snow historical data of the disaster prevention system. Then comparing the newly received on-site real-time monitoring data, and if the newly received on-site real-time monitoring data falls into a suspicious data space, defining the newly received on-site real-time monitoring data as singular points, thereby realizing the identification and filtration of suspicious wind, rain and snow monitoring data; meanwhile, the invention can also effectively identify suspicious error data which does not exceed the measuring range, does not generate messy codes or negative values and meets the resolution condition, greatly reduces the false alarm and the missing report of the system, and timely reminds the maintenance department of the on-line maintenance, thereby ensuring the stability and the reliability of the system.
assignees: BEIJING NAT RAILWAY RES & DESIGN INST SIGNAL & COMMUNICATION LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent formation disaster-causing mechanism analysis method based on pregnant disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent formation disaster-causing mechanism analysis method based on a disaster-causing environment, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a historical mountain torrent disaster attribute set and an environmental factor set of a research area, 2, determining a mountain torrent disaster-causing environment type partition and characteristics thereof, 3, determining explanation degree and uncertainty interval of each partition environment type and environmental factors on mountain torrent disaster attribute change, 4, determining dominant environmental factors of each disaster-causing environment type partition, and 5, analyzing influence of the dominant environmental factor change on a mountain torrent formation process and a disaster-causing process. The method fully considers the space-time heterogeneity of meteorological factors, geography and socioeconomic factors of a disaster-stricken river basin, separates and quantifies the contribution and uncertainty of different environmental factors such as meteorological factors, geography and socioeconomic factors to the formation of the torrential flood, can improve the comprehensive control level of the torrential flood disaster, has strong applicability, and provides scientific basis for the control and management of the torrential flood disaster.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Regional power grid evaluation model based on firefly algorithm and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power supply or distribution technology, in particular to a regional power grid assessment model and an optimization method based on a firefly algorithm, which are used for carrying out uncertainty risk calculation based on a risk theory and an N-1 fault, and quantifying the importance of a circuit return operation result representation branch; evaluating the network characteristics of the nodes based on the Floyd algorithm, comprehensively representing the node importance by combining the branch importance, and considering the electrical characteristics and the network characteristics by the element evaluation system; taking the sum of economic construction cost and network operation risk as an objective function, and constructing a core backbone network frame search model by combining actual operation constraint; and solving by adopting an improved binary firefly algorithm to obtain a final nuclear backbone net rack construction scheme. The method provides a new method and a new thought for constructing the core backbone network frame, optimizes the search result of the network frame, and improves the disaster recovery and fighting capacity of the system so as to establish a safer and more economical power system. The method has a certain reference value for the optimization planning development of the current regional power grid.

title_en: Two-stage robust optimization control method and device for toughness-oriented lifting active power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage robust optimization control method and device for a toughness-oriented lifting active power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: adopting robust optimization to process wind/light/load uncertainty, and constructing a two-stage robust optimization scheduling model; when the power supply of the upper power grid is interrupted due to the extreme disasters, the output quantity of the distributed power supply is adjusted to meet the load demand. The device comprises: a processor and a memory. And the toughness of the active power distribution network is improved. The invention realizes the improvement of the toughness of the system and reduces the reduction of the load of the system. The model provided by the invention integrates the toughness of other forms of energy and energy systems for demand response management, considers the uncertainty before and after disasters, can ensure uninterrupted power supply of key loads after system faults, improves the toughness of a power distribution network, and can obtain an operation scheme with minimum total operation cost of the system in a worst scene, namely an operation scene with maximum uncertainty. The invention enables a power distribution network decision maker to select the most reasonable control operation scheme by adjusting uncertainty.
