assignees: STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV NORTHEAST DIANLI;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disaster based on two-stage planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disasters based on two-stage planning, comprising the following steps: modeling wind speed uncertainty, line uncertainty and load uncertainty by using the acquired power distribution network information, meteorological information and geographic information to obtain a distribution function about typhoon wind speed and power distribution line damage probability of the power distribution network, and generating load scenes by Monte Carlo simulation to obtain reactive load and active load in each scene; on the basis of a distribution function, a distribution line damage probability, reactive loads and active power in each scene, constructing a two-stage random planning elastic lifting model for the distribution network; and solving the model under the first-stage constraint condition and the second-stage constraint condition to obtain an optimization decision result, and optimizing the power distribution network through the optimization decision result. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of the decision aiming at the power distribution network is improved, and the elastic coping capacity of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Dangerous rock early warning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a dangerous rock early warning method, a system, equipment and a medium, which are characterized in that local characteristics of ground particle cloud data are extracted, global characteristics are generated by aggregating the local characteristics, dangerous rock characteristics are obtained according to the global characteristics, a dangerous rock three-dimensional model is constructed according to the dangerous rock characteristics, stability and change trend prediction are carried out according to the dangerous rock three-dimensional model, dangerous rock early warning information is obtained, the change trend can be accurately predicted by utilizing the dangerous rock three-dimensional model, the accuracy of dangerous rock early warning is improved, the uncertainty analysis of dangerous rock disaster time is met according to the dynamic expression of dangerous rock hidden danger personalized characteristics, the reliability and accuracy of dangerous rock disaster early warning are improved, and a data basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction work of geological disasters.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Toughness index evaluation method and system for electric comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness index evaluation method of an electric comprehensive energy system, which comprises the steps of firstly, taking account of disaster uncertainty caused by extreme disasters to establish a typical fault scene set of the electric comprehensive energy system, secondly, taking account of dynamic and static characteristics and coupling constraints of an electric and gas heterogeneous energy flow system to establish a numerical simulation model of the electric comprehensive energy system under fault conditions, simulating cascade faults and energy supply recovery processes of the system under the typical fault scene set, and finally, drawing a multi-stage toughness curve of the system based on simulation results to establish a multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation index system of electric-gas dependency under a toughness view. The invention also discloses a toughness index evaluation system of the electric comprehensive energy system, which can realize full-dimensional quantitative analysis of the multi-energy dependence relationship under the fault working condition and effectively screen out weak links caused by multi-energy flow strong coupling.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Ship searching method, device, equipment and storage medium applied to river channel
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship searching method, a device, equipment and a storage medium applied to a river channel, wherein the method comprises the steps of cutting a searching area of the current river channel according to the length of a short side and the length of a 1:1 length-width ratio after confirming that the length-width ratio of the searching area on the current river channel is larger than a preset value to obtain a plurality of subareas; establishing respective quadtree models on a plurality of subareas in parallel, establishing respective neighbor tables for the established quadtree models in parallel, establishing the relation among the neighbor tables according to the spatial position relation among different quadtree models, determining leaf nodes in quadtrees to which specified places belong in a search area of a river channel, determining an effective search range, and finding K ships closest to the specified places through distance sorting. The invention can optimize the search and rescue path of the ship, and can reduce the time complexity and improve the inquiry efficiency on the premise of effectively reducing the cost of searching and rescuing the ship, thereby improving the success rate of searching and rescuing.

title_en: Hydrological model parameter uncertainty analysis method based on Morris and Sobol methods
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster research, and discloses a hydrological model parameter uncertainty analysis method based on Morris and Sobol methods, which comprises the steps of: collecting measured rainfall runoff data and geographic data of a research river basin; based on the collected data. According to the invention, an HEC-HMS hydrological model is constructed according to measured rainfall runoff data, soil types, land utilization and other remote sensing image data, and a proper yield and confluence scheme is selected to perform runoff simulation of a small river basin; the Morris method and the Sobol method are combined to qualitatively and quantitatively analyze the sensitivity of the model parameters, so that the relation between the parameter fluctuation and the model output variable is obtained, and the sensitivity parameters are identified; and constructing a parameter optimization regression model based on a random forest algorithm, analyzing HEC-HMS model results output by different parameter combinations, taking a Nash coefficient as an objective function, outputting a parameter optimal combination, and then substituting the parameter optimal combination into the HEC-HMS model for calibration and verification.

title_en: Near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data dual driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data double driving, which comprises the steps of obtaining multisource meteorological data, and adopting a multi-model self-adaptive integrated forecasting method to process the multisource meteorological data so as to obtain high-precision meteorological forecasting data; based on high-precision weather forecast data, a multidimensional feature typhoon path extraction and probability forecast method is adopted for processing, so that probability typhoon path forecast data are obtained; based on the probability typhoon path forecast data, adopting a physical constraint variation assimilation wind field correction method to process so as to obtain corrected wind field data; based on the corrected wind field data, processing by using a multi-grid wind-wave-stream coupling model solving method to obtain near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecast data; and calculating to obtain a final forecasting result by adopting an integrated learning offshore disaster forecasting and uncertainty quantifying method. The invention realizes the rapid and accurate prediction of the wind, wave, tide and flow of the important offshore areas during typhoons.

title_en: Regional possible maximum rainfall determining method for mountain flood ditch drainage basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the regional possible maximum rainfall for mountain and flood ditches, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting hydrological data and scene rainfall flood data of a research area; step 2, determining the spatial distribution of maximum rainfall in different duration of the scene rainfall; step 3, determining a storm similar area; step 4, determining the possible maximum rainfall in the storm similar area; and 5, determining the possible maximum rainfall time course distribution of the storm similar area. The method fully utilizes the existing data such as hydrological weather in various places, increases the short-duration rainfall sample capacity, ensures the consistency of analysis results of the upstream and downstream of the watershed, and avoids uncertainty caused by subjective selection of typical heavy storm; and fully consider the influence of the regional complex topography change of hilly area to regional rainfall continuous space distribution, the suitability is strong, and the degree of accuracy is high, can supply mountain torrent disaster defense department to select to support work such as mountain torrent disaster defense risk decision-making and planning under the extreme storm scene.

title_en: Wide area landslide rapid identification method based on interpretable intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-area landslide rapid identification method based on an interpretable intelligent algorithm, which relates to the field of remote sensing science and technology, and is characterized in that a dual-channel feature extraction architecture is constructed through multisource spatial-temporal data fusion and dynamic weighting of a knowledge map, wherein a light CNN captures local textures of images, a graph-convolution network models the geological space relevance, an interpretable contribution thermodynamic diagram and a rule chain are generated by combining SHAP values and causal reasoning, a knowledge map bidirectional verification system is introduced, a priori rule is utilized to verify space logic contradiction, a model and a rule library are triggered to co-evolve based on misjudgment samples, a multidimensional reliability report is output, the analysis granularity is customized and interpreted according to roles by Monte Carlo Dropout quantization uncertainty, and a terrain self-adaptive block-flow processing architecture is adopted, and edge light deployment and federal learning are combined to realize wide-area real-time early warning and dynamic updating of the model. The scheme breaks through the limitation of the traditional black box model, and forms a disaster prevention closed loop of physical driving, transparent decision and second-level response.

title_en: Beacon detection system for locating missing persons
abstract_en: A beacon detection system which can locate a missing search subject includes: a beacon signal receiver; a location position detector; and a beacon detector. The detector is configured to detect a location of a broadcasting beacon signal associated with a personal device of a search subject within search data covering a geographic search area derived from a search for the search subject, the search data gathered by the beacon signal receiver and location position detector. A computer implemented method of determining a location of a search subject is also provided. The method determines at least a possible connection request from Wi-Fi signals in search data gathered by a Wi-Fi radio covering a geographic search area for a search subject and associated location information to locate the search subject.

title_en: Source network load collaborative elastic lifting method and system considering multi-fault uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to a source network load collaborative elastic lifting method and a system considering multi-fault uncertainty, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power transmission network information and constructing a multi-type fault probability distribution uncertainty set under typhoon disasters; based on a distribution robust optimization idea, constructing a source network load collaborative elastic lifting model considering the multi-type fault probability distribution uncertainty set; based on the Benders decomposition and column and constraint generation ideas, solving the source network load collaborative elastic lifting model by adopting an original-dual parallel decomposition algorithm to obtain a source network load collaborative planning strategy. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of reducing line investment and power failure loss of the most serious fault scene under typhoon disasters to different degrees, further coordinating the economical efficiency of the power system and the elastic lifting target and the like.

title_en: Multimode integrated precipitation forecasting method and system based on generalized triangular cap theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode integrated rainfall forecasting method and system based on a generalized triangular cap theory, which relates to the technical field of weather forecast, the method eliminates systematic deviation by acquiring multisource numerical mode data in real time, and preprocessing through spatial standardization and real-time frequency matching, and dynamically analyzing a covariance matrix of a difference sequence between modes by using a generalized triangular cap theory to quantify uncertainty, dynamically distributing weight coefficients based on the uncertainty, and finally weighting and integrating to output a standardized rainfall forecast product. The method can realize that TS score is improved by 49% -124% compared with an international advanced mode (such as ECMWF) in the rainstorm and heavy rainstorm forecast without depending on historical or live observation data, and the method shows high precision and strong adaptability in turning weather scenes such as a scarce area of a meteorological site, typhoons and fronts, and the integrated result is directly connected with a national meteorological center service platform to support real-time disaster early warning decision.
assignees: NAT METEOROLOGICAL CENTER CENTRAL METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION MET

title_en: Wide area landslide rapid identification method based on interpretable intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-area landslide rapid identification method based on an interpretable intelligent algorithm, which relates to the field of remote sensing science and technology, and is characterized in that a dual-channel feature extraction architecture is constructed through multisource spatial-temporal data fusion and dynamic weighting of a knowledge map, wherein a light CNN captures local textures of images, a graph-convolution network models the geological space relevance, an interpretable contribution thermodynamic diagram and a rule chain are generated by combining SHAP values and causal reasoning, a knowledge map bidirectional verification system is introduced, a priori rule is utilized to verify space logic contradiction, a model and a rule library are triggered to co-evolve based on misjudgment samples, a multidimensional reliability report is output, the analysis granularity is customized and interpreted according to roles by Monte Carlo Dropout quantization uncertainty, and a terrain self-adaptive block-flow processing architecture is adopted, and edge light deployment and federal learning are combined to realize wide-area real-time early warning and dynamic updating of the model. The scheme breaks through the limitation of the traditional black box model, and forms a disaster prevention closed loop of physical driving, transparent decision and second-level response.

title_en: Landslide edge recognition method and system integrating CNN and ViT
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide edge recognition method and system fusing CNN and ViT, which belong to the field of landslide edge recognition and comprise the steps of obtaining a remote sensing image and a corresponding digital elevation model image of a landslide area, inputting the remote sensing image into the CNN, extracting a first characteristic map, inputting the digital elevation model image into ViT, extracting a second characteristic map, constructing an edge response map based on the first characteristic map, calculating a fuzzy perception map, constructing a structure expected map based on the second characteristic map, fusing the fuzzy perception map and the structure expected map pixel by pixel to form an occlusion risk thermodynamic map, fusing the occlusion risk thermodynamic map through a cross attention mechanism to generate boundary compensation characteristics, forming a fused characteristic map by the boundary compensation characteristics and the non-occlusion area characteristic map, and inputting the fused characteristic map into a decoder to generate the landslide edge probability map. The method and the device remarkably improve the accuracy of landslide boundary identification under the dust shielding condition, and can be used for the fields of primary disaster edge identification and secondary disaster emergency judgment.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP THIRD ENG BUREAU CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Sampling method for rainfall forecast samples under complex terrain condition of mountain area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and reduction, and relates to a sampling method for forecasting rainfall samples under the condition of complex terrains in mountain areas. On the basis of a rainfall probability distribution model, judging a sampling mode adopted by an early warning unit according to a forecast rainfall grade and the position of the early warning unit, wherein the sampling mode comprises tail enhanced sampling and Monte Carlo sampling, the tail enhanced sampling specifically comprises that the layering standard adopted by the early warning unit is judged by combining the forecast rainfall grade of the early warning unit and live rainfall data of the previous day and the position relation between the early warning unit and a major attention area, and corresponding layers are divided according to the layering standard, and the corresponding layers comprise a normal layer and a tail layer. The combination mode of tail reinforcement sampling and common Monte Carlo sampling is adopted, uncertainty and high disaster causing performance of rare events (high-intensity rainfall) at the tail of the rainfall are fully considered, and the problems of common sampling sample concentration and poor coverage are avoided.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INST GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECHNOLOGY GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIS

title_en: Search support system and search simulator
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a search support system capable of improving search efficiency.SOLUTION: Provided is a search support system which comprises a first terminal used by the disaster headquarters, an administration device installed in a data center, a second terminal used by a search director, and a third terminal used by each search staff member. The first terminal sends to the administration device search information necessary for search and requests the administration device to send the map data of disaster areas. The administration device sends the requested map data. The first terminal highlights search areas on the received map to prepare a search map and sends it to the administration device. Based on the search information, the administration device prepares search requisites for rescuing victims within seventy two hours in the search areas by a predetermined arithmetic operation and sends the prepared search requisites to the first or second terminal. The administration device receives from the third terminal position information of each search staff member and discovery information about those being searched for and displays the information on the search map. The second terminal receives and displays the search map and the search requisites sent by the administration device. The third terminal sends to the administration device position information acquired by positioning means and discovery information when the search staff member has discovered those being searched for.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fireman's safety apparatus and methods of use
abstract_en: A strap for utilization as a safety harness, particularly for use by firefighters is disclosed, wherein the strap comprises an elongated center section with four handles, two at each end extending from the elongated center section approximately opposite each other. The invention discloses a single easily deployable tool and methods which can at least carry S.C.B.A. cylinders and/or other equipment, work as a ladder belt and/or a hose strap, move charged lines, provide an increased search area, work as a hasty harness, work for dragging a victim or firefighter, work easily for Denver drill scenarios, and carry victims or firefighters up or down stairs.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) search and rescue operations are provided. A UAV may include a camera configured to capture one or more images of a search area. The UAV may include at least one logic device configured to calculate a flight pattern for searching the search area, receive a target image, and analyze the one or more images of the search area to identify a target matching the target image.

title_en: Optimization method, system and related device for reconstruction of localized emergency power supply charging pile
abstract_en: A method for optimizing the transformation of a local emergency power supply charging pile comprises the steps of considering the distribution and load uncertainty of a building-level electric automobile, considering disaster occurrence frequency estimation, determining a disaster scene set, defining an operation complexity index by combining economic loss and operation cost caused by the transformation of the charging and discharging states of the building-level electric automobile, taking the sum of the transportation and transformation cost of a charging station, the dispatching cost of the building-level electric automobile, the economic cost loss caused by the loss of load power and the conversion cost of the operation complexity index as an objective function of a charging pile transformation optimization model, carrying out linearization treatment on the charging pile transformation optimization model, and solving by taking the objective function and constraint conditions into consideration under the disaster scene set by utilizing the charging pile transformation optimization model after linearization treatment, so as to obtain the charging pile transformation optimization scheme. The invention can formulate a reasonable optimization scheme for the transformation of the bidirectional charging and discharging interface of the charging pile for the localization emergency power supply recovery of the post-disaster building.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for controlling cooperative voltage of regional micro-grid group based on approximate dynamic programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling the cooperative voltage of a district micro-grid group based on approximate dynamic programming, wherein the method comprises the steps of taking the characteristic of distributed photovoltaic as an aggregation index and aggregating the distributed photovoltaic in the district micro-grid based on a community theory; and for each decision time point, establishing an evolution uncertainty of the aggregate distributed photovoltaic in the district micro-grid as a Markov model, taking current voltage deviation and future expected voltage deviation into account in each Markov state, establishing a voltage iteration optimization control model comprising an optimization control objective function and constraint conditions, designing an approximate dynamic programming algorithm, estimating a target value function by adopting a piecewise linearization approximation method and a concept of a state after decision, and carrying out iterative solution to obtain an optimal district micro-grid group collaborative voltage control strategy. The invention solves the dimension disaster problem caused by a large number of state variables and decision variables, and accelerates the solving speed.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD LIANYUNGANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Flood vulnerability identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydrology and discloses a method and a system for identifying flood liability, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining flood point data, initially constructing a meteorological factor, a topography factor and an environmental factor data set which influence flood, screening factors which influence flood liability through Spearman rank correlation coefficient, tolerance and variance expansion factor, evaluating flood liability of a research area through an information quantity model to obtain a disaster liability partition map, selecting non-flood points in a low-incidence area and a lower-incidence area to construct a non-flood point data set, constructing a coupling information quantity model and a machine-learned flood liability model by utilizing the flood points and the non-flood point data, constructing a sample set of the non-flood data and the flood data, identifying an optimal flood liability model, and constructing a flood liability model from two angles of uncertainty of model simulation and uncertainty of data according to the invention and research on flood protection of different decision areas.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating earthquake damage of sedimentary basin building group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating earthquake damages of a sedimentation basin building group, which belong to the technical field of engineering disaster prevention and are characterized by comprising the steps of S1, determining target sites and characteristic input parameters, S2, establishing a three-dimensional sedimentation basin model, acquiring earthquake responses, S3, establishing an improved data set, S4, optimizing an artificial neural network, S5, acquiring samples, S6, determining earthquake damages parameters, and S7, predicting and evaluating. According to the method, the calculation efficiency of constructing a data set and evaluating the influence of the uncertainty of the site medium parameters on the basin vibration is sequentially improved through the rapid multipole algorithm and the proxy model, the peak acceleration statistical moment and the probability information of any position of the basin surface can be given out, and the method is applied to rapid prediction and evaluation of the earthquake damage of the building group and serves for toughness cities.

title_en: Weather drought prediction method and system based on WRF model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather drought prediction method and system based on a WRF model, and belongs to the technical field of weather drought prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining driving data, constructing a WRF mode aiming at a target area, setting an initial physical parameter combination, running a model, storing a precipitation result, evaluating the precipitation deviation ratio, wet daily frequency deviation and intensity frequency ratio dimensionality, and when a preset rule is not met, performing interactive constraint through dynamic weight parameters, quantitative feedback of driving data uncertainty and physical process consistency verification optimization parameters until the optimal parameter combination is determined. Based on the global climate mode future driving data and the optimal parameter operation model, the drought assessment is completed by combining SPI index calculation. The method realizes the comprehensive improvement of prediction precision, stability, physical interpretability, optimization efficiency and scene suitability, and provides efficient and reliable technical support for drought disaster scientific management and decision.

title_en: A kind of international SOS letter shape distress signal balloon
abstract_en: An international SOS letter shape distress signal balloon is made up of SOS letter spheric balloon body, SOS letter spheric balloon air-filled pore, draught line; Wherein, air-filled pore is provided with at SOS letter spheric balloon body lower part, draught line is provided with at SOS letter spheric balloon body lower part, multiple reflecting mark plaster is pasted with at SOS letter spheric balloon body surface, be that SOS letter spheric balloon body surface is pasted with multiple Luminous mark, be that SOS letter spheric balloon body is provided with red LED lamp.The mark that a few place is eye-catching is had in the present invention, holding lead-in wire by deliverer is put into high aerial, facilitate rescuer can find target with telescope at tens kilometers at several kilometers or rescuer, decrease search area, decrease rescuer, shorten the search and rescue time, be conducive to deliverer and succoured within the shortest time, ensure the life security of deliverer.Meanwhile, the distress signal instrument of the present invention or a kind of cheapness.

title_en: Nerve radiation field DSM generation method constrained by two-dimensional triangular network
abstract_en: The invention provides a nerve radiation field DSM generation method based on two-dimensional triangular mesh constraint, which comprises the following steps of step 1, implicit body density and radiation field modeling, step 2, extracting density field gradient and surface normal, step 3, constructing a two-dimensional triangular mesh, step 4, realizing normal consistency constraint based on the two-dimensional triangular mesh, step 5, calculating uncertainty perception rendering loss, and step 6, performing end-to-end joint optimization. The method of the invention optimizes geometric constraint and rendering loss through end-to-end combination, reduces root mean square error of three-dimensional reconstruction compared with the traditional NeRF method, and provides a high-precision DSM generation scheme for remote sensing applications such as city planning, disaster monitoring and the like.
assignees: NANJING INSTITUTE OF SURVEYING MAPPING & GEOTECHNICAL INVESTIG CO LTD;UNIV WUHAN;UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Emergency retractable water storage bag
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency retractable water storage bag, which comprises a plastic film water storage bag, wherein the plastic film water storage bag comprises a sealable opening; other mating components comprise a water current pressure pump, a hose, a sealing cover, a suction valve and a guiding pipe. The emergency retractable water storage bag has the beneficial effects that the storage of drinking water is preparation which is first carried out when people face a disaster, however, due to the uncertainty of the disaster, plenty of space can be occupied usually by a common barreled water storage way, and moreover, a food safety problem is also easily induced due to long-time storage; through the emergency retractable water storage bag provided by the invention, the demand of storing plenty of water when the disaster is coped with is met; the accommodating space is saved; the emergency retractable water storage bag is convenient to use; the food sanitation is also guaranteed through a food-grade plastic film.

title_en: Method for determining optimal loss curve of non-material city based on double-layer target optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an optimal loss curve of a data-free city based on a variation coefficient and beta distribution optimization principle double-layer target optimization, which is used for reducing uncertainty in a data processing process. Firstly, aiming at the inland plain city lacking disaster data, a data reference area loss rate value is transferred to a research area by using a comparison principle for reference; secondly, based on the optimal principle that the variation coefficient is minimum and the beta distribution probability is maximum, the citation error and the statistical error generated in the loss rate citation are reduced, the loss rate value of the research area is relatively accurate, and then a disaster-deficient data urban disaster-affected water depth-loss rate relation curve is established. Therefore, the generalized material-free urban disaster loss curve fitting method using the regional index value as the input parameter and the loss curve as the output result is formed, and scientific reference is provided for establishment of the material-free urban flood loss curve.

title_en: Enhanced recovery method and terminal of power distribution system based on disaster uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster uncertainty-based enhanced recovery method and terminal of a power distribution system, wherein first, the damage intensity of elements of the power distribution system is modeled based on disasters; secondly, aiming at uncertainty of disaster evolution rules and element fault probability, a fuzzy set generation method based on combination of moment measurement and minimum transmission cost measurement is adopted to construct a fuzzy set of the element fault probability, and then a collaborative distribution robust optimization model of pre-disaster strengthening and post-disaster recovery of the power distribution system is provided; and then, carrying out distributed solving on the distributed robust optimization model by using a column constraint generation algorithm, and improving the calculation efficiency of the model. In this way, the problem of coordination of reinforcement and recovery of the existing power distribution system in disaster facing can be solved, and efficient reinforcement and quick recovery of the power system are ensured.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring PRB data, drilling data and a digital elevation model; s2, calculating a geological interface hidden function equation according to PRB data; s3, extracting a DEM point set in the digital elevation model to obtain a tetrahedral geological model; s4, utilizing the hidden function property to carry out section division; s5, simulating the stratum state of the virtual geological drilling by using a Monte Carlo method; s6, defining corresponding geological properties of geological areas in the section according to section combination to form a section model; the method is based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, can generate a deterministic model which cannot capture the uncertainty of stratum attributes through implicit three-dimensional geological modeling, can better reflect the complex spatial cutting relationship and stacking relationship among geological structures and the specific form inside the structures, and has the characteristics of being more modified, being capable of accurately explaining the ground, carrying out disaster early warning analysis decision and the like on underground excavation engineering.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA ROAD & BRIDGE CORP

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage three-dimensional rescue path planning algorithm under complex disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-coverage three-dimensional rescue path planning algorithm for an unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex disaster environment. The method comprises the following steps: (1) establishing an environment model; (2) Dividing the model into different height layers through a hierarchical planning strategy, and reconstructing a map of the current height layer through a map reconstruction strategy to obtain a two-dimensional reconstruction map; (3) And carrying out two-dimensional full-coverage path planning on the two-dimensional reconstruction map: performing regional branch judgment on the position nodes, and screening according to the sequence from the dead zone to the local region to the global region; (4) Adopting an interlayer connection strategy to associate child nodes and father nodes among different layers; (5) judging whether all the height layers in the three-dimensional environment are traversed or not; (6) And (5) carrying out path tracing, finding out a complete three-dimensional path and outputting the path. The method effectively reduces the number of dead points involved, rapidly plans a shorter path in real time, reduces the path repetition rate, has better robustness, and is suitable for three-dimensional full-coverage path planning in complex disaster environments.

title_en: Power distribution network information physical system rush-repair method based on information gap decision theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power information physical systems and discloses a power distribution network information physical system rush-repair method based on an information gap decision theory. The method comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a model considering the coupling relation between a power distribution network and an information network by taking the total cost of the information physical system of the power distribution network as a target, then establishing a post-disaster coordination recovery model of the information physical system of the power distribution network after disaster on the basis of the coupling model of the power distribution network and the information network, then considering the emergency resource models such as network reconstruction of the power distribution network, a mobile emergency power supply and an emergency communication vehicle, and finally establishing a multi-source coordination recovery strategy of the information physical system of the power distribution network after disaster on the basis of the emergency resource model and considering the condition of wind power output uncertainty on the basis of an information gap decision theory. The invention can improve the elasticity of the information physical system of the power distribution network after faults and reduce the influence and loss of natural disasters to the power distribution network and users thereof.

title_en: A kind of maritime search region estimation technique that drift model is overturn based on leeway
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of maritime search region estimation technique that drift model is overturn based on leeway, comprise the following steps：Wind speed knots modification is normalized；The influence that target itself speed is overturn to leeway is obtained according to target drift velocity；Leeway upset rate is asked for according to the influence that the wind speed knots modification and target itself speed after normalization are overturn to leeway, and judges whether current leeway overturns；Structure is overturn according to leeway and obtains target drift model；Search Area is estimated using Monte Carlo method based on target drift model.The Search Area that the present invention overturns estimated by the maritime search region estimation technique of drift model based on leeway can be avoided that the search inactive area of futile effort, improve maritime search success rate farthest comprising search and rescue target, and area is small.

title_en: Dam strong earthquake simulation system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of dam safety, and discloses a dam strong earthquake simulation system based on digital twinning, which comprises a physical digital entropy flow twinning body module, a disaster source generation module, a digital twinning simulation module and a model correction module, wherein the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module is used for constructing a finite element model of a dam and dynamically coupling a material constitutive relation in the finite element model with the structural entropy, the disaster source generation module is used for generating a disaster source combination pair, the digital twinning simulation module is used for carrying out dynamic response simulation calculation on the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module, and the model correction module is used for correcting parameters of the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module. According to the application, the structural entropy is introduced to comprehensively quantify the damage, energy dissipation and information uncertainty of the material, and a dynamic coupling mechanism of the constitutive relation of the material and the structural entropy is established, so that the digital twin model is converted from a traditional static parameter model into a dynamic evolution model capable of reflecting the degradation and damage accumulation process of the material by endogenous property, and the reality and fidelity of simulation are improved.
assignees: YUNNAN HUADIAN JINSHAJIANG MIDSTREAM WATER POWER DEV CO LTD LIYUAN GENERATING BRANCH

title_en: Electrical interconnection system toughness assessment and improvement method considering seismic uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical interconnection system toughness assessment and improvement method considering seismic uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: enumerating the combination of the seismic source position and the seismic level gear, and obtaining the probability of each potential seismic scene according to the seismic disaster probability model; then, intensity distribution of different earthquake scenes is obtained through an intensity attenuation model, and the failure probability of the elements based on the intensity is worked out according to a pre-built electrical interconnection system; solving the load reduction amount under each order of fault state by applying an electrical interconnection system load reduction optimization algorithm based on a two-stage gas network optimization load flow model; calculating toughness indexes according to the probability of each potential earthquake scene, the element failure probability and the load reduction amount under each order of fault state, wherein if the system level toughness index is lower than a set standard value, the planning scheme reaches the standard, otherwise, a toughness improvement strategy needs to be implemented; and obtaining a plurality of alternative schemes according to the element-level toughness indexes, and working out an element strengthening scheme through cost-benefit analysis so as to correct the planning scheme.

title_en: Emergency broadcast early warning system and terminal based on big data dynamic linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency broadcast early warning system and a terminal based on big data dynamic linkage, wherein the system comprises an emergency broadcast data acquisition module, an emergency broadcast information production and broadcasting module, an emergency broadcast scheduling control module, an emergency broadcast transmission module and a terminal device; this terminal is including broadcasting accuse table, the emergent broadcast terminal of big dipper, ai automatic detection intelligent terminal, computer and control cabinet. The invention summarizes and arranges from multiple aspects of disaster attributes, social influences, economic influences and natural environment influences to form a set of comprehensive disaster evaluation index system considering the influences of all aspects, can provide reference for selecting disaster evaluation indexes of different disasters, considers randomness and fuzziness of subjective evaluation based on a weight determination method of a cloud model, realizes uncertainty conversion from evaluation weight to comprehensive weight data, automatically detects each area through a pre-installed camera and a sound post, and realizes linkage broadcast of video monitoring and emergency broadcast.

title_en: Rescue method for space point sound source localization based on microphone array
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of emergency rescue, in particular to a rescue method for positioning a space point sound source based on a microphone array. Through rotatable carrying platform, can make microphone array A and microphone array B form a pair of wrong plane, obtain the projection point of two planes of disaster personnel's sound source based on time delay estimation method again, through making the vector intersect on the mathematical model just can accomplish space point sound source location, and then to sound source area location and carry out the work of making a video recording through carrying the camera, locking coordinate information and image. The unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to perform point-around flight monitoring in the search area, so that the search area covers the whole target area to obtain specific position information of the disaster-stricken, and the disaster-stricken can be locked rapidly.
assignees: UNIV NANCHANG HANGKONG;ZHAOYANG GEVOTAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transformer substation enhanced resource allocation method considering uncertainty of element fault quantity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transformer substation strengthening resource allocation method considering uncertainty of element fault quantity, which comprises the following steps of S1, dividing cognitive uncertainty of damaged quantity of a transformer substation, S2, evaluating random scene probability of the damaged quantity of different transformer substations, S3, fusing probability evaluations of different experts by utilizing an improved D-S evidence theory, and S4, respectively calculating corresponding SSDAD models through NFE C & CG according to uncertainty division of the damaged quantity of the transformer substation, so as to obtain a transformer substation strengthening resource allocation scheme enabling system load shedding loss to be minimum. The random optimization model for the enhanced resource allocation of the transformer substation can enable the system to expect the optimal transformer substation rush repair and enhanced resource allocation scheme with the minimum load loss under extreme events, and the two-stage robust optimization C & CG algorithm embedded in the network flow can improve the solving speed by several orders of magnitude, so that more time is striven for the actual deployment execution of the optimal transformer substation enhanced resource allocation scheme before disaster.

title_en: A kind of electrical network disaster real-time monitoring device and method based on intuitionistic fuzzy-rough sets
abstract_en: A kind of electrical network disaster real-time monitoring device and method based on intuitionistic fuzzy-rough sets, calls the historical disaster data in Database Unit；According to the historical disaster data collected, utilize method based on intuitionistic fuzzy-rough sets to carry out yojan, obtain the disaster loss grade assessment rule of electrical network；Real-time Collection electrical network disaster data, the historical disaster grade assessment rule of formation, determine the disaster loss grade of current electric grid；Data after real-time assessment are updated in historical data base, for electrical network disaster knowledge storehouse is increased and revises；Implement electrical network calamity emergency to dispose, i.e. for different disaster ranks, start corresponding emergency recovery measure, electrical network is regulated and controled.The present invention has the features such as ambiguity, randomness, uncertainty and redundancy in view of the data volume in electrical network Disaster Assessment, utilize intuitionistic fuzzy-rough sets method, successfully overcome the methods such as conventional probability opinion and can not obtain the shortcoming of data attribute internal relation and implication relation, improve the accuracy of assessment.

title_en: The automatic identifying method of plant leaf blade damage symptoms
abstract_en: An automatic identifying method for plant leaf blade damage symptoms, it comprises the following steps: 1) obtain target leaf image; 2) target leaf image process; 3) Image differentiation and the analysis of regional standard colour is carried out; 4) quadratic function regretional analysis and regression parameter calculating is carried out according to area image norm value; 5) calculating of threshold parameter is carried out with method of analysis of variance; 6) discriminatory analysis of target blade damage symptoms is carried out with Optimal Parameters.The present invention achieves the automatic discrimination of plant leaf blade " ∧ " and " ∨ " type damage symptoms by application image measurements and calculations machine recognition technology, determine its harm mechanism by damage symptoms, accurate quantitative analysis is differentiated that " ∧ " and " ∨ " type damage symptoms and root of being injured thereof have important directive function; Be conducive to solving the uncertainty of current plant leaf blade damage symptoms in research and production and dispute; Robotization is differentiated to the disasters such as plant leaf blade meteorology and disease have most important theories and practical significance.

title_en: Geological disaster probability assessment method for multi-source big data fusion analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a geological disaster probability assessment method for multi-source big data fusion analysis. From three-dimensional coordinate system layout and multi-point sensor acquisition, to standardization, memory core construction, time sequence convolution fusion, anomaly identification, probability mapping and spatial interpolation, and to output of high risk areas. The spatial consistency of the data of each monitoring point is ensured by unifying a spatial reference system, and the dimension unification and comparability of the multi-source heterogeneous data are realized by the quality inspection and standardization of the whole-flow data. The method adopts a finite memory weight model and time sequence weighted convolution to comprehensively reflect the history accumulation effect and improve the anomaly discrimination robustness, thereby avoiding the defect of short-term data only. Probability mapping and space smoothing based on feature distance endow continuity and self-adaptability of risk expression, and scientific judgment of regional high-risk partition is realized.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY JINHUA SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on multi-temporal remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system based on multi-temporal remote sensing images, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and are used for collecting multi-temporal SAR images and multi-temporal multi-spectral optical images of a target area and carrying out standardized processing, carrying out super-resolution reconstruction and registration on the images after the standardized processing to generate a multi-modal remote sensing data cube, inputting the multi-modal remote sensing data cube into a pre-trained deep learning model, carrying out inversion and outputting a physical parameter map, dynamically calibrating parameters and boundary conditions of a three-dimensional geomechanical model pre-constructed for the target area based on the physical parameter map, and utilizing the dynamically calibrated three-dimensional geomechanical model to predict and generate a space-time evolution map and critical instability time, carrying out uncertainty fusion analysis on the physical parameter map, the space-time evolution map and the critical instability time, and generating dynamic hierarchical early warning information according to fusion analysis results.
assignees: EAST CHINA UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY NANCHANG CAMPUS

title_en: Multi-mode set-based method for forecasting icing thickness probability of power transmission line in complex terrain
abstract_en: A multi-mode set-based icing thickness probability forecasting method for a power transmission line in complex terrain relates to the technical field of disaster prevention, disaster reduction and weather forecasting of power systems, provides high-precision weather forecast data in complex terrain through a small micro-scale wind field forecasting mode, constructs a plurality of icing thickness forecasting models based on physical mechanisms and artificial intelligence based on the forecast data, and quantifies icing forecasting uncertainty by using the icing thickness probability forecasting method which integrates the icing thickness forecasting models into one. By the method, the accuracy and the robustness of ice coating thickness prediction under the complex terrain condition can be effectively improved, a scientific basis with certainty and probability is provided for the anti-icing and disaster reduction decision of the power grid, and therefore the risk early warning and prevention and control capability of the power grid for coping with ice disasters is enhanced.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Robot cluster search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot cluster search and rescue method, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of search and rescue robots form a cluster, a formation is kept to be carried out from the original place to the direction of a suspected target, and a plurality of distributed suspected search areas are searched in the proceeding direction in sequence; when the suspected search area does not find the target, leaving a search and rescue robot in the suspected search area, and keeping the rest search and rescue robots in a cluster state to continue to carry out until the target is searched; the invention can continue to expand search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area to improve the success rate of search and rescue, and when a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supply robot collaboratively sends the left search and rescue robots to the target positions together.

title_en: High-voltage transmission line icing process integrated prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-voltage transmission line icing process integrated prediction method and belongs to the overhead high-voltage transmission line on-line monitoring and early warning technical field. According to the method, icing process historical data of a high-voltage transmission line on-line monitoring system and corresponding micro meteorological data are utilized to establish an icing process fusion prediction system comprising a data pre processing module, an icing process prediction module and a fusion decision-making module. The method includes the following steps that: dimension reduction processing is performed on the meteorological data based on a principal component analysis method, so that the complexity of modeling can be decreased; a multivariable nonlinear regression model, a support vector machine model, an expert evaluation model and a fuzzy reasoning model are utilized to qualitatively or quantitatively predict the icing process of a power transmission line; and a DS evidence fusion theory is utilized to perform united judgment on four prediction results, and an icing early warning level is confirmed. The high-voltage transmission line icing process integrated prediction method has the following advantages that: a modeling process is simplified; the uncertainty of a single model is eliminated, so that the accuracy of prediction is improved; and effective basis can be provided for relevant departments in decision making of icing disasters.
assignees: UNIV YUNNAN;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: A kind of cities and towns masonry residence safety evaluation method based on analysis of uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of cities and towns masonry residence safety evaluation method based on analysis of uncertainty, belongs to engineering structure Performance Evaluation field.This method carries out the acceleration under ambient vibration to structure first and acquires, and obtains acceleration information.Secondly, using multiple reference points covariance driving Random Subspace Method and convolutional neural networks automatic identification modal parameters and uncertainty.Then, it is input with obtained uncertain modal parameter, using the Bayesian model modification method for being based on progressive Markov Chain Monte Carlo Method (TMCMC), the initial finite element model of correcting principle obtains the cities and towns masonry residence Security Evaluation Model with uncertain parameters.Finally, carried out to the model while considering load action and the probabilistic security evaluation of structural parameters.The present invention can construct effective cities and towns masonry residence Security Evaluation Model, to realize the target of such house long-term safety management and disaster alarm.

title_en: Beach vegetation restoration evaluation method based on image feature analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image analysis, in particular to a beach vegetation restoration evaluation method for image feature analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images of two time phases of a target beach restoration area before and after an environmental disturbance event occurs, respectively dividing the remote sensing images of the two time phases in an object-oriented manner to generate a plurality of vegetation objects, extracting morphological stability features and ecological stress resistance features of each vegetation object in the two time phases, calculating the functional toughness index of each vegetation object based on the changes of the morphological stability features and the ecological stress resistance features before and after the environmental disturbance event, and evaluating the overall effect of vegetation restoration according to the functional toughness index. The invention changes the uncertainty problem of the traditional graph selection according to the fixed time interval, so that the vegetation restoration evaluation has the advantages of event driving, accurate time phase and effective data, and provides technical support for post-disaster ecological monitoring, post-coastal engineering evaluation and the like.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for synchronization signals and improves broadcasting quality of radio shaded areas
title_ko: 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 동기신호를 보상하여 불확실성을 갖는 무선구간의 신뢰성을 향상시키고 전파음영지역에 용이하게 재난방송을 전달할 수 있도록 하는 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템에 관한 것으로, 전파음영지역의 건물내부에 설치되며 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하는 경우에 주변환경으로 인한 노이즈를 저감시키기 위한 노이즈 저감용 FPGA모듈을 구비하여 노이즈가 제거된 디지털 복조신호를 인터넷 패킷 데이터로 변환하여 출력하는 재난방송 수신장치, 상기 건물내부를 구성하는 층별로 설치되고 상기 재난방송 수신장치에서 출력되는 인터넷 패킷데이터를 유선망으로 수신하여 근거리 무선신호로 출력하는 메인중계장치, 상기 메인중계장치가 설치된 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되며 상기 메인중계장치에서 출력되는 근거리무선신호를 수신하여 동기화된 재난방송용 RF신호로 변조하여 출력하는 서브중계장치, 및 상기 서브중계장치를 통해 출력되는 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하기 위한 재난방송수신용 통신모듈을 구비하는 사용자 단말기;를 구비한다.

title_en: Multi-section snake-shaped robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multistage formula snake-shaped robot, include: the joint device is arranged between two adjacent front advancing devices and rear advancing devices; the travelling device comprises a plurality of travelling devices, each travelling device comprises three groups of tracks and three groups of track motors for driving the tracks, the three groups of tracks are respectively arranged on three surfaces of a regular triangle formed by two driving screw rods and one driven screw rod, and the three tracks run along the length directions of the driving screw rods and the driven screw rods; the sensor is arranged on the traveling device. The robot has the advantages that the regular triangle section can realize three-dimensional angle transformation, so that the purpose of crawling when any surface is contacted due to uneven ground during search and rescue is achieved, and meanwhile, the length expansion effect is realized by combining the segment number of the robot at will according to the uncertainty of the search and rescue site. In addition, compared with snake-shaped robots with other moving structures, the robot has the characteristics of small required space and high traveling speed.

title_en: Quakeproof and quake-resistant safety ward
abstract_en: The invention provides a quakeproof and quake-resistant safety ward which mainly comprises a buffer plate (1), an anti-impact plate (2), an anti-pressure beam (8), a partial stress plate (4), an anti-pressure column (5), an anti-collapse support (9) and a health cushion plate (10). The quakeproof and quake-resistant safety ward which is used in a building for effectively preventing earthquakes and lessening casualties in earthquakes is a safe and self-rescue facility, solves the problem of being lack of indoor earthquake safety facilities the problems of safe facility insufficiency and building quakeproof capability uncertainty in earthquake prevention and resistance, reduces common panic in the earthquake prevention and resistance, generally increases the safety feelings of people, and provides a relatively safe ward for people in the earthquake prevention.

title_en: Geometric probability model based search and rescue method and system for measuring random meeting uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geometric probability model based search and rescue method and system for measuring random meeting uncertainty. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a lost path L of a lost person and determining a position point of the lost person D finally appearing in the path L; step 2, measuring the path length l of the path L and measuring a position point of a searcher C in the path L; step 3, calculating all position combinations (x,y) of the searcher C and the lost person D, and calculating a position combination for ensuring that the searcher C can meet with the lost person D, wherein a condition that |y-x|<=md is met; step 4, calculating a meeting probability P(M) of the searcher C and the lost person D; and step 5, calculating the position of the searcher C meeting the lost person D with a maximum probability in the path L, and arranging for search and rescue personnel to perform search and rescue according to the position. According to the search and rescue method and system, the possibility of the searcher C meeting the lost person D in the path L can be confirmed, and the position of the searcher C meeting the lost person D with the maximum probability in the path L also can be determined.

title_en: Small rescue unmanned plane
abstract_en: This case is related to a kind of small rescue unmanned plane, cooperates rescue helicopters or ship to use, including drone body, air charging system, lifebuoy, lifebuoy storage device and spool；Lifebuoy storage device is the annular container that bottom has accommodating groove；Air charging system has Aerating needle；Aerating needle is set to lifebuoy storage device inside top；Lifebuoy, which folds, to be set in accommodating groove；Lifebuoy includes lifebuoy circle body and gas nozzle, and Aerating needle is inserted into gas nozzle；The rotatable level of spool is fixed on lifebuoy storage device inner ring；Traction rope is had on spool, traction rope one end is lain on lifebuoy；Small rescue unmanned plane of the invention is lower small-sized using price or miniature drone is carrier, greatly reduces search and rescue cost, the search and rescue visual field is wide, and search area is big, better than the search and rescue mode for largely throwing or shedding within a certain area lifesaving appliance；Rescue worker searches and rescues without going deep into strategical vantage point, improves the self-security of rescue worker.
assignees: TAIZHOU KEPUNI COMM EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-type power source cooperative active recovery method and system after network disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for active recovery after disaster in a distribution network with cooperation of multiple types of power supplies, belonging to the field of recovery after disaster in a distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on source load switching and source load uncertainty analysis, analyzing frequency indexes of a system under dynamic disturbance in a partition expansion process, and considering supporting effects of DG and MES in a distribution network on inertia, primary frequency modulation and load electric energy, constructing partition expansion constraint considering frequency safety and electric energy demand; and establishing a multi-partition net rack continuation model taking the multi-MES as a restoration starting point, and combining partition expansion constraint and source load restoration constraint to construct an overall active restoration model. The invention utilizes the flexible movement characteristic, the electric energy supporting characteristic and the frequency supporting characteristic of the MES, considers the recovery process after the disaster of the distribution network and cooperates with the DG to ensure that new energy is possible to be connected in advance on the premise of ensuring the frequency safety, and the power generation resources in the network are utilized in advance and fully, so that a larger amount of load can be recovered.

title_en: Geological deformation early warning method and system based on AI vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning and discloses a geological deformation early warning method and system based on AI vision, wherein the geological deformation early warning method based on AI vision comprises the steps of obtaining earth surface micro deformation characteristics by using an AI vision system and constructing a geological map structure network, fusing a nonlinear geomechanical equation to achieve characteristic extraction driven by physical constraints in the map neural network, creating a multidimensional map structure model representing different depth layers, achieving cross-layer information transmission through a physical information guiding type map attention mechanism, deploying the map neural network of a Bayesian probability framework to conduct geological stress field distribution modeling, quantifying prediction uncertainty, and finally generating intelligent early warning decision information with risk grade division.
assignees: CHENGDU HUIGAN BAOTONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Traffic scene big data searching system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic scene big data searching system, which comprises: the content feedback mechanism is used for acquiring a remote sensing image returned by the remote sensing satellite based on the positioning data of the target search area to be output as a target remote sensing image; and the third analysis equipment is used for taking each image block surrounded by each edge pixel point in the multiple conversion image as each reference image block, and sending out an object identification instruction when the contour of a certain reference image block in the multiple conversion image is matched with the reference contour of the human clothing, or else, sending out an object unrecognization instruction. According to the method and the device, when the contour of a certain reference image block in the multiple conversion image after the sea area picture optimization is matched with the reference contour of the human clothing, the object identification instruction can be sent out, and otherwise, when the object is not identified, the accuracy and the efficiency of the subsequent human clothing identification are improved, and the automatic implementation of sea surface human search and rescue is ensured.

title_en: Disaster-resistant toughness assessment method for urban comprehensive pipe rack, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster resistant toughness assessment method, a storage medium and electronic equipment for an urban comprehensive pipe rack, and relates to the technical field of urban comprehensive pipe racks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster resistance toughness classification information of the urban comprehensive pipe rack, obtaining a comprehensive influence matrix based on relative influence among factors affecting the disaster resistance toughness of the urban comprehensive pipe rack in the classification information, analyzing centrality and causality based on the comprehensive influence matrix, obtaining a target reachable matrix based on the comprehensive influence matrix, constructing a layered network model for disaster resistance toughness assessment based on the target reachable matrix and analysis results of centrality and causality, mapping the layered network model into a Bayesian network, and carrying out disaster resistance toughness assessment on the urban comprehensive pipe rack by utilizing the Bayesian network after mapping. Therefore, uncertainty caused by the fact that a single expert is relied on for judgment can be reduced, and accuracy and dynamic response capability of an evaluation result are improved.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV;UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Index construction method for representing sensitivity of multidimensional joint probability model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an index construction method for representing sensitivity of a multi-dimensional joint probability model, which comprises the following steps of carrying out generalized extremum distribution edge fitting on each univariate sample, calculating first-meeting extremum of T years under different reproduction periods according to edge distribution, converting the samples into standard probability space of [0,1], constructing a three-dimensional joint probability model, generating three-dimensional environment equivalent surfaces under different reproduction periods by adopting an inverse first-order reliability method based on each three-dimensional joint probability model, obtaining joint extreme load combinations, and constructing a composite disaster index based on the univariate extremum and the joint load combinations. The method can solve the problem of obvious uncertainty of the existing multi-dimensional joint probability model in the process of estimating the load of the extreme ocean environment, and overcomes the defect that the unified sensitivity evaluation index is lacking among different models. Providing a stable and reliable basis for selecting the environmental load of structures such as offshore wind power, ocean oil and gas platforms and the like.

title_en: Method and system for calculating fault rate of power distribution network under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for calculating the fault rate of a power distribution network under typhoon disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively establishing a probability density function model representing typhoon intensity and a probability distribution function model representing typhoon duration; establishing a power distribution network fault rate calculation model under typhoon disasters; and calculating the total probability of load power loss in the duration time of the typhoon disaster based on the power distribution network fault rate calculation model. The invention simultaneously considers the uncertainty of typhoon intensity and duration, analyzes the physical principle of different types of faults of the power distribution network caused by typhoon disasters and has higher accuracy. The method is used for modeling the fault rate of the power distribution network, the influence of typhoon intensity and duration on the fault rate of the power distribution network is comprehensively considered, the running state of the power distribution network under the typhoon disaster is completely and accurately described by carrying out detailed modeling on multiple disaster-causing factors and disaster-causing mechanisms of the typhoon disaster, and the precision of the fault rate model of the power distribution network is greatly improved by utilizing the advantage of combined driving of the data model.

title_en: Wing section gradient optimization design method integrating working condition and geometric uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention provides an airfoil gradient optimization design method integrating working conditions and geometric uncertainties, which combines the flight working conditions with the geometric uncertainties to carry out airfoil optimization design, considers the uncertainty influence of an aircraft in the processing and manufacturing processes and the actual flight processes, is beneficial to improving the capability of the airfoil for resisting the disturbance of the flight working conditions and the disturbance of the geometric uncertainties and improving the average performance and the performance robustness of the airfoil; aiming at the problem of dimension disaster caused by taking geometric uncertainty factors into consideration, the sampling dimension is reduced by a Karhunen-Loeve expansion method, and the sampling point number is greatly reduced on the premise of ensuring solving precision by carrying out sparsification treatment on a polynomial chaotic expansion method, so that the efficiency of airfoil robustness optimization design is greatly improved; in addition, the invention effectively improves the calculation precision and reduces the calculation cost by utilizing the gradient optimization design method, thereby enabling the airfoil design result to meet the requirements more under the condition of less calculation cost.

title_en: Prediction method for maximum drift distance of debris flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a forecasting method of the maximum washout distance of a debris flow, which comprises the steps of firstly determining an optimal one-dimensional probability distribution model of the maximum washout distance of the debris flow, a washout volume of the debris flow and a height difference of a debris flow basin; then, establishing three-dimensional joint probability distribution among the maximum debris flow rushing-out distance, the debris flow rushing-out volume and the height difference of the drainage basin based on an optimal one-dimensional probability distribution model of the maximum debris flow rushing-out distance, the debris flow rushing-out volume and the height difference of the drainage basin; and finally, a predicted value of the maximum drift distance of the debris flow under a certain conditional probability is given based on the established three-dimensional joint probability model. The calculation result shows that the maximum rush-out distance of the debris flow predicted by the method is well consistent with the measured value. The method overcomes the defects that the existing method for determining the maximum rushing-out distance of the debris flow cannot consider the self variability and uncertainty of the debris flow, and researches the probability prediction method of the debris flow danger zone from an uncertain angle. The probability prediction method has extremely important significance in aspects of debris flow danger range prediction, debris flow disaster risk assessment research and the like.

title_en: Automatic rescue unit recommendation method for intelligent emergency disposal process of elevator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic rescue unit recommendation method facing an elevator intelligent emergency disposal process, which comprises the steps of taking the position of a failed elevator as the center and a set distance R as the radius to form a search area and acquiring information of all elevator maintenance units in the search area; 2. constructing a rescue capacity evaluation system model of an elevator maintenance unit; 3. and (4) comprehensively evaluating all the elevator maintenance in the step one by utilizing a rescue ability evaluation system to obtain an optimal scheme, and using the optimal scheme as a recommendation unit to rescue the fault elevator. According to the invention, the rescue capacity of each maintenance unit is comprehensively considered through multiple indexes, the rescue dispatching task is recommended, the most reasonable rescue unit is allocated for the fault elevator, professional maintenance personnel are rapidly dispatched to risk the trapped people, the elevator fault rescue speed can be accelerated, the elevator rescue resource utilization efficiency is improved, secondary damage is reduced, and unnecessary casualties are avoided; the problem of dimension guarantor's rescue task allocation inequality, unreasonable is solved.
assignees: NANJING SPECIAL EQUIPMENT INSPECTION INST;NANJING NINGTE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic land transfer bee-way recommendation method and system
