abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic forward bee-putting route recommendation method and a system, which belong to the technical field of route planning, wherein the method considers the type, the position, the florescence, the forward migration cost time, the price of bee products, the yield of bee products and the uncertainty of disastrous weather events of honey sources; in the solving part, an approximate dynamic planning method combining the offline and online learning processes is designed to cope with the dimension disaster problem, and three acceleration methods are provided to improve the solving efficiency. The invention provides a thought for the transfer land bee farmers to dynamically recommend efficient and reliable migration routes, and provides a key decision support for the transfer land bee farmers to cope with the transfer land bee production risks and to realize the increase of production and income.

title_en: Weather drought prediction method and system based on WRF model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather drought prediction method and system based on a WRF model, and belongs to the technical field of weather drought prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining driving data, constructing a WRF mode aiming at a target area, setting an initial physical parameter combination, running a model, storing a precipitation result, evaluating the precipitation deviation ratio, wet daily frequency deviation and intensity frequency ratio dimensionality, and when a preset rule is not met, performing interactive constraint through dynamic weight parameters, quantitative feedback of driving data uncertainty and physical process consistency verification optimization parameters until the optimal parameter combination is determined. Based on the global climate mode future driving data and the optimal parameter operation model, the drought assessment is completed by combining SPI index calculation. The method realizes the comprehensive improvement of prediction precision, stability, physical interpretability, optimization efficiency and scene suitability, and provides efficient and reliable technical support for drought disaster scientific management and decision.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER PLANNING AND DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous rock early warning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a dangerous rock early warning method, a system, equipment and a medium, which are characterized in that local characteristics of ground particle cloud data are extracted, global characteristics are generated by aggregating the local characteristics, dangerous rock characteristics are obtained according to the global characteristics, a dangerous rock three-dimensional model is constructed according to the dangerous rock characteristics, stability and change trend prediction are carried out according to the dangerous rock three-dimensional model, dangerous rock early warning information is obtained, the change trend can be accurately predicted by utilizing the dangerous rock three-dimensional model, the accuracy of dangerous rock early warning is improved, the uncertainty analysis of dangerous rock disaster time is met according to the dynamic expression of dangerous rock hidden danger personalized characteristics, the reliability and accuracy of dangerous rock disaster early warning are improved, and a data basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction work of geological disasters.

title_en: Multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation
abstract_en: The multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation that the invention discloses a kind of, method include：S1 establishes potential tsunami source region seismicity parameters logic tree using a variety of focal shock parameter methods of estimation；S2 establishes tsunami unit source Green's function database using linear tsunami numerical simulation；S3 generates Stochastic earthquake event set according to above-mentioned logic tree, using Monte Carlo stochastic simulation；S4 is simulated using random slippage according to tsunami unit source Green's function database and Stochastic earthquake event set and is generated tsunami wave amplitude collection；S5 is according to tsunami wave amplitude collection, the analysis of uncertainty to multiple current Tsunami disaster distribution results statistics and result.The above method can solve the problems, such as that risk evaluation result is higher in the prior art and can not provide its correspondence probability of happening, a variety of uncertainties are fused in final assessment result, increase the confidence level of result, operational efficiency is improved simultaneously, policymaker is facilitated targetedly to make prevent and reduce natural disasters deployment and physical construction planning.

title_en: A kind of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior material, preparation method and applications
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior materials, it is a kind of three layers of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior material, with the light metal layers in three layers of molten bath in reactor lower head in metal Na simulation major accident, eutectics fused salt LiCl/KCl simulates oxide skin(coating), and metal Sn simulates heavy metal layer.Simulation material of the invention have the characteristics that simple process, be easily achieved, performance is stable and cost is relatively low.Since physical property difference can form natural layering between each component, molten bath top and bottom metal layers in actual response heap are simulated using metal material, the characteristic close of material, the uncertainty that can effectively reduce experimental result, the problem of can be used for reactor disaster mechanism and mitigation strategy experimental study.

title_en: Wing section gradient optimization design method integrating working condition and geometric uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention provides an airfoil gradient optimization design method integrating working conditions and geometric uncertainties, which combines the flight working conditions with the geometric uncertainties to carry out airfoil optimization design, considers the uncertainty influence of an aircraft in the processing and manufacturing processes and the actual flight processes, is beneficial to improving the capability of the airfoil for resisting the disturbance of the flight working conditions and the disturbance of the geometric uncertainties and improving the average performance and the performance robustness of the airfoil; aiming at the problem of dimension disaster caused by taking geometric uncertainty factors into consideration, the sampling dimension is reduced by a Karhunen-Loeve expansion method, and the sampling point number is greatly reduced on the premise of ensuring solving precision by carrying out sparsification treatment on a polynomial chaotic expansion method, so that the efficiency of airfoil robustness optimization design is greatly improved; in addition, the invention effectively improves the calculation precision and reduces the calculation cost by utilizing the gradient optimization design method, thereby enabling the airfoil design result to meet the requirements more under the condition of less calculation cost.

title_en: Machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation method and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation method and a machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation product, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and aims to analyze and evaluate different limit state resistance capacities of buildings with different structural forms by using nonlinearity Pushover, construct a building resistance capacity prediction dataset through multi-parameter combination simulation and train a machine learning prediction model. And analyzing the impact force of the building under the action of different landslide impact strengths by using a smooth particle flow and finite element coupling dynamic model, and constructing a mathematical calculation model of the landslide impact force based on impact force data. And (3) establishing a filling wall damage judging condition, comparing landslide impact force with building structure resistance capacity and filling wall resistance capacity, and determining the damage state of the building. And calculating probability vulnerability of the building by considering the landslide impact strength and the uncertainty of building material parameters, constructing vulnerability contour maps of the buildings with different structural forms, and providing theoretical and technical support for landslide quantitative risk evaluation disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Ground-air combined cooperation search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground-air combined cooperative search and rescue system, which comprises: the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a robot group consisting of a plurality of crawler-type search and rescue robots and an electric energy supply robot for providing electric energy; the unmanned aerial vehicle, the crawler-type search and rescue robot and the electric energy supply robot are all scheduled and controlled by a server; according to the invention, the suspected search area is determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the search value is better than that preset, the left crawler-type search and rescue robot can continue to perform search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area, so that the search and rescue success rate is improved, and after a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supplying robot cooperates with the left crawler-type search and rescue robot to reach the target position, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the effective search and rescue time is strived for to the maximum extent through the cooperative work of a large number of robots in the target position.

title_en: Geological disaster hidden trouble point distribution prediction method based on neural network integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster hidden danger point distribution prediction method based on neural network integration, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining geological environment data and preprocessing, S2, constructing and training a heterogeneous model integrated by a graph convolutional neural network and a multi-layer perceptron, S3, combining residual connection and a attention mechanism to enhance the characteristic recognition capability of the model, optimizing model parameters through a cross entropy loss function, S4, evaluating the heterogeneous model through cross verification, calculating precision, mean square error and confidence level, dynamically distributing integration weight, S5, weighting and fusing the model output according to the integration weight, introducing Bayesian uncertainty estimation to generate a risk distribution probability map, S6, quantifying hidden danger point risk level, mapping into a two-dimensional space distribution map, and visualizing, S7, screening hidden danger points with the risk level higher than a threshold value, and outputting a prediction result. The invention provides a high-precision and reliable geological disaster hidden danger prediction method through an integrated neural network and a depth fusion technology.

title_en: Electric power system scheduling method and system for uncertainty in ice disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preventive optimization scheduling, and discloses a power system scheduling method and system of uncertainty in ice disaster weather, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining prediction data of the ice disaster weather, calculating wind speeds at all moments of a power transmission line in a power system, and obtaining wind speed information of the line at all moments; the method comprises the steps of calculating the icing thickness of a line at each moment based on wind speed information, constructing a comprehensive load model of the line, calculating the fault rate of the power transmission line at each moment in ice disaster weather based on the comprehensive load model, constructing a line fault rate model in the ice disaster weather, constructing a power transmission line fault fuzzy set, a power transmission line fault state supporting set and a wind-light-water prediction deviation uncertain set in the ice disaster weather, and constructing a two-stage distribution robust optimization scheduling model based on the line fault rate model and the uncertain set to obtain an optimal unit start-stop and line maintenance scheme. The operation cost of the power system under the extreme weather condition is effectively reduced, and the phenomena of wind discarding, light discarding and water discarding are reduced.

title_en: Building disaster evaluation uncertainty optimization method for coupling multi-source data with random distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data and random distribution coupled building disaster damage assessment uncertainty optimization method which comprises the steps of collecting historical flood data of different cities and different types of buildings, meshing an assessment area, simulating and generating high-resolution water depth data of each grid unit by using a HiPIMS model, verifying and generating disaster damage data of each grid by combining remote sensing data, generalizing the cost of the different types of buildings by using building cost data in urban statistics annual authentication, assessing the building flood vulnerability based on a meshing method, and quantifying assessment uncertainty of the building flood vulnerability by using a confidence level analysis method. The method solves the problems of multi-source data fusion and accurate classification of buildings, unifies the scale difference of flood characteristics and socioeconomic data, introduces quantitative uncertainty of a confidence level analysis method, remarkably improves evaluation accuracy and reliability, and provides scientific support for urban disaster prevention and reduction, risk management and planning.

title_en: Multi-source fusion-perceived space-world integrated geological disaster identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a multisource fusion-perceived space-earth integrated geological disaster identification method and system. The method comprises the steps of acquiring satellite images of a target area acquired by a static orbit satellite, a synthetic aperture radar satellite and a polar orbit satellite in real time, performing time interpolation and spatial super-resolution reconstruction on multi-source heterogeneous satellite image data to obtain three types of satellite images with consistent space and time and uniform resolution, synchronously inputting the three types of satellite images into a pre-trained coarse-granularity disaster recognition model to obtain a macroscopic probability map reflecting geological disaster risks, identifying a local area with high risk, then mutually matching with ground monitoring equipment, an unmanned plane and the like to obtain a complete high-resolution image, and finally inputting the high-resolution image into a pre-trained fine-granularity disaster recognition model to obtain a geological disaster recognition result. The invention solves the problems of the existing geological disaster monitoring scheme in real-time and accurate aspects.
assignees: ANHUI MINGSHENG HENGZHUO TECH CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: DRO-based energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling method under typhoon strong uncertainty
abstract_en: The DRO-based energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling method under typhoon strong uncertainty comprises the steps of S1, constructing a typhoon field model by considering uncertainty of typhoon paths and strength, S2, describing fault rates of overhead lines and towers of a power distribution network power transmission line under typhoon disasters, constructing a power distribution network power transmission line fault model, describing line fault uncertainty by utilizing moment fuzzy sets, constructing a power distribution network power transmission line fault fuzzy set, S3, constructing a DRO-based two-stage energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling model, optimizing pre-disaster layout positions of MES in a first stage, optimizing power output schemes of SES and MES in typhoon disasters in a second stage, S4, acquiring typhoon forecast information and power distribution network information, and S5, inputting the acquired information into the two-stage energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling model, and obtaining an energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling strategy under typhoon strong uncertainty based on CG and C & CG.

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for analyzing instability risk of bedding slope containing weak interlayer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering slope instability risk analysis, in particular to a method, equipment and medium for analyzing instability risk of a soft interlayer-containing bedding slope. According to the technical scheme, the complex and uncertain slope engineering problem is converted into a computable and inferable probability map model. The full life cycle disaster control factors from natural conditions, geological conditions, engineering design, construction and operation maintenance are systematically combed, the omission of key factors is avoided, and the comprehensiveness of risk analysis is ensured. The traditional qualitative causal analysis is upgraded to quantitative probability dependency relationship, and a mathematical model foundation is provided for subsequent risk diagnosis and prediction. The crossing of risk analysis from "static evaluation" to "dynamic reasoning" is achieved. The model not only can give a static risk value, but also can dynamically update the probability of all relevant variables after new evidence (such as monitoring data) is obtained, thereby realizing intelligent diagnosis and prediction.

title_en: Two-stage self-adaptive robust elastic lifting method for high-proportion renewable energy power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage self-adaptive robust elastic lifting method of a high-proportion renewable energy power distribution network, which comprises the specific steps of establishing a two-stage self-adaptive robust optimization model for a power system in a pre-disaster stage and a post-disaster stage, establishing an uncertainty scene set according to the output and load demands of renewable energy sources, determining an objective function of a min-max-min structure of the two-stage self-adaptive robust optimization model and constraint of the power system, decomposing the min-max-min structure of the two-stage self-adaptive robust optimization model, decomposing the model into a main problem of the min structure and a sub problem of the max-min structure, iterating the main problem and the sub problem, and solving an optimal power supply recovery strategy.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Remote sensing image segmentation method based on foreground perception network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image segmentation and discloses a remote sensing image segmentation method based on a foreground sensing network, which comprises the steps of constructing the foreground sensing network based on a coder and decoder structure and constructing a combined loss function; the method comprises the steps of training a foreground sensing network, utilizing the trained foreground sensing network to divide to obtain a class probability map of each pixel, carrying out multi-scale classification on the class probability map based on dynamic multi-resolution attention and combining environmental characteristics, dynamically adapting a post-processing strategy, and carrying out post-processing according to the adapted post-processing strategy so as to optimize a division result. According to the invention, through multi-scale feature fusion, environment self-adaptive post-processing and geographic semantic constraint, an end-to-end intelligent segmentation framework is constructed, segmentation precision, robustness and practicability in a complex remote sensing scene are remarkably improved, and an efficient solution is provided for the fields of natural resource management, disaster emergency response and the like.

title_en: Real-time early warning system and method for disaster of coal mine tunnel roof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and discloses a real-time early warning system and method for a coal mine roadway roof disaster, wherein the real-time early warning system and method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequence reasoning on monitoring data acquired in real time, respectively judging whether a roof key physical quantity triggers primary early warning or secondary early warning by acquiring an expected value prediction curve and an uncertainty boundary curve of the roof key physical quantity in a future time step, acquiring corresponding early warning information when the early warning is triggered, constructing a dynamic causal graph, inputting the early warning information and the currently acquired key physical quantity into the dynamic causal graph to carry out reasoning, calling candidate intervention measures based on the acquired current state node to carry out anti-fact reasoning in the dynamic causal graph, acquiring a risk track and a risk inhibition efficacy index of the candidate intervention measures, sequencing and preferring the risk inhibition efficacy index, and outputting a causal early warning report containing an optimal intervention scheme, thereby improving the scientificity and effectiveness of the risk inhibition.
assignees: JINING MINING IND GROUP CO LTD XIAOYUN COAL MINE

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster power supply recovery method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for recovering power supply of a power distribution network after a disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current state information of a power distribution network system; and acquiring an optimal control strategy of the power distribution network according to the current state information of the power distribution network system and the trained power supply model, wherein the trained power supply model is obtained by training the power supply model through a training sample and a training label. The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for recovering power supply of a power distribution network after a disaster, aiming at uncertainty in a micro-grid system, a power supply model is trained, so that the power supply model can fully learn a plurality of uncertain factors in the micro-grid during training, and the robustness of the method is improved; and by utilizing the trained power supply model, the power supply model does not need to be solved again in different scenes, so that the recovery capability of the power distribution network and the load power supply duration are improved.

title_en: Natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bayesian network-based natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method, which uses an emergency model to carry out basic modeling on a natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission change process, utilizes the advantages of the Bayesian network on uncertainty event analysis on the basis, analyzes a basic model, extracts the association relation between key elements and elements to form a node table and an adjacent matrix, builds the Bayesian network on the basis to carry out reasoning calculation, and realizes the carbon emission change analysis of a power system under the action of multiple natural disasters. The method provides support for subsequent disaster prevention optimization, energy structure optimization, emission reduction and carbon fixation measures and the like of the power system, and can be applied to analysis of other complex carbon emission processes.

title_en: Goaf collapse disaster risk partition grading assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a goaf collapse disaster risk partition grading assessment method, which comprises the steps of determining the instability probability of each ore pillar in a goaf, assuming any ore pillar to be unstable, judging the condition that the instability of the ore pillar causes the instability of other ore pillars by adopting a repeated iteration instability method until the instability is ended, determining the quantity of induced ore pillars in the rest ore pillar groups, calculating disaster result values of the ore pillars, obtaining disaster result values of all the ore pillars according to the method, calculating the risk weight value of each ore pillar to be unstable, and finally determining the risk grades of all the ore pillars in the goaf to obtain a goaf collapse disaster risk partition grading cloud picture. Based on the pillar group stability theory, uncertainty of pillar strength is considered, and potential of goaf collapse, especially goaf linkage collapse induced by single pillar instability, is quantified by introducing the induced pillar, so that risk partition grading evaluation of goaf linkage collapse disasters is realized, and the goaf linkage collapse disasters can be used for guiding related personnel to conduct differential treatment on different risk grade areas.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring system based on microwave and wireless transmission
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forest fire prevention monitoring system based on microwave and wireless transmission. The forest fire prevention monitoring system comprises a monitoring center and monitoring stations, wherein each monitoring station comprises a monitoring room and a monitoring terminal, each monitoring terminal comprises a visible-light camera, a microwave transmitter and a wireless data transmission module A, each monitoring room comprises a microwave receiver and a monitoring room display, outputs of the microwave receivers are connected to the monitoring room displays, and the monitoring center comprises a central processor, a wireless data transmission module B and a TV wall. The forest fire prevention monitoring system based on microwave and wireless transmission has the beneficial effects that images shot by the monitoring terminals are sent to a duty room and the monitoring center respectively, if the fire is small or the phenomenon of uncertainty occurs, only the operator on duty goes to check out for extinguishing the fire, and if the fire is severe, the monitoring center sends additional personnel and instructs the firefighting.
assignees: JING LIN CHENGDU SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent deduction and inundation probability visualization system, method and medium for dike breach situation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dike breach rescue and discloses an intelligent deduction and inundation probability visualization system, method and medium for dike breach. The engineering intervention deduction engine is constructed based on a physical guided nerve operator, takes a two-dimensional multi-physical reconstruction field comprising pile body positions, material distribution, flow velocity fields and terrains as input, directly outputs the water flow velocity-water depth physical field time course of a future period, the on-line self-evolution engine triggers fine adjustment of a model by comparing deviation of a deduction result and real-time monitoring data, and an uncertainty quantitative visual interface dynamically displays the deduction result in a probability inundation thermodynamic diagram mode. The invention initiates a deduction framework of fusion of physical constraint and nerve operator, solves the technical problems of low calculation efficiency of traditional numerical simulation and inconsistent physical of a pure data driving method, realizes unification of minute-level deduction speed and physical rule compliance, and provides real-time and reliable scientific decision support for levee breach rescue.

title_en: Small watershed torrential flood disaster risk analysis method based on information diffusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small watershed torrent disaster risk analysis method based on information diffusion, which introduces an information diffusion theory, takes limited historical torrent data as a basis, integrates samples with single-value observation values under the incomplete information condition into fuzzy integrated value samples with fuzzy uncertainty, establishes a torrent disaster information matrix, and introduces the calculation of a Pearson's triple curve, an override probability and a confidence coefficient, thereby realizing the rapid quantitative evaluation of torrent disaster risks through limited knowledge and leading the result to be closer to the actual condition. This patent can improve the objectivity and the scientificity of mountain torrent calamity risk analysis result.

title_en: Source network load collaborative elastic lifting method and system considering multi-fault uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to a source network load collaborative elastic lifting method and a system considering multi-fault uncertainty, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power transmission network information and constructing a multi-type fault probability distribution uncertainty set under typhoon disasters; based on a distribution robust optimization idea, constructing a source network load collaborative elastic lifting model considering the multi-type fault probability distribution uncertainty set; based on the Benders decomposition and column and constraint generation ideas, solving the source network load collaborative elastic lifting model by adopting an original-dual parallel decomposition algorithm to obtain a source network load collaborative planning strategy. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of reducing line investment and power failure loss of the most serious fault scene under typhoon disasters to different degrees, further coordinating the economical efficiency of the power system and the elastic lifting target and the like.

title_en: Gas-electricity combined distribution network distribution robust extension planning method considering system toughness constraint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of planning of a gas-electricity combined system and toughness improvement, in particular to a gas-electricity combined network distribution robust expansion planning method considering system toughness constraint, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a gas-electricity combined network expansion planning model taking the sum of operation cost and planning cost as an objective function, considering the capability of changing fuel supply load when natural gas of a dual-fuel unit is insufficient under a disaster in the aspect of improving the toughness, further modeling the construction of the dual-fuel unit and a connecting line, and considering constraints such as power distribution network reconstruction at the operation level, and secondly establishing a two-stage distribution robust expansion planning model considering the toughness constraint of the gas-electricity combined network system under the extreme disaster by using a distribution robust optimization method based on KL divergence to consider the uncertainty of the influence of the extreme disaster. The method can improve the economical efficiency of the gas-electricity combined distribution network in normal operation and enhance the toughness capability in extreme disasters.

title_en: Intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of safety prediction and early warning, and comprises the steps of obtaining online monitoring historical data of a tailing dam, preprocessing data, constructing a GRU main prediction model to predict main prediction displacement, obtaining an error sequence through actual measurement data and the main prediction displacement, decomposing the error sequence into a trend item and a noise item error sequence through PSO-VMD-TOPSIS, respectively constructing a trend item and noise item error correction model based on GRU, obtaining error correction values and standard deviations of the trend item and the noise item through MC-dropout technology, constructing a dynamic weight calculation mechanism, obtaining a final displacement prediction value and a confidence interval through combining the main prediction displacement, judging whether to alarm or not, realizing high-precision real-time prediction, uncertainty quantization and real-time early warning of the tailing dam displacement, and providing intelligent decision support for the safety state assessment and disaster early warning of the tailing dam.

title_en: Search and rescue resource scheme generation method based on search theory and related equipment
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide a search and rescue resource scheme generation method and related devices based on a search theory, including: acquiring accident information and search and rescue capacity information of search and rescue resources; determining the search area and the discovery probability of search and rescue resources so as to determine the search success rate; determining a comprehensive score of the search and rescue resources according to the search and rescue capacity information so as to determine a robustness score; and determining a solution set based on a multi-objective decision analysis algorithm, determining an optimal solution set according to the search success rate and the robustness score, and generating and outputting an optimal solution scheme. One or more embodiments of the present disclosure determine the search success rate and the robustness score of the search and rescue resources based on the accident information and the available search and rescue resource information, and perform analysis and solution to provide a more reasonable search and rescue resource scheme to assist a decision maker in making a scientific decision, so that a task allocation scheme for the search and rescue resources can be efficiently completed, the search and rescue time is saved, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Optimal conservation power distribution network recovery method based on information decision and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal conservative power distribution network recovery method based on information decision and a storage medium, wherein an uncertain parameter is defined and a robustness function is required to be used for determining a risk avoidance area of power distribution line interruption and the total damage length of the risk avoidance area, an optimal topology reconstruction method is realized through a linear optimization model, and a method for adjusting the input of the model through a new conservative selection algorithm is realized. The method comprises the steps of establishing a resilience model based on an information gap decision theory, establishing an execution method of the resilience model, establishing a new conservative degree selection method, optimizing the resource allocation of the distributed power supply, performing topology reconstruction and the like. The method for recovering the power distribution network under the extreme uncertainty of the natural disaster is realized, the reliability and the recovery force of the power distribution network can be obviously improved, the optimal optimization effect can be obtained under the limited budget, and meanwhile, the tolerance to the length of the power failure line is improved under the same load level.

title_en: Cluster system formation collision prevention control method based on constraint following
abstract_en: The invention provides a cluster system formation collision prevention control method based on constraint following, which comprises the following steps: establishing a dynamic equation of a cluster system; based on a control strategy of constraint following, a constraint condition of formation collision avoidance is proposed; the constraint function is designed, so that compact formation and collision prevention can be completed at the same time, and the problem of dimension disaster caused by the increase of the number of individuals of the cluster system can be solved; obtaining a corresponding constraint matrix based on the constraint function; forming a collision avoidance control design for the cluster system, wherein the collision avoidance control design comprises a nominal system control design without uncertainty and initial state error and a control design of an uncertain system; an adaptive law is designed to estimate the combined impact of uncertainty on the system. By the method, the cluster system can realize compact formation and collision avoidance under the condition of uncertainty, and can solve the problem of dimension disasters.

title_en: Multi-unmanned water surface ship maritime search and rescue path planning method based on POS-DQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned-ship maritime search and rescue path planning method based on POS-DQN, and relates to the technical field of path planning. Aiming at the problem of reasonably and efficiently completing maritime search and rescue tasks of multiple unmanned ships, the maritime search and rescue path planning method which is reasonable in task allocation and capable of searching high-probability areas preferentially is provided based on an improved task allocation algorithm and a POS-DQN deep reinforcement learning algorithm. The invention firstly uses an improved task allocation algorithm to integrally divide the search area, so that the task area of each unmanned ship has priority and no repeated division. Secondly, the invention considers the POS of the search environment and provides a POS-DQN algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning. The algorithm can adapt to complex changing environments of search and rescue, and the probability weight rewarding function is utilized to train a plurality of unmanned boats to obtain an optimal search path. Finally, on the basis of considering the whole coverage of obstacle avoidance and collision avoidance, the search path can search the high-probability area preferentially, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Elastic micro-grid networking method and system considering ice disaster disconnection uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elastic micro-grid networking method and system considering ice disaster disconnection uncertainty, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network toughness improvement, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving line outage probability and preset ice melting decisions, and generating a decision-dependent uncertainty fuzzy set between a deicing decision and line disconnection based on a dynamic coupling relation between the line outage probability and the preset ice melting decisions; the method comprises the steps of establishing a two-stage distribution robust model in advance based on a decision-dependent uncertainty fuzzy set between deicing decisions and line breaks, solving the two-stage distribution robust model based on a constraint generation algorithm and an alternative optimization method to obtain an elastic micro-grid networking result, and improving the toughness of the distribution network to ice disasters.

title_en: Underwater target search and rescue strategy determination method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining an underwater target search and rescue strategy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining marine environment information of a target sea area, calculating motion characteristics of an underwater target according to the marine environment information, constructing a dynamics model, predicting a target track of the underwater target based on a Monte Carlo algorithm and combining the dynamics model, constructing a grid probability model, preliminarily determining a search strategy based on the grid probability model, dynamically updating probability distribution through Bayesian theory to optimize the search strategy, and establishing a cost-effectiveness analysis model to secondarily optimize the optimized search strategy. The uncertainty of the environment and the target motion is fully considered, and the reliability of track prediction is improved. And constructing a grid probability model, dynamically updating probability distribution and optimizing a search strategy through Bayesian theory, so that the search has pertinence and the efficiency is improved. Through optimizing the strategy secondarily, optimal allocation of resources is realized, the search and rescue effect is guaranteed, the cost is controlled, and the economical efficiency and the practicability are improved.
assignees: NO 707 INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Disaster risk assessment method and system based on hesitation fuzzy set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster risk assessment method based on a hesitation fuzzy set in the field of disaster assessment research, and aims to solve the problem that the accuracy and the usability of an assessment result are low due to the fact that the traditional disaster risk assessment depends on uncertainty information too much, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of the disaster risk assessment are improved. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of converting hesitation fuzzy semantic terms into interval numbers by means of a rough set thought, expressing uncertain information such as urban water disaster occurrence frequency, severity and tightness by adopting the hesitation fuzzy semantic terms, sequencing risk modes by means of DEMATEL analysis of net influence degree of risk factors and a VIKOR method, and constructing a disaster risk assessment model.

title_en: Distributed power supply loss reduction planning configuration method and device for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed power supply loss reduction planning configuration method and device for a power distribution network, which are characterized by establishing a load uncertainty set and a natural disaster uncertainty model in the power distribution network, establishing a distributed power supply configuration model for power distribution network loss reduction according to a random robust optimization theory based on the load uncertainty set and the natural disaster uncertainty model, performing random optimization model and robust optimization model decomposition on the distributed power supply configuration model, solving a distributed power supply installation position, and performing distributed power supply configuration according to a distributed power supply installation position solving result. The invention simultaneously considers the influence of load fluctuation and natural disasters based on a random robust optimization theory, so that the distribution of the distributed power supply is more effective, the loss reduction effect of the distribution network is more reasonable, and the technical problems that the existing distributed power supply configuration method does not simultaneously consider the fluctuation of the load and the uncertainty of the natural disasters, influences the effectiveness and the low reliability of the distributed power supply configuration are solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Toughness improving method for electrothermal communication system under endogenous uncertainty and nonlinear reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toughness improvement of an electrothermal information physical system, and discloses a method for improving toughness of an electrothermal communication system under endophytic uncertainty and nonlinear reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of: an electric wired communication network model and a thermal wireless communication network model, and a natural disaster uncertainty set model established based on decision-dependent uncertainty; then taking the minimum total investment and running cost as an objective function, and performing dimension reduction and linearization treatment on the electric heating information physical system toughness collaborative lifting model by utilizing an improved Yen's algorithm, so as to establish an electric heating information physical system toughness lifting linearization model; and finally, reconstructing the uncertainty problem into a deterministic problem by a strong dual theory, and generating a robust cutting plane solving method by using the proposed relaxation columns and constraints. The invention realizes the toughness improvement of the electric heating information physical system more economically, reduces the threat of natural disasters to the system and ensures the operation safety of the system.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system toughness assessment method based on Kolmogorov equation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy systems, in particular to a comprehensive energy system toughness assessment method based on a Kelmogorov equation. The method comprises the steps of constructing a random differential equation of the multi-energy system, decomposing a system change process into a system slow change process and a system fast change process, deducing the characteristics of the system slow change process and the system fast change process by utilizing historical data of extreme disasters, calculating expectations and variances of the system slow change process and the system fast change process, obtaining probability distribution of the system operation process, constructing a forward equation of the Kolmogorov, calculating the entropy value of the Kolmogorov, solving a drift coefficient and a diffusion coefficient, inputting the data of the predicted extreme disasters to be faced into the forward equation of the Kolmogorov, combining an optimized scheduling strategy of the multi-energy system, solving the probability distribution of emergency load shedding of the system, and evaluating the toughness uncertainty of the system by using the probability distribution, supporting a subsequent toughness lifting means, and having important significance for guaranteeing safe and stable operation of the social folk and comprehensive energy systems.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling charging network toughness assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electric power-traffic coupling charging network, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis. According to the method, an electric power-traffic coupling charging network is built, a Bezier curve is combined to simulate a typhoon path and a Holland wind field model to calculate wind speed, dynamic traffic flow distribution, alternating current optimal power flow and cascading fault models are built, a Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate a fault data set, a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to train a fault prediction model, a dynamic probability map is output after the actually measured wind speed is input, and dynamic toughness indexes are calculated to evaluate the toughness of the electric power-traffic coupling charging network. According to the method, the problem of fault propagation and insufficient dynamic evaluation among the systems is considered, and the toughness evaluation precision of the power-traffic coupling charging network under typhoon disasters is improved.

title_en: Multi-source fusion-perceived space-world integrated geological disaster identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a multisource fusion-perceived space-earth integrated geological disaster identification method and system. The method comprises the steps of acquiring satellite images of a target area acquired by a static orbit satellite, a synthetic aperture radar satellite and a polar orbit satellite in real time, performing time interpolation and spatial super-resolution reconstruction on multi-source heterogeneous satellite image data to obtain three types of satellite images with consistent space and time and uniform resolution, synchronously inputting the three types of satellite images into a pre-trained coarse-granularity disaster recognition model to obtain a macroscopic probability map reflecting geological disaster risks, identifying a local area with high risk, then mutually matching with ground monitoring equipment, an unmanned plane and the like to obtain a complete high-resolution image, and finally inputting the high-resolution image into a pre-trained fine-granularity disaster recognition model to obtain a geological disaster recognition result. The invention solves the problems of the existing geological disaster monitoring scheme in real-time and accurate aspects.

title_en: Marine rescue resource allocation scheme optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue scheme optimization in the technical field of marine rescue, and discloses a method for optimizing a marine rescue resource allocation scheme, which comprises the following steps: obtaining the types and the quantity of search resources which can be provided according to the received search and rescue tasks and the maximum allowable search and rescue time; calculating a target search area and an actual rescue position based on the water falling point of the person falling into water and the sea condition when the person falls into water; calculating a total search range and a total search time of a single search resource of different search schemes based on the search resource and the target search area; calculating the total needed sea rescue time based on the searching total time and the actual rescue position; based on the total maritime rescue time, the maximum allowable search and rescue time and the total search range of a single search resource, and combining the state and sea conditions of people falling into water, the optimal search and rescue scheme is obtained through screening. The rescue plan can be rapidly and effectively planned, precious search and rescue time is saved, search resources are optimally allocated, and the probability of successfully searching the target is maximized.
assignees: BEIJING JINGHANG COMPUTING COMMUNICATION RES INST

title_en: Coal mine disaster intelligent linkage method based on space-time event chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent linkage method for coal mine disasters based on a space-time event chain, which belongs to the technical field of mining and information and comprises the following steps: step 1, arranging sensors at key positions in a coal mine stope so as to sense environmental parameters in the stope in real time; step 2, storing data by adopting a self-defined data storage mode, fusing and integrating the spatio-temporal data acquired from different sensors, and establishing a complete spatio-temporal event chain; step 3, modeling and deducing the data in the event chain by applying a probability map model; step 4, automatically identifying abnormal conditions of the coal mine stope by utilizing a Boltzmann machine model; and 5, estimating and updating the state of the coal mine stope in real time by using a particle filtering algorithm, automatically triggering an early warning signal according to a preset early warning rule or a threshold value, and automatically generating a rescue scheme and a disaster avoidance route. According to the invention, by constructing a space-time event chain, dynamic monitoring, information acquisition, multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis of coal mine disaster events are realized.

title_en: Geological disaster automatic identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster automatic identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing data, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, wherein the identification method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source remote sensing data of a region to be detected and performing cross-modal registration to generate a registered multi-source data set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-modal feature extraction based on a multi-source data set and carrying out space-time correlation analysis to obtain a multi-modal feature map, carrying out dynamic weight distribution on the multi-modal feature map to generate a fusion feature vector and inputting the fusion feature vector into a pre-trained geological disaster prediction model to output a geological disaster probability map, carrying out binarization segmentation on the geological disaster probability map to obtain a potential disaster area mask, and carrying out risk classification on the potential disaster area according to the geological disaster probability map and the potential disaster area mask and based on a preset joint judgment rule of the surface deformation rate and gradient features to obtain a risk class distribution map of an area to be detected. The disaster prediction method and the disaster prediction device can improve disaster prediction precision and enhance emergency response capability.
assignees: SHAANXI GEOLOGY AND MINERAL FIRST GEOLOGICAL TEAM CO LTD

title_en: A kind of decision-making technique of uncertain emergency materials distribution
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of decision-making technique of uncertain emergency materials distribution, mainly for the initial stage occurred in extensive accident, in the case of Disaster degree, material requirements and road condition are uncertain fuzzy quantity, fuzzy decision Element Theory is expanded into uncertain fuzzy decision Element Theory, to support decision under uncertainty index.On this basis, using fairness, benefit and feasibility as principle, index Design is carried out to emergency materials allocation unit decision system, so that science quickly determines that emergent life is required assistance the allocative decisions of goods and materials between multiple disaster-stricken points so that first batch of life rescue goods and materials can play maximum utility.The present invention in the case of relevant information is uncertain, science decision method can be provided for the quick allocative decision for determining life rescue goods and materials in multiple disaster areas in initial stage of disasters.

title_en: Coal mine gas safety evaluation method based on D-S evidence theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine gas safety evaluation method based on a D-S evidence theory, which comprises the following steps of S1, setting classification indexes and constructing an identification framework; s2, obtaining original data and calculating a plurality of evidence source data for evaluation; s3, designing a basic probability distribution function by adopting a posterior probability modeling method; s4, correcting a basic probability distribution function, reducing the conflict of evidence data for evaluation, S5, adopting a conflict distribution coefficient, improving a Dempster combination rule, and fusing the evidence data for evaluation; s6, uncertainty measurement is carried out by using Shannon entropy, and decision suggestions are provided; according to the invention, the predicted value of the monitoring data is used as evidence source data, so that the gas safety state is prejudged in advance, and the emergency level and the control capability of the gas disaster are improved; the Dempster combination rule is improved, the accuracy of fusion data is improved, and the automation and the credibility of evaluation are improved.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization, which comprises the following steps of S1, converting a to-be-searched and rescue area into a two-dimensional search and rescue area, S2, conducting grid decomposition on the two-dimensional search and rescue area, S3, obtaining a probability map through a Gaussian mixture model, S4, establishing a multi-target collaborative optimization function of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, S5, solving the function based on a mixed particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution, and generating a specific search and rescue path of an unmanned aerial vehicle according to the solved optimal solution. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue multi-objective collaborative optimization function, the unmanned aerial vehicle is guided to execute the search and rescue task by taking the resource balanced allocation, the maximum path safety, the priority coverage of the high-risk area and the minimum energy consumption as targets, the task allocation, the path planning and the energy management are improved, the multi-objective optimization of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path planning is realized, the accurate flight path is determined for each unmanned aerial vehicle, the whole coverage of the search and rescue task is ensured, and the search and rescue efficiency and the success rate are remarkably improved.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning. The monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a model construction module and a disaster early warning module. According to the invention, the displacement and shear stress of the rock-soil body are predicted through the displacement-hydrologic-geological coupling prediction model, so that the comprehensive influence of the mechanical state and environmental factors of the rock-soil body on the rock-soil engineering disasters can be more comprehensively reflected, the coupling effect of each item of monitoring data can be comprehensively considered, the prediction error and uncertainty caused by the data loss or the single model can be effectively reduced, the hydrologic data are processed through causal convolution, the long-term dependency relationship among the hydrologic data can be effectively captured, the relevance and hysteresis between the water level, rainfall and pore water pressure can be embodied, the accuracy of model prediction can be remarkably improved, and the early warning accuracy of the monitoring and early warning system is also improved.
assignees: FUJIAN RONGQI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Path planning method and device for searching of unmanned aircraft and unmanned aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method and a path planning device for unmanned aircraft searching and an unmanned aircraft, and belongs to the technical field of offshore intelligent search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: analyzing the marine accident information by adopting a Monte Carlo random particle simulation method to establish a particle initial distribution map; performing cluster analysis on the initial particle distribution by using a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), and determining a target search area corresponding to the probability of the best particle based on a corrosion expansion confidence ellipse algorithm; s2: establishing an under-actuated unmanned aircraft steering mathematical model adaptive to boundary characteristics, and determining a steering non-working path; s3: and optimizing the global search discovery probability and the search total path based on a double-normalization multi-target search planning algorithm to obtain an area coverage optimal path planning strategy. The invention provides a search area determining method, improves a classic parallel line sea sweeping search strategy to realize area search planning, and improves the search success probability of the people in distress on the premise of putting limited search force.

title_en: Loose water-bearing sand layer grouting modification effect checking method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a loose water-containing sand layer grouting modification effect inspection method, a system, a medium and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine roof water-bursting sand-bursting disaster prevention and control. The point data of the treatment holes distributed in the point shape are converted into the surface data with continuous space through the spatial interpolation process, the suspicious target area is quickly grouting according to the water permeability partition map, the treatment weak area is determined by adopting a ground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination method, the treatment weak area is comprehensively judged by adopting a downhole drilling-geophysical prospecting combination method, and finally the loose water sand layer grouting treatment effect test result is obtained. The water permeability partition map is introduced as an objective basis for defining a suspicious grouting target area, so that subjectivity and uncertainty of selection of an inspection area in the traditional technology are avoided, and blindness in engineering design of conventional grouting effect inspection and verification is avoided according to a flow of defining the suspicious grouting target area, rapidly positioning and treating a weak area through ground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination and verifying the weak area through underground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination.
assignees: ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL & ELECTRIC CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Node recovery importance expected value evaluation method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a node recovery importance expected value evaluation method, a system, a device and a medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining power grid operation information and a power transmission line fault probability evaluation result, and initializing an integral calculation parameter and a round of calculation parameter of sampling simulation based on the power transmission line fault probability evaluation result; sequentially identifying the power grid states of the power transmission line and the node at each time point through iterative sampling of sampling simulation of the recoverable state, removing the power transmission line and the node which do not meet the recoverable requirement in each round of sampling results, calculating the importance degree of the reserved power transmission line and the node, integrating the sampling results after all iterative rounds are finished, and calculating the importance index and the expected operation time value of the damaged power transmission line and the node based on the importance degree of the power transmission line and the node. According to the method, the node importance which considers the influence of disaster uncertainty is dynamically evaluated and updated on line, so that the identification capability of key nodes and lines of the power grid in a recovery state is remarkably improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Ship search and rescue path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship search and rescue path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-ship search and rescue mathematical model, wherein a ship set, a waypoint set and an unpaired waypoint set are defined in the multi-ship search and rescue mathematical model, constructing a state parameterized model diagram covering a search and rescue area based on the multi-ship search and rescue mathematical model, constructing a search model diagram according to the state parameterized model diagram, and planning search and rescue paths according to the state parameterized model diagram and the search model diagram. By constructing a mathematical model and two model diagrams, the complex search and rescue path planning process is simplified, the planning efficiency is remarkably improved, and the planning time is shortened. The multi-aspect factors such as ship set and waypoint set are comprehensively considered, so that the planned search and rescue path is more reasonable, the coverage integrity and accuracy of a search area are improved, search and rescue tasks and paths of a plurality of ships can be reasonably distributed, optimal allocation of search and rescue resources is realized, and the resource utilization efficiency is improved.
assignees: NO 707 INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: High-permeability power distribution network risk identification model and system based on dynamic power flow analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vulnerability assessment and pre-disaster risk management of power systems, in particular to a high-permeability power distribution network risk identification method based on dynamic power flow analysis. The existing vulnerability assessment method focuses on static analysis, ignores uncertainty of dynamic tide and distributed generation output, and cannot accurately identify weak links in a power distribution network. The invention provides a vulnerability assessment method based on dynamic power flow analysis. According to the method, a Latin hypercube sampling method is adopted to generate a plurality of distributed power generation output scenes, power grid tide under different weather and load conditions is simulated, and key components in a power distribution network are identified by combining tide calculation and vulnerability analysis, so that scientific basis is provided for risk assessment and emergency response before disaster. Compared with the traditional method, the method can more comprehensively consider the uncertainty of the distributed power generation output and the dynamic characteristics of the power distribution network, and improves the vulnerability identification accuracy of the power distribution network under the condition that the high-permeability renewable energy is accessed to the power distribution network. In addition, the vulnerability of the nodes and the branches in the power system is uniformly evaluated, more comprehensive and reliable technical support is provided for pre-disaster prevention and emergency response of the power grid, and important theoretical value and practical application prospect are achieved.

title_en: Electrical interconnection system toughness assessment and improvement method considering seismic uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical interconnection system toughness evaluation and improvement method considering seismic uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: enumerating the combination of the seismic source position and the seismic level gear, and obtaining the probability of each potential seismic scene according to the seismic disaster probability model; then, intensity distribution of different earthquake scenes is obtained through an intensity attenuation model, and the failure probability of the elements based on the intensity is worked out according to a pre-built electrical interconnection system; solving the load reduction amount under each order of fault state by applying an electrical interconnection system load reduction optimization algorithm based on a two-stage gas network optimization load flow model; calculating toughness indexes according to the probability of each potential earthquake scene, the element failure probability and the load reduction amount under each order of fault state, wherein if the system level toughness index is lower than a set standard value, the planning scheme reaches the standard, otherwise, a toughness improvement strategy needs to be implemented; and obtaining a plurality of alternative schemes according to the element-level toughness indexes, and making an element strengthening scheme through cost-benefit analysis so as to correct the planning scheme.

title_en: Landslide edge recognition method and system integrating CNN and ViT
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide edge recognition method and system fusing CNN and ViT, which belong to the field of landslide edge recognition and comprise the steps of obtaining a remote sensing image and a corresponding digital elevation model image of a landslide area, inputting the remote sensing image into the CNN, extracting a first characteristic map, inputting the digital elevation model image into ViT, extracting a second characteristic map, constructing an edge response map based on the first characteristic map, calculating a fuzzy perception map, constructing a structure expected map based on the second characteristic map, fusing the fuzzy perception map and the structure expected map pixel by pixel to form an occlusion risk thermodynamic map, fusing the occlusion risk thermodynamic map through a cross attention mechanism to generate boundary compensation characteristics, forming a fused characteristic map by the boundary compensation characteristics and the non-occlusion area characteristic map, and inputting the fused characteristic map into a decoder to generate the landslide edge probability map. The method and the device remarkably improve the accuracy of landslide boundary identification under the dust shielding condition, and can be used for the fields of primary disaster edge identification and secondary disaster emergency judgment.

title_en: Urban flood disaster dynamic emergency decision method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic emergency decision method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for urban flood disasters, and relates to the technical field of emergency management and response scheduling. The method comprises the steps of constructing a random differential game model for flood disaster emergency decision, solving a game saddle point strategy through a forward-backward scanning algorithm to obtain an optimal emergency prevention and control strategy, carrying out multi-dimensional simulation verification by taking a typical flood disaster event as a sample, and finally adjusting the strategy according to a simulation result to form a target emergency prevention and control strategy and using the target emergency prevention and control strategy for actual emergency decision. The application can give consideration to space-time dynamic characteristics and random uncertainty in emergency decisions of urban flood disasters, and realize dynamic adaptation and continuous efficient decisions of disaster systems and emergency response systems.

title_en: Improved maritime search and rescue region predicting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved maritime search and rescue region predicting method and an improved maritime search and rescue region predicting system. A dynamic drifting trajectory of a maritime search and rescue target object can be predicted according to existing meteorological and environmental data, a three-dimensional flow field, an improved AP98 air pressure model and a maritime search and rescue target drifting trajectory calculation model. The improved air pressure drifting model fully considers the uncertainty that motion in the side wind direction at each moment of a drifting target, so that a search and rescue region is more precise.
assignees: XIAMEN LANHIT INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster information providing system, disaster information providing method, and disaster information providing program
abstract_en: To appropriately calculate an estimated value of a damage scale due to a disaster even when there is a missing value in a report value of the damage scale and an unexpected disaster occurs.SOLUTION: The disaster information providing system holds a report value including a missing value of a damage scale of a disaster at each of a plurality of points, adjacency information indicating an adjacency relationship between points, and a probability distribution model in which the damage scale at each point follows, and calculates an estimation value including uncertainty of a damage scale at a point having a report value that is a missing value and a parameter controlling a spatial random effect included in the probability distribution, based on the report value, a spatial random effect of each point based on the adjacency information, and the probability distribution model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for multidimensional parameters in electrical impedance imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quantifying uncertainty of multidimensional parameters in an electrical impedance imaging technology. According to the method, a deep neural network is trained to construct a substitution model of an original uncertainty system, and then the uncertainty parameter analysis and quantification are carried out on the basis of the deep neural network substitution model and combined with a single-variable-element dimension reduction method, so that the distribution of uncertainty output is finally obtained. And compared to a baseline method to evaluate the performance of the method of the invention. The result shows that the method has high calculation precision and can accurately quantify the uncertainty of output; when the uncertainty dimension of the parameters is increased, the uncertainty quantization problem of the high-dimensional parameters can be effectively solved, the dimension disaster is relieved, the limitation of whether interaction exists between variables is avoided, and the calculation cost is effectively reduced. In addition, the method can be widely applied to the uncertainty system quantification in other complex fields.

title_en: Method for demarcating large-deformation landslide displacement field based on high-resolution remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for demarcating a large-deformation landslide displacement field based on a high-resolution remote sensing image. The method is that two geometric models are utilized to perform ortho-rectification for the high-resolution remote sensing image and corresponding DEM at different time phases in a search area; after the preprocessing and high-precision image matching, a vector set model is created based on the accurately matched feature points with the same feature points; the space displacement field of a landslide body can be demarcated according to the model. With the adoption method for early warning of large landslide disaster, in particular the landslide disaster under a complex terrain, the sliding landslide can be automatically found out and subjected to macroscopic monitoring, so that the macroscopic displacement direction and displacement of the large deformation landslide body at some time quantum can be obtained, and the sliding range can be determined; the basic data and basis can be provided to accurately monitor the landslide displacement and early warn the landslide disaster. The system and the method are mature in technology, low in cost, convenient to operate, quick to calculate, and high in accuracy; the scientific basis can be provided to monitor and evaluate the landslide disaster, and the safety in fire preventing and reduction can be ensured.

title_en: Communication equipment deployment method and device, storage medium and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication equipment deployment method, a device, a storage medium and an intelligent terminal, and relates to the technical field of the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the disconnection position of a disconnection user, wherein the disconnection position is the last position of the disconnection user; determining a searching area according to the disconnection position, wherein an area center point of the searching area is a coordinate point corresponding to the disconnection position; and deploying a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles for searching the offline user in the searching area, wherein the area searched by different unmanned aerial vehicles is partially different. According to the invention, the last position of the lost user is used as a search center to determine the possible search area where the lost user stays, and a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles are arranged in the search area to cruise, so that the time for finding the position of the lost user can be shortened, and the search and rescue efficiency of the lost user can be improved by quickly inspecting the search area through an unmanned aerial vehicle set formed by the unmanned aerial vehicles.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINGTIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
