title_en: Flexible resource allocation optimization method and device based on elastic planning model
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible resource allocation optimization method and device based on an elastic planning model. An optimization objective is determined by targeting a first cost at all random failure scenarios in a set of random failure scenarios consisting of failure scenarios occurring in the power distribution network due to natural disasters (e.g., extreme weather events), a second cost of distributed power sources in the power distribution network, and a third cost compensating for interruptible loads in the power distribution network. Based on a particle swarm algorithm, combining an optimization target and a target constraint condition followed by the optimization target, carrying out iterative updating on each particle to obtain a configuration optimization scheme of flexible resources in the power distribution network, overcoming the limitation that only single flexible resources are configured and optimized in the related technology, fully utilizing the potential and synergistic effect of each flexible resource, comprehensively considering the uncertainty and the diversity of random fault scenes caused by natural disasters, and improving the adaptability and the robustness of the configuration optimization scheme, thereby improving the disaster resistance and the disaster reduction capability of the power distribution network.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Geological disaster emergency decision method and system based on self-adaptive generation type AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster emergency decision method and a system based on self-adaptive generation type AI, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster emergency response and artificial intelligence intersection, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing; S2, landslide segmentation and uncertainty quantification, S3, feature extraction and uncertainty gating, S4, high confidence report Prompt construction, S5, low confidence retrieval enhancement processing, S6, final report generation and output, S7, active learning and model iteration. The geological disaster emergency decision method based on the self-adaptive generation type AI is used for realizing high-efficiency analysis, omitting emergency labeling and retraining cost, improving the reliability of a report, combining an external professional knowledge base which can be dynamically maintained, and enabling a power assisting system to self-evolve, so that the identification accuracy and robustness are continuously improved, and the low confidence coefficient target is reduced.

title_en: Search-and-rescue method and system based on differential measure random meet uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search-and-rescue method and system based on differential measure random meet uncertainty. The method comprises the following steps: 1, determining a path L along which a lost person D gets lost, and determining a position point where the lost person D is located on the path L finally; 2, measuring a position point where a searcher C is located on the path L; 3, calculating probability density functions pc and pd that the searcher C and the lost person D are distributed on the path L and the probability that C can meet D when being located at a point of the path L, and finding a position point xm corresponding to the maximum value of the differential meet probability; calculating the meet probability that the searcher C can find the lost person D on the path L; 5, arranging the searcher C to conduct search and rescue on the path L according to the position point corresponding to the maximum value of the differential meet probability and the meet probability obtained through calculation.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion environment anomaly detection method under communication limited condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, in particular to a multi-sensor fusion environment anomaly detection method under a communication limited condition. The sensor node is used for collecting multidimensional environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, methane, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide concentration and the like in real time, the multisource data are fused through a Dempster-Shafer evidence theory, the conflict and uncertainty of the sensor are solved, and the one-dimensional convolutional neural network 1DCNN classifier is used for identifying fire disaster abnormality based on the fused data. The invention adopts the edge computing technology to deploy the DSET filter and the 1DCNN classifier on the microcontroller. The method not only reduces the dependence on cloud computing, but also improves the real-time performance and the data security of the system. By local processing, the system remains efficient even in the event of network disruption or delay.

title_en: Ground-air combined cooperation search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground-air combined cooperative search and rescue system, which comprises: the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a robot group consisting of a plurality of crawler-type search and rescue robots and an electric energy supply robot for providing electric energy; the unmanned aerial vehicle, the crawler-type search and rescue robot and the electric energy supply robot are all scheduled and controlled by a server; according to the invention, the suspected search area is determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the search value is better than that preset, the left crawler-type search and rescue robot can continue to perform search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area, so that the search and rescue success rate is improved, and after a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supplying robot cooperates with the left crawler-type search and rescue robot to reach the target position, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the effective search and rescue time is strived for to the maximum extent through the cooperative work of a large number of robots in the target position.

title_en: Rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change, which comprises the following five steps of (I) collecting future daily rainfall data in a global climate model and performing scale reduction treatment, (II) quantifying time-varying characteristics of non-stationary rainfall variables under the influence of climate change, (III) establishing a rainfall interval-rainfall duration alternating random process update model considering climate change, (IV) analyzing vulnerability of a rainfall slope considering uncertainty of rock-soil parameters, and (V) estimating the slope instability probability based on a full probability theorem convolution rainfall disaster curve and a slope vulnerability curve in a future predefined time. Compared with the prior art, the invention provides a new rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change, realizes quantitative characterization of non-stationary rainfall caused by climate change effect, and provides an effective method for more accurate estimation of future rainfall slope instability probability.

title_en: Intelligent mountain torrent disaster early warning monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of natural disaster early warning, and discloses an intelligent early warning mountain torrent disaster monitoring system which comprises a data acquisition unit, a risk prediction unit and a dynamic utility evaluation unit, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring multi-source dynamic monitoring data and static geographic data, the risk prediction unit is connected with the data acquisition unit and is used for generating probabilistic prediction of mountain torrent disaster states in a specific time window in the future based on the multi-source dynamic monitoring data and the static geographic data, and the dynamic utility evaluation unit is used for combining a preset decision maker risk preference model and a public trust dynamic evolution model to quantify the comprehensive utility of different early warning decisions under different disaster situations. By fusing the multi-element heterogeneous data and applying a hybrid prediction model of dynamic Bayesian network and Gaussian process regression, the accuracy and reliability of mountain torrent risk prediction are obviously improved. Compared with the early warning mode relying on a single data source or a simple model in the prior art, the method effectively overcomes the defect that the data is not fully utilized and uncertainty is difficult to quantify.

title_en: Electric automobile behavior clustering and peak clipping scheduling method based on DQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle behavior clustering and peak clipping scheduling method based on DQN, and belongs to the technical field of electric vehicle and power grid interactive scheduling. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting EV charge and discharge data and power grid operation data, accurately grouping EV users by utilizing MEAN SHIFT and K-means++ combined clustering algorithm to reduce decision dimension, then constructing a dynamic excitation electricity price and user response uncertainty model based on a Logistic function, then establishing a hierarchical optimization model, finally constructing a Markov decision process based on the model, and performing strategy optimization training by adopting DQN to generate a specific scheduling scheme. The method effectively solves the problem of dimension disaster caused by large-scale EV access, achieves the dual goals of obviously reducing peak load of the power grid and optimizing and reducing charging cost of users, and improves the running stability and dispatching economy of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER;LUOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Simple typhoon moving direction prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simple typhoon moving direction prediction method, which comprises the following steps: 1. acquiring physical quantity and time sequence of the physical quantity on the lattice constant pressure surface; 2. preprocessing the physical quantity to ensure that the time intervals are equidistant and calculating the total time; 3. performing multi-scale subspace transformation scale decomposition on the physical quantity; 4. computing kinetic energy regular transmission between typhoons and environments in which typhoons are located 5. Intercepting typhoons within 7 degrees of the center And vertically averaging the two components; 6. calculating typhoon center The direction of the dipole. The prediction method only predicts by the existing data, does not need large-scale numerical prediction, and saves a large amount of calculation amount and precious time on the premise of ensuring accuracy. Timely comments are provided for coping with typhoon disaster early warning decisions, typhoon disaster protection policies can be adjusted more timely, panic of public on typhoon disaster uncertainty is reduced, public can transfer property early, and direct economic loss is reduced.

title_en: Reservoir-lake-river system extreme flood simulation and flood control risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir-lake-river system extreme flood simulation and flood control risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method firstly identifies risk source factors of historical extreme flood events, and utilizes Vine Copula functions to describe the uncertainty of spatial distribution of the risk source factors, and Latin hypercube sampling is used for generating a risk source factor sample; the method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out a sampling analysis on a sample, then carrying out sample reduction based on a Neural Gas algorithm, constructing a risk source factor scene tree, combining historical flood data and adopting a homonymy scaling method to generate an extreme flood process line scene, then constructing a combined flood control optimization scheduling model, evaluating flood control risks of reservoirs and lakes, and analyzing evaluation effects. The invention has simple structure, accurate and stable risk assessment, is not only beneficial to the fine risk assessment of the high-incidence area of the flood disasters, but also provides theoretical support for extreme flood risk assessment in the data-deficient area.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue device and method based on sound wave positioning
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle rescue device and a method based on sound wave positioning comprise an unmanned aerial vehicle, a ground trapped person matching device and a ground control PC, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is internally provided with a communication module, a loudspeaker, an unmanned aerial vehicle end audio frequency identification module and a sound source positioning module, the ground trapped person matching device comprises a wearable bracelet and a portable sound production device, the wearable bracelet is in communication connection with the portable sound production device, the wearable bracelet is internally provided with a Bluetooth module, a ground person end audio frequency identification device and a sound production device control module, a search area covers the whole target area by controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to hover at intervals in the search area, the portable sound production device is controlled to emit audio signals after the audio signals emitted by the unmanned aerial vehicle are identified by the ground person end audio frequency identification device, the unmanned aerial vehicle calculates the coordinate information of ground persons according to the received audio signals and the time delay of a microphone and performs marking and, and transmits the information to the ground control PC.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle collision risk perception method based on conditional risk value
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle collision risk perception method based on a condition in-danger value, which utilizes risk information caused by uncertainty of obstacle positions when an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomously flies in a complex environment to search paths, and improves the safety of autonomous operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle. Firstly, establishing a random walk model describing uncertainty of a heart position of an obstacle substance, and solving joint distribution of random variables of non-independent positions based on a Copula function; then, establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle motion and dynamics model, and defining a safe flight airspace; secondly, quantifying collision risk of the unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting a risk measurement index based on the condition risk value, generating a risk map, and setting a risk threshold value to reduce conservation; and finally, designing a CVaR-A algorithm, and searching a collision-free optimal path. The method can remarkably improve the autonomous safety obstacle avoidance performance of the unmanned aerial vehicle in an unstructured environment, and can be used for unmanned aerial vehicle operation tasks in dangerous extreme scenes such as emergency rescue material delivery, harmful gas leakage monitoring and the like.

title_en: High-cold mountain area slope space-time probability prediction method considering snow cover change
abstract_en: The invention provides a space-time probability prediction method for a slope of a alpine mountain area, which considers the change of snow cover, combines a remote sensing model, a climate model and slope stability analysis, comprehensively considers the change of snow cover and the influence of the snow cover on the future climate change, and can more accurately predict the space-time probability of the slope of the alpine mountain area. The accuracy and the reliability of slope space-time probability prediction are effectively improved by accurately detecting the current snow coverage range, scientifically predicting the future snow coverage range change and reasonably determining the rainfall parameter for slope probability prediction, and more powerful support is provided for early warning and prevention and control of geological disasters. The invention considers the temperature and snowfall change under different climate change situations in the future, so that the prediction result can better adapt to the uncertainty of the climate change, and provides scientific basis for the sustainable development of the alpine mountain area.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cluster formation cooperative safety control method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, in particular to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cluster formation cooperative security control method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining brief information of a target search area and unmanned aerial vehicle information of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster; the method comprises the steps of adopting a first analysis model to analyze brief information and unmanned aerial vehicle information to obtain an initial cooperative control strategy, controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster according to the initial cooperative control strategy and obtaining monitoring information and image acquisition information of a first type formation of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, carrying out image analysis on the image acquisition information of a disaster area to obtain state evaluation information of the disaster area, and regulating unmanned aerial vehicles and standby unmanned aerial vehicles which are executing tasks in the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in real time according to the state of the unmanned aerial vehicles so as to complete preset tasks in a single image acquisition task. The unmanned aerial vehicle cluster power utilization system and the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster power utilization method can solve the problems that due to the fact that the scheme in the aspect of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster power utilization and distribution is small, the duration of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster formation is short, and task interruption occurs frequently due to insufficient power.

title_en: Disaster explore robot and operating method of thereof
title_ko: 재난 탐사 로봇 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a disaster exploration robot capable of performing a precise investigation on a target, and an operation method thereof. The disaster exploration robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a movement unit moving the disaster exploration robot; a measurement unit which acquires an image of a search area; a recognition unit which detects a plurality of objects from the image and recognizes coordinates of each of the plurality of objects; a communication unit transmitting the image to a remote device; and a control unit which sets the at least one object as a target object and controls the movement unit to move to coordinates of the target object, when the communication unit receives a selection of at least one of the plurality of objects from the remote device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 의한 재난 탐사 로봇은, 상기 재난 탐사 로봇을 이동시키는 이동부; 와 탐색 지역에 대한 영상을 획득하는 측정부; 와 상기 영상으로부터 복수개의 물체를 검출하고, 상기 복수개의 물체 각각의 좌표를 인식하는 인식부; 와 상기 영상을 원격기기에 전송하는 통신부; 및 상기 통신부가 상기 원격기기로부터 상기 복수개의 물체 중 적어도 어느 하나의 물체에 대한 선택을 수신하는 경우, 상기 적어도 어느 하나의 물체를 목표 물체로 설정하고, 상기 목표 물체의 좌표로 이동하도록 상기 이동부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent identification system and method for earthquake ground surface fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster emergency monitoring, in particular to an intelligent identification system and an intelligent identification method for an earthquake ground surface fracture zone, wherein the intelligent identification system comprises modules of heterogeneous data registration, feature extraction and fusion, fracture zone segmentation, active learning, form optimization and the like, and realizes accurate processing of remote sensing data and intelligent identification of the fracture zone; the system adopts multi-scale feature point matching and self-adaptive weight registration, improves the data registration precision by more than 30%, overcomes the dependence of the traditional method on artificial experience, combines multi-scale space pyramid pooling and deformation sensitive segmentation through multi-mode feature decoupling and attention-directed feature fusion, effectively identifies fracture zones and evaluates prediction uncertainty, optimizes training data through Bayesian estimation and mixed sampling strategies by an active learning module, and finally outputs accurate fracture zone distribution and attribute information by a morphological optimization module through geological constraint and fault topological reasoning, thereby improving the intelligent level and efficiency of earthquake disaster emergency monitoring.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning. The monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a model construction module and a disaster early warning module. According to the invention, the displacement and shear stress of the rock-soil body are predicted through the displacement-hydrologic-geological coupling prediction model, so that the comprehensive influence of the mechanical state and environmental factors of the rock-soil body on the rock-soil engineering disasters can be more comprehensively reflected, the coupling effect of each item of monitoring data can be comprehensively considered, the prediction error and uncertainty caused by the data loss or the single model can be effectively reduced, the hydrologic data are processed through causal convolution, the long-term dependency relationship among the hydrologic data can be effectively captured, the relevance and hysteresis between the water level, rainfall and pore water pressure can be embodied, the accuracy of model prediction can be remarkably improved, and the early warning accuracy of the monitoring and early warning system is also improved.

title_en: Rainfall evaluation method based on Multi-source Information Fusion
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of rainfall evaluation method based on Multi-source Information Fusion, including：Rainfall data are observed by earth station in survey region and survey region multi-source satellite rainfall product data body is combined, constitute survey region multi-source data collection；Establish Bayes's precipitation predicting model of the survey region based on Dynamic Bayesian theory；The non-linear optimal solution of Bayes's precipitation predicting model is sought using maximum entropy method, and then determines the optimal weight and unascertained information in each satellite data source；Optimal weight based on satellite data source and uncertainty generate the estimation result of application Multi-source Information Fusion rainfall in survey region.Advantage is：The result of multiple data sources convergence analysis of the present invention reduces since the Regional Rainfall amount that the inaccuracy of certain single class rainfall data is brought estimates uncertainty；For reinforced region high-precision disaster alarm, evade flooding risk or Storm flood of small basins estimation provides the input of more structurally sound data and the more rich modeling data more refined.

title_en: A kind of higher-dimension complication system Uncertainty Analysis Method based on statistical machine learning
abstract_en: The higher-dimension complication system Uncertainty Analysis Method based on statistical machine learning that the invention discloses a kind of, wherein method includes: the uncertain factor that selection influences higher-dimension complication system, and obtains high n-dimensional random variable n input sample matrix；By high n-dimensional random variable n input sample matrix, and be converted to low-dimensional stochastic variable sample matrix；High n-dimensional random variable n input sample matrix is calculated one by one, obtains output response moment matrix；Random response face agent model is precisely modeled, is obtained about the approximate random response surface model of studied higher-dimension complication system height；The mean value and variance of random response surface model output response amount are obtained by derivation of equation method；Uncertain factor is analyzed according to mean value and variance, obtains analysis of uncertainty result.This method has many advantages, such as that calculated result has high-accuracy, reduces calculation amount on the basis of guaranteeing computational accuracy and improve computational efficiency, avoids " dimension disaster " problem and degree of flexibility is high.

title_en: Intelligent identification system and method for earthquake ground surface fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster emergency monitoring, in particular to an intelligent identification system and an intelligent identification method for an earthquake ground surface fracture zone, wherein the intelligent identification system comprises modules of heterogeneous data registration, feature extraction and fusion, fracture zone segmentation, active learning, form optimization and the like, and realizes accurate processing of remote sensing data and intelligent identification of the fracture zone; the system adopts multi-scale feature point matching and self-adaptive weight registration, improves the data registration precision by more than 30%, overcomes the dependence of the traditional method on artificial experience, combines multi-scale space pyramid pooling and deformation sensitive segmentation through multi-mode feature decoupling and attention-directed feature fusion, effectively identifies fracture zones and evaluates prediction uncertainty, optimizes training data through Bayesian estimation and mixed sampling strategies by an active learning module, and finally outputs accurate fracture zone distribution and attribute information by a morphological optimization module through geological constraint and fault topological reasoning, thereby improving the intelligent level and efficiency of earthquake disaster emergency monitoring.

title_en: A kind of Robot Extinguishing Fire system and Intelligent fire-fighting robot of Multi-sensor Fusion
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Robot Extinguishing Fire system of Multi-sensor Fusion and Intelligent fire-fighting robots, belong to firefighting robot technical field.The Robot Extinguishing Fire system of the Multi-sensor Fusion of the utility model, including main control module, infrared sensor, UV sensor, visual sensor, water fog sprinkler and powder extinguishing system, infrared sensor and UV sensor are connect with main control module respectively, visual sensor is bi-directionally connected by host computer and main control module, and main control module is connected with water fog sprinkler and powder extinguishing system respectively.The utility model quickly finds fire behavior using infrared sensor, UV sensor and visual sensor and fire behavior is identified, later fire extinguishing processing is carried out using water spray and the segmentation of fine mist fire-fighting mechanism and dry powder bullet fire suppression mechanism, realize the specific aim fire extinguishing processing of different fire behaviors, fire-fighting efficiency and accuracy are more preferable, can preferably cope with uncertainty and the variability of fire behavior.
assignees: BEIJING ZIAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for wind speed of atmospheric boundary layer
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of boundary layer wind speed numerical calculation in atmospheric science, and particularly relates to an uncertainty quantification method for wind speed of an atmospheric boundary layer. The method comprises the following steps: 1, decorrelating the viscosity coefficient of the random turbulence by utilizing K-L decomposition; 2, projecting the multivariate response value to a dimension by using a projection resampling method; 3, solving a full dimension reduction conversion matrix by using a slice inverse regression method; 4, regarding the dimension reduction space obtained in the step 3 as a control variable to restrain the error of the Monte Carlo method; and 5, solving the mean value and the variance of the wind speed of the atmospheric boundary layer along with the height change. The effect of inertia item has been kept in this application, has considered the change of torrent stickness coefficient along with the height, and calculates portably, is a practical and effectual mode of research atmospheric boundary layer, and its result is more accurate, and belongs to non-invasive method, can effectively overcome the problem of "dimension disaster", can also guarantee that the precision of result is more excellent simultaneously under the circumstances that the calculated amount is less than the Monte Carlo method.

title_en: Method for evaluating occurrence probability grade of tunnel water inrush disaster in fault fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for evaluating the occurrence probability grade of a tunnel inrush water disaster in a fault fracture zone, which comprises the following steps: designing index system constituent elements; establishing an inrush water disaster occurrence probability evaluation index system; utilizing an expert evaluation mechanism to obtain the membership degree of each level of the evaluation index of the occurrence probability of the inrush water disaster; carrying out weight calculation on the evaluation index of the occurrence probability of the sudden water inrush disaster; and evaluating by adopting a multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. The method overcomes the defect of subjectivity of a hierarchy analysis method decision result in the existing disaster risk evaluation, adopts a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to carry out decision making, utilizes concepts of fuzzy sets and membership degrees to describe and quantify fuzzy uncertainty factors, adopts an entropy weight method to weaken the subjectivity of evaluation, and improves the defect of strong evaluation uncertainty of the grade of the occurrence probability of the tunnel inrush water disaster.

title_en: Uncertainty analysis-based power transmission line environment risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention of a power transmission line, and provides a power transmission line environment risk assessment method based on uncertainty analysis, which comprises the steps of collecting impedance amplitude, phase angle and multidimensional temperature data of a wire, and constructing a multidimensional impedance data set after wavelet noise reduction, temperature compensation and normalization processing; the method comprises the steps of adopting an icing state analysis model to invert the thickness of an ice layer and fuse weather and mechanical parameters to obtain a three-dimensional risk vector, generating a five-dimensional risk parameter matrix based on the fusion time and space dimensions of the three-dimensional risk vector, constructing a risk evolution map, extracting topological critical features through a Morse complex structure and a continuous coherent method to locate high risk critical points, finally combining an NSGA-II multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a risk index and grade early warning result with geographic coordinates, and outputting an environmental risk assessment report of a power transmission line. The icing thickness inversion precision, the risk assessment response speed and the critical point positioning capability are effectively improved, and the method is suitable for power transmission line environment risk early warning under complex terrains and extreme weather.
assignees: CHUXIONG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode data-driven potential disaster intelligent sensing and emergency data engineering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode data-driven potential disaster intelligent sensing and emergency data engineering system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent information processing, and comprises a super-surface communication module, a communication node and a communication node, wherein the super-surface communication module calculates phase gradients between the communication nodes by utilizing a disaster risk probability map and terrain height data to generate a beam forming matrix, performs low-power consumption non-line-of-sight data transmission, monitors link quality and feeds back communication energy consumption to generate an encrypted data packet; the system comprises a cloud coordination module, a rescue decision module and a communication power consumption data and a feedback topographic parameter, wherein the cloud coordination module decrypts the encrypted data packet and carries out three-dimensional disaster deduction to generate a disaster influence thermodynamic diagram, and the rescue decision module utilizes an improved path planning algorithm to carry out path optimization on the disaster influence thermodynamic diagram to generate an optimized rescue path, and combines the communication power consumption data and the feedback topographic parameter to generate updated communication power and redundancy configuration parameters. The invention greatly improves the reliability and the energy utilization efficiency of emergency communication and ensures the stability and redundancy of the communication link in the key area.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Mountain torrent early warning method and system based on meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent early warning method and system based on meteorological data, and relates to the field of mountain torrent early warning; calculating the small-river-basin runoff and the surface runoff according to the characteristics of the small-river-basin torrential flood, obtaining the ratio of the flow peak value to the river basin area according to the flow peak value obtained in the process of calculating the small-river-basin runoff and carrying out early warning on the torrential flood disaster according to the ratio of the flow peak value to the river basin area. The invention improves the accuracy of the mountain torrent early warning, can effectively cope with randomness and uncertainty in the mountain torrent incident process, and reserves enough reaction time for the mountain torrent early warning.
assignees: GUOTIE CHUANZANG SCIENCE AND INNOVATION CENTER CHENGDU CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Gaussian process method and device for rapidly identifying stability coefficient of sliding karst dangerous rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Gaussian process method and device for rapidly identifying a stability coefficient of sliding karst dangerous rocks, and mainly solves the problem of reasonably identifying the anti-sliding stability safety coefficient of sliding unstable collapse type dangerous rocks in a karst region. Firstly, selecting 14 characteristic indexes which significantly influence the stability coefficient of the sliding karst dangerous rock; secondly, establishing a machine learning sample set through collection of a plurality of engineering examples and calculation of stability coefficients; then, training and testing a GPR model by adopting a cross validation strategy; further, inputting a new dangerous rock mass to be recognized into the trained GPR model, and directly outputting a recognition result with probability significance of the stability coefficient of the dangerous rock mass to be recognized; and finally, quantitatively evaluating the uncertainty of the identification result. The method can be used for rapidly identifying the stability coefficient of the large-batch slippage type dangerous rock mass in the karst region, and is particularly suitable for geological disaster management or technical personnel application without professional background knowledge and experience of calculation and analysis of the stability of the dangerous rock mass.

title_en: Deep learning-based power transmission channel surrounding environment classification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for classifying surrounding environments of a power transmission channel based on deep learning, wherein the method and the system comprise the following steps: acquiring a high-resolution remote sensing image of the surrounding environment of a power transmission channel to be classified; inputting the high-resolution remote sensing image into a pre-trained deep learning model to generate a class probability map of the surrounding environment of the power transmission channel; classifying the power transmission channel surrounding environment based on the class probability map; the deep learning model is obtained by training by using an object-oriented classification method based on the historical remote sensing images and the probability of each ground object type in the historical remote sensing images. The classification of the surrounding environment of the power transmission channel is realized by utilizing the deep learning model and the object-oriented method, the high-resolution remote sensing image can be further utilized to classify the ground surface covering objects around the power transmission channel, and meanwhile, basic data support and auxiliary decision basis are provided for the safe operation of power facilities, emergency rescue planning and the like.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of disaster monitoring early warning platform construction method based on SOA framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to be based onSOAThe disaster monitoring early warning platform construction method of framework, solving current Geological Hazards Monitoring early warning is by monitoring and the progress early warning of monitoring device Threshold Alerts of manually patrolling mostly, but the diversity and uncertainty of the factor due to inducing geological disaster, and the usually interspersed complicated geogen that blends, management and evaluation to data become abnormal difficult defect.This invention makes full use ofSOAThe lower coupling feature of framework willAIWarning Service preferably with monitoring system combine, while using machine learning algorithm processing complex data and precise classification advantage, the hazard assessment of risk source and monitoring object evaluation on the basis of,The data of each monitoring object of real-time monitoring, a series of grade for varying strength geological disasters that certain period may occur in predicted area of danger, for different risk areas the characteristics of, propose the every countermeasure reduced risks, and provide aid decision for Geological Hazards Monitoring early warning.

title_en: Critical rainfall early warning method for torrential flood disasters in multi-scenario mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a critical rainfall early warning method for torrential flood disasters in a multi-scenario mode, which comprises the following steps of: collecting disaster prevention object data by taking the small watershed as a unit; determining the early soil state; determining the type of rainstorm which possibly occurs locally to carry out rainfall time course distribution design; combining the contextual models; determining critical rainfall under different situation modes; and selecting corresponding critical rainfall grading early warning according to different weather conditions. The method considers the torrential flood disaster outbreak conditions under different scenes under natural conditions, focuses on the uncertainty influence of designing the rainfall type and the early-stage soil state, combines the actually measured data of the control section of the small watershed, calculates different critical rainfall values in a trial mode, issues corresponding torrential flood early warning according to the actual situation, and verifies that the torrential flood disaster early warning mode under the multi-scene mode is feasible through the actually measured disaster torrential rain flood process inspection, so that the fitness of the torrential flood disaster early warning and the natural conditions is improved, and the reliability, the credibility and the applicability of the torrential flood disaster early warning are further improved.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue instrument based on infrared detector
abstract_en: The application discloses a maritime search and rescue instrument based on an infrared detector, which comprises a supporting frame and a detector main body; the detector main part bottom is provided with places the case, the department of holding frame bottom central point puts and is fixed with the back shaft, and the back shaft passes through the bearing and places case internal connection. Drive guide frame and movable plate horizontal reciprocating motion through the dwang, thereby drive gear revolve through the tooth piece, then drive through the back shaft and place case reciprocating motion, in the time of the search area of increase detector main part, through reciprocating search's mode, guarantee the validity of searching, the search effect of searching and rescuing the appearance has been improved, and labour saving and time saving more, thereby pivoted angle when can searching the detector main part is adjusted, adjust the search area of detector main part with this, be convenient for according to the actual search condition improvement search efficiency as far as, be convenient for adapt to different search heights, the suitability of searching and rescuing the appearance has been improved greatly, also can guarantee the stability when the carriage is placed simultaneously.

title_en: Method for determining optimal search area of maritime crash airplane and drowning person
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an optimal search area for a maritime crash airplane and drowning personnel. According to the method, firstly, the crash position of the maritime crash airplane is calculated by using the airplane crash model according to the known air crash information. And then, based on the calculated crash position of the maritime crash airplane, calculating the optimal search area of the maritime crash airplane and the personnel falling into the water by using a search target drift model according to the information of the crash position. The method solves the problem of low success rate of maritime search and rescue depending on experience and judgment of search and rescue personnel, and has important significance for improving the success rate of maritime search and rescue.

title_en: Method for constructing forest fire early warning system, decision method and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a forest fire early warning system, a decision method and a device thereof, wherein the method for constructing the forest fire early warning system comprises the steps of acquiring a weather condition set, a date set and a relation set in different areas; generating an incomplete T-ball type fuzzy relation set according to the weather condition set, the date set and the relation set; constructing a complement method aiming at the incomplete T-ball type fuzzy relation set; generating a fire early warning standard set according to the T-ball fuzzy relation set; and constructing a forest fire early warning system according to the weather condition set, the date set, the relation set, the incomplete T-ball type fuzzy relation set and the fire early warning standard set. The scheme can solve the problems of imperfection and uncertainty of the relation between weather factors and the possibility of occurrence of the fire under the background of the actual forest fire early warning, improves the accuracy and problem processing efficiency of the forest fire early warning, and enables forest firefighters to intuitively know the instant relevant information of the forest fire so as to timely judge the situation.
assignees: SHANXI INFORMATION INDUSTRIAL TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SHANXI

title_en: Power distribution network topology reconstruction method based on extreme disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network topology reconstruction method based on an extreme disaster scene, which considers the uncertainty of disaster occurrence through a random optimization method, optimizes the power distribution network topology on the basis of accurately predicting the probability distribution of a power grid fault scene, and realizes the optimal topology reconstruction of the power distribution network under the extreme disaster fault. The virtual tide method is adopted to keep the radial operation of the power distribution network, and the power and voltage balance of the power distribution network under the topology reconstruction is considered, so that a power distribution network topology reconstruction model based on extreme disaster scenes is constructed. According to the invention, the current natural environment and the actual situation that severe weather frequently occur are considered, the fault occurrence scene is considered through a random optimization method, the topology of the power distribution network is reconstructed, and the power supply reliability and the safety of the power distribution network under extreme disasters are ensured.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on multi-granularity cascade forest model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SAR image change detection method based on a multi-granularity cascade forest model, which mainly solves the problem of strong dependence of a traditional method on a difference map, and the implementation scheme is as follows: given two registered multi-temporal SAR images I 1 And I 2 (ii) a To I 1 And I 2 Generation of disparity map I by using logarithmic ratio operator d (ii) a To I d Extracting haar-like features and inputting the haar-like features into a trained multi-granularity cascade forest model to generate two probability maps I 1 And I 0 And the difference chart I d Forming new features; retraining the model by using the new characteristics to obtain a new prediction result Handle Kappa coefficient of (2) and last time And selecting a prediction result with a higher coefficient as a final change detection result compared with the Kappa coefficient. The method can effectively inhibit the influence of the difference map on the final result, improve the accuracy of change detection, and can be used for environment detection and disaster detection.

title_en: Simulation method for evacuation process of people in fire, evacuation early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating the evacuation process of people under a fire disaster, an evacuation early warning method and a system. The sample is obtained by a simulation method of a personnel evacuation process under the fire, the simulation method comprehensively considers the correlation among building fire spread, structural failure and personnel evacuation in the simulation process, and simulates an evacuation route corresponding to a fire source according to the preset fire source. The evacuation route adopted by the invention is obtained according to the actual simulation condition, the risk uncertainty of fire spread, the resistance uncertainty of structural failure and the environment uncertainty of personnel evacuation are considered, and the real-time evacuation efficiency and the personnel safety under the condition of uncertain structural failure, in particular the safety of fire rescue people, can be improved.

title_en: Transformer substation fire-fighting monitoring model based on multi-information fusion algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation fire protection monitoring model based on a multi-information fusion algorithm, which comprises the following steps: selecting a plurality of sensor measurement signals to obtain a plurality of sensor detection values; describing the measurement trust degree distribution of each sensor according to the detection value of each sensor, and acquiring membership function between the detection value of each sensor and the probability of fire, the probability of no fire and the probability of uncertainty of fire under the framework of fire identification; the method adopts a D-S fire disaster fusion algorithm to perform fusion calculation on the monitoring values of the sensors, and makes an accurate prejudgment on the fire disaster occurrence probability.
assignees: HENAN SHOUZHEN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geomagnetic storm disaster prevention blocking device optimal configuration method based on sensitivity scene
abstract_en: The application relates to an optimized configuration method of a geomagnetic storm disaster prevention blocking device based on a sensitivity scene. The IGF sensitivity model established in the application can effectively reflect the influence of the running characteristics of the magnetoresi-system besides reflecting the uncertainty of IGF. According to the IGF sensitivity scene probability model, the blocking device is optimally configured, so that the number of installation devices can be reduced, and the problem of poor treatment effect caused by IGF amplitude or direction change can be better solved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING TIANHE BENAN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Expressway tunnel fire evacuation research method and system considering uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a highway tunnel fire evacuation research method and system considering uncertainty, and relates to the technical field of tunnel emergency safety, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the evacuation characteristics and the evacuation uncertainty of tunnel fires based on highway tunnel fire evacuation cases; constructing an evacuation behavior uncertainty quantitative model, and inputting the model by using a fuzzy tool box based on MATLAB; setting up a simulation model, setting up a scene through tunnel space meshing, constructing an evacuation rule based on a floor field model, and introducing an evacuation behavior uncertainty quantitative model into evacuation behavior selection; and carrying out simulation experiments of typical scenes and single-factor control fixed scenes in different cross-hole intervals, carrying out sensitivity analysis on the results of the single-factor control experiments, and determining influence factors of evacuation uncertainty. The application is helpful to reveal the uncertainty influencing factors and the influencing mechanism of crowd evacuation under the fire disaster of the highway tunnel, so that the evacuation simulation result is closer to the actual evacuation behavior.
assignees: CHINA COMMUNICATIONS 2ND HIGHWAY SURVEY DESIGN & RES INST

title_en: Damage assessment method and system for shallow foundation bridge under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damage assessment method under a shallow foundation bridge flood disaster, which comprises the steps of constructing a finite element model of the shallow foundation bridge, introducing uncertainty of flood level height, foundation flushing pit length and flushing depth by using a random Pushover method, obtaining bridge pier top yield displacement of the shallow foundation bridge under a plurality of groups of flushing working conditions, calculating first two-order moment of the structure flood fighting capability logarithm, obtaining flood fighting capability, carrying out flood fighting requirement analysis on response of the shallow foundation bridge under different flood flushing environments based on a finite element reliability method, comparing the flood fighting capability with the requirement analysis, assessing failure probability of the shallow foundation bridge under different working conditions, and fitting through a least square method to generate a vulnerability curve of the shallow foundation bridge. The damage assessment method under the flood disasters of the shallow foundation bridge can quantify the influence of multiple factors such as flow velocity, scouring depth and the like on the performance of the shallow foundation bridge, and effectively assess the damage states of all levels of the shallow foundation bridge.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering management system based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and discloses a hydraulic engineering management system based on GIS, which comprises a data access and processing module, a multidimensional factor comprehensive evaluation module, a high-precision DEM generation and calibration module, a flooding simulation module, a scene setting and uncertainty analysis module, a decision support and early warning report module, a machine learning and prediction module and a real-time monitoring and updating module. According to the invention, various factors are introduced, a more accurate risk index is provided, a dynamic adjustment of risk level is supported, the inundation simulation and geological disaster prediction are more close to the actual situation through the high-precision DEM, an automatic early warning mechanism provides powerful technical support for disaster prevention and emergency management, a real-time monitoring updating module ensures rapid updating of post-disaster data, and a detailed support is provided for repairing work.

title_en: It is a kind of that the emergency materials method for optimizing scheduling rescued a little is had more towards how disaster-stricken point
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency materials method for optimizing scheduling for having more and being rescued a little towards how disaster-stricken point, this method consider emergency management and rescue during due to traffic congestion, weather, the influence of the uncertain factors such as road conditions, the uncertainty of haulage time is represented using interval number, establish the multi-objective Model for meeting " crash time is no more than the true degree maximum of crash time limitation and cost of transportation is minimum ", with confidence level highest and the minimum multiple target structure emergency materials Scheduling Optimization Model of cost, uniformity is not had based on confidence level and two targets of cost, introduce the derivation algorithm that ideal point proposes model, the ideal point sought between the two is optimal case, rescue the emergency materials intervention schedule problem of a little how disaster-stricken point to have more and provide method for solving.The inventive method, which solves, calculates simplicity, and required master data is easy to get, and energy aid decision making person determines rapidly rescue method after disaster occurs, and the rescue time of preciousness has been saved for emergency disaster relief action, has been with a wide range of applications.

title_en: A kind of debris flow early-warning method based on rainfall monitoring
abstract_en: The present invention relates to mountain region disaster fields, particularly disclose a kind of debris flow early-warning method based on rainfall monitoring.It combines the test that the critical excitation approaches of mud-rock flow occur and theoretical calculation determination and the calculating of condition of raining probability, the construction method for the pre-warning indexes system that the rainfall that the probabilistic probability of concentrated expression mud-rock flow and debris flow formation start combines.Theoretical method of the present invention is reliable, and computational science is convenient, and warning index is clear, both the Critical Value Problem that rainfall induces mud-rock flow starting had been solved, debris flow formation, the uncertainty in motion process are reflected again, to improve forecast reliability, accuracy and science.

title_en: Quick evaluation method for toughness of power transmission system based on influence increment sensitivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly evaluating toughness of a power transmission system based on influence increment sensitivity, which comprises the following steps of: step 1: inputting initial parameters; step 2: enumerating a transmission system N-order fault state set omega N Initializing a fault state counter s to be 1; and step 3: calculating the load loss I of each fault state s s (ii) a And 4, step 4: calculating the incremental influence DeltaI of each fault state s s (ii) a And 5: if s<S, enabling S to be S +1, and returning to the step 3; otherwise, go to step 6; step 6: calculating a toughness evaluation index value R under the typhoon disaster scene 1 1 (ii) a And 7: calculation of R 1 Partial derivatives of the N order, and the like; finally, calculating a toughness index R of the power transmission system with typhoon uncertainty; the method can quantitatively calculate the variable quantity of the toughness index of the power transmission system when the fault probability of the power transmission branch changes in different typhoon scenes, and further can quickly calculate the uncertainty of the typhoonToughness index of power transmission system.

title_en: Output calculation method and terminal for multi-seaborne wind power plant group under influence of typhoons
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for calculating the output of a multi-seaborne wind power plant group under the influence of typhoons, wherein the obtained historical typhoons track data are trained so as to predict the typhoons track range, and the uncertainty of typhoons tracks is simulated in the mode; according to the predicted typhoon track range, a vortex wind field model is adopted to obtain surrounding wind speed scenes, a wind speed-fan output physical model is built by combining the wind speed scenes, environment parameters and fan parameters of the wind power fields, and then output scenes corresponding to a plurality of wind power fields are calculated according to the wind speed-fan output physical model. In this way, under the condition that typhoon disasters occur in the working environment of the offshore multi-wind power plant, the uncertainty of typhoon tracks can be taken into consideration to change brought by wind power output prediction, so that the cooperative operation of various power supplies under the typhoon disasters is facilitated, and the utilization of wind resources and the operation safety of a power grid are considered.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on negative sample optimization selection strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on a negative sample optimization selection strategy, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring landslide multi-source data: acquiring historical landslide catalogue data, acquiring landslide influence factor multi-source data of a research area, and unifying the spatial resolution, a projection coordinate system and a geographic coordinate system of the landslide influence factor multi-source data; s2: and (3) extracting evaluation factor layer information: extracting evaluation factor information from the multi-source data through a GIS platform, and establishing a landslide susceptibility evaluation index system; s3: three-dimensional slope stability analysis: and carrying out three-dimensional slope stability analysis on the whole research area by Scoops D by utilizing elevation information and bedrock thickness information of the research area. The invention avoids the interference of artificial factors in the process of selecting the negative sample, improves the quality and the interpretability of selecting the negative sample, reduces the uncertainty of selecting the negative sample, and can objectively and efficiently realize landslide susceptibility evaluation.
assignees: WUHAN CAMPUS OF YANGTZE UNIV;SICHUAN YANJIANG PANNING EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Method and system for generating protection strategy optimization of power generation equipment in extreme weather
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of establishing a power generation equipment defense strategy establishment model, wherein the power generation equipment defense strategy establishment model comprises a first layer model and outputting a power generator protection scheme when the cut load is minimum; the method comprises the steps of establishing a disaster attack strategy for a generator protection scheme, setting a second layer model, a third layer model, outputting generator output, load distribution and optimized line flow when expected values of load loss cut down by an attack are minimum, taking the first layer model as a main problem, combining the second layer model and the third layer model as sub-problems, solving the main problem to obtain the optimal generator protection scheme under the current attack plan set, solving the sub-problems to obtain the worst attack strategy after the given generator protection scheme, judging whether convergence conditions are met, outputting a protection strategy of power generation equipment if the convergence conditions are met, and otherwise, carrying out next iteration solution. The invention considers extreme weather effect, improves emergency response capability and capability of coping with uncertainty of the power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network elastic lifting method and device considering typhoon space-time characteristics, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a storage medium and a terminal for elastically lifting a power distribution network by considering typhoon space-time characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of elastic lifting of power distribution networks; the three-layer problem model is obtained by converting an elastic lifting model of the power distribution network, the elastic lifting model of the power distribution network is constructed according to an investment layer model and an attack uncertainty set, the attack uncertainty set is constructed according to space-time characteristics of typhoons and historical fault operation data of the power distribution network, and nodes and branches in the power distribution network are controlled according to solutions to complete elastic lifting of the power distribution network. According to the invention, the influence of the space-time characteristics of typhoons on the branch fault uncertainty of the power distribution network is simulated by utilizing the space-time characteristics of typhoons, and the system elasticity of the power distribution network to typhoons disasters is increased by combining an investment strategy and an operation strategy.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue device and method based on sound wave positioning
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle rescue device and a method based on sound wave positioning comprise an unmanned aerial vehicle, a ground trapped person matching device and a ground control PC, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is internally provided with a communication module, a loudspeaker, an unmanned aerial vehicle end audio frequency identification module and a sound source positioning module, the ground trapped person matching device comprises a wearable bracelet and a portable sound production device, the wearable bracelet is in communication connection with the portable sound production device, the wearable bracelet is internally provided with a Bluetooth module, a ground person end audio frequency identification device and a sound production device control module, a search area covers the whole target area by controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to hover at intervals in the search area, the portable sound production device is controlled to emit audio signals after the audio signals emitted by the unmanned aerial vehicle are identified by the ground person end audio frequency identification device, the unmanned aerial vehicle calculates the coordinate information of ground persons according to the received audio signals and the time delay of a microphone and performs marking and focusing camera shooting, and transmits the information to the ground control PC.

title_en: Intelligent deduction and inundation probability visualization system, method and medium for dike breach situation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dike breach rescue and discloses an intelligent deduction and inundation probability visualization system, method and medium for dike breach. The engineering intervention deduction engine is constructed based on a physical guided nerve operator, takes a two-dimensional multi-physical reconstruction field comprising pile body positions, material distribution, flow velocity fields and terrains as input, directly outputs the water flow velocity-water depth physical field time course of a future period, the on-line self-evolution engine triggers fine adjustment of a model by comparing deviation of a deduction result and real-time monitoring data, and an uncertainty quantitative visual interface dynamically displays the deduction result in a probability inundation thermodynamic diagram mode. The invention initiates a deduction framework of fusion of physical constraint and nerve operator, solves the technical problems of low calculation efficiency of traditional numerical simulation and inconsistent physical of a pure data driving method, realizes unification of minute-level deduction speed and physical rule compliance, and provides real-time and reliable scientific decision support for levee breach rescue.

title_en: Building fire early warning and fire disaster situation assessment system and method based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of building fire early warning based on Internet of Things and fire disaster situation assessment system and method, the present invention has the environmental information being closely connected, electric information with fire by building Internet of Things and gathering in building, feature extraction and data fusion are carried out to the collection information, fire alarm is carried out to building；The present invention gathers building information using Internet of things system is built, the comprehensive information from multiple sensors, data analysis is carried out using data fusion method, accurate, quick early warning is carried out to building fire situation, pass through the weight calculation of much information, effectively filtering interference signal, overcome the uncertainty and limitation of single sensor, improve building fire early-warning and predicting accuracy and effectively condition of a fire situation can be carried out and assess.

title_en: Potential landslide movement path and accumulation state prediction method based on graphic data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential landslide movement path and accumulation state prediction method based on graphic data, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a basic numerical model, 2) generating a sample combination, 3) solving a control equation and saving a sample calculation result, 4) extracting and reconstructing channel data to form a data set, 5) training the model to an suspension condition, and 6) outputting the model to predict the landslide movement path and the final accumulation state according to given information. The method has the advantages that the method can solve the problems that landslide disasters in engineering have multiple uncertain factors, movement paths and damage ranges cannot be accurately predicted, and has a more efficient prediction analysis process for potential landslide disasters with uncertainty under the condition of ensuring accuracy.

title_en: Embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and early warning of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical time sequence monitoring data of a landslide body, constructing a training data set, performing space-time characteristic decoupling on the data, decomposing the data into a global component and a detail component, constructing a double-branch lightweight time sequence convolution network comprising the global branch and the detail branch, completing joint training and self-adaptive weight fusion at a cloud end, performing differential lightweight processing on the trained network, deploying the trained network in an embedded terminal, performing characteristic decoupling and prediction by utilizing a real-time data stream at the embedded end, obtaining a predicted value and uncertainty estimation by combining a lightweight Monte Carlo Dropout method, and finally realizing dynamic threshold calculation and hierarchical early warning. The method effectively solves the problem that the existing method is difficult to consider the prediction precision and the calculation efficiency at the embedded terminal, and achieves real-time, accurate and self-adaptive early warning of landslide disasters.

title_en: Flood inundation drawing method and system integrating social media data and SAR (synthetic aperture radar) images
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood inundation drawing method and a system integrating social media data and SAR images, which relate to the technical field of emergency management and comprise the steps of acquiring text data which are related to a storm flood event and provided with POI address information in social media; the method comprises the steps of generating a rough flood inundation range map and a flood inundation probability map of a disaster area based on DEM data, POI inundation points and corresponding water depth information, confirming a flood inundation probability threshold interval based on field pictures and video data obtained through searching, obtaining a flood inundation range map of an urban built-up area by taking intersection, extracting water body data of different periods according to multi-view SAR images before, during and after a disaster, generating a river inundation range map, and combining the flood inundation range map of the urban built-up area and the river inundation range map to obtain a flood inundation range map of the disaster area. According to the method, the advantages of social media data and time sequence SAR images in urban flood and river flood detection are fully utilized, and high-precision drawing of large-scale flood events is achieved.

title_en: Near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data dual driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data dual driving, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source weather data, processing by adopting a multi-model self-adaptive integrated forecasting method to obtain high-precision weather forecasting data, processing by adopting a multi-dimensional characteristic typhoon path extraction and probability forecasting method based on the high-precision weather forecasting data to obtain probability typhoon path forecasting data, processing by adopting a physical constraint variation assimilation wind field correction method based on the probability typhoon path forecasting data to obtain corrected wind field data, processing by adopting a multi-grid wind-wave-current coupling model solving method based on the corrected wind field data to obtain near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting data, and calculating by adopting an integrated learning near-shore disaster forecasting and uncertainty quantification method to obtain a final forecasting result. The invention realizes the rapid and accurate prediction of the wind, wave, tide and flow of the important offshore areas during typhoons.

title_en: Self-adaptive plain reservoir dam break simulation method for break position
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, discloses a method for simulating dam break of a plain reservoir with self-adaptive break position, and aims to solve the problems of low modeling efficiency, large human error, poor model reusability and the like existing in the traditional method for simulating dam break aiming at uncertainty of the break position of the plain reservoir. According to the invention, the position of the breach is decoupled from the grid profile through a predefined self-adaptive boundary and automatic matching mechanism, the single scene switching is shortened to the minute level, the manual operation error is eliminated, the simulation of the breach at any position of the box dam is supported, the efficiency, the reliability and the flexibility of dam break risk analysis of a plain reservoir are greatly improved, and a powerful technical support is provided for flood control and disaster relief emergency decision.

title_en: Mathematical modeling method for uncertainty of intermittent energy output
abstract_en: The application relates to a mathematical modeling method for uncertainty of intermittent energy output. The existing modeling mode usually adopts historical data to fit the probability distribution of intermittent energy output, can not accurately describe the actual output distribution after natural disasters, and can not consider the influence caused by weather conditions. The application provides a mathematical modeling method for uncertainty of intermittent energy output, which comprises the following steps: step 1: initialization of the maximum expectation algorithm: solving initial values of model parameters by adopting a hard clustering algorithm; step 2: calculating the expectation: carrying out probability calculation aiming at hidden variables of each datum; and step 3: maximization: deducing a Gaussian mixture model parameter iteration formula with weight data; and 4, step 4: repeating the steps 2-3 until convergence. The method has the advantages that the problem of weight brought by different weather types is considered, the intermittent energy output probability distribution with different weights is effectively fitted, the model parameters are updated in real time, and the uncertainty of the intermittent energy in the extreme fault period is more accurately described.

title_en: Mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of power distribution network in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of a power distribution network in extreme weather, which comprises the following steps: establishing an element fault rate model, and modeling an uncertainty scene of a power distribution network with fault disasters; extracting an extreme weather scene by a Monte Carlo method, reducing the extreme weather scene by adopting a K-means algorithm, and extracting the load, the distributed power output and a power distribution network fault scene by adopting Latin hypercube sampling in consideration of the uncertainty of the load and the distributed power output; selecting evaluation indexes from multiple angles, calculating objective weight of each index and constructing a power distribution network reliability and elasticity evaluation index system; taking two indexes of pre-disaster loss and post-disaster recovery rate as optimization targets, and establishing a mobile energy storage optimization planning model considering the whole disaster time period; and solving the mobile energy storage optimization planning model by using a COBL-PSO algorithm. According to the invention, the reliability and elasticity of the power distribution network are improved through the mobile energy storage optimization planning scheme.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster rush-repair operation strategy optimization method considering renewable energy and load uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster rush-repair operation strategy optimization method for a power distribution network, which is characterized in that renewable energy and load uncertainty are considered, a two-stage post-disaster rush-repair operation decision robust optimization model for the power distribution network is firstly constructed, the optimization model is decomposed based on a column and constraint generation method, a double-layer structure problem is converted into a single-layer problem, and an optimized power distribution network rush-repair operation robust scheme is obtained through solving.
