The distribution network emergency repair operation scheme obtained based on the invention can consider the worst case of renewable energy and load uncertainty, can ensure the effectiveness and safety of the recovery process after the distribution network disaster, can accelerate the distribution network emergency repair recovery process, reduces the load loss, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for determining marine rescue search area
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for determining an offshore rescue search area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out drift prediction on the offshore targets to be searched and rescuing based on the drift prediction model to obtain predicted scattered point data meeting the time sequence; under the condition that the search period is determined, determining a target strategy based on the search requirement and the predicted scattered point data, wherein the target strategy is used for determining target scattered points corresponding to the target to be searched and rescuing under the search period in the predicted scattered point data; calculating a target convex hull based on a target algorithm for the target scattered points, and forming a first search area based on polygons formed by the target convex hulls; and calculating a minimum coverage rectangle for the first search area, and forming a second search area based on a calculation result, wherein the search and rescue efficiency of the second search area is higher than that of the first search area. The method for determining the search area of the marine rescue can quickly and effectively determine the search area when the marine rescue task is executed.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Emergency plan validity assessment method considering integrity and operability
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency plan validity assessment method considering integrity and operability, which models an emergency plan according to an emergency response flow; collecting and determining disaster-bearing bodies influenced by emergency and related information thereof; constructing an emergency response logic flow based on the disaster-bearing body; constructing an integrity evaluation index system of the plan text, and determining index weights by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; scoring the index by comparing the text description of the plan, and calculating to obtain an integrity comprehensive evaluation score; constructing a plan implementation operability evaluation index system, and determining index weights by adopting a triangle fuzzy number analytic hierarchy process; and scoring the actual implementation effect, processing the scoring data to eliminate the influence of uncertainty on the evaluation result, and calculating to obtain the operability comprehensive evaluation score. The invention adopts quantitative evaluation to reduce the influence of data blurring caused by subjectivity on the evaluation result as much as possible, has stronger universality on the effectiveness of the evaluation on emergency plans corresponding to different emergencies.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster power supply recovery method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for recovering power supply of a power distribution network after a disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current state information of a power distribution network system; and acquiring an optimal control strategy of the power distribution network according to the current state information of the power distribution network system and the trained power supply model, wherein the trained power supply model is obtained by training the power supply model through a training sample and a training label. The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for recovering power supply of a power distribution network after a disaster, aiming at uncertainty in a micro-grid system, a power supply model is trained, so that the power supply model can fully learn a plurality of uncertain factors in the micro-grid during training, and the robustness of the method is improved; and by utilizing the trained power supply model, the power supply model does not need to be solved again in different scenes, so that the recovery capability of the power distribution network and the load power supply duration are improved.

title_en: Dynamic risk level assessment method for village scale typhoon and storm related secondary disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk level assessment method for a village scale typhoon and storm related secondary disaster, which comprises the following steps: and constructing a geographic information database of the area to be researched, and obtaining real-time disaster information of all types of buildings according to the real-time wind speed and inundation conditions in a certain time range in the future. Taking the number of disaster-stricken residential buildings, the number of people to be evacuated and the expected value of total economic loss at village level as the dividing index of risk level, when considering the flood secondary disasters and geological secondary disasters caused by typhoons and storm, respectively analyzing by utilizing residential building function evaluation frames which are not coupled and coupled with the geological disasters to obtain the numerical value of each dividing index and dividing the numerical value into corresponding levels. And (5) carrying out cyclic calculation along with updating of weather forecast information. The disaster situation deduction is carried out based on a physical mechanism, building function assessment is taken as a core, and uncertainty of weather forecast and building disaster bearing capacity is considered to carry out real-time dynamic risk level assessment on different kinds of secondary disasters.

title_en: Multi-disaster power distribution network recovery method and device considering source-load uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-disaster power distribution network recovery method and device considering source load uncertainty, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring meteorological data under the current disaster, determining the fault probability of each line through a preset line fault probability calculation formula based on the meteorological data, and determining a fault line; the method comprises the steps of identifying a power supply region to be restored from a target power distribution network according to a fault line, determining the predicted load demand of each load node in the power supply region to be restored according to a preset load uncertainty model, determining the rigid load demand and the flexible load demand of the power supply region to be restored based on the predicted load demand, generating various predicted disaster scenes corresponding to the power supply region to be restored according to meteorological data under current disasters, constructing an objective function and constraint conditions according to the network topology of the power supply region to be restored, and solving the objective function under each predicted disaster scene to obtain a power supply restoration scheme under each predicted disaster scene.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid toughness enhancement method for cooperative response of hydrogen storage system under heterogeneous uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid toughness enhancement method for cooperative response of a hydrogen storage system under heterogeneous uncertainty, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a mathematical model of a heterogeneous uncertainty set of power transmission line faults, energy output fluctuation and load change of the grid system under a typhoon scene, 2, incorporating a daily market of the power transmission line and a real-time unit combination and the mathematical model of the hydrogen storage system into the mathematical model of the heterogeneous uncertainty set in the step 1, constructing a two-stage robust optimization model, and 3, solving the two-stage robust optimization model obtained in the step 2 by combining a column and constraint generation iterative solution technology to obtain a grid toughness enhancement decision. Aiming at the problem that the existing power grid toughness enhancement strategy generally depends on only emergency means of single disaster prevention and reduction unit combination, and multi-level response is difficult to realize under extreme events, the method can flexibly coordinate resource allocation under typhoon disaster disturbance, and obviously enhance the toughness of a power system.

title_en: Mobile robot visual range coverage path planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for planning a coverage path of a visual range of a mobile robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, abstracting a visual range of a camera into a fan-shaped plane, and therefore geometrically filling a map by using the fan-shaped plane; s2, planning a path according to the coverage result of the visible range node in the map obtained in the S1: and converting the coverage result into a traveling salesman problem to solve, and planning the path according to the visiting sequence. The invention expands the coverage problem from point coverage to surface coverage, better meets the actual requirements of search and rescue tasks, can effectively shorten the path length and improve the search efficiency.

title_en: Helicopter deployment method for multiple types of areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a helicopter deployment method in a multi-type area, which comprises the following steps: the first step is as follows: the search area is regulated into a search graph with a regular shape; a second step; calculating the maximum hovering times of each fluctuation of a single helicopter; the third step: taking a single helicopter search range as a reference circle, filling a plurality of reference circle arrays into a search graph formed in the first step, and calculating the number of frames of the helicopter to be deployed and the number of waves of the helicopter to be launched for a single wave according to the array types of the plurality of reference circles; and fourthly, planning and generating a search path of the single-wave helicopter according to the number of the helicopters which need to be deployed in the single-wave mode. The invention aims to provide a deployment method for orderly and efficiently deploying a plurality of helicopters for search and rescue in a multi-type area.
